    'contact_number', 'permanent_address', 'birth_date', 'birthday_private',
    'sss_number', 'philhealth_number', 'pagibig_number', 'tin_number', 'other_ids',
    'medical_conditions', 'blood_type', 'emergency_contact_name', 'emergency_contact_phone',
    'is_office_staff', 'is_test_account',
])]
class EmployeeProfile extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<EmployeeProfileFactory> */
    use HasFactory;

    /**
     * Defaults the app reads right after create() (the DB default is not read back).
     *
     * @var array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected $attributes = [
        'employment_status' => 'probationary',
        'is_office_staff' => false,
        'is_test_account' => false,
        'office_id' => null,
        'birthday_private' => false,
    ];

    /**
     * A test account's email domain: reserved (RFC 2606), so nothing sent there is
     * ever delivered, and User::routeNotificationForMail() doesn't even try.
     */
    public const TEST_EMAIL_DOMAIN = 'test.invalid';

    /**
     * Fields shown in the audit log as "changed", never with their values.
     *
     * @var list<string>
     */
    public const SENSITIVE = ['birth_date', 'sss_number', 'philhealth_number', 'pagibig_number', 'tin_number', 'other_ids', 'medical_conditions'];

    /** Suggested names for other IDs (any name can be typed). */
    public const OTHER_ID_SUGGESTIONS = [
        'Security Guard License (LESP)', "Driver's License", 'Passport', 'UMID', 'PhilSys National ID',
        'PRC License', 'Postal ID', "Voter's ID", 'NBI Clearance', 'Police Clearance', 'Barangay Clearance',
    ];

    /** At most this many other IDs on one record. */
    public const MAX_OTHER_IDS = 10;

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'position' => Position::class,
            'hire_date' => 'date',
            'employment_status' => EmploymentStatus::class,
            // Encrypted at rest with APP_KEY: a leaked database dump doesn't leak government IDs.
            'sss_number' => 'encrypted',
            'philhealth_number' => 'encrypted',
            'pagibig_number' => 'encrypted',
            'tin_number' => 'encrypted',
            'other_ids' => 'encrypted:array',
            'medical_conditions' => 'encrypted',
            // Age is sensitive (RA 10173 sec. 3(l)): encrypted like the IDs.
            'birth_date' => 'encrypted',
            'birthday_private' => 'boolean',
            'pending_role' => Role::class,
            'pending_region' => Region::class,
            'is_office_staff' => 'boolean',
            'is_test_account' => 'boolean',
        ];
    }

    public function birthDate(): ?CarbonImmutable
    {
        return filled($this->birth_date) ? CarbonImmutable::parse($this->birth_date) : null;
    }

    /**
     * Their birthday in that year; Feb 29 falls on Feb 28 in a common year. Null without a date of birth.
     */
    public function birthdayIn(int $year): ?CarbonImmutable
    {
        $born = $this->birthDate();

        if ($born === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $day = $born->month === 2 && $born->day === 29 && ! checkdate(2, 29, $year) ? 28 : $born->day;

        return CarbonImmutable::create($year, $born->month, $day);
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function user(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
    }

    /**
     * Records this viewer may see: all, or for a regional account only those
     * deployed to a client in their region (none until a region is set).
     *
     * @param  Builder<EmployeeProfile>  $query
     */
    public function scopeVisibleTo(Builder $query, User $viewer): void
    {
        if (! $viewer->isRegionallyLimited()) {
            // Operation HQ (no view-office-staff) looks after guards, and heads the Satellite Operations.
            if (! $viewer->can(Ability::ViewOfficeStaff->value)) {
                $query->where(fn (Builder $who) => $who->where('is_office_staff', false)
                    ->when($viewer->hasRole(Role::OperationsHq), fn (Builder $who) => $who->orWhereHas('user.roles', fn (Builder $roles) => $roles->where('role', Role::SatelliteOperations->value))));
            }

            return;
        }

        $viewer->operations_region === null
            ? $query->whereRaw('1 = 0')
            : $query->whereHas('client', fn (Builder $client) => $client->where('region', $viewer->operations_region->value));
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<Shift, $this>
     */
    public function shift(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Shift::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<TrainingAttendee, $this>
     */
    public function trainingAttendances(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(TrainingAttendee::class);
    }

    /**
     * The client site they're deployed to; `detachment` holds its name.
     *
     * @return BelongsTo<Client, $this>
     */
    public function client(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Client::class);
    }

    /**
     * The OSSI office an office staffer works at: where their clock-in must be.
     *
     * @return BelongsTo<Office, $this>
     */
    public function office(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Office::class);
    }

    /**
     * Employees who appear on payroll: an account exists, they still work
     * here, and they aren't paid outside it (User::scopeOnPayroll's rule).
     *
     * @param  Builder<EmployeeProfile>  $query
     */
    public function scopeOnPayroll(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->whereNotNull('user_id')->paidHere();
    }

    /**
     * Still working here, with or without an account yet.
     *
     * @param  Builder<EmployeeProfile>  $query
     */
    public function scopeActive(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->whereIn('employment_status', EmploymentStatus::active());
    }

    /**
     * When probation ended, for someone still marked Probationary past it; null
     * otherwise. Labor Code Art. 296: allowed to keep working, they're regular by
     * law, so the Employees list and HR's dashboard flag it until HR decides.
     */
    public function probationOverdueSince(): ?CarbonImmutable
    {
        if ($this->employment_status !== EmploymentStatus::Probationary || $this->hire_date === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $endsOn = CarbonImmutable::parse($this->hire_date)->addMonthsNoOverflow((int) config('hr.probation.months'));

        return $endsOn->isBefore(CarbonImmutable::today()) ? $endsOn : null;
    }

    /**
     * Probationary, and past the probation months (ended before today).
     *
     * @param  Builder<EmployeeProfile>  $query
     */
    public function scopeProbationOverdue(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->where('employment_status', EmploymentStatus::Probationary)
            ->whereNotNull('hire_date')
            ->whereDate('hire_date', '<', CarbonImmutable::today()->subMonthsNoOverflow((int) config('hr.probation.months'))->toDateString());
    }

    /**
     * Still working here (with or without an account yet) and paid through
     * this payroll, so not, e.g., the President or Vice President: the records that need a daily rate.
     *
     * @param  Builder<EmployeeProfile>  $query
     */
    public function scopePaidHere(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->active()->where(fn (Builder $paid) => $paid->whereNull('user_id')
            ->orWhereDoesntHave('user.roles', fn (Builder $roles) => $roles->whereIn('role', array_map(fn (Role $role) => $role->value, Role::paidOutsidePayroll()))));
    }

    /**
     * Neither a personal rate nor a rate for their position in force today:
     * payroll pays them the schedule's company default until Accounting sets
     * one (Daily Rates). Mirrors EffectiveRatesQuery.
     *
     * @param  Builder<EmployeeProfile>  $query
     */
    public function scopeWithoutRate(Builder $query): void
    {
        $today = today()->toDateString();

        $query->whereDoesntHave('rates', fn (Builder $rates) => $rates->whereDate('effective_from', '<=', $today))
            ->where(fn (Builder $noPositionRate) => $noPositionRate
                ->whereNull('position')
                ->orWhereNotExists(fn (\Illuminate\Database\Query\Builder $rate) => $rate->selectRaw('1')
                    ->from('position_rates')
                    ->whereColumn('position_rates.position', 'employee_profiles.position')
                    ->whereDate('position_rates.effective_from', '<=', $today)));
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<EmployeeRate, $this>
     */
    public function rates(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(EmployeeRate::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<EmployeeRequirement, $this>
     */
    public function requirements(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(EmployeeRequirement::class);
    }

    public function isClaimed(): bool
    {
        return $this->user_id !== null;
    }

    /**
     * A test account's email: the employee number, capitals kept (the province code reads as
     * on the ID card, -RH too), at test.invalid: 260627PAM-0950@test.invalid. The account keeps
     * the same capitals; registering and signing in match the email in any case.
     */
    public static function testEmailFor(string $employeeNumber): string
    {
        return EmployeeNumber::normalize($employeeNumber).'@'.self::TEST_EMAIL_DOMAIN;
    }

    public static function isTestEmail(string $email): bool
    {
        return str_ends_with(strtolower($email), '@'.self::TEST_EMAIL_DOMAIN);
    }

    /**
     * Detachment and post describe where a GUARD is deployed. Office staff
     * (HR, Admin, Accounting…) have neither, so screens ask this instead of
     * showing two empty "—" fields.
     */
    public function hasDeployment(): bool
    {
        return ! $this->is_office_staff;
    }

    /**
     * "SM Megamall · Main Entrance" for a guard, "Office staff" for the office.
     */
    public function assignmentLabel(): string
    {
        if (! $this->hasDeployment()) {
            return 'Office staff';
        }

        return collect([$this->detachment, $this->post])->filter()->implode(' · ') ?: '—';
    }

    /**
     * The roster's Assignment column: where a guard is posted, what an office
     * employee does ("Accounting", "HR Staff"); "Office staff" if no position yet.
     */
    public function rosterAssignmentLabel(): string
    {
        if (! $this->hasDeployment()) {
            return $this->position?->label() ?? 'Office staff';
        }

        return $this->assignmentLabel();
    }

    /**
     * @return list<Requirement>
     */
    public function applicableRequirements(): array
    {
        return Requirement::for($this->is_office_staff);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Forms;

use App\Actions\People\ShiftForTimes;
use App\Enums\EmploymentStatus;
use App\Enums\Position;
use App\Enums\Region;
use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\Office;
use App\Models\Shift;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\EmployeeNumber;
use App\Support\GovernmentId;
use App\Support\PhilippineFormats;
use App\Support\Provinces;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection as EloquentCollection;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Livewire\Form;

/**
 * The HR employee record, used by both "Add employee" and "Edit". A Form
 * object keeps 20 fields and their rules out of the page component.
 */
class EmployeeProfileForm extends Form
{
    /** ABO and Rh: a list, so nobody types "o pos". */
    public const BLOOD_TYPES = ['A+', 'A-', 'B+', 'B-', 'AB+', 'AB-', 'O+', 'O-'];

    public ?int $profileId = null;

    /** The number as saved, so an untouched old-format number (EMP-1001) still passes. */
    public ?string $savedEmployeeNumber = null;

    /**
     * Where the number comes from: "generate" (a new record: from the hire date and
     * province of birth, EmployeeNumber::generate), "keep" (editing: it never changes
     * by itself, it's the ID card's identity) or "card" (the number on an OSSI ID
     * card already printed, typed by HR).
     */
    public string $numberSource = self::GENERATE;

    public const GENERATE = 'generate';

    public const KEEP = 'keep';

    public const CARD = 'card';

    /** Newly hired / Rehired: a generated number ends in -RH for a rehire. */
    public bool $rehired = false;

    /** Only typed in "card" mode; otherwise generated, or the saved one. */
    public string $employee_number = '';

    public string $name = '';

    public string $email = '';

    /** The client site (detachment). Its name is copied into `detachment`. */
    public string $client_id = '';

    /** Office staff: the OSSI office they work at (where their clock-in must be). */
    public string $office_id = '';

    /**
     * Region and province narrow the Detachment list (a Region value, a province name).
     * Not saved: the client carries its own region and province.
     */
    public string $region = '';

    public string $province = '';

    /**
     * A detachment typed before clients existed (no client_id). Kept as it is
     * until HR picks the client, so editing a phone number doesn't erase it.
     */
    public ?string $legacyDetachment = null;

    public string $post = '';

    public string $position = '';

    public string $hire_date = '';

    public string $employment_status = 'probationary';

    /** A shift's id, '' for the default shift, or self::CUSTOM_SHIFT to type the times. */
    public string $shift_id = '';

    public const CUSTOM_SHIFT = 'custom';

    /** Typed times when shift_id is "custom" (HH:MM, 24-hour). */
    public string $custom_start = '';

    public string $custom_end = '';

    public string $custom_grace = '10';

    public bool $is_office_staff = false;

    /**
     * A tester without a real email (chosen when adding only): the email is made from
     * the employee number (EmployeeProfile::testEmailFor) and confirmed on registering.
     */
    public bool $is_test_account = false;

    /**
     * Province of birth: gives the number's 3 letters (Provinces). Not a column:
     * the number holds it, and this follows its letters on edit.
     */
    public string $birth_province = '';

    public string $contact_number = '';

    public string $permanent_address = '';

    public string $birth_date = '';

    /** They objected to the birthday reminder: nobody is told. */
    public bool $birthday_private = false;

    public string $sss_number = '';

    public string $philhealth_number = '';

    public string $pagibig_number = '';

    public string $tin_number = '';

    /**
     * Other IDs, as rows of name and number (blank rows are dropped on save).
     *
     * @var list<array{label: string, number: string}>
     */
    public array $other_ids = [];

    public string $emergency_contact_name = '';

    public string $emergency_contact_phone = '';

    public string $blood_type = '';

    public string $medical_conditions = '';

    public function fillFrom(EmployeeProfile $profile): void
    {
        $this->profileId = $profile->id;
        $this->employee_number = $profile->employee_number;
        $this->savedEmployeeNumber = $profile->employee_number;
        $this->numberSource = self::KEEP;
        $this->rehired = EmployeeNumber::isRehire($profile->employee_number);
        $this->birth_province = (string) EmployeeNumber::provinceCode($profile->employee_number);
        $this->name = $profile->name;
        $this->email = $profile->email;
        $this->client_id = (string) $profile->client_id;
        $this->office_id = (string) $profile->office_id;
        $profile->loadMissing('client');
        $this->region = (string) $profile->client?->region->value;
        $this->province = (string) $profile->client?->province;
        $this->legacyDetachment = $profile->client_id === null && filled($profile->detachment) ? $profile->detachment : null;
        $this->post = (string) $profile->post;
        $this->position = (string) $profile->position?->value;
        $this->hire_date = (string) $profile->hire_date?->toDateString();
        $this->employment_status = $profile->employment_status->value;
        $this->useShiftTimes($profile->shift);
        $this->is_office_staff = $profile->is_office_staff;
        $this->is_test_account = $profile->is_test_account;
        $this->contact_number = (string) $profile->contact_number;
        $this->permanent_address = (string) $profile->permanent_address;
        $this->birth_date = (string) $profile->birthDate()?->toDateString();
        $this->birthday_private = $profile->birthday_private;
        $this->sss_number = (string) $profile->sss_number;
        $this->philhealth_number = (string) $profile->philhealth_number;
        $this->pagibig_number = (string) $profile->pagibig_number;
        $this->tin_number = (string) $profile->tin_number;
        $this->other_ids = $profile->other_ids ?? [];
        $this->emergency_contact_name = (string) $profile->emergency_contact_name;
        $this->emergency_contact_phone = (string) $profile->emergency_contact_phone;
        $this->blood_type = (string) $profile->blood_type;
        $this->medical_conditions = (string) $profile->medical_conditions;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            // Generated or kept: nothing typed to check. A card's number: the format, and that
            // it fits the hire date and province of birth on the record (both filled from it).
            'employee_number' => $this->numberSource !== self::CARD ? ['exclude'] : ['required', 'string', 'max:50',
                function (string $attribute, mixed $value, \Closure $fail) {
                    if ($value === $this->savedEmployeeNumber) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (! EmployeeNumber::isValid((string) $value)) {
                        $fail(EmployeeNumber::HELP);
                    } elseif ($this->hire_date !== '' && EmployeeNumber::hireDate((string) $value)?->toDateString() !== $this->hire_date) {
                        $fail('This card number is for a hire date of '.EmployeeNumber::hireDate((string) $value)?->format('M j, Y').', not the hire date below.');
                    } elseif ($this->birth_province !== '' && EmployeeNumber::provinceCode((string) $value) !== $this->birth_province) {
                        $fail('This card number is for '.Provinces::name((string) EmployeeNumber::provinceCode((string) $value)).', not the province of birth chosen.');
                    }
                },
                Rule::unique('employee_profiles', 'employee_number')->ignore($this->profileId)],
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255', 'regex:'.PhilippineFormats::NAME_PATTERN],
            // The email the employee must register with. A test account's is made from the number.
            'email' => $this->is_test_account ? ['exclude'] : ['required', 'email', 'max:255', Rule::unique('employee_profiles', 'email')->ignore($this->profileId)],
            // Chosen when adding; an existing record stays what it is.
            'is_test_account' => $this->profileId === null ? ['boolean'] : ['exclude'],
            'client_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'exists:clients,id'],
            'office_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'exists:offices,id'],
            'post' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            // Only positions that fit the staff type: no "Security Guard" in the office.
            'position' => ['nullable', Rule::in(array_map(fn (Position $position) => $position->value, Position::for($this->is_office_staff)))],
            // The number is made from these two.
            'hire_date' => $this->numberSource === self::GENERATE ? ['required', 'date'] : ['nullable', 'date'],
            'employment_status' => ['required', Rule::enum(EmploymentStatus::class)],
            // A listed shift, or "custom" with the times typed below.
            'shift_id' => ['nullable', function (string $attribute, mixed $value, \Closure $fail) {
                if ($value !== self::CUSTOM_SHIFT && ! Shift::query()->whereKey((int) $value)->exists()) {
                    $fail('Choose a shift from the list, or "Custom time".');
                }
            }],
            'custom_start' => ['exclude_unless:shift_id,'.self::CUSTOM_SHIFT, 'required', 'date_format:H:i'],
            'custom_end' => ['exclude_unless:shift_id,'.self::CUSTOM_SHIFT, 'required', 'date_format:H:i', 'different:custom_start'],
            'custom_grace' => ['exclude_unless:shift_id,'.self::CUSTOM_SHIFT, 'required', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:120'],
            'is_office_staff' => ['boolean'],
            'birth_province' => [$this->numberSource === self::GENERATE ? 'required' : 'nullable', Rule::in(Provinces::codes())],
            // Their own phone: a mobile (load requests use it). The emergency contact may be a landline.
            'contact_number' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:50', function (string $attribute, mixed $value, \Closure $fail) {
                if (PhilippineFormats::mobileNumber((string) $value) === null) {
                    $fail('Enter a Philippine mobile number, e.g. 0917 123 4567.');
                }
            }],
            'permanent_address' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            // At least 18 (no minors on staff); born 1940 or later, to catch a mistyped year.
            'birth_date' => ['nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d', 'after_or_equal:1940-01-01', 'before_or_equal:'.CarbonImmutable::today()->subYears(18)->toDateString()],
            'birthday_private' => ['boolean'],
            // Digits in the agency's pattern only (GovernmentId), or blank until known.
            ...array_map(fn () => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:50', function (string $attribute, mixed $value, \Closure $fail) {
                $problem = GovernmentId::problem(str_replace('form.', '', $attribute), (string) $value);
                if ($problem !== null) {
                    $fail($problem);
                }
            }], GovernmentId::FORMATS),
            // A name needs its number and a number its name (same row).
            'other_ids' => ['array', 'max:'.EmployeeProfile::MAX_OTHER_IDS],
            'other_ids.*.label' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:60', 'required_with:other_ids.*.number'],
            'other_ids.*.number' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100', 'required_with:other_ids.*.label'],
            'emergency_contact_name' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255', 'regex:'.PhilippineFormats::NAME_PATTERN],
            'emergency_contact_phone' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:50', function (string $attribute, mixed $value, \Closure $fail) {
                if (PhilippineFormats::phoneNumber((string) $value) === null) {
                    $fail('Enter a mobile (0917 123 4567) or a landline with its area code ((02) 8123 4567).');
                }
            }],
            'blood_type' => ['nullable', Rule::in(self::BLOOD_TYPES)],
            'medical_conditions' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:2000'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function messages(): array
    {
        return ['name.regex' => PhilippineFormats::NAME_MESSAGE, 'emergency_contact_name.regex' => PhilippineFormats::NAME_MESSAGE,
            'birth_date.before_or_equal' => 'They must be at least 18.', 'birth_date.after_or_equal' => 'Check the year.'];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function validationAttributes(): array
    {
        return ['custom_start' => 'start time', 'custom_end' => 'end time', 'custom_grace' => 'grace minutes', 'birth_province' => 'province of birth',
            'other_ids' => 'other IDs', 'other_ids.*.label' => 'ID name', 'other_ids.*.number' => 'ID number'];
    }

    /** The number so far, for the form: "260627PAM-····", or null until hire date and province are in. */
    public function numberPreview(): ?string
    {
        $date = rescue(fn () => $this->hire_date !== '' ? CarbonImmutable::parse($this->hire_date) : null, report: false);

        if ($date === null || ! Provinces::isCode($this->birth_province)) {
            return null;
        }

        return EmployeeNumber::prefix($date, $this->birth_province).'-····'.($this->rehired ? '-RH' : '');
    }

    /** Switch between a generated number and an ID card's (and back to the saved one when editing). */
    public function useNumberFrom(string $source): void
    {
        $this->numberSource = match (true) {
            $source === self::CARD => self::CARD,
            $this->profileId !== null => self::KEEP,
            default => self::GENERATE,
        };
        $this->employee_number = $this->numberSource === self::KEEP ? (string) $this->savedEmployeeNumber : '';
    }

    /**
     * A card's number typed (the page's updatedForm hook calls this): tidy it,
     * and fill the hire date and province of birth from it, so they agree.
     */
    public function numberChanged(string $field): void
    {
        if ($field !== 'employee_number' || $this->numberSource !== self::CARD) {
            return;
        }

        $this->employee_number = EmployeeNumber::normalize($this->employee_number);

        if (EmployeeNumber::isValid($this->employee_number)) {
            $this->hire_date = (string) EmployeeNumber::hireDate($this->employee_number)?->toDateString();
            $this->birth_province = (string) EmployeeNumber::provinceCode($this->employee_number);
            $this->rehired = EmployeeNumber::isRehire($this->employee_number);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Validated attributes for SaveEmployeeProfile, with "" turned into null.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toProfileAttributes(): array
    {
        // Ticking or unticking "Office staff" can leave a position of the other
        // kind selected; drop it instead of failing validation on a hidden choice.
        if (! in_array(Position::tryFrom($this->position), Position::for($this->is_office_staff), true)) {
            $this->position = '';
        }

        // Test account is chosen when adding: an existing record keeps what it was saved as,
        // whatever the browser sends (its email stays the one made from the number).
        if ($this->profileId !== null) {
            $this->is_test_account = (bool) EmployeeProfile::query()->whereKey($this->profileId)->value('is_test_account');
        }

        $this->employee_number = EmployeeNumber::normalize($this->employee_number);
        // "34 1234567 8" or "3412345678" is saved as 34-1234567-8.
        foreach (array_keys(GovernmentId::FORMATS) as $field) {
            $this->{$field} = GovernmentId::format($field, $this->{$field});
        }
        // "+63 917-123-4567" is saved as 0917 123 4567; names lose stray spaces.
        $this->contact_number = PhilippineFormats::readableMobile($this->contact_number) ?? trim($this->contact_number);
        $this->emergency_contact_phone = PhilippineFormats::phoneNumber($this->emergency_contact_phone) ?? trim($this->emergency_contact_phone);
        $this->name = PhilippineFormats::name($this->name);
        $this->emergency_contact_name = PhilippineFormats::name($this->emergency_contact_name);
        $validated = $this->validate();

        // Other IDs: trimmed, blank rows dropped, none at all saved as null.
        $otherIds = [];
        foreach ($validated['other_ids'] ?? [] as $row) {
            $label = trim((string) ($row['label'] ?? ''));
            $number = trim((string) ($row['number'] ?? ''));
            if ($label !== '' && $number !== '') {
                $otherIds[] = ['label' => $label, 'number' => $number];
            }
        }
        $validated['other_ids'] = $otherIds === [] ? null : $otherIds;

        // A new record's number is made here, from what was just validated.
        if ($this->numberSource === self::GENERATE) {
            $validated['employee_number'] = EmployeeNumber::generate(CarbonImmutable::parse($this->hire_date), $this->birth_province, $this->rehired);
        }
        // The shift is passed separately (chosenShift()), not as a profile column.
        unset($validated['shift_id'], $validated['custom_start'], $validated['custom_end'], $validated['custom_grace'], $validated['birth_province']);

        // A test account's email follows its number (a kept number keeps the saved email).
        if ($this->is_test_account) {
            if (isset($validated['employee_number'])) {
                $validated['email'] = EmployeeProfile::testEmailFor((string) $validated['employee_number']);
            }
        } else {
            $validated['email'] = strtolower(trim((string) $validated['email']));
        }

        // Office staff are not deployed anywhere: clear what a guard record may have left behind.
        // Guards work at a client, not an office.
        if ($validated['is_office_staff']) {
            $validated['client_id'] = null;
            $validated['post'] = null;
            $validated['office_id'] = filled($validated['office_id']) ? (int) $validated['office_id'] : null;
        } else {
            $validated['office_id'] = null;
        }

        // The detachment shown everywhere is the client's name.
        $validated['client_id'] = filled($validated['client_id']) ? (int) $validated['client_id'] : null;
        $validated['detachment'] = match (true) {
            $validated['client_id'] !== null => Client::query()->whereKey($validated['client_id'])->value('name'),
            (bool) $validated['is_office_staff'] => null,
            default => $this->legacyDetachment,
        };

        return array_map(fn (mixed $value) => $value === '' ? null : $value, $validated);
    }

    /**
     * Keeps region → province → detachment consistent as HR picks (the page's
     * updatedForm hook calls this): a new region clears the province, a narrower
     * area drops a detachment outside it, and choosing a detachment fills in its area.
     */
    public function areaChanged(string $field): void
    {
        if ($field === 'region') {
            $this->province = '';
        }

        if ($field === 'region' || $field === 'province') {
            if ($this->client_id !== '' && ! $this->clientsInArea()->contains('id', (int) $this->client_id)) {
                $this->client_id = '';
            }

            return;
        }

        if ($field === 'client_id' && $this->client_id !== '') {
            $client = Client::query()->find((int) $this->client_id);
            $this->region = (string) $client?->region->value;
            $this->province = (string) $client?->province;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Regions that have at least one client, in the enum's order (NCR, CAR, Region I…).
     *
     * @return list<Region>
     */
    public function regionsWithClients(): array
    {
        $used = Client::query()->distinct()->pluck('region')->map(fn (Region $region) => $region->value)->all();

        return array_values(array_filter(Region::cases(), fn (Region $region) => in_array($region->value, $used, true)));
    }

    /**
     * Provinces of the chosen region that have clients.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function provincesInRegion(): array
    {
        if ($this->region === '') {
            return [];
        }

        return array_values(Client::query()->where('region', $this->region)->orderBy('province')->get(['province'])
            ->map(fn (Client $client): string => $client->province)
            ->filter()->unique()->all());
    }

    /**
     * The OSSI offices an office staffer can work at.
     *
     * @return EloquentCollection<int, Office>
     */
    public function offices(): EloquentCollection
    {
        return Office::query()->orderBy('name')->get();
    }

    /**
     * The detachments to choose from: the chosen region and province, or all of them.
     *
     * @return EloquentCollection<int, Client>
     */
    public function clientsInArea(): EloquentCollection
    {
        return Client::query()
            ->when($this->region !== '', fn ($query) => $query->where('region', $this->region))
            ->when($this->province !== '', fn ($query) => $query->where('province', $this->province))
            ->orderBy('region')->orderBy('province')->orderBy('name')
            ->get();
    }

    /**
     * HR types the hours (no list to pick from): start from this shift's
     * times, or the company default's for a record without one.
     */
    public function useShiftTimes(?Shift $shift): void
    {
        $shift ??= Shift::fallback();

        $this->shift_id = self::CUSTOM_SHIFT;
        $this->custom_start = substr($shift->start_time, 0, 5);
        $this->custom_end = substr($shift->end_time, 0, 5);
        $this->custom_grace = (string) $shift->grace_minutes;
    }

    public function shiftId(): ?int
    {
        return $this->shift_id !== '' && $this->shift_id !== self::CUSTOM_SHIFT ? (int) $this->shift_id : null;
    }

    /**
     * The shift to save on the record, after toProfileAttributes() validated:
     * the one picked, the default (null), or the one with the typed times
     * (reused when it exists, created otherwise).
     */
    public function chosenShift(ShiftForTimes $shiftForTimes, User $actor): ?Shift
    {
        if ($this->shift_id === self::CUSTOM_SHIFT) {
            return $shiftForTimes->handle($this->custom_start, $this->custom_end, (int) $this->custom_grace, $actor);
        }

        return Shift::query()->find($this->shiftId());
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\People;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\PositionChange;
use App\Models\Shift;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\UpdateNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Creates or updates an HR employee record. Creating one is what allows that
 * person to register (see ClaimEmployeeAccount).
 */
final class SaveEmployeeProfile
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data  validated fillable attributes
     */
    public function handle(?EmployeeProfile $profile, array $data, ?Shift $shift, User $actor): EmployeeProfile
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($profile, $data, $shift, $actor) {
            $isNew = $profile === null;
            $profile ??= new EmployeeProfile;

            $before = $isNew ? [] : [...$profile->only(array_keys($data)), 'shift_id' => $profile->shift_id];
            $oldPosition = $profile->position;

            $profile->fill($data);
            $profile->shift()->associate($shift);
            $profile->save();

            // A position edited on the form goes in the history too (from today), so pay for
            // earlier cut-offs keeps the position they were paid at. Promotions use ChangePosition.
            if (! $isNew && $profile->position !== null && $profile->position !== $oldPosition) {
                $change = new PositionChange;
                $change->forceFill([
                    'employee_profile_id' => $profile->id,
                    'from_position' => $oldPosition,
                    'to_position' => $profile->position,
                    'kind' => PositionChange::EDIT,
                    'effective_on' => CarbonImmutable::today()->toDateString(),
                    'recorded_by' => $actor->id,
                    'applied_at' => CarbonImmutable::now(),
                ])->save();
            }

            $after = [...$profile->only(array_keys($data)), 'shift_id' => $profile->shift_id];
            $changes = AuditLogger::diff($before, $after, EmployeeProfile::SENSITIVE);

            if ($isNew || $changes['new'] !== []) {
                $this->audit->record(
                    AuditArea::People,
                    $isNew ? 'profile.created' : 'profile.updated',
                    ($isNew ? 'Added employee ' : 'Updated employee ').$profile->name,
                    $profile,
                    $changes,
                    causer: $actor,
                );
            }

            if (! $isNew) {
                $this->tellEmployee($profile, array_keys($changes['new']), $actor);
            }

            return $profile;
        });
    }

    /**
     * What the employee must know about an edit HR made: where they report, and their
     * employment status (e.g. now Regular). Contact details and the like aren't announced.
     *
     * @param  list<string>  $changed
     */
    private function tellEmployee(EmployeeProfile $profile, array $changed, User $actor): void
    {
        if (array_intersect($changed, ['client_id', 'post', 'shift_id']) !== [] && $profile->hasDeployment()) {
            $profile->loadMissing('shift');
            UpdateNotice::tellProfile($profile, $actor, 'Your deployment changed',
                $profile->assignmentLabel().($profile->shift !== null ? ' · '.$profile->shift->label() : '').'.', route('attendance'), 'map-pin', email: true);
        }

        if (in_array('employment_status', $changed, true) && $profile->employment_status->isActive()) {
            UpdateNotice::tellProfile($profile, $actor, "Your employment status: {$profile->employment_status->label()}",
                'HR updated your record. See it on My Profile.', route('profile'), 'user', email: true);
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Factories\ShiftFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

/**
 * @property int $id
 * @property string $name
 * @property string $start_time "HH:MM" or "HH:MM:SS"
 * @property string $end_time
 * @property int $grace_minutes
 * @property bool $is_default
 * @property CarbonImmutable $created_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable $updated_at
 */
#[Fillable(['name', 'start_time', 'end_time', 'grace_minutes', 'is_default'])]
class Shift extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<ShiftFactory> */
    use HasFactory;

    /**
     * @var array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected $attributes = [
        'grace_minutes' => 0,
        'is_default' => false,
    ];

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'grace_minutes' => 'integer',
            'is_default' => 'boolean',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<EmployeeProfile, $this>
     */
    public function employeeProfiles(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(EmployeeProfile::class);
    }

    /**
     * The shift marked default, or an unsaved one built from config so the
     * attendance rules always have a schedule (spec: 09:00–18:00, 10 min grace).
     */
    public static function fallback(): self
    {
        $default = static::query()->where('is_default', true)->first();

        if ($default !== null) {
            return $default;
        }

        /** @var array{name: string, start_time: string, end_time: string, grace_minutes: int} $config */
        $config = config('attendance.default_shift');

        return new self($config);
    }

    /**
     * True for shifts such as 22:00–06:00 that end the next day.
     */
    public function crossesMidnight(): bool
    {
        return $this->minutesOfDay($this->end_time) <= $this->minutesOfDay($this->start_time);
    }

    public function scheduledMinutes(): int
    {
        $minutes = $this->minutesOfDay($this->end_time) - $this->minutesOfDay($this->start_time);

        return $minutes <= 0 ? $minutes + 24 * 60 : $minutes;
    }

    public function label(): string
    {
        return sprintf('%s · %s – %s', $this->name, substr($this->start_time, 0, 5), substr($this->end_time, 0, 5));
    }

    /** "06:00–15:00", for tight spaces like a roster cell. */
    public function timeRange(): string
    {
        return substr($this->start_time, 0, 5).'–'.substr($this->end_time, 0, 5);
    }

    private function minutesOfDay(string $time): int
    {
        [$hours, $minutes] = array_map('intval', explode(':', $time));

        return $hours * 60 + $minutes;
    }
}
Question you'd askAnswer
Why is the shift on the profile and not on users?HR assigns a shift before the person has an account. A column on users would have nowhere to live yet.
What happens if APP_KEY changes?The encrypted columns can't be read. Back the key up, and use APP_PREVIOUS_KEYS if you ever rotate it.
Why the $attributes defaults on models?Laravel does not read the row back after create(), so a database default isn't on the PHP object. With strict mode on, reading it would throw.
How does an overnight shift work?An end time before the start time means it ends the next day. crossesMidnight() and scheduledMinutes() handle it.

The form: hire type and the client site

Under one Client site heading, Region narrows Province, which narrows Detachment, and nothing new is stored: the region and province are the client's. areaChanged() keeps the three consistent from each page's updatedForm hook (a new region clears the province; a narrower area drops a detachment outside it; picking a detachment fills in its area), so a hidden choice can never be saved.

The employee number is generated

The employee number is the OSSI ID card's control number, made by the same rule as the ID card app: the hire date as YYMMDD, the province of birth code (ISO 3166-2:PH, 82 provinces plus NCR for Metro Manila), a dash, 4 random digits, and -RH for a rehire, e.g. 260627PAM-0950. HR fills the hire date and province, and the form shows 260627PAM-····; EmployeeNumber::generate picks the digits on save, from the ones still free for that date and province, so it never repeats. A person who already has a printed card gets the card's number instead: "Enter the card's number" checks the format and fills the hire date and province from it, so the two can't disagree. Editing keeps the number, because it's the card's identity and what they registered with.

flowchart LR
  H[Hire date 2026-06-27] --> P[260627]
  B[Province of birth: Pampanga] --> C[PAM]
  P & C --> X[260627PAM]
  X --> R[- 4 free random digits] --> N[260627PAM-0950]
  N --> RH{Rehired?} -->|yes| N2[260627PAM-0950-RH]

Nothing extra is stored for the province: the number already holds it, read back with EmployeeNumber::provinceCode(). Older numbers stay valid until changed.

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * OSSI employee numbers, the same as the control number on the OSSI ID card
 * (OSSI_ID_GEN_R_SOFTWARE): YYMMDD of the hire date, the 3-letter code of the
 * province of birth (Provinces), a dash, 4 digits, and "-RH" for a rehire.
 * E.g. 260627PAM-0950, 260627PAM-0950-RH.
 *
 * The app generates it (generate()): the 4 digits are random, unique among
 * numbers with the same date and province, like the card app. HR can instead
 * enter the number of an ID card already printed; it must then fit the format.
 *
 * Numbers saved before this format (EMP-1001, 240601-SEC-1001) stay valid where
 * they are; the format applies when a number is created or changed.
 */
final class EmployeeNumber
{
    public const PATTERN = '/^(\d{6})([A-Z]{3})-(\d{4})(-RH)?$/';

    public const EXAMPLE = '260627PAM-0950';

    public const HELP = 'Use the number on the OSSI ID card, e.g. 260627PAM-0950: the hire date (YYMMDD), the province of birth code (PAM for Pampanga, NCR for Metro Manila), a dash, 4 digits, and -RH for a rehire.';

    /**
     * Uppercase, no spaces: "260627pam-0950 " → "260627PAM-0950". A dash left out of a
     * current-format number is put back ("260627PAM0950RH" → "260627PAM-0950-RH");
     * older numbers (EMP-1001) are only uppercased.
     */
    public static function normalize(string $number): string
    {
        $number = strtoupper((string) preg_replace('/\s+/', '', $number));

        return preg_match('/^(\d{6}[A-Z]{3})-?(\d{4})(?:-?(RH))?$/', $number, $match) === 1
            ? $match[1].'-'.$match[2].(($match[3] ?? '') !== '' ? '-RH' : '')
            : $number;
    }

    public static function isValid(string $number): bool
    {
        return self::hireDate($number) !== null && self::provinceCode($number) !== null;
    }

    public static function isRehire(string $number): bool
    {
        return str_ends_with($number, '-RH');
    }

    /** The province-of-birth code in the number ("PAM"), or null if it has none. */
    public static function provinceCode(string $number): ?string
    {
        // Also reads the earlier 260627-PAM-0950 shape, for records saved with it.
        $letters = preg_match('/^\d{6}-?([A-Z]{3})-\d{4}/', $number, $match) === 1 ? $match[1] : '';

        return Provinces::isCode($letters) ? $letters : null;
    }

    /** The hire date in the number (YYMMDD, 20YY), or null if it isn't a real date. */
    public static function hireDate(string $number): ?CarbonImmutable
    {
        if (preg_match(self::PATTERN, $number, $match) !== 1) {
            return null;
        }

        [$year, $month, $day] = [2000 + (int) substr($match[1], 0, 2), (int) substr($match[1], 2, 2), (int) substr($match[1], 4, 2)];

        return checkdate($month, $day, $year) ? CarbonImmutable::create($year, $month, $day) : null;
    }

    /** "260627PAM": what every number for this hire date and province starts with. */
    public static function prefix(CarbonInterface $hireDate, string $provinceCode): string
    {
        return $hireDate->format('ymd').$provinceCode;
    }

    /**
     * A new number: the prefix, then 4 random digits no one with the same prefix
     * has (rehire or not, as the card app counts them). Picked from the free ones,
     * so it finds one while any is left.
     */
    public static function generate(CarbonInterface $hireDate, string $provinceCode, bool $rehire): string
    {
        $prefix = self::prefix($hireDate, $provinceCode);
        $taken = EmployeeProfile::query()->where('employee_number', 'like', $prefix.'-%')->pluck('employee_number')
            ->map(fn (string $number) => (int) substr($number, strlen($prefix) + 1, 4))
            ->all();
        $free = array_values(array_diff(range(0, 9999), $taken));

        if ($free === []) {
            throw new RuntimeException("No free employee number left for {$prefix}.");
        }

        $sequence = str_pad((string) $free[random_int(0, count($free) - 1)], 4, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);

        return $prefix.'-'.$sequence.($rehire ? '-RH' : '');
    }
}

Government IDs take digits only, in the agency's pattern. SSS is 10 digits (00-0000000-0), the PhilHealth PIN 12 (00-000000000-0), the Pag-IBIG MID 12 (0000-0000-0000), and the TIN 9 (000-000-000), plus a 3- or 5-digit branch code if the card shows one. While HR types, formatGovernmentId drops anything that isn't a digit and adds the dashes. On save, GovernmentId::format() tidies spaces and dashes the same way, and a closure rule refuses letters or a wrong length with a plain message ("SSS No. has 10 digits (00-0000000-0); this one has 9."). A blank field is allowed, since a new hire may not have every number yet. One list, GovernmentId::FORMATS, drives the rules, the placeholders and the dash pattern, so they can't disagree.

<?php

namespace App\Support;

/**
 * The four government numbers on an employee record, as the agencies issue them:
 *   SSS         10 digits   00-0000000-0
 *   PhilHealth  12 digits   00-000000000-0  (the PIN on the PhilHealth ID / MDR)
 *   Pag-IBIG    12 digits   0000-0000-0000  (the MID number)
 *   TIN          9 digits   000-000-000, plus a branch code of 3 or 5 digits if
 *                           the card shows one (000-000-000-000 / -00000)
 * Digits only: spaces and dashes are tidied away and put back in the agency's pattern,
 * anything else is refused. resources/js/government-id.js formats the same way as it's typed.
 */
final class GovernmentId
{
    /** @var array<string, array{label: string, groups: list<int>, lengths: list<int>, example: string}> */
    public const FORMATS = [
        'sss_number' => ['label' => 'SSS No.', 'groups' => [2, 7, 1], 'lengths' => [10], 'example' => '00-0000000-0'],
        'philhealth_number' => ['label' => 'PhilHealth No.', 'groups' => [2, 9, 1], 'lengths' => [12], 'example' => '00-000000000-0'],
        'pagibig_number' => ['label' => 'Pag-IBIG No.', 'groups' => [4, 4, 4], 'lengths' => [12], 'example' => '0000-0000-0000'],
        'tin_number' => ['label' => 'TIN', 'groups' => [3, 3, 3, 5], 'lengths' => [9, 12, 14], 'example' => '000-000-000 or 000-000-000-000'],
    ];

    /** Why a typed number is refused, or null when it fits. Blank is allowed (not known yet). */
    public static function problem(string $field, string $value): ?string
    {
        $format = self::FORMATS[$field];
        $compact = preg_replace('/[\s-]+/', '', $value) ?? '';

        if ($compact === '') {
            return null;
        }

        if (preg_match('/^\d+$/', $compact) !== 1) {
            return "Numbers only, like {$format['example']}.";
        }

        if (! in_array(strlen($compact), $format['lengths'], true)) {
            $digits = implode(', ', array_slice($format['lengths'], 0, -1));
            $digits = $digits === '' ? (string) end($format['lengths']) : $digits.' or '.end($format['lengths']);

            return "{$format['label']} has {$digits} digits ({$format['example']}); this one has ".strlen($compact).'.';
        }

        return null;
    }

    /** The number in the agency's pattern ("3412345678" → "34-1234567-8"); unchanged if it isn't digits. */
    public static function format(string $field, string $value): string
    {
        $compact = preg_replace('/[\s-]+/', '', $value) ?? '';

        if (preg_match('/^\d+$/', $compact) !== 1) {
            return trim($value);
        }

        $parts = [];
        foreach (self::FORMATS[$field]['groups'] as $size) {
            if ($compact === '') {
                break;
            }
            $parts[] = substr($compact, 0, $size);
            $compact = substr($compact, $size);
        }

        return implode('-', $parts);
    }
}

The same idea for phones and names. Every field is cleaned twice. The browser drops characters that can never be right (letters in a phone, digits in a name), so a typo shows up at once. The server then checks and tidies the value, so nothing dirty is saved even if the browser check is bypassed. An employee's own number must be a mobile, because load requests send to it. It is saved as 0917 123 4567 whether typed as +63 917-123-4567 or 639171234567. An emergency contact or a client may also give a landline with its area code. A mobile with a digit missing still starts with 09, so it can't pass as a landline. Names allow letters, including ñ and accents, and . , ' -, which covers "Ma. Cristina Dela Cruz-Reyes Jr.".

<?php

namespace App\Support;

/**
 * Normalizers for what people type, so "+63 917 123 4567", "0917-123-4567"
 * and "639171234567" are all stored as 09171234567.
 */
final class PhilippineFormats
{
    public static function mobileNumber(string $input): ?string
    {
        $digits = (string) preg_replace('/\D+/', '', $input);

        if (strlen($digits) === 12 && str_starts_with($digits, '63')) {
            $digits = '0'.substr($digits, 2);
        } elseif (strlen($digits) === 10 && str_starts_with($digits, '9')) {
            $digits = '0'.$digits;
        }

        return preg_match('/^09\d{9}$/', $digits) === 1 ? $digits : null;
    }

    /** A mobile as people read it: "0917 123 4567"; null if it isn't a Philippine mobile. */
    public static function readableMobile(string $input): ?string
    {
        $mobile = self::mobileNumber($input);

        return $mobile === null ? null : substr($mobile, 0, 4).' '.substr($mobile, 4, 3).' '.substr($mobile, 7);
    }

    /**
     * A mobile (made readable) or a landline, kept as typed but tidied: "(02) 8123 4567",
     * "046 123 4567", "8123 4567". A landline is 0 + area code (2-8) + the number, 9-10 digits,
     * or the local number alone (7-8). Anything else, letters included, is null, and so is a
     * mobile with a digit missing (it starts with 09, so it can't pass for a landline).
     */
    public static function phoneNumber(string $input): ?string
    {
        $mobile = self::readableMobile($input);
        if ($mobile !== null) {
            return $mobile;
        }

        $tidy = trim((string) preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $input));
        $digits = (string) preg_replace('/\D+/', '', $tidy);
        if (str_starts_with($digits, '63')) {
            $digits = '0'.substr($digits, 2);
        }

        return preg_match('/^[\d\s()+\-]+$/', $tidy) === 1 && preg_match('/^(0[2-8]\d{7,8}|[2-8]\d{6,7})$/', $digits) === 1 ? $tidy : null;
    }

    /** A person's name: letters (ñ, é…), spaces, and . , ' - as in "Ma. Cristina Dela Cruz-Reyes Jr." */
    public const NAME_PATTERN = "/^[\pL\pM][\pL\pM .,'\-]*$/u";

    public const NAME_MESSAGE = 'Letters only; spaces, periods, commas, hyphens and apostrophes are fine.';

    /** A name with its spaces tidied: "  juan   dela cruz " → "juan dela cruz". */
    public static function name(string $input): string
    {
        return trim((string) preg_replace('/\s+/u', ' ', $input));
    }
}

83 provinces is too many to scroll, so the list is searchable: <x-ui.select searchable> adds a search box at the top of the styled list. It matches anywhere in the name ("del n" finds every "del Norte"), and an exact code ranks first ("pam" → Pampanga). Letters typed on the closed list start the search, even typed fast before the box has focus. The hidden real <select> is still the source of truth, so wire:model is untouched, and lists without searchable behave as before.

Copied from the repository as it is today
/**
 * A styled replacement for the native <select> list (the OS draws <option>,
 * so Tailwind can't). The real <select> stays in the DOM, hidden, as the
 * single source of truth: wire:model keeps working, and we write back to it
 * with a real "change" event.
 *
 * searchable: a filter box at the top of the list (long lists, like the 83
 * provinces). It matches anywhere in the label, so "pam" and "PAM" both find
 * "Pampanga · PAM". Typing on the closed button opens it with that letter.
 */
export default function customSelect(searchable = false) {
    return {
        open: false,
        dropUp: false,
        options: [],
        selectedValue: '',
        highlightedIndex: -1,
        searchable,
        query: '',

        /** The options the list draws: all of them, or those matching the search. */
        get shown() {
            const query = this.query.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (query === '') return this.options;

            // The empty "Select…" choice isn't a match for anything typed. Best first: the
            // value itself ("pam" → PAM), then labels starting with it, then the rest.
            const rank = (option) => (option.value.toLowerCase() === query ? 0 : option.label.toLowerCase().startsWith(query) ? 1 : 2);

            return this.options
                .filter((option) => option.value !== '' && (option.label.toLowerCase().includes(query) || option.value.toLowerCase() === query))
                .map((option, index) => ({ option, index }))
                .sort((a, b) => rank(a.option) - rank(b.option) || a.index - b.index)
                .map(({ option }) => option);
        },

        init() {
            this.sync();
            // wire:model sets the <select>'s value while Alpine initializes its
            // children, which is after this init(); a value set that way fires
            // no event, so read it again once they're done.
            this.$nextTick(() => this.sync());
            this.observer = new MutationObserver(() => this.sync());
            this.observer.observe(this.$refs.select, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true });
            this.$refs.select.addEventListener('change', () => this.sync());

            // The server changing the value (e.g. a card number filling in the province)
            // sets the <select>'s value with no event and no mutation: watch the property.
            const model = Array.from(this.$refs.select.attributes).find((attribute) => attribute.name.startsWith('wire:model'));
            if (model && this.$wire && /^[\w.]+$/.test(model.value)) {
                this.$watch('$wire.' + model.value, () => setTimeout(() => this.sync()));
            }
        },

        destroy() {
            this.observer?.disconnect();
        },

        sync() {
            // A closing modal can fire a last mutation after its <select> is already gone.
            if (!this.$refs.select) {
                return;
            }

            this.options = Array.from(this.$refs.select.options).map((option) => ({
                value: option.value,
                label: option.textContent.trim(),
                disabled: option.disabled,
            }));
            this.selectedValue = this.$refs.select.value;
        },

        get selectedLabel() {
            return this.options.find((option) => option.value === this.selectedValue)?.label ?? '';
        },

        toggle() {
            this.open ? this.close() : this.openList();
        },

        openList(query = '') {
            this.dropUp = this.shouldDropUp();
            this.query = query;
            this.open = true;
            this.highlightedIndex = query === '' ? Math.max(0, this.options.findIndex((option) => option.value === this.selectedValue)) : 0;

            if (this.searchable) {
                this.$nextTick(() => this.$refs.search?.focus());
            }
        },

        /** Typing in the search box: highlight the first match. */
        onSearch() {
            this.highlightedIndex = this.shown.length > 0 ? 0 : -1;
        },

        /**
         * Open upward when the list (max-h-60, 240px) doesn't fit below the
         * button but fits better above, inside whatever clips it: a modal's
         * scrolling body or the window.
         */
        shouldDropUp() {
            const button = this.$refs.button.getBoundingClientRect();
            let clip = { top: 0, bottom: window.innerHeight };

            for (let node = this.$el.parentElement; node; node = node.parentElement) {
                if (/(auto|scroll|hidden)/.test(getComputedStyle(node).overflowY)) {
                    const box = node.getBoundingClientRect();
                    clip = { top: Math.max(0, box.top), bottom: Math.min(window.innerHeight, box.bottom) };
                    break;
                }
            }

            const below = clip.bottom - button.bottom;
            const above = button.top - clip.top;

            return below < 248 && above > below;
        },

        close() {
            this.open = false;
            this.highlightedIndex = -1;
            this.query = '';
        },

        choose(option) {
            if (option.disabled) return;

            if (this.$refs.select.value !== option.value) {
                this.$refs.select.value = option.value;
                this.$refs.select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
            }

            this.close();
            this.$refs.button.focus();
        },

        onKeydown(event) {
            if (!this.open && ['ArrowDown', 'ArrowUp', 'Enter', ' '].includes(event.key)) {
                event.preventDefault();
                this.openList();
                return;
            }

            // A letter on the closed button of a searchable list starts the search with it.
            if (!this.open && this.searchable && event.key.length === 1 && !event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey && !event.altKey) {
                event.preventDefault();
                this.openList(event.key);
                return;
            }

            if (!this.open) return;

            // In the search box a space is part of the search ("del norte"), not a choice.
            const inSearch = event.target === this.$refs.search;

            // Letters typed fast, before the search box has focus, still go into the search.
            if (this.searchable && !inSearch && event.key.length === 1 && !event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey && !event.altKey) {
                event.preventDefault();
                this.query += event.key;
                this.onSearch();
                this.$refs.search?.focus();
                return;
            }

            if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
                event.preventDefault();
                this.highlightedIndex = Math.min(this.highlightedIndex + 1, this.shown.length - 1);
            } else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
                event.preventDefault();
                this.highlightedIndex = Math.max(this.highlightedIndex - 1, 0);
            } else if (event.key === 'Enter' || (event.key === ' ' && !inSearch)) {
                event.preventDefault();
                const option = this.shown[this.highlightedIndex];
                if (option) this.choose(option);
            } else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
                event.preventDefault();
                this.close();
                this.$refs.button.focus();
            } else if (event.key === 'Tab') {
                this.close();
            }
        },
    };
}

namespace App\Support;

/**
 * Province of birth → the 3-letter code in an employee number (260627PAM-0950).

    public static function isCode(string $code): bool
    {

The roster: one search, tabs by kind

Employees keeps one search box for everyone (name, email or employee number), because people search by name without knowing which side someone works on. Tabs under the header, All · Guards · Office staff, narrow it, each with a count that follows the search and the other filters, and the tab is kept in the URL (?kind=office). The list and the counts share one private query, filtered(), so they can't disagree. Only viewers with view-office-staff get the tabs. Operations sees guards only, as on the dashboard, and ?kind=office changes nothing for them. The Assignment column shows a guard's detachment · post and an office employee's position (rosterAssignmentLabel()).

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Admin;

use App\Actions\People\AddEmployee;
use App\Actions\People\ShiftForTimes;
use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\EmploymentStatus;
use App\Enums\RequirementStatus;
use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Livewire\Concerns\FiltersByArea;
use App\Livewire\Concerns\InteractsWithUser;
use App\Livewire\Forms\EmployeeProfileForm;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\Shift;
use App\Queries\People\MeritTotalsQuery;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\WithPagination;

/**
 * HR's roster. Adding an employee here is what allows them to register:
 * share the employee number, and they sign up with the email entered here.
 *
 * @property-read LengthAwarePaginator<int, EmployeeProfile> $employees
 */
#[Title('Employees')]
class Employees extends Component
{
    use FiltersByArea, InteractsWithUser, WithPagination;

    #[Url(as: 'q', except: '')]
    public string $search = '';

    #[Url(as: 'status', except: 'all')]
    public string $statusFilter = 'all';

    #[Url(as: 'account', except: 'all')]
    public string $accountFilter = 'all';

    /** all | field | office: one search box for everyone, narrowed by kind. */
    #[Url(as: 'kind', except: 'all')]
    public string $kind = 'all';

    /**
     * Sees office staff too (view-office-staff: HR, the President or Vice President, Admin, Accounting):
     * gets the All · Guards · Office staff tabs. Operations sees guards only, no tabs.
     */
    public function seesBothKinds(): bool
    {
        return $this->currentUser()->can(Ability::ViewOfficeStaff->value);
    }

    public function showKind(string $kind): void
    {
        $this->kind = in_array($kind, ['field', 'office'], true) ? $kind : 'all';
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    /**
     * How many of each kind this viewer sees (for the tabs), with the search and filters applied.
     *
     * @return array{all: int, field: int, office: int}
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function kindCounts(): array
    {
        $count = fn (?bool $office) => $this->filtered()->when($office !== null, fn ($query) => $query->where('is_office_staff', $office))->count();

        return ['all' => $count(null), 'field' => $count(false), 'office' => $count(true)];
    }

    public bool $showForm = false;

    public EmployeeProfileForm $form;

    public function updatedSearch(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function updatedStatusFilter(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function updatedAccountFilter(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    /** Region → province → detachment stay consistent as HR picks. */
    public function updatedForm(mixed $value, string $key): void
    {
        $this->form->areaChanged($key);
        $this->form->numberChanged($key);
    }

    /** Generated number, or the one on an ID card already printed. */
    public function useNumberFrom(string $source): void
    {
        $this->form->useNumberFrom($source);
        $this->resetErrorBag('form.employee_number');
    }

    public function create(): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::ManagePeople->value);

        $this->form->reset();
        // The company's default hours, for HR to change.
        $this->form->useShiftTimes(Shift::query()->where('is_default', true)->first());
        $this->resetErrorBag();
        $this->showForm = true;
    }

    public function save(AddEmployee $addEmployee, ShiftForTimes $shiftForTimes): void
    {
        // Re-checked on every write, not just on page load (spec).
        $this->authorize(Ability::ManagePeople->value);

        $attributes = $this->form->toProfileAttributes();
        $profile = $addEmployee->handle($attributes, $this->form->chosenShift($shiftForTimes, $this->currentUser()), $this->currentUser());

        $this->showForm = false;
        $this->dispatch('notify', message: "Added {$profile->name}. Give them employee number {$profile->employee_number} so they can register.");
    }

    /**
     * @return LengthAwarePaginator<int, EmployeeProfile>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function employees(): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        return $this->filtered()
            ->with(['user', 'shift'])
            // 201 completion in the same query: on file and not expired.
            ->withCount(['requirements as requirements_on_file_count' => fn ($query) => $query
                ->where('status', RequirementStatus::OnFile)
                ->where(fn ($valid) => $valid->whereNull('expires_on')->orWhereDate('expires_on', '>=', today()->toDateString()))])
            ->when($this->seesBothKinds() && $this->kind === 'field', fn ($query) => $query->where('is_office_staff', false))
            ->when($this->seesBothKinds() && $this->kind === 'office', fn ($query) => $query->where('is_office_staff', true))
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->paginate(20);
    }

    /**
     * Who this viewer sees, with the search and filters (not the kind tab):
     * shared by the list and the tab counts.
     *
     * @return Builder<EmployeeProfile>
     */
    private function filtered(): Builder
    {
        return $this->filterProfilesByArea(EmployeeProfile::query())
            ->visibleTo($this->currentUser())
            // Operations doesn't see office staff (view-office-staff), here as on the dashboard.
            ->when(! $this->seesBothKinds(), fn ($query) => $query->where('is_office_staff', false))
            ->when($this->search !== '', fn ($query) => $query->where(fn ($inner) => $inner
                ->where('name', 'like', "%{$this->search}%")
                ->orWhere('email', 'like', "%{$this->search}%")
                ->orWhere('employee_number', 'like', "%{$this->search}%")))
            ->when(EmploymentStatus::tryFrom($this->statusFilter), fn ($query, EmploymentStatus $status) => $query->where('employment_status', $status))
            ->when($this->accountFilter === 'registered', fn ($query) => $query->whereNotNull('user_id'))
            ->when($this->accountFilter === 'unregistered', fn ($query) => $query->whereNull('user_id'));
    }

    /**
     * 12-month merit and demerit points for the people on this page, one query,
     * for those who may see merits (give them, or HR / the President or Vice President).
     *
     * @return array<int, array{merits: int, demerits: int, net: int}>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function meritTotals(): array
    {
        $viewer = $this->currentUser();

        if (! $viewer->can(Ability::GiveMerits->value)) {
            return [];
        }

        // HR, the President or Vice President and Super Admin see everyone's; Operations, guards' only.
        $everyone = $viewer->hasAnyRole(Role::Hr, Role::SuperAdmin, ...Role::leadership());
        $ids = [];
        foreach ($this->employees->items() as $profile) {
            if ($profile->user_id !== null && ($everyone || ! $profile->is_office_staff)) {
                $ids[] = $profile->user_id;
            }
        }

        return app(MeritTotalsQuery::class)->handle($ids);
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        return view('livewire.admin.employees');
    }
}

Attendance: selfie + GPS punches

Alpine owns the camera, GPS and canvas; Livewire receives the finished punch; RecordPunch enforces the rules. The day's row is locked with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, and for a clock-in, where there is no row to lock yet, the unique (user_id, log_date) index stops the double tap.

flowchart TD
  A[Open modal] --> B[Front camera, or Back camera via the switch + GPS watch]
  B --> C[Capture: downscale to 960px, burn in time + address]
  C --> D["$wire.submitPunch(type, photo, lat, lon)"]
  D --> E[PunchPhotoStore: real JPEG/PNG bytes, private disk]
  E --> F{Transaction + row lock}
  F -->|clock in| G[late minutes, status]
  F -->|clock out| H[undertime, overtime, final status]
  F -->|rule broken| X[delete photo, return message]
