<?php

namespace App\Actions\Attendance;

use App\Actions\Patrols\CloseForgottenAways;
use App\Actions\Relievers\RecordNoShowArrival;
use App\Data\DutyForPunch;
use App\Enums\PunchType;
use App\Enums\TimeLogStatus;
use App\Models\AwayLog;
use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\Office;
use App\Models\Shift;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Queries\Attendance\CurrentDutyQuery;
use App\Services\Attendance\AttendanceCalculator;
use App\Services\Attendance\Geofence;
use App\Services\Attendance\PunchPhotoStore;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\UniqueConstraintViolationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Records one clock-in or clock-out with its selfie and GPS position.
 *
 * Which schedule it counts against: the guard's rostered duty for now
 * (CurrentDutyQuery), or their usual shift when they aren't on the roster.
 * Off duty, too early or after the duty ended, the clock-in is refused.
 *
 * Anti-cheating, checked BEFORE anything is saved:
 *  - a GPS fix rougher than attendance.max_gps_accuracy_meters is refused;
 *  - the punch must be inside the post's geofence (client coordinates + radius),
 *    for clock-out too, so nobody clocks out from home; office staff inside their
 *    OSSI office's (an office staffer with no office set has no geofence);
 *  - the server's clock, never the phone's; the selfie is burned with the time.
 * Clocking in early is allowed but earns nothing: late, night differential
 * and overtime all count from the scheduled start.
 *
 * Concurrency (spec: "two rapid taps produce one punch"):
 *  - the day's time log row is locked with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, so a second
 *    request waits, then sees the first punch and is rejected;
 *  - for a clock-in there is no row to lock yet, so two racing inserts are
 *    stopped by the unique (user_id, log_date) index instead.
 *
 * The caller says WHICH punch it means. If the server guessed, a double-tapped
 * clock-in would silently become a clock-out.
 *
 * The phone (a cookie code, CheckPunchDevice): a guard's first clock-in registers
 * their phone; a punch from another one still counts, and is flagged to Operations
 * and HR (ReportOtherPhone).
 */
final class RecordPunch
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PunchPhotoStore $photos,
        private readonly AttendanceCalculator $calculator,
        private readonly CurrentDutyQuery $currentDuty,
        private readonly Geofence $geofence,
        private readonly RecordNoShowArrival $noShowArrival,
        private readonly CheckPunchDevice $checkDevice,
        private readonly ReportOtherPhone $reportOtherPhone,
    ) {}

    public function handle(
        User $user,
        PunchType $type,
        string $photoDataUrl,
        float $latitude,
        float $longitude,
        ?int $accuracyMeters = null,
        ?string $address = null,
        ?string $deviceToken = null,
        ?string $deviceLabel = null,
    ): TimeLog {
        $this->ensureValidCoordinates($latitude, $longitude);
        $this->ensureAccurateEnough($accuracyMeters);

        $now = CarbonImmutable::now();
        $duty = null;

        if ($type === PunchType::ClockIn) {
            $duty = $this->currentDuty->handle($user, $now);

            if ($duty->refusal !== null) {
                throw $this->reject($duty->refusal.$this->nextDutyHint($duty));
            }

            $this->ensureAtPost($duty->site ?? $this->officeOf($user), $latitude, $longitude, $accuracyMeters, $type);
        } else {
            $this->ensureAtPost($this->clockOutSite($user, $now) ?? $this->officeOf($user), $latitude, $longitude, $accuracyMeters, $type);
        }

        // Stored first, outside the transaction: file writes can't be rolled back, so we delete it on failure instead.
        $photoPath = $this->photos->store($photoDataUrl, $user, $type, $now);

        try {
            [$timeLog, $punch] = DB::transaction(function () use ($user, $type, $now, $duty, $photoPath, $latitude, $longitude, $accuracyMeters, $address, $deviceToken, $deviceLabel) {
                $timeLog = $duty !== null
                    ? $this->clockIn($user, $now, $duty)
                    : $this->clockOut($user, $now);

                $punch = $timeLog->punches()->create([
                    'type' => $type,
                    'punched_at' => $now,
                    'photo_path' => $photoPath,
                    'latitude' => $latitude,
                    'longitude' => $longitude,
                    'accuracy_meters' => $accuracyMeters,
                    // A failed address lookup never blocks the punch (spec rule 6).
                    'address' => $address !== null && trim($address) !== '' ? mb_substr(trim($address), 0, 500) : null,
                    ...$this->checkDevice->handle($user, $deviceToken, $deviceLabel !== null ? mb_substr($deviceLabel, 0, 100) : null, $now),
                ]);

                return [$timeLog, $punch];
            });
        } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException) {
            $this->photos->delete($photoPath);

            throw $this->reject('You have already clocked in for this duty.');
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->photos->delete($photoPath);

            throw $e;
        }

        // After the commit: the punch is saved whatever happens to the alert.
        if ($punch->other_device) {
            $this->reportOtherPhone->handle($punch);
        }

        return $timeLog;
    }

    private function clockIn(User $user, CarbonImmutable $now, DutyForPunch $duty): TimeLog
    {
        $existing = TimeLog::query()
            ->where('user_id', $user->id)
            ->whereDate('log_date', $duty->dutyDate->toDateString())
            ->lockForUpdate()
            ->first();

        if ($existing !== null) {
            throw $this->reject($duty->dutyDate->isToday() ? 'You have already clocked in today.' : 'You have already clocked in for this duty.');
        }

        $shift = $duty->shift;
        $late = $this->calculator->lateMinutes($now, $shift, $duty->dutyDate);

        $timeLog = new TimeLog;
        $timeLog->user()->associate($user);
        $timeLog->shift_id = $shift->exists ? $shift->id : null;
        $timeLog->duty_assignment_id = $duty->duty?->id;
        $timeLog->log_date = $duty->dutyDate;
        $timeLog->clock_in_at = $now;
        $timeLog->late_minutes = $late;
        $timeLog->status = TimeLogStatus::fromMinutes($late, 0, hasClockedOut: false);
        $timeLog->save();

        // Still "away" from an earlier duty (never tapped Back, never clocked out, and the
        // scheduler hasn't closed it yet)? It ended with that duty: close it, flagged, so it
        // doesn't carry into this one and hide the patrol scanner.
        AwayLog::query()->where('user_id', $user->id)->where('time_log_id', '!=', $timeLog->id)->open()->with('timeLog.shift')->get()
            ->each(function (AwayLog $away) use ($now) {
                $dutyEnd = CloseForgottenAways::dutyEnd($away)->min($now);
                $away->forceFill(['returned_at' => $dutyEnd->greaterThan($away->left_at) ? $dutyEnd : $away->left_at, 'auto_closed_at' => $now])->save();
            });

        // Flagged as a no-show, then turned up: Operations stops looking for a reliever.
        $this->noShowArrival->handle($timeLog);

        return $timeLog;
    }

    private function clockOut(User $user, CarbonImmutable $now): TimeLog
    {
        $timeLog = $this->openLog($user, $now, lock: true);

        if ($timeLog === null) {
            $closedToday = TimeLog::query()
                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
                ->whereDate('log_date', $now->toDateString())
                ->whereNotNull('clock_out_at')
                ->exists();

            throw $this->reject($closedToday ? 'You have already clocked out today.' : 'You must clock in before you can clock out.');
        }

        $shift = $timeLog->shift ?? $this->usualShift($user);
        $clockIn = $timeLog->clock_in_at ?? $now;

        $timeLog->clock_out_at = $now;
        $timeLog->undertime_minutes = $this->calculator->undertimeMinutes($now, $shift, $timeLog->log_date);
        $timeLog->overtime_minutes = $this->calculator->overtimeMinutes($clockIn, $now, $shift);
        $timeLog->status = TimeLogStatus::fromMinutes($timeLog->late_minutes, $timeLog->undertime_minutes, hasClockedOut: true);
        $timeLog->save();

        // Still marked away? The clock-out passed the geofence, so they're back at the post.
        AwayLog::query()->where('time_log_id', $timeLog->id)->open()->update(['returned_at' => $now]);

        return $timeLog;
    }

    /**
     * Today's open log, or yesterday's if that shift crosses midnight (a
     * 22:00–07:00 guard clocks out the next morning). A day-shift log left
     * open yesterday is NOT closed today; it stays incomplete.
     */
    private function openLog(User $user, CarbonImmutable $now, bool $lock): ?TimeLog
    {
        $candidates = TimeLog::query()
            ->with(['shift', 'dutyAssignment.client'])
            ->where('user_id', $user->id)
            ->whereNotNull('clock_in_at')
            ->whereNull('clock_out_at')
            ->whereDate('log_date', '>=', $now->subDay()->toDateString())
            ->whereDate('log_date', '<=', $now->toDateString())
            ->orderByDesc('log_date')
            ->when($lock, fn ($query) => $query->lockForUpdate())
            ->get();

        return $candidates->first(function (TimeLog $log) use ($now): bool {
            if ($log->log_date->isSameDay($now)) {
                return true;
            }

            return ($log->shift ?? Shift::fallback())->crossesMidnight();
        });
    }

    /**
     * Where a clock-out must happen: the post of the duty being closed, else
     * the guard's usual client.
     */
    private function clockOutSite(User $user, CarbonImmutable $now): ?Client
    {
        $open = $this->openLog($user, $now, lock: false);
        $user->loadMissing('employeeProfile.client');

        return $open->dutyAssignment->client ?? $user->employeeProfile?->client;
    }

    private function usualShift(User $user): Shift
    {
        $user->loadMissing('employeeProfile.shift');

        return $user->employeeProfile->shift ?? Shift::fallback();
    }

    /** An office staffer's OSSI office (their clock-in place); null for guards or when none is set. */
    private function officeOf(User $user): ?Office
    {
        $user->loadMissing('employeeProfile.office');

        return $user->employeeProfile?->is_office_staff ? $user->employeeProfile->office : null;
    }

    private function ensureAtPost(Client|Office|null $site, float $latitude, float $longitude, ?int $accuracyMeters, PunchType $type): void
    {
        if ($site === null || ! $site->hasGeofence()) {
            return;
        }

        $distance = $this->geofence->distanceMeters($latitude, $longitude, (float) $site->latitude, (float) $site->longitude);

        if (! $this->geofence->isInside($distance, $site->geofence_meters, $accuracyMeters)) {
            $verb = $type === PunchType::ClockIn ? 'Clock in' : 'Clock out';
            $where = $site instanceof Office ? 'at the office' : 'at your post';

            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['location' => "You're {$this->geofence->describe($distance)} from {$site->name}. {$verb} {$where}."]);
        }
    }

    private function ensureAccurateEnough(?int $accuracyMeters): void
    {
        $limit = (int) config('attendance.max_gps_accuracy_meters');

        if ($accuracyMeters !== null && $accuracyMeters > $limit) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['location' => "Your GPS fix is too rough (±{$accuracyMeters} m). Step into an open spot or wait a few seconds, then try again."]);
        }
    }

    private function nextDutyHint(DutyForPunch $duty): string
    {
        if ($duty->next === null) {
            return '';
        }

        [$start] = $this->calculator->shiftWindow($duty->next->shift, $duty->next->duty_date);

        return " Your next duty: {$start->format('D, M j \a\t g:i A')}, {$duty->next->placeLabel()}.";
    }

    private function ensureValidCoordinates(float $latitude, float $longitude): void
    {
        if ($latitude < -90 || $latitude > 90 || $longitude < -180 || $longitude > 180) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['location' => 'Your GPS location is missing or invalid. Allow location access and try again.']);
        }
    }

    private function reject(string $message): ValidationException
    {
        return ValidationException::withMessages(['punch' => $message]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services\Attendance;

use App\Models\Shift;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;

/**
 * Pure attendance math: no queries, no clock reads. Every input is passed in,
 * so a test can say "a clock-in at 09:15 on a 09:00 + 10 min shift" directly.
 */
final class AttendanceCalculator
{
    /**
     * When the shift that started on $logDate begins and ends. A shift such as
     * 22:00–06:00 ends on the following day.
     *
     * @return array{0: CarbonImmutable, 1: CarbonImmutable}
     */
    public function shiftWindow(Shift $shift, CarbonImmutable $logDate): array
    {
        $start = $this->onDate($logDate, $shift->start_time);
        $end = $this->onDate($logDate, $shift->end_time);

        if ($shift->crossesMidnight()) {
            $end = $end->addDay();
        }

        return [$start, $end];
    }

    /**
     * Minutes after shift start + grace. Never negative (spec rule 4).
     */
    public function lateMinutes(CarbonImmutable $clockIn, Shift $shift, CarbonImmutable $logDate): int
    {
        [$start] = $this->shiftWindow($shift, $logDate);
        $deadline = $start->addMinutes($shift->grace_minutes);

        return $this->wholeMinutesBetween($deadline, $clockIn);
    }

    /**
     * Minutes before scheduled shift end. Never negative.
     */
    public function undertimeMinutes(CarbonImmutable $clockOut, Shift $shift, CarbonImmutable $logDate): int
    {
        [, $end] = $this->shiftWindow($shift, $logDate);

        return $this->wholeMinutesBetween($clockOut, $end);
    }

    /**
     * Worked minutes beyond the scheduled length. Payroll later caps this at
     * the approved overtime request for the day.
     */
    public function overtimeMinutes(CarbonImmutable $clockIn, CarbonImmutable $clockOut, Shift $shift): int
    {
        $worked = $this->wholeMinutesBetween($clockIn, $clockOut);

        return max(0, $worked - $shift->scheduledMinutes());
    }

    /**
     * Minutes worked between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM (Labor Code Art. 86), only
     * within the scheduled shift: clocking in early or staying late without
     * approval doesn't earn night differential. Without a shift, the whole
     * clocked time counts.
     */
    public function nightMinutes(CarbonImmutable $clockIn, CarbonImmutable $clockOut, ?Shift $shift, CarbonImmutable $logDate): int
    {
        $from = $clockIn;
        $to = $clockOut;

        if ($shift !== null) {
            [$start, $end] = $this->shiftWindow($shift, $logDate);
            $from = $from->max($start);
            $to = $to->min($end);
        }

        $minutes = 0;

        // Each night runs 22:00 to 06:00 the next day; check the nights that can touch [from, to].
        for ($night = $from->startOfDay()->subDay(); $night->lessThanOrEqualTo($to); $night = $night->addDay()) {
            $nightStart = $night->setTime(22, 0)->max($from);
            $nightEnd = $night->addDay()->setTime(6, 0)->min($to);
            $minutes += $this->wholeMinutesBetween($nightStart, $nightEnd);
        }

        return $minutes;
    }

    /**
     * Full minutes from $from to $to, or 0 when $to is not after $from.
     * intdiv on seconds: 4 min 59 s late is 4 minutes, not 5.
     */
    private function wholeMinutesBetween(CarbonImmutable $from, CarbonImmutable $to): int
    {
        return max(0, intdiv($to->getTimestamp() - $from->getTimestamp(), 60));
    }

    private function onDate(CarbonImmutable $date, string $time): CarbonImmutable
    {
        [$hours, $minutes] = array_map('intval', explode(':', $time));

        return $date->setTime($hours, $minutes);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services\Attendance;

use App\Enums\PunchType;
use App\Models\User;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Validates a camera capture and saves it on the PRIVATE photo disk.
 *
 * The browser's claimed MIME type is never trusted: the bytes must decode to
 * a real JPEG or PNG. (Safari sometimes returns PNG when asked for JPEG, so
 * both are accepted as long as the bytes prove it.)
 */
final class PunchPhotoStore
{
    private const ALLOWED_TYPES = [
        IMAGETYPE_JPEG => 'jpg',
        IMAGETYPE_PNG => 'png',
    ];

    public function store(string $dataUrl, User $user, PunchType $type, CarbonImmutable $at): string
    {
        return $this->storeAs($dataUrl, sprintf('punches/%d/%s', $user->id, $at->toDateString()), $type->value);
    }

    /**
     * The same checks for any camera capture (patrol scans), saved under $directory.
     */
    public function storeAs(string $dataUrl, string $directory, string $prefix): string
    {
        if (preg_match('/^data:image\/(?:jpeg|jpg|png);base64,(?<data>[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+)$/', trim($dataUrl), $matches) !== 1) {
            throw $this->invalid('The photo must be captured with the camera.');
        }

        $binary = base64_decode($matches['data'], strict: true);

        if ($binary === false || $binary === '') {
            throw $this->invalid('The photo could not be read. Please retake it.');
        }

        if (strlen($binary) > (int) config('attendance.photo_max_bytes')) {
            throw $this->invalid('The photo is too large. Please retake it.');
        }

        $info = @getimagesizefromstring($binary);
        $extension = $info === false ? null : (self::ALLOWED_TYPES[$info[2]] ?? null);

        if ($extension === null) {
            throw $this->invalid('The photo is not a valid image.');
        }

        // Random name: the path reveals nothing and can't be guessed.
        $path = sprintf('%s/%s-%s.%s', $directory, $prefix, Str::uuid(), $extension);

        Storage::disk($this->disk())->put($path, $binary, ['visibility' => 'private']);

        return $path;
    }

    public function delete(string $path): void
    {
        Storage::disk($this->disk())->delete($path);
    }

    public function disk(): string
    {
        return (string) config('attendance.photo_disk');
    }

    private function invalid(string $message): ValidationException
    {
        return ValidationException::withMessages(['photo' => $message]);
    }
}

/**
 * Clock in/out camera modal. Lives only while the modal is open (x-if), and
 * destroy() stops the camera and GPS watch, so nothing keeps running after
 * the punch.
 *
 * The photo is drawn onto a canvas with a "timemark" burned in (event, time,
 * address, coordinates), downscaled to fit Livewire's 1 MB request limit, and
 * sent to ClockPanel::submitPunch(), which returns { ok, message }.
 *
 * Capture takes ONE snapshot (position, accuracy and the address looked up for that
 * position) and both the photo's timemark and the saved record use it. The GPS keeps
 * moving while the camera is open, and the address is looked up at most every 15 s,
 * so reading them again at Submit (or burning a stale address) made the photo and
 * the record disagree.
 */
const MAX_SIDE = 960;
const JPEG_QUALITY = 0.82;
// An address looked up farther than this from the current position is out of date.
const ADDRESS_FRESH_METERS = 25;

function metersBetween(a, b) {
    const rad = (deg) => (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
    const dLat = rad(b.latitude - a.latitude);
    const dLon = rad(b.longitude - a.longitude);
    const h = Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 + Math.cos(rad(a.latitude)) * Math.cos(rad(b.latitude)) * Math.sin(dLon / 2) ** 2;

    return 2 * 6371000 * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(h));
}

export default function clockCapture({ punchType, geocodeUrl, logoUrl, simulateAt = null, maxAccuracy = 100 }) {
    return {
        punchType,
        stream: null,
        watchId: null,
        clockTimer: null,
        cameraReady: false,
        cameraError: null,
        // 'user' (front, the selfie) or 'environment' (back); the switch shows only on phones with both.
        facing: 'user',
        canSwitch: false,
        locationError: null,
        coords: null,
        address: null,
        // Where the last address lookup was for, so a stale address isn't shown or burned in.
        addressAt: null,
        lastLookupAt: 0,
        clockText: '',
        photo: null,
        // What Capture saw: { latitude, longitude, accuracy, address }. Burned in and submitted.
        shot: null,
        capturing: false,
        submitting: false,
        message: null,
        logo: null,
        // The phone's model code (e.g. "SM-A156E"), from Chrome / Samsung Internet / Edge on
        // Android; iPhones and Firefox don't give one. Shown with its brand to supervisors.
        model: null,

        get canCapture() {
            return this.cameraReady && !this.capturing && this.coords !== null && (this.coords.accuracy ?? 0) <= maxAccuracy;
        },

        // The address only while it belongs to where the phone is now.
        get currentAddress() {
            if (!this.address || !this.addressAt || !this.coords) return null;

            return metersBetween(this.addressAt, this.coords) <= ADDRESS_FRESH_METERS ? this.address : null;
        },

        // Shown as the Capture button's tooltip while it is locked.
        get captureBlockedReason() {
            if (this.capturing) return 'Getting the street address for this exact spot, to print on the photo.';
            if (!this.cameraReady) return 'Waiting for the camera. Allow camera access if your browser asks.';
            if (this.coords === null) return 'Waiting for your GPS location. Allow location access and stay outdoors or near a window.';
            // The first fix is often rough (Wi-Fi or cell towers); the phone sharpens it within seconds.
            if ((this.coords.accuracy ?? 0) > maxAccuracy) return `Getting a precise GPS fix (now ±${Math.round(this.coords.accuracy)} m, needs ±${maxAccuracy} m). Step outside or near a window.`;
            return '';
        },

        get label() {
            return this.punchType === 'clock_in' ? 'CLOCK IN' : 'CLOCK OUT';
        },

        get coordsText() {
            return this.formatCoords(this.shot ?? this.coords);
        },

        formatCoords(at) {
            if (!at) return '';

            return `${at.latitude.toFixed(6)}, ${at.longitude.toFixed(6)} (±${Math.round(at.accuracy ?? 0)} m)`;
        },

        init() {
            this.tickClock();
            this.clockTimer = setInterval(() => this.tickClock(), 1000);
            this.logo = new Image();
            this.logo.src = logoUrl;
            this.startCamera();
            this.startLocation();
            navigator.userAgentData?.getHighEntropyValues?.(['model'])
                .then((values) => { this.model = values.model || null; })
                .catch(() => {});
        },

        destroy() {
            clearInterval(this.clockTimer);
            this.stream?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
            if (this.watchId !== null) navigator.geolocation?.clearWatch(this.watchId);
        },

        tickClock() {
            this.clockText = new Date().toLocaleString('en-PH');
        },

        async startCamera() {
            this.cameraError = null;
            this.cameraReady = false;

            if (!window.isSecureContext || !navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
                this.cameraError = 'The camera needs HTTPS. Open this site with https://';
                return;
            }

            // A phone opens one camera at a time: release the current one before asking for the other.
            this.stream?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
            this.stream = null;

            try {
                this.stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: { ideal: this.facing } }, audio: false });
                this.$refs.video.srcObject = this.stream;
                // Ready only once a real frame plays: before that, videoWidth is 0 and the photo would be black.
                await this.$refs.video.play();
                this.cameraReady = true;
                // Device labels and counts are only reliable once camera access is granted.
                const devices = await navigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices().catch(() => []);
                this.canSwitch = devices.filter((device) => device.kind === 'videoinput').length > 1;
            } catch (error) {
                this.cameraError = `Camera unavailable: ${error.message}`;
            }
        },

        async switchCamera() {
            if (!this.canSwitch || this.photo) return;

            this.facing = this.facing === 'user' ? 'environment' : 'user';
            await this.startCamera();
        },

        startLocation() {
            if (!navigator.geolocation) {
                this.locationError = 'This browser cannot share its location.';
                return;
            }

            this.watchId = navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(
                (position) => {
                    this.coords = position.coords;
                    this.locationError = null;
                    this.lookupAddress(position.coords.latitude, position.coords.longitude);
                },
                (error) => {
                    this.locationError = `Location error: ${error.message}`;
                },
                { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 15000, maximumAge: 5000 },
            );
        },

        // While watching: at most every 15 s (the server also caches and rate-limits).
        // At Capture (force): now, for exactly the captured position.
        async lookupAddress(lat, lon, force = false) {
            if (!force && Date.now() - this.lastLookupAt < 15000) return;
            this.lastLookupAt = Date.now();

            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${geocodeUrl}?lat=${lat}&lon=${lon}`, { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
                const data = await response.json();
                this.address = response.ok ? data.address : null;
                this.addressAt = response.ok ? { latitude: lat, longitude: lon } : null;
            } catch {
                this.address = null;
                this.addressAt = null;
            }
        },

        async capture() {
            if (!this.canCapture) return;

            this.capturing = true;
            // Freeze the position first; the GPS keeps moving while the address is fetched.
            const at = { latitude: this.coords.latitude, longitude: this.coords.longitude, accuracy: this.coords.accuracy };

            try {
                if (!this.addressAt || metersBetween(this.addressAt, at) > ADDRESS_FRESH_METERS) {
                    await this.lookupAddress(at.latitude, at.longitude, true);
                }
                const fresh = this.addressAt && metersBetween(this.addressAt, at) <= ADDRESS_FRESH_METERS;
                this.shot = { ...at, address: fresh ? this.address : null };

                const video = this.$refs.video;
                const scale = Math.min(1, MAX_SIDE / Math.max(video.videoWidth, video.videoHeight));
                this.drawAndSave(video, Math.round(video.videoWidth * scale), Math.round(video.videoHeight * scale));
            } finally {
                this.capturing = false;
            }
        },

        // Local development only: lets you punch from a desktop without a camera or GPS.
        // It stands at the post (simulateAt), so the server's geofence lets it through.
        simulate() {
            this.coords = { latitude: simulateAt?.latitude ?? 14.5995, longitude: simulateAt?.longitude ?? 120.9842, accuracy: 5 };
            this.address = simulateAt ? 'At the post (simulated)' : 'Manila, Philippines (simulated)';
            this.addressAt = { latitude: this.coords.latitude, longitude: this.coords.longitude };
            this.shot = { ...this.coords, address: this.address };

            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = 480;
            canvas.height = 640;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            ctx.fillStyle = '#1f2937';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            this.drawAndSave(canvas, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        },

        drawAndSave(source, width, height) {
            const canvas = this.$refs.canvas;
            canvas.width = width;
            canvas.height = height;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            ctx.drawImage(source, 0, 0, width, height);

            this.burnTimemark(ctx, width, height);

            this.photo = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', JPEG_QUALITY);
            this.message = null;
        },

        burnTimemark(ctx, width, height) {
            const pad = Math.round(width * 0.03);
            const big = Math.max(14, Math.round(width * 0.032));
            const small = Math.max(11, Math.round(width * 0.022));

            if (this.logo?.complete && this.logo.naturalWidth > 0) {
                const logoWidth = Math.round(width * 0.3);
                const logoHeight = Math.round(logoWidth * (this.logo.naturalHeight / this.logo.naturalWidth));
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.roundRect(pad, pad, logoWidth + pad, logoHeight + pad, pad / 2);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.drawImage(this.logo, pad * 1.5, pad * 1.5, logoWidth, logoHeight);
            }

            const lines = [this.shot?.address ?? 'Address unavailable', this.formatCoords(this.shot)];
            const boxHeight = pad * 2 + big * 1.6 + lines.length * small * 1.4;
            const boxY = height - boxHeight - pad;

            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.roundRect(pad, boxY, width - pad * 2, boxHeight, pad / 2);
            ctx.fill();

            ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
            ctx.font = `700 ${big}px sans-serif`;
            ctx.fillStyle = this.punchType === 'clock_in' ? '#60a5fa' : '#fbbf24';
            ctx.fillText(this.label, pad * 2, boxY + pad);

            ctx.font = `600 ${Math.round(big * 0.8)}px sans-serif`;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.fillText(this.clockText, pad * 2 + ctx.measureText(this.label).width + big * 2.2, boxY + pad + big * 0.15);

            ctx.font = `400 ${small}px sans-serif`;
            lines.forEach((line, index) => {
                ctx.fillText(line.slice(0, 90), pad * 2, boxY + pad + big * 1.6 + index * small * 1.4);
            });
        },

        retake() {
            this.photo = null;
            this.shot = null;
            this.message = null;
        },

        // Sends exactly what the photo shows (the snapshot), not where the GPS has drifted since.
        async submit() {
            if (!this.photo || !this.shot || this.submitting) return;

            this.submitting = true;
            this.message = null;

            try {
                const result = await this.$wire.submitPunch(
                    this.punchType,
                    this.photo,
                    this.shot.latitude,
                    this.shot.longitude,
                    this.shot.accuracy ? Math.round(this.shot.accuracy) : null,
                    this.shot.address,
                    this.model,
                );

                if (result?.ok) {
                    this.$dispatch('close-punch-modal');
                } else {
                    this.message = result?.message ?? 'The punch could not be saved. Please try again.';
                }
            } catch {
                this.message = 'Network error. Check your connection and try again.';
            } finally {
                this.submitting = false;
            }
        },
    };
}
Question you'd askAnswer
Why does the browser say which punch it means?If the server guessed, a double-tapped clock-in would turn into a clock-out.
Why downscale the photo in the browser?Livewire refuses request payloads over 1 MB. A 960 px JPEG at 0.82 quality is about 150 KB.
Why does submitPunch return an array?The camera area is wire:ignore so a re-render doesn't kill the live video, which also means it can't show Blade error messages.
Front or back camera?Front by default. On a phone with both, the Back camera / Front camera button switches (switchCamera()): it stops the current camera first, since phones open one at a time, and asks for facingMode: { ideal: 'environment' }. Only the front preview is mirrored, and the saved photo never is.
Can someone fake the photo?They can't send a non-image: the bytes must decode as JPEG or PNG. The burned-in timemark and supervisors reviewing photos are the human check.
What if the address lookup is down?The punch is saved with a blank address. The geocoder is an interface, cached by rounded coordinates, and faked in tests.
Why does it need HTTPS?Browsers only expose the camera and GPS on secure origins. Run herd secure ossi_official_site.
Try it
  1. Sign in as Maria and press Clock In. On a desktop without a camera, use the dashed "simulate capture" button (local only).
  2. Clock in again from a second tab: "You have already clocked in today."
  3. Clock in as Maria, then clock out from another browser (another "phone"): the clock-out counts, is marked Other phone, and HR and Operations get a bell. In Details, Make this their phone makes the new phone hers; on her employee page, Forget phone lets her next clock-in register a new one. A website can't read a phone's IMEI, so the phone is a random code in an HttpOnly cookie, stored only as a hash.
  4. As HR, open Attendance Log: each shift is one row (in and out side by side) under its day. Try the On duty now, Late and Not clocked out views, and Details for both selfies and GPS positions.
07

Leave & overtime

Employees file, supervisors decide: guards' leave climbs Operations to HR, and their overtime goes to HR, Admin or Operations (a Satellite only in its region). Office staff's leave and overtime go to their head (App\Support\Heads, the owner's chain): HR for Admin and others; Operation HQ for a Satellite; the President or VP for HR, Operation HQ and Accounting. The President or VP still see them all, and HR sees every non-HR staffer's (view only). Reviews lock the row so two supervisors can't both decide, nobody reviews their own request, and approved overtime can be less than requested, never more. Payroll later pays the smaller of logged and approved overtime, day by day.

One chain of headsApp\Support\Heads answers both "who heads this person" (of, label) and "does X head Y" (isHeadOf). It covers a guard → Operation HQ + the region's Satellite; HR, Operation HQ and Accounting → the President or VP; a Satellite → Operation HQ; anyone else in the office (Admin…) → HR. Operation HQ and Accounting first sat under HR. The owner moved them after comparing with how agencies usually run: Operations and Accounting answer to the President / GM, while HR administers leave rather than heading other departments. So HR keeps a view-only window on every non-HR staffer, and Heads::toTell copies HR on their attendance alerts. Leave, overtime, time away, attendance alerts, Notices to Explain and merits all ask it, so the chain lives in one place. A Satellite's leave waits at stage hq, where Operation HQ decides it rather than endorsing it on to HR as for a guard. ChainOfHeadsMatrixTest asks all five flows at once for each pair: a head acts for their own people, never upward, sideways, across the chain or for themselves. It found one hole: the President has no employee record, so they fell into the default group and HR counted as their "head". Now nobody heads the Super Admin, President or VP.

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use App\Enums\Region;
use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;

/**
 * The owner's chain of heads (2026-10-23): who supervises whom, in one place.
 *
 *   a guard                                         Operations: Operation HQ, and the Satellite of their client's region
 *   HR, Operation HQ, Accounting                    the President or Vice President
 *   a Satellite Operation                           Operation HQ
 *   other office staff (Admin, Developer,
 *   staff with no role)                             HR
 *
 * Used for attendance alerts, deciding office staff's leave and overtime, watching their
 * time away, and Notices to Explain / merits. The Super Admin may act for any head (backup).
 * The President or Vice President SEE every office staffer's requests, and HR every non-HR
 * office staffer's (they monitor; HR also gets their attendance alerts, as timekeeper).
 */
final class Heads
{
    public const OPERATIONS = 'operations';

    public const LEADERSHIP = 'leadership';

    public const OPERATIONS_HQ = 'operations_hq';

    public const HR = 'hr';

    /** Which group heads this person. */
    public static function groupOf(User $person): string
    {
        $person->loadMissing(['roles', 'employeeProfile']);

        return match (true) {
            $person->employeeProfile !== null && ! $person->employeeProfile->is_office_staff => self::OPERATIONS,
            $person->hasAnyRole(...self::underLeadership()) => self::LEADERSHIP,
            $person->hasRole(Role::SatelliteOperations) => self::OPERATIONS_HQ,
            default => self::HR,
        };
    }

    /** "HR", "Operation HQ", "the President or Vice President", "Operations": for messages. */
    public static function label(User $person): string
    {
        return match (self::groupOf($person)) {
            self::OPERATIONS => 'Operations',
            self::LEADERSHIP => Role::LEADERSHIP_LABEL,
            self::OPERATIONS_HQ => 'Operation HQ',
            default => 'HR',
        };
    }

    /**
     * The people who head this person, still working here; never the person themselves.
     * $client: where a guard actually worked (a relief duty), else their own client.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, User>
     */
    public static function of(User $person, ?Client $client = null): Collection
    {
        $person->loadMissing('employeeProfile.client');

        if (self::isTopOfChain($person)) {
            return new Collection;
        }

        $heads = match (self::groupOf($person)) {
            self::OPERATIONS => self::operationsFor(($client ?? $person->employeeProfile?->client)?->region),
            self::LEADERSHIP => User::query()->notifiable(Role::leadership())->get(),
            self::OPERATIONS_HQ => User::query()->notifiable([Role::OperationsHq])->get(),
            default => User::query()->notifiable([Role::Hr])->get(),
        };

        return $heads->reject(fn (User $head) => $head->is($person))->values();
    }

    /**
     * HR, kept informed (as timekeeper) about office staff it doesn't head: Operation HQ,
     * Accounting and the Satellites. Never about HR staff.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, User>
     */
    public static function informed(User $person): Collection
    {
        if (self::isTopOfChain($person) || $person->hasRole(Role::Hr) || ! in_array(self::groupOf($person), [self::LEADERSHIP, self::OPERATIONS_HQ], true)) {
            return new Collection;
        }

        return User::query()->notifiable([Role::Hr])->get()->reject(fn (User $hr) => $hr->is($person))->values();
    }

    /**
     * Everyone to tell about this person: their heads, then HR when it's only informed.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, User>
     */
    public static function toTell(User $person, ?Client $client = null): Collection
    {
        return self::of($person, $client)->merge(self::informed($person))->unique('id')->values();
    }

    /** @return list<Role> office roles the President or VP head directly */
    public static function underLeadership(): array
    {
        return [Role::Hr, Role::OperationsHq, Role::Accounting];
    }

    /** Whether $head heads $person (and so may decide for them). The Super Admin may, as backup. */
    public static function isHeadOf(User $head, User $person): bool
    {
        if ($head->is($person) || self::isTopOfChain($person)) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($head->hasRole(Role::SuperAdmin)) {
            return true;
        }

        return match (self::groupOf($person)) {
            self::OPERATIONS => $head->hasRole(Role::OperationsHq) || ($head->hasRole(Role::SatelliteOperations) && $head->canSeeEmployee($person)),
            self::LEADERSHIP => $head->hasAnyRole(...Role::leadership()),
            self::OPERATIONS_HQ => $head->hasRole(Role::OperationsHq),
            default => $head->hasRole(Role::Hr),
        };
    }

    /**
     * Narrows a query of users to the OFFICE staff this viewer heads: HR → office staff who aren't
     * HR, Operation HQ, Accounting or a Satellite; Operation HQ → Satellites; the President or VP →
     * HR, Operation HQ and Accounting; Super Admin → all.
     *
     * @param  Builder<User>  $users
     */
    public static function constrainOfficeStaffHeadedBy(Builder $users, User $viewer): void
    {
        $users->officeStaff();
        $role = fn (Role ...$roles) => fn (Builder $userRoles) => $userRoles->whereIn('role', array_map(fn (Role $r) => $r->value, $roles));

        match (true) {
            $viewer->hasRole(Role::SuperAdmin) => null,
            $viewer->hasAnyRole(...Role::leadership()) => $users->whereHas('roles', $role(...self::underLeadership())),
            $viewer->hasRole(Role::OperationsHq) => $users->whereHas('roles', $role(Role::SatelliteOperations)),
            $viewer->hasRole(Role::Hr) => $users->whereDoesntHave('roles', $role(Role::SatelliteOperations, ...self::underLeadership())),
            default => $users->whereRaw('1 = 0'),
        };
    }

    /**
     * Narrows a query of users to the OFFICE staff whose requests and time away this viewer sees:
     * the ones they head, plus, for HR, every non-HR office staffer (monitor only).
     *
     * @param  Builder<User>  $users
     */
    public static function constrainOfficeStaffSeenBy(Builder $users, User $viewer): void
    {
        match (true) {
            self::seesAllOfficeStaff($viewer) => $users->officeStaff(),
            $viewer->hasRole(Role::Hr) => $users->officeStaff()->whereDoesntHave('roles', fn (Builder $userRoles) => $userRoles->where('role', Role::Hr->value)),
            default => self::constrainOfficeStaffHeadedBy($users, $viewer),
        };
    }

    /** Sees every office staffer's requests and time away: the President or VP (monitor) and the Super Admin. */
    public static function seesAllOfficeStaff(User $viewer): bool
    {
        return $viewer->hasAnyRole(Role::SuperAdmin, ...Role::leadership());
    }

    /** Sees some office staff's requests: everyone who heads office staff (HR, Operation HQ) or monitors them all. */
    public static function headsOfficeStaff(User $viewer): bool
    {
        return self::seesAllOfficeStaff($viewer) || $viewer->hasAnyRole(Role::Hr, Role::OperationsHq);
    }

    /**
     * The Super Admin, President and VP: no employee record, so nobody here heads them
     * (without this they'd fall into the default group, and HR would "head" the President).
     */
    private static function isTopOfChain(User $person): bool
    {
        return $person->employeeProfile === null && $person->hasAnyRole(...Role::withoutEmployeeRecord());
    }

    /**
     * Operation HQ, and the Satellite Operation covering this region.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, User>
     */
    private static function operationsFor(?Region $region): Collection
    {
        return User::query()->notifiable([Role::OperationsHq, Role::SatelliteOperations])->with('roles')->get()
            ->filter(fn (User $user) => $user->hasRole(Role::OperationsHq) || ($region !== null && $user->operations_region === $region))
            ->values();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Leave;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\RequestStatus;
use App\Models\LeaveRequest;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\RequestDecided;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Support\Heads;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use InvalidArgumentException;

/**
 * Who decides depends on who's asking: HR decides guards' leave (final),
 * once the region's Satellite Operation and Operation HQ have endorsed it
 * (EndorseLeaveRequest); an office staffer's head decides theirs (Heads: HR for Admin and
 * others; Operation HQ for a Satellite; the President or VP for HR, Operation HQ, Accounting).
 */
final class ReviewLeaveRequest
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    /**
     * Why this reviewer can't decide it, or null when they can. The list shows the same text
     * in place of the Review button. A guard's: HR, once Operations has endorsed it. An office
     * staffer's: their head (Heads). No HR profile (e.g. a Super Admin's own account) counts
     * as office staff.
     */
    public static function blockedReason(LeaveRequest $leaveRequest, User $reviewer): ?string
    {
        $leaveRequest->loadMissing('user.employeeProfile');
        $office = $leaveRequest->user->isOfficeStaff();

        return match (true) {
            $leaveRequest->user_id === $reviewer->id => 'You cannot review your own request.',
            $office && ! Heads::isHeadOf($reviewer, $leaveRequest->user) => 'Their head decides it: '.Heads::label($leaveRequest->user).'.',
            ! $office && ! $reviewer->can(Ability::ReviewFieldLeave->value) => 'Guards\' leave is approved by HR.',
            // A guard's leave reaches HR only once Operation HQ has endorsed it.
            ! $office && $leaveRequest->stage !== null && $leaveRequest->stage->endorses() => "Waiting for {$leaveRequest->stage->label()} to endorse it.",
            ! $reviewer->canSeeEmployee($leaveRequest->user) => 'This employee is outside your region.',
            default => null,
        };
    }

    /**
     * Why it can't be approved yet (rejecting is still possible): the proof it
     * needs isn't attached. The review box shows the same text.
     */
    public static function approvalBlockedReason(LeaveRequest $leaveRequest): ?string
    {
        $leaveRequest->loadMissing('documents');

        return $leaveRequest->missingDocument()
            ? 'Waiting for the document: '.lcfirst((string) $leaveRequest->documentNeeded()).'. They attach it on My Leave.'
            : null;
    }

    public function handle(LeaveRequest $leaveRequest, User $reviewer, RequestStatus $decision, ?string $note): LeaveRequest
    {
        if (! in_array($decision, [RequestStatus::Approved, RequestStatus::Rejected], true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('A review either approves or rejects.');
        }

        // Separation of duties (nobody approves their own leave), who decides what, and the region.
        if (($reason = self::blockedReason($leaveRequest, $reviewer)) !== null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['review' => $reason]);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($leaveRequest, $reviewer, $decision, $note) {
            // Locked: two supervisors clicking at once can't both decide.
            $locked = LeaveRequest::query()->with('user')->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($leaveRequest->id);

            if ($locked->status !== RequestStatus::Pending) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['review' => 'This leave request has already been reviewed.']);
            }

            // Re-checked on the locked row: an endorsement may have just moved it (or not yet).
            if (($reason = self::blockedReason($locked, $reviewer)) !== null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['review' => $reason]);
            }

            // Proof first (a medical certificate, a birth certificate…): no approving without it.
            if ($decision === RequestStatus::Approved && ($reason = self::approvalBlockedReason($locked)) !== null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['review' => $reason]);
            }

            $locked->forceFill([
                'status' => $decision,
                'stage' => null,
                'reviewed_by' => $reviewer->id,
                'reviewed_at' => now(),
                'review_note' => $note,
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Leave, 'leave.'.$decision->value, ucfirst($decision->value)." leave of {$locked->user->name} ({$locked->dateRangeLabel()})", $locked, [
                'old' => ['status' => RequestStatus::Pending->value],
                'new' => ['status' => $decision->value, 'review_note' => $note],
            ], causer: $reviewer);

            // The person who asked hears the answer.
            $locked->user->notify(new RequestDecided($locked->setRelation('reviewer', $reviewer)));

            return $locked;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Overtime;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\RequestStatus;
use App\Models\OvertimeRequest;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\RequestDecided;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Support\Heads;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use InvalidArgumentException;

/**
 * Approving sets approved_minutes, which may be LESS than requested. Payroll
 * pays the smaller of logged and approved overtime, day by day.
 *
 * Who decides depends on who's asking, like leave: an office staffer's head (Heads: HR for
 * Admin and others; Operation HQ for a Satellite; the President or VP for HR, Operation HQ, Accounting);
 * Operations, HR or Admin decide guards'.
 */
final class ReviewOvertimeRequest
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    /**
     * Why this reviewer can't decide it, or null when they can: their own request, not
     * their head, not their kind of request, or a guard outside a Satellite's region.
     */
    public static function blockedReason(OvertimeRequest $overtimeRequest, User $reviewer): ?string
    {
        $overtimeRequest->loadMissing('user.employeeProfile');
        $office = $overtimeRequest->user->isOfficeStaff();

        return match (true) {
            $overtimeRequest->user_id === $reviewer->id => 'You cannot review your own request.',
            $office && ! Heads::isHeadOf($reviewer, $overtimeRequest->user) => 'Their head decides it: '.Heads::label($overtimeRequest->user).'.',
            ! $office && ! $reviewer->can(Ability::ReviewOvertime->value) => 'Guards\' overtime is approved by Operations, HR or Admin.',
            ! $reviewer->canSeeEmployee($overtimeRequest->user) => 'This employee is outside your region.',
            default => null,
        };
    }

    public function handle(OvertimeRequest $overtimeRequest, User $reviewer, RequestStatus $decision, ?string $note, ?int $approvedMinutes = null): OvertimeRequest
    {
        if (! in_array($decision, [RequestStatus::Approved, RequestStatus::Rejected], true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('A review either approves or rejects.');
        }

        if (($reason = self::blockedReason($overtimeRequest, $reviewer)) !== null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['review' => $reason]);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($overtimeRequest, $reviewer, $decision, $note, $approvedMinutes) {
            $locked = OvertimeRequest::query()->with('user')->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($overtimeRequest->id);

            if ($locked->status !== RequestStatus::Pending) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['review' => 'This overtime request has already been reviewed.']);
            }

            $approved = null;

            if ($decision === RequestStatus::Approved) {
                $approved = $approvedMinutes ?? $locked->requested_minutes;

                if ($approved < 1 || $approved > $locked->requested_minutes) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages(['approvedHours' => 'Approved time must be more than zero and no more than what was requested.']);
                }
            }

            $locked->forceFill([
                'status' => $decision,
                'approved_minutes' => $approved,
                'reviewed_by' => $reviewer->id,
                'reviewed_at' => now(),
                'review_note' => $note,
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Overtime, 'overtime.'.$decision->value, ucfirst($decision->value)." overtime of {$locked->user->name} on {$locked->date->format('M j, Y')}", $locked, [
                'old' => ['status' => RequestStatus::Pending->value, 'requested_minutes' => $locked->requested_minutes],
                'new' => ['status' => $decision->value, 'approved_minutes' => $approved, 'review_note' => $note],
            ], causer: $reviewer);

            // The person who asked hears the answer (and how much, if less was approved).
            $locked->user->notify(new RequestDecided($locked->setRelation('reviewer', $reviewer)));

            return $locked;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Admin;

use App\Actions\Leave\EndorseLeaveRequest;
use App\Actions\Leave\ReviewLeaveRequest;
use App\Actions\Leave\SaveLeaveRules;
use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\LeaveStage;
use App\Enums\RequestStatus;
use App\Livewire\Concerns\GroupsByStaffKind;
use App\Livewire\Concerns\InteractsWithUser;
use App\Models\LeaveRequest;
use App\Support\LeaveRules;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\WithPagination;

/**
 * Guards' leave climbs Satellite Operation → Operation HQ → HR (final);
 * office staff's goes to their head (App\Support\Heads). Each viewer gets the button for their
 * step: Endorse, Review, or a "waiting for…" note.
 *
 * @property-read LengthAwarePaginator<int, LeaveRequest> $requests
 * @property-read LeaveRequest|null $reviewing
 * @property-read LeaveRequest|null $endorsing
 * @property-read int $pendingCount
 */
#[Title('Leave Requests')]
class LeaveRequests extends Component
{
    use GroupsByStaffKind, InteractsWithUser, WithPagination;

    protected function requestModel(): string
    {
        return LeaveRequest::class;
    }

    #[Url(as: 'status', except: 'pending')]
    public string $statusFilter = 'pending';

    public ?int $reviewingId = null;

    public string $reviewNote = '';

    /** The guard's leave being endorsed (Satellite Operation / Operation HQ). */
    public ?int $endorsingId = null;

    public bool $endorseRecommends = true;

    public string $endorseNote = '';

    // Rules: HR edits them here (SaveLeaveRules); others see them.
    public bool $editingRules = false;

    public string $sickCertificateFromDays = '';

    public string $fileAfterDays = '';

    /** HR sets the leave rules; everyone who sees this page sees them. */
    public function canEditRules(): bool
    {
        return $this->currentUser()->can(Ability::ManagePeople->value);
    }

    public function editRules(): void
    {
        abort_unless($this->canEditRules(), 403);
        $rules = LeaveRules::all();
        $this->sickCertificateFromDays = (string) $rules['sick_certificate_from_days'];
        $this->fileAfterDays = (string) $rules['file_after_days'];
        $this->resetErrorBag();
        $this->editingRules = true;
    }

    public function saveRules(SaveLeaveRules $save): void
    {
        $validated = $this->validate([
            'sickCertificateFromDays' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:30'],
            'fileAfterDays' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:30'],
        ], [], ['sickCertificateFromDays' => 'days', 'fileAfterDays' => 'days']);

        $save->handle($this->currentUser(), (int) $validated['sickCertificateFromDays'], (int) $validated['fileAfterDays']);

        $this->editingRules = false;
        $this->dispatch('notify', message: 'Leave rules saved. My Leave uses them from now on.');
    }

    public function updatedStatusFilter(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function startEndorse(int $id): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::EndorseGuardLeave->value);

        $request = LeaveRequest::query()->visibleTo($this->currentUser())->findOrFail($id);

        if (EndorseLeaveRequest::endorsesAs($request, $this->currentUser()) === null) {
            $this->addError('list', 'This leave isn\'t waiting for your endorsement.');

            return;
        }

        $this->endorsingId = $request->id;
        $this->endorseRecommends = true;
        $this->endorseNote = '';
        $this->resetErrorBag();
    }

    public function cancelEndorse(): void
    {
        $this->reset(['endorsingId', 'endorseRecommends', 'endorseNote']);
        $this->resetErrorBag();
    }

    public function endorse(EndorseLeaveRequest $endorse): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::EndorseGuardLeave->value);
        $this->validate(['endorseNote' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000']]);

        $endorsement = $endorse->handle(LeaveRequest::query()->visibleTo($this->currentUser())->findOrFail($this->endorsingId), $this->currentUser(), $this->endorseRecommends, $this->endorseNote);

        $this->cancelEndorse();
        unset($this->requests, $this->pendingCount);
        $this->dispatch('notify', message: ($endorsement->recommends ? 'Endorsed' : 'Sent up as not recommended').' to '.($endorsement->stage === LeaveStage::Satellite ? 'Operation HQ' : 'HR').'.');
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function endorsing(): ?LeaveRequest
    {
        return $this->endorsingId !== null ? LeaveRequest::query()->with(['user.employeeProfile', 'endorsements.endorser', 'documents'])->find($this->endorsingId) : null;
    }

    public function startReview(int $id): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::MonitorRequests->value);

        $request = LeaveRequest::query()->visibleTo($this->currentUser())->findOrFail($id);

        if (($reason = ReviewLeaveRequest::blockedReason($request, $this->currentUser())) !== null) {
            $this->addError('list', $reason);

            return;
        }

        $this->reviewingId = $request->id;
        $this->reviewNote = '';
        $this->resetErrorBag();
    }

    public function cancelReview(): void
    {
        $this->reset(['reviewingId', 'reviewNote']);
    }

    public function approve(ReviewLeaveRequest $review): void
    {
        $this->decide($review, RequestStatus::Approved);
    }

    public function reject(ReviewLeaveRequest $review): void
    {
        $this->decide($review, RequestStatus::Rejected);
    }

    private function decide(ReviewLeaveRequest $review, RequestStatus $decision): void
    {
        // Re-checked here: a role removed while this page was open must stop the write.
        // ReviewLeaveRequest then checks this reviewer may decide THIS request.
        $this->authorize(Ability::MonitorRequests->value);

        $this->validate(['reviewNote' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000']]);

        $review->handle(LeaveRequest::query()->visibleTo($this->currentUser())->findOrFail($this->reviewingId), $this->currentUser(), $decision, $this->reviewNote !== '' ? $this->reviewNote : null);

        $this->cancelReview();
        unset($this->requests, $this->pendingCount);
        $this->dispatch('notify', message: 'Leave request '.$decision->value.'.');
    }

    /**
     * @return LengthAwarePaginator<int, LeaveRequest>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function requests(): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        return LeaveRequest::query()
            ->with(['user.employeeProfile.client', 'reviewer', 'endorsements.endorser', 'documents'])
            ->visibleTo($this->currentUser())
            ->tap(fn ($query) => $this->inShownGroup($query))
            ->when($this->statusFilter === 'mine', fn ($query) => $query->awaitingActionBy($this->currentUser()))
            ->when(RequestStatus::tryFrom($this->statusFilter), fn ($query, RequestStatus $status) => $query->where('status', $status))
            ->latest('start_date')
            ->paginate(20);
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function reviewing(): ?LeaveRequest
    {
        return $this->reviewingId !== null ? LeaveRequest::query()->with(['user.employeeProfile', 'endorsements.endorser', 'documents'])->find($this->reviewingId) : null;
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function pendingCount(): int
    {
        return LeaveRequest::query()->pending()->visibleTo($this->currentUser())->count();
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        return view('livewire.admin.leave-requests');
    }
}
Question you'd askAnswer
How is cancelling someone else's leave prevented?The id is looked up through the user: $user->leaveRequests()->findOrFail($id). Another person's id is simply not found.
Why snapshot the post onto the overtime request?So reassigning the guard later doesn't rewrite where they actually worked that night.
Who gets a guard's overtime request?Operations, automatically: Operation HQ and the guard's region's Satellite Operation are told (SubmitOvertimeRequest::operationsFor). Office staff's goes to their head (Heads::of). Employees used to pick a supervisor from a list, which was an extra step and an easy mistake (the wrong person, or one who couldn't approve it). Who decides is still by role; lists show Sent to.
Which leave needs a document?Sick leave from 2 days (a medical certificate), and the leaves under special laws: maternity, paternity, solo parent, VAWC and special leave for women, each with its proof (LeaveType::document()). Vacation and emergency don't: there's nothing to prove, and asking only slows people down.
Can someone file sick leave after the fact?Yes, up to 7 days after it started (sick and emergency only). They're sick first and file once back, attaching the certificate then. Everything else starts today or later.
Who decides the 2 days and the 7 days?HR, in the app: Leave Requests → Rules → Change. Saved as a Setting and audited (SaveLeaveRules, LeaveRules), and My Leave reads the same numbers. Company policy belongs with the people who run the company, not in a server file.
What if the document isn't there yet?It can be attached later from My Leave, and whoever acts next is told again. The decider can still reject, but Approve stays locked with "Waiting for the document" (ReviewLeaveRequest::approvalBlockedReason).
Why not enforce the law's day counts?The laws count days differently (calendar or working days). The form shows the entitlement, and a longer request is flagged to the approver ("This asks for more"), who decides. A wrong hard limit would refuse a lawful leave.
Who can open the documents?The employee and whoever decides: HR for guards, the President or Vice President for office staff (LeaveRequest::documentsVisibleTo). Medical papers are sensitive personal information, so endorsers see only that a document is attached, and the decider's views are audited.
Why is VAWC handled differently?RA 9262 keeps these records confidential. VAWC leave skips the endorsers and goes straight to the decider, and it's hidden from everyone else's list (LeaveRequest::scopeVisibleTo). The bell and email say only "Confidential leave".
Operations knows a guard stayed 3 hours longer. Does the guard have to file it?No. Add extra time on Overtime Requests records it for them (RecordOvertime): saved approved, filed_by Operations, audited, and the guard is told ("Extra time added"). Lists show Added by …. If the guard already asked for that day, Operations is sent to review that request instead: one per day.
Couldn't that pay hours nobody worked?No. Payroll pays the smaller of approved and clocked overtime, day by day, so the guard's own clock-out is still the ceiling. Recording it as an ordinary approved request means payroll needed no change.

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Overtime;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\RequestStatus;
use App\Models\OvertimeRequest;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\RequestDecided;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Operations adds a guard's extra time themselves: the guard who held the post
 * longer, a reliever kept on. It's saved approved (they decide guards' overtime
 * anyway), filed_by them, and the guard is told. Payroll still pays the smaller
 * of this and what the guard actually clocked, so it can't pay hours not worked.
 */
final class RecordOvertime
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function handle(User $recorder, User $guard, CarbonImmutable $date, int $minutes, string $reason): OvertimeRequest
    {
        $guard->loadMissing('employeeProfile');

        $refusal = match (true) {
            ! $recorder->can(Ability::ReviewOvertime->value) => 'Only Operations, HR or Admin add a guard\'s extra time.',
            $guard->id === $recorder->id => 'You cannot add extra time for yourself.',
            $guard->isOfficeStaff() => 'Office staff ask their head for overtime on My Overtime.',
            ! $recorder->canSeeEmployee($guard) => 'This guard is outside your region.',
            $date->isAfter(today()) => 'Extra time is added once it\'s worked: choose today or an earlier date.',
            $minutes < 15 || $minutes > 12 * 60 => 'Extra time is from 15 minutes to 12 hours.',
            default => null,
        };

        if ($refusal !== null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['extra' => $refusal]);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($recorder, $guard, $date, $minutes, $reason) {
            // One per day, as when the guard asks: a request they already filed is reviewed instead.
            $existing = $guard->overtimeRequests()->whereDate('date', $date->toDateString())->whereIn('status', RequestStatus::blocking())->lockForUpdate()->first();

            if ($existing !== null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['extra' => $existing->status === RequestStatus::Pending
                    ? "{$guard->name} already asked for overtime on {$date->format('M j')}: review that request instead."
                    : "{$guard->name} already has approved overtime on {$date->format('M j')}."]);
            }

            $overtime = new OvertimeRequest([
                'date' => $date->toDateString(),
                'post' => $guard->employeeProfile?->assignmentLabel(),
                'requested_minutes' => $minutes,
                'reason' => $reason,
            ]);
            $overtime->user()->associate($guard);
            $overtime->forceFill([
                'filed_by' => $recorder->id,
                'status' => RequestStatus::Approved,
                'approved_minutes' => $minutes,
                'reviewed_by' => $recorder->id,
                'reviewed_at' => now(),
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Overtime, 'overtime.recorded', "Added {$guard->name}'s extra time on {$date->format('M j, Y')}", $overtime, [
                'new' => ['status' => RequestStatus::Approved->value, 'approved_minutes' => $minutes, 'reason' => $reason],
            ], causer: $recorder);

            $guard->notify(new RequestDecided($overtime->setRelation('reviewer', $recorder)));

            return $overtime;
        });
    }
}

Payroll

One query gathers every input in bulk, one pure calculator applies the formula, and one resolver returns either the frozen record or a live estimate. The payroll screen and "My Payslips" both call that resolver, so their numbers are identical by construction.

flowchart LR

run start date]
  DB[(time logs, approved OT,
holidays, loans, brackets)] --> IQ[PayslipInputsQuery]
  IQ --> CALC[PayslipCalculator]
  RR --> CALC
  REC[(payslip_records)] --> FR[fromRecord]
  CALC --> RP[ResolvePayslips]
  FR --> RP
  RP --> S1[Payroll screen]
  RP --> S2[My Payslips]
