<?php

namespace App\Queries\People;

use App\Enums\EmploymentStatus;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;

/**
 * Probationary employees whose probation ends within the reminder window,
 * or has already ended without a decision.
 */
final class ProbationEndingQuery
{
    /**
     * @return Collection<int, EmployeeProfile>
     */
    public function handle(CarbonImmutable $today): Collection
    {
        // ends_on = hire_date + months, and we want ends_on - remind_days <= today.
        $latestHireDate = $today
            ->addDays((int) config('hr.probation.remind_days_before'))
            ->subMonthsNoOverflow((int) config('hr.probation.months'));

        return EmployeeProfile::query()
            ->where('employment_status', EmploymentStatus::Probationary)
            ->whereNotNull('hire_date')
            ->whereDate('hire_date', '<=', $latestHireDate->toDateString())
            ->orderBy('hire_date')
            ->get();
    }

    public static function endsOn(EmployeeProfile $profile): ?CarbonImmutable
    {
        return $profile->hire_date?->addMonthsNoOverflow((int) config('hr.probation.months'));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Notifications;

use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\WritesBellImmediately;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Messages\MailMessage;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notification;

/**
 * Tells HR that an employee's probation ends soon, ends today, or ended and
 * is still undecided (weekly), so the regularization decision is made: under
 * Labor Code Art. 296, someone allowed to keep working after probation is
 * regular by law, whatever their record says.
 */
final class ProbationEnding extends Notification implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable, WritesBellImmediately;

    /** Ends today or already ended. */
    public readonly bool $isDue;

    /**
     * @param  int  $daysPast  days since probation ended: negative = still ahead, 0 = today
     */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly EmployeeProfile $profile,
        public readonly CarbonImmutable $endsOn,
        public readonly int $daysPast,
    ) {
        $this->isDue = $daysPast >= 0;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function via(User $notifiable): array
    {
        return ['database', 'mail'];
    }

    public function toMail(User $notifiable): MailMessage
    {
        return (new MailMessage)
            ->subject($this->title())
            ->greeting("Hello {$notifiable->name},")
            ->line($this->body())
            ->action('Open employee record', $this->url())
            ->line('Update the employment status once a decision is made.');
    }

    /**
     * @return array{title: string, body: string, url: string, icon: string}
     */
    public function toArray(User $notifiable): array
    {
        return ['title' => $this->title(), 'body' => $this->body(), 'url' => $this->url(), 'icon' => 'user'];
    }

    private function title(): string
    {
        return match (true) {
            $this->daysPast < 0 => "Probation ending soon: {$this->profile->name}",
            $this->daysPast === 0 => "Probation ends today: {$this->profile->name}",
            default => 'Probation ended '.$this->daysPast.' '.str('day')->plural($this->daysPast)." ago: {$this->profile->name}",
        };
    }

    private function body(): string
    {
        $months = (int) config('hr.probation.months');
        $who = "{$this->profile->name} ({$this->profile->employee_number})";

        if ($this->daysPast > 0) {
            return "{$who} passed {$months} months of probation on {$this->endsOn->format('M j, Y')} and is still marked Probationary. "
                .'Under Labor Code Art. 296, an employee allowed to keep working after probation becomes regular. Decide now.';
        }

        return "{$who} reaches {$months} months of probation on {$this->endsOn->format('M j, Y')}. Decide on regularization.";
    }

    private function url(): string
    {
        return route('employees.show', $this->profile);
    }
}

The bell

app/Livewire/NotificationBell.php98 lines
Copied from the repository as it is today
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use App\Livewire\Concerns\InteractsWithUser;
use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Illuminate\Notifications\DatabaseNotification;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Component;

/**
 * The bell in the top bar. Deliberately NO wire:poll: a poll is a request,
 * and every request resets the idle timeout, so polling would keep an
 * unattended screen signed in forever. New notifications are pushed over
 * the WebSocket instead (NotificationArrived, Reverb) and drawn in the browser
 * by live-bell.js; without Reverb the bell still refreshes on each page load.
 *
 * @property-read int $unreadCount
 * @property-read Collection<int, DatabaseNotification> $recent
 */
class NotificationBell extends Component
{
    use InteractsWithUser;

    #[Computed]
    public function unreadCount(): int
    {
        return $this->currentUser()->unreadNotifications()->count();
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, DatabaseNotification>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function recent(): Collection
    {
        return $this->currentUser()->notifications()->latest()->limit(8)->get();
    }

    /**
     * Marks one as read and follows its link. Only the link's path is kept and
     * opened on the address the person is using now: a notice queued by the
     * worker carries APP_URL's host, which differs from a tunnel or a renamed
     * domain. Dropping the host also means a link can never lead off-site.
     */
    public function open(string $id): void
    {
        /** @var DatabaseNotification $notification */
        $notification = $this->currentUser()->notifications()->whereKey($id)->firstOrFail();
        $notification->markAsRead();

        $path = $this->localPath($notification->data['url'] ?? null);

        if ($path !== null) {
            $this->redirect(url($path), navigate: true);

            return;
        }

        unset($this->unreadCount, $this->recent);
    }

    /**
     * "https://any-host/leave-requests?x=1" → "/leave-requests?x=1"; null for anything that isn't a link.
     */
    private function localPath(mixed $url): ?string
    {
        if (! is_string($url) || $url === '') {
            return null;
        }

        $parts = parse_url($url);

        if ($parts === false) {
            return null;
        }

        $path = '/'.ltrim($parts['path'] ?? '', '/');

        return isset($parts['query']) ? "{$path}?{$parts['query']}" : $path;
    }

    public function markAllRead(): void
    {
        $this->currentUser()->unreadNotifications()->update(['read_at' => now()]);

        unset($this->unreadCount, $this->recent);
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        // Icons the notification classes use, so one that arrives live is drawn with its own.
        return view('livewire.notification-bell', [
            'liveIcons' => ['shield', 'clipboard', 'clock-plus', 'arrows-right-left', 'user', 'banknotes', 'megaphone', 'folder', 'flag', 'phone', 'info'],
        ]);
    }
}
QuestionAnswer
Why check the URL before redirecting?A notification stores a link. Only links into this app are followed, so a crafted notification can never send someone to a phishing page.
Why notifications()->whereKey($id) and not DatabaseNotification::find($id)?Scoping to the current user means someone else's notification id is simply "not found" (there is a test).

Full late details

The list reads the same time_logs.late_minutes, over the same dates, that the payslip total sums. So the days always add up to the minutes shown, and the deduction still comes from the late brackets applied to that total.

app/Queries/Payroll/LateDaysQuery.php40 lines
Copied from the repository as it is today
<?php

namespace App\Queries\Payroll;

use App\Data\LateDay;
use App\Models\PayrollRun;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use App\Models\User;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;

/**
 * The days behind a payslip's "Late" line. Reads the same time_logs.late_minutes
 * that PayslipInputsQuery sums, over the same run dates, so the list always adds
 * up to the minutes on the payslip.
 */
final class LateDaysQuery
{
    /**
     * @return list<LateDay>
     */
    public function handle(PayrollRun $run, User $user): array
    {
        return array_values(TimeLog::query()
            ->where('user_id', $user->id)
            ->between($run->start_date, $run->end_date)
            ->where('late_minutes', '>', 0)
            ->with('shift:id,name,start_time,grace_minutes')
            ->orderBy('log_date')
            ->get(['id', 'shift_id', 'log_date', 'clock_in_at', 'late_minutes'])
            ->map(fn (TimeLog $log) => new LateDay(
                date: $log->log_date,
                shiftName: $log->shift?->name,
                shiftStart: $log->shift !== null ? CarbonImmutable::createFromFormat('H:i', substr($log->shift->start_time, 0, 5))?->format('g:i A') : null,
                graceMinutes: $log->shift->grace_minutes ?? 0,
                clockInAt: $log->clock_in_at,
                lateMinutes: $log->late_minutes,
            ))
            ->all());
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Payroll;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Models\PayrollRun;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;

/**
 * Who opened whose payslip, and when. A website can't stop a screenshot, but
 * a leaked payslip can be traced to the people who opened it (see the viewer
 * watermark in <x-sensitive>).
 */
final class RecordPayslipView
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function handle(PayrollRun $run, User $employee, User $viewer): void
    {
        $whose = $employee->is($viewer) ? 'their own' : "{$employee->name}'s";

        $this->audit->record(
            AuditArea::Payroll,
            'payslip.viewed',
            "Viewed {$whose} payslip for {$run->periodLabel()}",
            $run,
            ['employee_id' => $employee->id],
            causer: $viewer,
        );
    }
}

Announcements & FAQs

Saving a live announcement notifies its audience immediately. One that starts later is picked up by app:publish-announcements every five minutes. Both paths claim the same sent_alerts row, so they can't double-send. Urgent announcements go to the bell and to email; routine ones to the bell only.

app/Actions/Content/SendAnnouncementNotifications.php45 lines
Copied from the repository as it is today
<?php

namespace App\Actions\Content;

use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Models\Announcement;
use App\Models\SentAlert;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\AnnouncementPublished;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;

/**
 * Notifies an announcement's audience once it is live. Called right after a
 * save (when it starts immediately) and by the scheduler (for ones that start
 * later). The sent_alerts claim makes both paths safe to overlap.
 */
final class SendAnnouncementNotifications
{
    /**
     * @return bool whether notifications were sent now
     */
    public function handle(Announcement $announcement): bool
    {
        if (! $announcement->isLive()) {
            return false;
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($announcement) {
            if (! SentAlert::claim('announcement.published', $announcement)) {
                return false;
            }

            $roles = $announcement->audienceRoles() ?: Role::cases();

            // Chunked: one query and one batch of queued jobs per 200 people.
            User::query()->notifiable($roles)->chunkById(200, function (Collection $users) use ($announcement) {
                Notification::send($users, new AnnouncementPublished($announcement));
            });

            return true;
        });
    }
}
app/Actions/Content/SaveAnnouncement.php51 lines
Copied from the repository as it is today
<?php

namespace App\Actions\Content;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Models\Announcement;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

final class SaveAnnouncement
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
        private readonly SendAnnouncementNotifications $notify,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array{title: string, body: string, audience: list<string>, is_urgent: bool, starts_at: string, ends_at: string|null}  $data
     */
    public function handle(?Announcement $announcement, array $data, User $actor): Announcement
    {
        $announcement = DB::transaction(function () use ($announcement, $data, $actor) {
            $isNew = $announcement === null;
            $announcement ??= new Announcement;
            $fields = ['title', 'body', 'audience', 'is_urgent', 'starts_at', 'ends_at'];
            $before = $isNew ? [] : $announcement->only($fields);

            $announcement->fill([...$data, 'audience' => $data['audience'] === [] ? null : $data['audience']]);

            if ($isNew) {
                $announcement->created_by = $actor->id;
            }

            $announcement->save();

            $after = $announcement->only($fields);
            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Content, $isNew ? 'announcement.created' : 'announcement.updated', "Saved announcement \"{$announcement->title}\"", $announcement, AuditLogger::diff(
                array_map(fn ($value) => is_array($value) ? implode(', ', $value) : $value, $before),
                array_map(fn ($value) => is_array($value) ? implode(', ', $value) : $value, $after),
            ), causer: $actor);

            return $announcement;
        });

        // Outside the save: a notification problem must never undo the announcement itself.
        $this->notify->handle($announcement);

        return $announcement;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use App\Actions\Content\DeleteFaq;
use App\Actions\Content\SaveFaq;
use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Livewire\Concerns\InteractsWithUser;
use App\Models\Faq;
use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;

/**
 * Help & FAQs. Everyone reads the published questions; people who can
 * publish content also see drafts and can edit in place, so there is one
 * page to maintain instead of a reader page plus an admin copy.
 *
 * @property-read bool $canEdit
 * @property-read Collection<int, Faq> $faqs
 */
#[Title('Help & FAQs')]
class Help extends Component
{
    use InteractsWithUser;

    public bool $formOpen = false;

    public ?int $editingId = null;

    public string $question = '';

    public string $answer = '';

    public int $sortOrder = 0;

    public bool $isPublished = true;

    #[Computed]
    public function canEdit(): bool
    {
        return $this->currentUser()->can(Ability::PublishContent->value);
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, Faq>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function faqs(): Collection
    {
        return Faq::query()
            ->unless($this->canEdit, fn ($query) => $query->where('is_published', true))
            ->ordered()
            ->get();
    }

    public function create(): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::PublishContent->value);

        $this->resetForm();
        $this->sortOrder = ((int) Faq::query()->max('sort_order')) + 10;
        $this->formOpen = true;
    }

    public function edit(int $id): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::PublishContent->value);

        $faq = Faq::query()->findOrFail($id);
        $this->resetForm();
        $this->editingId = $faq->id;
        $this->question = $faq->question;
        $this->answer = $faq->answer;
        $this->sortOrder = $faq->sort_order;
        $this->isPublished = $faq->is_published;
        $this->formOpen = true;
    }

    public function cancel(): void
    {
        $this->resetForm();
    }

    public function save(SaveFaq $saveFaq): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::PublishContent->value);

        $validated = $this->validate([
            'question' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'answer' => ['required', 'string', 'max:5000'],
            'sortOrder' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:100000'],
            'isPublished' => ['boolean'],
        ]);

        $saveFaq->handle(
            $this->editingId !== null ? Faq::query()->findOrFail($this->editingId) : null,
            ['question' => $validated['question'], 'answer' => $validated['answer'], 'sort_order' => (int) $validated['sortOrder'], 'is_published' => $validated['isPublished']],
            $this->currentUser(),
        );

        $this->resetForm();
        unset($this->faqs);
        $this->dispatch('notify', message: 'Question saved.');
    }

    public function delete(int $id, DeleteFaq $deleteFaq): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::PublishContent->value);

        $deleteFaq->handle(Faq::query()->findOrFail($id), $this->currentUser());
        unset($this->faqs);
        $this->dispatch('notify', message: 'Question deleted.');
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        return view('livewire.help');
    }

    private function resetForm(): void
    {
        $this->reset(['formOpen', 'editingId', 'question', 'answer', 'sortOrder', 'isPublished']);
        $this->resetErrorBag();
    }
}

Laravel Cloud: turn on the scheduler for the environment, as well as the queue worker. Without it, no probation alert is ever sent (chapter 11 checklist).

14

V2 phase 2.1: the 201 file

The 21-document checklist from the old system, rebuilt with uploads, HR verification, expiry alerts and promised dates. The old "GKE" report is now RAE. Employees upload; only HR verifies.

No row = missingA new hire doesn't need 21 placeholder rows. The checklist query fills the gaps from the enum.
Expired is computedNever stored, so it can't drift out of date and no nightly job has to flip a status.
File and row agreeThe new file is written first and deleted if the transaction fails. The replaced file is deleted only after the commit.
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> missing
  missing --> missing: employee sets "submit by" date
  missing --> submitted: employee uploads
  missing --> on_file: HR uploads / records paper copy
  submitted --> on_file: HR verifies (+ expiry date)
  submitted --> missing: HR returns with reason (file deleted, employee told)
  on_file --> on_file: replaced / expiry corrected
  on_file --> missing: HR returns

<?php

namespace App\Enums;

/**
 * The documents of an employee's 201 file. Ported from the old system's
 * TwoOOneDocument enum, with "GKE" renamed to "RAE" (V2 item 9).
 *
 * The values are stored in employee_requirements.requirement, so renaming a
 * LABEL is safe at any time; renaming a VALUE needs a data migration.
 */
enum Requirement: string
{
    case PersonalDataSheet = 'personal_data_sheet';
    case DataPrivacyAcknowledgement = 'data_privacy_acknowledgement';
    case BirthCertificate = 'birth_certificate';
    case Picture2x2 = 'picture_2x2';
    case DiplomaTor = 'diploma_tor';
    case CertificateOfEmployment = 'certificate_of_employment';
    case PoliceClearance = 'police_clearance';
    case NbiClearance = 'nbi_clearance';
    case BarangayClearance = 'barangay_clearance';
    case SssE1 = 'sss_e1';
    case PhilhealthMdr = 'philhealth_mdr';
    case PagibigMdr = 'pagibig_mdr';
    case TinId = 'tin_id';
    case SecurityLicense = 'security_license';
    case NeuroPsychTest = 'neuro_psych_test';
    case DrugTest = 'drug_test';
    case PreEmploymentMedical = 'pre_employment_medical';
    case TrainingCertificate = 'training_certificate';
    case RaeReport = 'rae_report';
    case FiringCertificate = 'firing_certificate';
    case SosiaCertificate = 'sosia_certificate';

    public function label(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::PersonalDataSheet => 'Personal Data Sheet',
            self::DataPrivacyAcknowledgement => 'Data Privacy Notice Acknowledgement (RA 10173)',
            self::BirthCertificate => 'Birth Certificate (PSA)',
            self::Picture2x2 => '2pcs 2x2 Picture (Type A Uniform & White Background)',
            self::DiplomaTor => 'Diploma / TOR',
            self::CertificateOfEmployment => 'Certificate of Employment',
            self::PoliceClearance => 'Police Clearance',
            self::NbiClearance => 'NBI Clearance',
            self::BarangayClearance => 'Barangay Clearance',
            self::SssE1 => 'SSS (E-1 Form)',
            self::PhilhealthMdr => 'PhilHealth (MDR)',
            self::PagibigMdr => 'Pag-IBIG (MDR)',
            self::TinId => 'TIN ID',
            self::SecurityLicense => 'Security License',
            self::NeuroPsychTest => 'Neuro & Psychiatric Test Result',
            self::DrugTest => 'Drug Test Result',
            self::PreEmploymentMedical => 'Pre-Employment Medical Examination',
            self::TrainingCertificate => 'Training Certificate',
            self::RaeReport => 'RAE Opening and Closing Report',
            self::FiringCertificate => 'Firing Certificate',
            self::SosiaCertificate => 'SOSIA Certificate',
        };
    }

    /**
     * Documents with a validity period. HR records the expiry date when the
     * document is filed, and the daily alert check warns before it lapses.
     */
    public function expires(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this, [
            self::SecurityLicense, self::NbiClearance, self::PoliceClearance, self::BarangayClearance,
            self::NeuroPsychTest, self::DrugTest, self::PreEmploymentMedical,
        ], true);
    }

    /**
     * Security-guard documents. Office staff are not asked for them.
     */
    public function isGuardOnly(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this, [
            self::SecurityLicense, self::NeuroPsychTest, self::TrainingCertificate,
            self::RaeReport, self::FiringCertificate, self::SosiaCertificate,
        ], true);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<self>
     */
    public static function for(bool $isOfficeStaff): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(self::cases(), fn (self $requirement) => ! ($isOfficeStaff && $requirement->isGuardOnly())));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Queries\People;

use App\Data\RequirementItem;
use App\Enums\RequirementStatus;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\EmployeeRequirement;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;

/**
 * The 201 checklist of one employee: every requirement that applies to them
 * (office staff skip the guard-only ones), in enum order, in one query.
 */
final class RequirementChecklistQuery
{
    /**
     * @return list<RequirementItem>
     */
    public function handle(EmployeeProfile $profile, ?CarbonImmutable $today = null): array
    {
        $today ??= CarbonImmutable::today();

        $records = $profile->requirements()
            ->with('verifier:id,name')
            ->get()
            ->keyBy(fn (EmployeeRequirement $record) => $record->requirement->value);

        $items = [];

        foreach ($profile->applicableRequirements() as $requirement) {
            /** @var EmployeeRequirement|null $record */
            $record = $records->get($requirement->value);
            $status = $record->status ?? RequirementStatus::Missing;

            $items[] = new RequirementItem(
                requirement: $requirement,
                record: $record,
                status: $status,
                isExpired: $status === RequirementStatus::OnFile && $record?->isExpired($today) === true,
                daysToExpiry: $status === RequirementStatus::OnFile ? $record?->daysToExpiry($today) : null,
                isPromiseOverdue: $status === RequirementStatus::Missing && $record?->promised_on !== null && $record->promised_on->lessThan($today),
            );
        }

        return $items;
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<RequirementItem>  $items
     * @return array{total: int, on_file: int, submitted: int, expired: int}
     */
    public static function summarize(array $items): array
    {
        $count = fn (callable $test) => count(array_filter($items, $test));

        return [
            'total' => count($items),
            'on_file' => $count(fn (RequirementItem $item) => $item->status === RequirementStatus::OnFile && ! $item->isExpired),
            'submitted' => $count(fn (RequirementItem $item) => $item->status === RequirementStatus::Submitted),
            'expired' => $count(fn (RequirementItem $item) => $item->isExpired),
        ];
    }
}

Uploading, safely

app/Actions/People/SubmitRequirementDocument.php103 lines
Copied from the repository as it is today
<?php

namespace App\Actions\People;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\Requirement;
use App\Enums\RequirementStatus;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\EmployeeRequirement;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\RequirementSubmitted;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\People\RequirementDocumentStore;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Uploads one 201 document. From HR it is filed (verified) at once; from the
 * employee it waits for HR's check, and HR gets a bell notification.
 *
 * File and row stay consistent: the new file is written first, deleted
 * again if the transaction fails, and the replaced file is only deleted
 * after the commit.
 */
final class SubmitRequirementDocument
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly RequirementDocumentStore $documents,
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {}

    public function handle(EmployeeProfile $profile, Requirement $requirement, UploadedFile $file, ?string $expiresOn, User $actor): EmployeeRequirement
    {
        if (! $actor->can('submitRequirements', $profile)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        if (! in_array($requirement, $profile->applicableRequirements(), true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['document' => 'This document is not required for this employee.']);
        }

        $byHr = $actor->can(Ability::ManagePeople->value);
        $stored = $this->documents->store($file, $profile, $requirement);
        $replacedPath = null;

        try {
            $record = DB::transaction(function () use ($profile, $requirement, $stored, $expiresOn, $actor, $byHr, &$replacedPath) {
                $record = EmployeeRequirement::query()
                    ->where('employee_profile_id', $profile->id)
                    ->where('requirement', $requirement)
                    ->lockForUpdate()
                    ->first() ?? new EmployeeRequirement;

                $replacedPath = $record->file_path;
                $now = CarbonImmutable::now();

                $record->forceFill([
                    'employee_profile_id' => $profile->id,
                    'requirement' => $requirement,
                    'status' => $byHr ? RequirementStatus::OnFile : RequirementStatus::Submitted,
                    'file_path' => $stored['path'],
                    'file_name' => $stored['name'],
                    'file_mime' => $stored['mime'],
                    'file_size' => $stored['size'],
                    'expires_on' => $requirement->expires() && filled($expiresOn) ? $expiresOn : null,
                    'promised_on' => null,
                    'note' => null,
                    'submitted_by' => $actor->id,
                    'submitted_at' => $now,
                    'verified_by' => $byHr ? $actor->id : null,
                    'verified_at' => $byHr ? $now : null,
                ])->save();

                $this->audit->record(AuditArea::People, $byHr ? 'requirement.filed' : 'requirement.submitted', ($byHr ? 'Filed' : 'Submitted')." {$requirement->label()} for {$profile->name}", $record, [
                    'requirement' => $requirement->value,
                    'file_name' => $stored['name'],
                    'expires_on' => $record->expires_on?->toDateString(),
                    'replaced_file' => $replacedPath !== null,
                ], causer: $actor);

                if (! $byHr) {
                    Notification::send(User::query()->notifiable(Ability::ManagePeople->roles())->get(), new RequirementSubmitted($record));
                }

                return $record;
            });
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            $this->documents->delete($stored['path']);

            throw $exception;
        }

        $this->documents->delete($replacedPath);

        return $record;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services\People;

use App\Enums\Requirement;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Services\Files\PrivateUploadStore;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;

/**
 * 201 scans on the PRIVATE documents disk: 201/{profile}/{requirement}-{uuid}.{ext}.
 * The byte checks live in PrivateUploadStore.
 */
final class RequirementDocumentStore
{
    public function __construct(private readonly PrivateUploadStore $uploads) {}

    /**
     * @return array{path: string, name: string, mime: string, size: int}
     */
    public function store(UploadedFile $file, EmployeeProfile $profile, Requirement $requirement): array
    {
        return $this->uploads->store($file, $this->disk(), sprintf('201/%d', $profile->id), $requirement->value, ['pdf', 'png', 'jpg']);
    }

    public function delete(?string $path): void
    {
        $this->uploads->delete($this->disk(), $path);
    }

    public function disk(): string
    {
        return (string) config('hr.documents.disk');
    }
}
QuestionAnswer
Why check the file signature when the component already validates mimes:?Actions are called from more than one place (tests, a future API, a console command). The rule protects the form; the signature check protects the Action.
Why keep the original filename at all?People recognise "nbi-2026.pdf". It is only shown back to them; the stored path is random and never built from it.
Why audit every document view?NBI clearances and medical results are the most sensitive files here. The question "who saw this?" must have an answer.

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Models\EmployeeRequirement;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\People\RequirementDocumentStore;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

/**
 * 201 scans are never public URLs. Each view passes EmployeeRequirementPolicy
 * (the employee or HR) and is audited: NBI clearances and medical results
 * are the most sensitive files in the system.
 */
final class ShowRequirementDocumentController extends Controller
{
    public function __invoke(EmployeeRequirement $requirement, RequirementDocumentStore $documents, AuditLogger $audit): StreamedResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize('viewDocument', $requirement);

        $disk = Storage::disk($documents->disk());
        abort_unless($requirement->file_path !== null && $disk->exists($requirement->file_path), 404);

        $audit->record(AuditArea::People, 'requirement.document_viewed', "Viewed {$requirement->requirement->label()} of {$requirement->profile->name}", $requirement);

        return $disk->response($requirement->file_path, $requirement->file_name, [
            'Content-Type' => (string) $requirement->file_mime,
            'Cache-Control' => 'private, no-store',
            'X-Content-Type-Options' => 'nosniff',
        ], 'inline');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\User;

/**
 * Who may touch a 201 file. HR (manage-people) does everything; the employee
 * may upload their own documents and say when a missing one will come, but
 * never verify anything themselves.
 */
final class EmployeeProfilePolicy
{
    public function viewRequirements(User $user, EmployeeProfile $profile): bool
    {
        return $this->isOwner($user, $profile) || $user->can(Ability::ManagePeople->value);
    }

    public function submitRequirements(User $user, EmployeeProfile $profile): bool
    {
        return $this->viewRequirements($user, $profile);
    }

    public function reviewRequirements(User $user, EmployeeProfile $profile): bool
    {
        return $user->can(Ability::ManagePeople->value);
    }

    private function isOwner(User $user, EmployeeProfile $profile): bool
    {
        return $profile->user_id !== null && $profile->user_id === $user->id;
    }
}

app/Actions/People/ReviewRequirement.php103 lines
Copied from the repository as it is today
<?php

namespace App\Actions\People;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\Requirement;
use App\Enums\RequirementStatus;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\EmployeeRequirement;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\RequirementNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\People\RequirementDocumentStore;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * HR's decision on one 201 document:
 *
 *   FILE   → on file and verified. Accepts an upload, records a paper copy
 *            HR already holds, or corrects the expiry date.
 *   RETURN → back to missing with a reason; the upload is deleted and the
 *            employee is told why (bell + email).
 */
final class ReviewRequirement
{
    public const FILE = 'file';

    public const RETURN = 'return';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly RequirementDocumentStore $documents,
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {}

    public function handle(EmployeeProfile $profile, Requirement $requirement, string $decision, ?string $expiresOn, ?string $note, User $actor): EmployeeRequirement
    {
        if (! $actor->can('reviewRequirements', $profile)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        if ($decision === self::RETURN && blank($note)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['note' => 'Say why the document is being returned.']);
        }

        $removedPath = null;

        $record = DB::transaction(function () use ($profile, $requirement, $decision, $expiresOn, $note, $actor, &$removedPath) {
            $record = EmployeeRequirement::query()
                ->where('employee_profile_id', $profile->id)
                ->where('requirement', $requirement)
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->first() ?? new EmployeeRequirement;

            $before = $record->exists ? ['status' => $record->status->value, 'expires_on' => $record->expires_on?->toDateString()] : [];

            if ($decision === self::RETURN) {
                if (! $record->exists || $record->status === RequirementStatus::Missing) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages(['note' => 'There is nothing to return.']);
                }

                $removedPath = $record->file_path;
                $record->forceFill([
                    'status' => RequirementStatus::Missing,
                    'file_path' => null, 'file_name' => null, 'file_mime' => null, 'file_size' => null,
                    'expires_on' => null,
                    'note' => $note,
                    'verified_by' => null, 'verified_at' => null,
                ]);
            } else {
                $record->forceFill([
                    'status' => RequirementStatus::OnFile,
                    'expires_on' => $requirement->expires() && filled($expiresOn) ? $expiresOn : null,
                    'promised_on' => null,
                    'note' => filled($note) ? $note : null,
                    'verified_by' => $actor->id,
                    'verified_at' => CarbonImmutable::now(),
                ]);
            }

            $record->forceFill(['employee_profile_id' => $profile->id, 'requirement' => $requirement])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::People, $decision === self::RETURN ? 'requirement.returned' : 'requirement.verified', ($decision === self::RETURN ? 'Returned' : 'Verified')." {$requirement->label()} for {$profile->name}", $record, [
                ...AuditLogger::diff($before, ['status' => $record->status->value, 'expires_on' => $record->expires_on?->toDateString()]),
                'note' => $record->note,
            ], causer: $actor);

            $owner = $profile->loadMissing('user')->user;

            if ($decision === self::RETURN && $owner !== null) {
                $owner->notify(new RequirementNotice($record, RequirementNotice::RETURNED, email: true));
            }

            return $record;
        });

        $this->documents->delete($removedPath);

        return $record;
    }
}

Expiry and promise alerts

The same sent_alerts claim as the probation alerts. Two extra rules apply. Only the nearest threshold is sent, so a scheduler that was down for a week never sends two alerts at once. The alert key includes the expiry date, so a renewed document re-arms its alerts.

app/Actions/People/SendRequirementAlerts.php148 lines
Copied from the repository as it is today
<?php

namespace App\Actions\People;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\EmploymentStatus;
use App\Enums\RequirementStatus;
use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Models\EmployeeRequirement;
use App\Models\SentAlert;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\RequirementNotice;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;

/**
 * Run daily. Two kinds of alert, each sent once:
 *
 * 1. Expiry: at 60, 30 and 7 days before and on the day (config). Only the
 *    nearest threshold is sent, so a missed week never sends 60 and 30
 *    together. The alert key includes the expiry date, so a renewed
 *    document (new date) gets its own alerts.
 * 2. Promise overdue: a missing document whose promised date has passed.
 *
 * Recipients: the employee, HR, and Admin (operations).
 */
final class SendRequirementAlerts
{
    /**
     * @return int how many alerts were sent
     */
    public function handle(CarbonImmutable $today): int
    {
        $staff = User::query()->notifiable([...Ability::ManagePeople->roles(), Role::Admin])->get();

        return $this->expiryAlerts($today, $staff) + $this->promiseAlerts($today, $staff);
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, User>  $staff
     */
    private function expiryAlerts(CarbonImmutable $today, Collection $staff): int
    {
        /** @var list<int> $thresholds */
        $thresholds = config('hr.documents.expiry_alert_days');

        // An empty list in config switches expiry alerts off.
        if ($thresholds === []) {
            return 0;
        }

        sort($thresholds);

        $records = $this->activeEmployees(EmployeeRequirement::query())
            ->where('status', RequirementStatus::OnFile)
            ->whereNotNull('expires_on')
            ->whereDate('expires_on', '<=', $today->addDays((int) max($thresholds))->toDateString())
            ->get();

        $sent = 0;

        foreach ($records as $record) {
            $daysLeft = (int) $record->daysToExpiry($today);
            $threshold = $this->nearestThreshold($daysLeft, $thresholds);
            $alert = sprintf('requirement.expiry.%d.%s', $threshold, $record->expires_on?->format('Ymd'));
            $reason = $daysLeft < 0 ? RequirementNotice::EXPIRED : RequirementNotice::EXPIRING;

            $sent += $this->send($alert, $record, new RequirementNotice($record, $reason, email: $threshold <= 30), $staff) ? 1 : 0;
        }

        return $sent;
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, User>  $staff
     */
    private function promiseAlerts(CarbonImmutable $today, Collection $staff): int
    {
        $records = $this->activeEmployees(EmployeeRequirement::query())
            ->where('status', RequirementStatus::Missing)
            ->whereNotNull('promised_on')
            ->whereDate('promised_on', '<', $today->toDateString())
            ->get();

        $sent = 0;

        foreach ($records as $record) {
            $alert = 'requirement.promise.'.$record->promised_on?->format('Ymd');
            $sent += $this->send($alert, $record, new RequirementNotice($record, RequirementNotice::PROMISE_OVERDUE), $staff) ? 1 : 0;
        }

        return $sent;
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, User>  $staff
     */
    private function send(string $alert, EmployeeRequirement $record, RequirementNotice $notice, Collection $staff): bool
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($alert, $record, $notice, $staff) {
            if (! SentAlert::claim($alert, $record)) {
                return false;
            }

            $recipients = $staff->collect();

            if ($record->profile->user !== null) {
                $recipients->push($record->profile->user);
            }

            Notification::send($recipients->unique('id')->values(), $notice);

            return true;
        });
    }

    /**
     * The smallest threshold the remaining days fall under: 25 days left → 30.
     *
     * @param  list<int>  $thresholds  ascending
     */
    private function nearestThreshold(int $daysLeft, array $thresholds): int
    {
        foreach ($thresholds as $threshold) {
            if ($daysLeft <= $threshold) {
                return $threshold;
            }
        }

        return (int) end($thresholds);
    }

    /**
     * Documents of people who still work here, with the profile and account loaded.
     *
     * @param  Builder<EmployeeRequirement>  $query
     * @return Builder<EmployeeRequirement>
     */
    private function activeEmployees(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        return $query
            ->whereHas('profile', fn (Builder $profile) => $profile->whereIn('employment_status', EmploymentStatus::active()))
            ->with('profile.user');
    }
}

One component, two audiences

A filter that changes nothing looks broken. "Only what needs action (20 of 21)" says how many documents it keeps, and offersFilter() shows the checkbox only when some documents are done and some aren't. On a brand-new 201 file, where everything still needs action, it doesn't appear.

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\People;

use App\Actions\People\PromiseRequirement;
use App\Actions\People\ReviewRequirement;
use App\Actions\People\SubmitRequirementDocument;
use App\Data\RequirementItem;
use App\Enums\Requirement;
use App\Livewire\Concerns\InteractsWithUser;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Queries\People\RequirementChecklistQuery;
use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\WithFileUploads;

/**
 * The 201 checklist, on both the employee record (HR) and My Profile (the
 * employee). One component, two audiences: the policy decides which buttons
 * appear, and every action re-checks it, so hiding a button is never the
 * only protection.
 *
 * @property-read EmployeeProfile $profile
 * @property-read list<RequirementItem> $items
 * @property-read list<RequirementItem> $visibleItems
 * @property-read int $openCount
 * @property-read array{total: int, on_file: int, submitted: int, expired: int} $summary
 * @property-read bool $canReview
 * @property-read RequirementItem|null $activeItem
 */
class RequirementsChecklist extends Component
{
    use InteractsWithUser, WithFileUploads;

    #[Locked]
    public int $profileId;

    public bool $onlyOpen = false;

    /** The requirement value the modal is about. */
    public ?string $active = null;

    /** upload | review | promise */
    public string $mode = '';

    /** @var UploadedFile|null */
    public $document = null;

    public string $expiresOn = '';

    public string $promisedOn = '';

    public string $decision = ReviewRequirement::FILE;

    public string $note = '';

    public function mount(int $profileId): void
    {
        $this->profileId = $profileId;
        $this->authorize('viewRequirements', $this->profile);
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function profile(): EmployeeProfile
    {
        return EmployeeProfile::query()->findOrFail($this->profileId);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<RequirementItem>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function items(): array
    {
        return app(RequirementChecklistQuery::class)->handle($this->profile);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<RequirementItem>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function visibleItems(): array
    {
        return $this->onlyOpen
            ? array_values(array_filter($this->items, fn (RequirementItem $item) => $item->needsAction()))
            : $this->items;
    }

    /** Documents still missing, waiting for HR's check, or expired. */
    #[Computed]
    public function openCount(): int
    {
        return count(array_filter($this->items, fn (RequirementItem $item) => $item->needsAction()));
    }

    /**
     * The "Only what needs action" filter is offered only when it would change the list: some
     * documents are done and some aren't (or it's already on, so it can be turned off).
     */
    public function offersFilter(): bool
    {
        return $this->onlyOpen || ($this->openCount > 0 && $this->openCount < count($this->items));
    }

    /**
     * @return array{total: int, on_file: int, submitted: int, expired: int}
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function summary(): array
    {
        return RequirementChecklistQuery::summarize($this->items);
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function canReview(): bool
    {
        return $this->currentUser()->can('reviewRequirements', $this->profile);
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function activeItem(): ?RequirementItem
    {
        foreach ($this->items as $item) {
            if ($item->requirement->value === $this->active) {
                return $item;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    // ---- Opening the modal ------------------------------------------------

    public function startUpload(string $requirement): void
    {
        $this->authorize('submitRequirements', $this->profile);
        $this->open($requirement, 'upload');
    }

    public function startReview(string $requirement): void
    {
        $this->authorize('reviewRequirements', $this->profile);
        $this->open($requirement, 'review');
        $this->note = $this->activeItem->record->note ?? '';
    }

    public function startPromise(string $requirement): void
    {
        $this->authorize('submitRequirements', $this->profile);
        $this->open($requirement, 'promise');
        $this->promisedOn = $this->activeItem?->record?->promised_on?->toDateString() ?? '';
    }

    public function cancel(): void
    {
        $this->reset(['active', 'mode', 'document', 'expiresOn', 'promisedOn', 'decision', 'note']);
        $this->resetErrorBag();
    }

    // ---- Saving -----------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Not called "upload": $wire.upload() is Livewire's own JavaScript file-upload
     * method, so wire:submit="upload" would call that instead of this.
     */
    public function submitDocument(SubmitRequirementDocument $submit): void
    {
        $this->authorize('submitRequirements', $this->profile);

        $this->validate([
            'document' => ['required', 'file', 'mimes:'.implode(',', (array) config('hr.documents.mimes')), 'max:'.(int) config('hr.documents.max_kilobytes')],
            'expiresOn' => ['nullable', 'date'],
        ], attributes: ['expiresOn' => 'expiry date']);

        /** @var UploadedFile $document */
        $document = $this->document;
        $record = $submit->handle($this->profile, $this->activeRequirement(), $document, $this->expiresOn ?: null, $this->currentUser());

        $this->finish($record->requirement->label().($this->canReview ? ' filed.' : ' sent to HR for checking.'));
    }

    public function review(ReviewRequirement $review): void
    {
        $this->authorize('reviewRequirements', $this->profile);

        $this->validate([
            'decision' => ['required', Rule::in([ReviewRequirement::FILE, ReviewRequirement::RETURN])],
            'expiresOn' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'note' => [Rule::requiredIf($this->decision === ReviewRequirement::RETURN), 'nullable', 'string', 'max:500'],
        ], attributes: ['expiresOn' => 'expiry date', 'note' => 'reason']);

        $record = $review->handle($this->profile, $this->activeRequirement(), $this->decision, $this->expiresOn ?: null, $this->note ?: null, $this->currentUser());

        $this->finish($record->requirement->label().($this->decision === ReviewRequirement::RETURN ? ' returned to the employee.' : ' marked on file.'));
    }

    public function promise(PromiseRequirement $promise): void
    {
        $this->authorize('submitRequirements', $this->profile);

        $this->validate(['promisedOn' => ['required', 'date', 'after_or_equal:today']], attributes: ['promisedOn' => 'date']);

        $record = $promise->handle($this->profile, $this->activeRequirement(), $this->promisedOn, $this->currentUser());

        $this->finish("Noted: {$record->requirement->label()} by {$record->promised_on?->format('M j, Y')}.");
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        return view('livewire.people.requirements-checklist', [
            'isOwner' => $this->profile->user_id === $this->currentUser()->id,
        ]);
    }

    // ---- Helpers ----------------------------------------------------------

    private function open(string $requirement, string $mode): void
    {
        $this->cancel();
        $this->active = Requirement::tryFrom($requirement)->value ?? abort(404);
        $this->mode = $mode;
        $this->expiresOn = $this->activeItem?->record?->expires_on?->toDateString() ?? '';
    }

    private function activeRequirement(): Requirement
    {
        return Requirement::tryFrom((string) $this->active) ?? abort(404);
    }

    private function finish(string $message): void
    {
        $this->cancel();
        unset($this->items, $this->visibleItems, $this->summary, $this->activeItem);
        $this->dispatch('notify', message: $message);
    }
}
The trap this phase hit
  1. The action was first named upload(). In the browser, wire:submit="upload" called Livewire's own JavaScript $wire.upload() and threw.
  2. Every Pest test still passed, because ->call('upload') goes straight to PHP.
  3. Fix: rename to submitDocument(), and add an architecture test that rejects any component method named like a built-in $wire method. It also caught an old PunchLog::refresh().
  4. Lesson: component tests prove the PHP, and a browser run proves the wiring. Do both.
Try it
  1. php artisan migrate:fresh --seed, then php artisan app:send-requirement-alerts: Maria's NBI expires in 20 days and her drug-test promise is overdue.
  2. As Maria: My Profile → 201 file → upload a Police Clearance with a "Valid until" date.
  3. As HR: Employees (see the 201 column) → Maria → Review the Birth Certificate → Return it with a reason.
15

Borrow Load

Mobile load on credit. The employee requests it, an Admin sends it from the company phone and approves, and the amount is deducted from the next payslip. No GCash, no reference numbers, no receipts.

Approve = deductionApproving creates a balance-tracked Load deduction in the same transaction, so the next payslip takes it and it switches itself off.
Never twiceThe request row is locked and the move checked against LoadRequestStatus, so two Admins can't both approve and charge twice.
A receipt, alwaysApproving needs a screenshot of the load confirmation. It's emailed to the employee as an attachment and shown as "Receipt" in the app, never as a public link.
Not your ownNobody approves their own request, and Load isn't in Accounting's manual deduction list: every Load line traces back to a request.
Authorized in writingLabor Code Art. 113 allows a deduction from pay only with the employee's written authorization. The form's tick, "I authorize the company to deduct ₱100 from my next payslip for this load", is required by SubmitLoadRequest itself, and the sentence is saved with the time (deduction_authorization, authorized_at).
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> pending: employee requests (network, number, amount)
  pending --> approved: Admin sends load, approves → Load deduction
  pending --> rejected: Admin rejects (reason)
  pending --> cancelled: employee cancels

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Load;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\DeductionType;
use App\Enums\LoadRequestStatus;
use App\Models\EmployeeDeduction;
use App\Models\LoadRequest;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\LoadRequestNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\Files\PrivateUploadStore;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * The Admin's side, after sending the load from the company phone:
 *
 *  - Approved: with a screenshot of the load confirmation as proof (the
 *    employee's receipt, emailed to them). In the same transaction a "Load" deduction for the full amount
 *    is created, so the next generated payslip deducts it (and it switches
 *    itself off once paid, like any balance-tracked loan);
 *  - Rejected: with a reason, nothing is deducted.
 *
 * The row is locked and the move checked against LoadRequestStatus, so two
 * Admins clicking at once can't both approve (and charge twice). Nobody
 * approves their own request.
 */
final class ReviewLoadRequest
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
        private readonly PrivateUploadStore $uploads,
    ) {}

    public function handle(LoadRequest $loadRequest, LoadRequestStatus $to, ?string $reason, User $actor, ?UploadedFile $proof = null): LoadRequest
    {
        if (! $actor->can(Ability::ManageLoadRequests->value) || ! in_array($to, [LoadRequestStatus::Approved, LoadRequestStatus::Rejected], true)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        if ($loadRequest->user_id === $actor->id) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reason' => 'You can\'t approve or reject your own load request. Another Admin has to.']);
        }

        if ($to === LoadRequestStatus::Rejected && blank($reason)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reason' => 'Say why the request is rejected.']);
        }

        if ($to === LoadRequestStatus::Approved && $proof === null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['proof' => 'Attach a screenshot of the load confirmation: it\'s the employee\'s receipt.']);
        }

        $disk = (string) config('load.disk');
        $stored = $proof !== null ? $this->uploads->store($proof, $disk, 'load-proofs/'.$loadRequest->user_id, 'load-'.$loadRequest->id, ['png', 'jpg'], 'proof') : null;

        try {
            return $this->decide($loadRequest, $to, $reason, $actor, $stored);
        } catch (\Throwable $exception) {
            // Nothing was approved: don't keep a receipt for it.
            $this->uploads->delete($disk, $stored['path'] ?? null);

            throw $exception;
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param  array{path: string, name: string, mime: string, size: int}|null  $stored
     */
    private function decide(LoadRequest $loadRequest, LoadRequestStatus $to, ?string $reason, User $actor, ?array $stored): LoadRequest
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($loadRequest, $to, $reason, $actor, $stored) {
            $locked = LoadRequest::query()->whereKey($loadRequest->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();

            if (! $locked->status->canMoveTo($to)) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reason' => "Not possible: this request is \"{$locked->status->label()}\". Refresh to see its latest state."]);
            }

            $now = CarbonImmutable::now();
            $from = $locked->status;

            if ($to === LoadRequestStatus::Approved) {
                $deduction = new EmployeeDeduction([
                    'label' => $locked->deductionLabel(),
                    'type' => DeductionType::Load,
                    'installment_amount' => $locked->amount,
                    'original_amount' => $locked->amount,
                ]);
                $deduction->user()->associate($locked->user_id);
                $deduction->remaining_balance = (string) $locked->amount;
                $deduction->save();

                $locked->forceFill(['status' => $to, 'approved_by' => $actor->id, 'approved_at' => $now, 'employee_deduction_id' => $deduction->id, 'proof_path' => $stored['path'] ?? null, 'proof_mime' => $stored['mime'] ?? null])->save();
            } else {
                $locked->forceFill(['status' => $to, 'rejected_by' => $actor->id, 'rejected_at' => $now, 'rejection_reason' => $reason])->save();
            }

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Load, 'load.'.$to->value, "{$to->label()}: ₱{$locked->amount} {$locked->networkLabel()} load".($to === LoadRequestStatus::Approved ? ', deducted on the next payslip' : ''), $locked, [
                'old' => ['status' => $from->value],
                'new' => ['status' => $to->value],
                'reason' => $reason,
                'employee_deduction_id' => $locked->employee_deduction_id,
            ], causer: $actor);

            $locked->loadMissing('user')->user->notify(new LoadRequestNotice($locked, $to === LoadRequestStatus::Approved ? LoadRequestNotice::APPROVED : LoadRequestNotice::REJECTED));

            return $locked;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Load;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\LoadRequestStatus;
use App\Models\LoadRequest;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\LoadRequestNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Support\PhilippineFormats;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * An employee asks for mobile load on credit; the amount is deducted from
 * their next payslip once an Admin approves.
 *
 * The rules live here, not only in the form: network and amount must be on
 * the configured lists, the number is normalized, only people on payroll can
 * borrow (the deduction needs a payslip), nobody can have more than
 * `max_open_requests` waiting at a time, and the employee must authorize the
 * deduction in writing (Labor Code Art. 113): the text they ticked is saved.
 */
final class SubmitLoadRequest
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    /**
     * @param  array{network: string, mobile_number: string, amount: int, authorized?: bool, locale?: string}  $data
     */
    public function handle(User $user, array $data): LoadRequest
    {
        $mobile = PhilippineFormats::mobileNumber($data['mobile_number']);

        $errors = array_filter([
            'network' => array_key_exists($data['network'], (array) config('load.networks')) ? null : 'Choose a network from the list.',
            'amount' => in_array($data['amount'], (array) config('load.amounts'), true) ? null : 'Choose an amount from the list.',
            'mobileNumber' => $mobile === null ? 'Enter a Philippine mobile number, e.g. 0917 123 4567.' : null,
            // Without it, there's no legal basis to take it from their pay.
            'authorized' => ($data['authorized'] ?? false) === true ? null : 'Tick the box to authorize the deduction from your payslip.',
        ]);

        if (! User::query()->whereKey($user->id)->onPayroll()->exists()) {
            $errors['amount'] = 'Borrow Load is for employees on payroll: it is deducted from your payslip.';
        }

        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages($errors);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($user, $data, $mobile) {
            // Lock the person, not the requests: two tabs submitting at once must count each other's request.
            User::query()->whereKey($user->id)->lockForUpdate()->first();

            if (LoadRequest::query()->where('user_id', $user->id)->open()->count() >= (int) config('load.max_open_requests')) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['amount' => 'You already have '.config('load.max_open_requests').' load requests waiting. Please wait for those first.']);
            }

            $loadRequest = new LoadRequest;
            $loadRequest->forceFill([
                'user_id' => $user->id,
                'network' => $data['network'],
                'mobile_number' => $mobile,
                'amount' => $data['amount'],
                'status' => LoadRequestStatus::Pending,
                'deduction_authorization' => LoadRequest::authorizationText($data['amount'], $data['locale'] ?? 'en'),
                'authorized_at' => now(),
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Load, 'load.submitted', "Requested ₱{$loadRequest->amount} {$loadRequest->networkLabel()} load on credit", $loadRequest, [
                'mobile_number' => $mobile,
            ], causer: $user);

            Notification::send(User::query()->notifiable(Ability::ManageLoadRequests->roles())->get(), new LoadRequestNotice($loadRequest, LoadRequestNotice::SUBMITTED));

            return $loadRequest;
        });
    }
}
app/Enums/LoadRequestStatus.php70 lines

<?php

namespace App\Enums;

/**
 * Load on credit:
 *
 *   pending ──approve (Admin sent the load)──▶ approved   → deducted on the next payslip
 *      ├──reject (reason)──▶ rejected
 *      └──cancel (employee)──▶ cancelled
 *
 * transitionsTo() is the single list of allowed moves; Actions ask it
 * instead of comparing statuses themselves.
 */
enum LoadRequestStatus: string
{
    case Pending = 'pending';
    case Approved = 'approved';
    case Rejected = 'rejected';
    case Cancelled = 'cancelled';

    public function label(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Pending => 'Waiting for approval',
            self::Approved => 'Approved',
            self::Rejected => 'Rejected',
            self::Cancelled => 'Cancelled',
        };
    }

    public function tone(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Pending => 'amber',
            self::Approved => 'blue',
            self::Rejected => 'red',
            self::Cancelled => 'gray',
        };
    }

    /**
     * @return list<self>
     */
    public function transitionsTo(): array
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Pending => [self::Approved, self::Rejected, self::Cancelled],
            self::Approved, self::Rejected, self::Cancelled => [],
        };
    }

    public function canMoveTo(self $next): bool
    {
        return in_array($next, $this->transitionsTo(), true);
    }

    public function isOpen(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Pending;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<self>
     */
    public static function open(): array
    {
        return [self::Pending];
    }
}

QuestionAnswer
Why create the deduction inside the approval transaction?So there's never an "approved" request without a deduction, or a deduction without an approval. Both commit together or not at all.
What if the payslip can't cover the load?Net pay never goes below ₱0. The Load deduction keeps its balance, and the next payslip takes it.
Why only employees on payroll?The money comes back through a payslip. Without one, there's nothing to deduct from.

  2. As Maria: Borrow Load → Smart, ₱200 → Send request.
  3. As admin@example.test: Load Requests → Approve → attach any screenshot → Approve and send receipt. Maria sees "Receipt"; generate her payslip and "Borrowed load: ₱200 Smart…" is deducted.
16

13th month pay

PD 851: 1/12 of the basic pay earned in the calendar year, paid by December 24. Accounting computes it from the year's generated payslips, reviews it, approves it (employees then see it on My Payslips) and marks it paid.

From frozen payslipsBasic pay minus late deductions, from payslip_records. Overtime, holiday premium, night differential and adjustments don't count. Every payout stores the cutoffs it came from.
Balance runsDecember 16–31 isn't generated by the 24th. Pay up to Dec 15, then run again up to Dec 31: it pays earned − already paid.
Approve what you sawIf a payslip was generated after the compute, Approve refuses, refreshes the draft, and asks for another look.
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> draft: Compute (year, covers until, pay date)
  draft --> draft: Recompute
  draft --> approved: Approve (re-checked against payslips)
  approved --> paid: Mark as paid
  draft --> [*]: Delete (drafts only)

<?php

namespace App\Queries\Payroll;

use App\Enums\FinalPayStatus;
use App\Enums\ThirteenthMonthStatus;
use App\Models\FinalPay;
use App\Models\PayslipRecord;
use App\Models\ThirteenthMonthPayout;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;

/**
 * Each employee's 13th month (PD 851) for a year, from generated payslips:
 *
 *   earned = (basic pay − late deductions) ÷ 12, over the year's payslips up to `coversUntil`
 *   amount = earned − what approved runs of the same year already paid
 *
 * Basic pay only: overtime, holiday premium, night differential and
 * adjustments are not part of it (Revised Guidelines on PD 851). Everyone with
 * a payslip in the year counts, including those who have since left.
 */
final class ThirteenthMonthBasisQuery
{
    /**
     * @return array<int, array{days_worked: int, basic_pay: float, late_deductions: float, earned: float, earlier_paid: float, amount: float, cutoffs: list<array{payroll_run_id: int, period: string, basic_pay: float, late_deduction: float}>}> keyed by user_id
     */
    public function handle(int $year, CarbonImmutable $coversUntil, ?int $exceptRunId = null): array
    {
        $rows = [];

        PayslipRecord::query()
            ->with('payrollRun')
            ->join('payroll_runs', 'payroll_runs.id', '=', 'payslip_records.payroll_run_id')
            ->whereDate('payroll_runs.end_date', '>=', "{$year}-01-01")
            ->whereDate('payroll_runs.end_date', '<=', min($coversUntil->toDateString(), "{$year}-12-31"))
            ->orderBy('payroll_runs.start_date')
            ->select('payslip_records.*')
            ->orderBy('payslip_records.id')
            ->lazy(500)
            ->each(function (PayslipRecord $record) use (&$rows) {
                $row = $rows[$record->user_id] ?? ['days_worked' => 0, 'basic_pay' => 0.0, 'late_deductions' => 0.0, 'earned' => 0.0, 'earlier_paid' => 0.0, 'amount' => 0.0, 'cutoffs' => []];
                $row['days_worked'] += $record->days_worked;
                $row['basic_pay'] += (float) $record->basic_pay;
                $row['late_deductions'] += (float) $record->late_deduction;
                $row['cutoffs'][] = ['payroll_run_id' => $record->payroll_run_id, 'period' => $record->payrollRun->periodLabel(), 'basic_pay' => (float) $record->basic_pay, 'late_deduction' => (float) $record->late_deduction];
                $rows[$record->user_id] = $row;
            });

        $earlier = ThirteenthMonthPayout::query()
            ->whereHas('run', fn ($run) => $run->where('year', $year)->whereIn('status', [ThirteenthMonthStatus::Approved, ThirteenthMonthStatus::Paid])->when($exceptRunId, fn ($q) => $q->whereKeyNot($exceptRunId)))
            ->selectRaw('user_id, SUM(amount) as paid')
            ->groupBy('user_id')
            ->pluck('paid', 'user_id');

        // Also what a released final pay already paid (someone who resigned): December's run must not pay it again.
        FinalPay::query()->where('status', FinalPayStatus::Released)->where('thirteenth_year', $year)
            ->selectRaw('user_id, SUM(thirteenth_amount) as paid')->groupBy('user_id')->pluck('paid', 'user_id')
            ->each(function (mixed $paid, int $userId) use (&$earlier) {
                $earlier[$userId] = (float) ($earlier[$userId] ?? 0) + (float) $paid;
            });

        foreach ($rows as $userId => $row) {
            $row['basic_pay'] = round($row['basic_pay'], 2);
            $row['late_deductions'] = round($row['late_deductions'], 2);
            $row['earned'] = round(max(0, $row['basic_pay'] - $row['late_deductions']) / 12, 2);
            $row['earlier_paid'] = round((float) ($earlier[$userId] ?? 0), 2);
            $row['amount'] = round(max(0, $row['earned'] - $row['earlier_paid']), 2);
            $rows[$userId] = $row;
        }

        return $rows;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Payroll;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\ThirteenthMonthStatus;
use App\Models\ThirteenthMonthRun;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\UpdateNotice;
use App\Queries\Payroll\ThirteenthMonthBasisQuery;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * draft → approved → paid.
 *
 *  - approving re-checks the numbers against the payslips: if a payslip was
 *    generated since the last compute, the draft is refreshed and nothing is
 *    approved, so what Accounting approves is what they saw;
 *  - marking paid stamps paid_at on every payout.
 */
final class AdvanceThirteenthMonthRun
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ThirteenthMonthBasisQuery $basis,
        private readonly RecomputeThirteenthMonthRun $recompute,
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {}

    public function handle(ThirteenthMonthRun $run, User $actor): ThirteenthMonthRun
    {
        // Outside the approval transaction: the refresh must stay saved when approval is refused.
        $changed = DB::transaction(function () use ($run) {
            $locked = ThirteenthMonthRun::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($run->id);

            if ($locked->status !== ThirteenthMonthStatus::Draft || ($changed = $this->changedSinceCompute($locked)) === 0) {
                return 0;
            }

            $this->recompute->fill($locked);

            return $changed;
        });

        if ($changed > 0) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['run' => "{$changed} employee(s) changed since the last compute (new payslips). The amounts are updated: review them and approve again."]);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($run, $actor) {
            $locked = ThirteenthMonthRun::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($run->id);
            $from = $locked->status;
            $to = $from->next();

            if ($to === null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['run' => 'This 13th month run is already paid.']);
            }

            $locked->status = $to;
            $locked->save();

            if ($to === ThirteenthMonthStatus::Paid) {
                $locked->payouts()->whereNull('paid_at')->update(['paid_at' => now()]);

                // Everyone paid hears it, with their own amount.
                foreach ($locked->payouts()->with('user')->get() as $payout) {
                    UpdateNotice::tell($payout->user, $actor, '13th month pay released: ₱'.number_format((float) $payout->amount, 2),
                        "Your {$locked->label()}. See it on My Payslips.", route('payslips'), 'gift', email: true);
                }
            }

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Payroll, 'thirteenth_month.'.$to->value, "Moved {$locked->label()} to {$to->label()}", $locked, [
                'old' => ['status' => $from->value],
                'new' => ['status' => $to->value],
                'total' => (float) $locked->payouts()->sum('amount'),
            ], causer: $actor);

            return $locked;
        });
    }

    private function changedSinceCompute(ThirteenthMonthRun $run): int
    {
        $fresh = $this->basis->handle($run->year, $run->covers_until, $run->id);
        $stored = $run->payouts()->pluck('amount', 'user_id')->map(fn ($amount) => (float) $amount)->all();

        $changed = count(array_diff_key($stored, $fresh));

        foreach ($fresh as $userId => $row) {
            if (! array_key_exists($userId, $stored) || abs($stored[$userId] - $row['amount']) > 0.004) {
                $changed++;
            }
        }

        return $changed;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Payroll;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\ThirteenthMonthStatus;
use App\Models\ThirteenthMonthRun;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Creates a draft 13th month run and computes it. One draft per year at a
 * time, and a balance run must cover more of the year than the approved ones.
 */
final class CreateThirteenthMonthRun
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly RecomputeThirteenthMonthRun $recompute,
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {}

    public function handle(int $year, CarbonImmutable $coversUntil, CarbonImmutable $payDate, User $actor): ThirteenthMonthRun
    {
        if ($coversUntil->year !== $year) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['coversUntil' => "Pick a date in {$year}."]);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($year, $coversUntil, $payDate, $actor) {
            $runs = ThirteenthMonthRun::query()->where('year', $year)->lockForUpdate()->get();

            if ($runs->contains(fn (ThirteenthMonthRun $run) => $run->status === ThirteenthMonthStatus::Draft)) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['year' => "There is already a draft for {$year}. Approve or delete it first."]);
            }

            $lastCovered = $runs->max(fn (ThirteenthMonthRun $run) => $run->covers_until->toDateString());

            if (is_string($lastCovered) && $coversUntil->toDateString() <= $lastCovered) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['coversUntil' => 'An approved run already covers up to '.CarbonImmutable::parse($lastCovered)->format('M j, Y').'. A balance run must cover later than that.']);
            }

            $run = new ThirteenthMonthRun;
            $run->forceFill(['year' => $year, 'covers_until' => $coversUntil->toDateString(), 'pay_date' => $payDate->toDateString(), 'created_by' => $actor->id])->save();

            $count = $this->recompute->fill($run);

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Payroll, 'thirteenth_month.created', "Created {$run->label()} for {$count} employee(s)", $run, [
                'total' => (float) $run->payouts()->sum('amount'),
            ], causer: $actor);

            return $run;
        });
    }
}
QuestionAnswer
Why only generated payslips?An estimate can still change. A frozen payslip is what the employee was actually paid for, so the 13th month can always be explained.
Why does the approve step refresh outside its transaction?Approval is refused by throwing an error, and the error would roll back the refresh too. The refresh is committed first, then the refusal is raised.
Is it taxed?Up to ₱90,000 with other benefits is exempt (RA 10963). Anyone above gets an "excess taxable" badge for the year-end adjustment; nothing is withheld here.
Try it
  1. As Accounting: 13th Month Pay → New 13th month run → Compute.
  2. Click a name to see the cutoffs counted, then Approve.
  3. As that employee: My Payslips shows the 13th month card.

Clients by region

Operation HQ or Admin (or the Super Admin) files every client site by where it is, before HR onboards guards there: Region → Province → Client (Region IV-A → Cavite → Metrobank – Imus). A guard's detachment is a client. It's the deployment site, never their home address.

Fixed listsRegion::provinces() holds every region's provinces (NCR: cities), so "cavite" can never become a second Cavite. SaveClient re-checks the province belongs to the region.
Name kept as textemployee_profiles.detachment still holds the client's name, so every old screen works. A rename updates it in the same transaction.
Nothing lostA detachment typed before clients existed stays until HR picks the client; editing a phone number never erases it.

<?php

namespace App\Enums;

/**
 * Philippine administrative regions, used for where CLIENTS are (the sites
 * guards are deployed to), never for anyone's home address.
 *
 * Provinces are listed here, so a client's province is always one of these
 * and "cavite" / "Cavite " can't split one province in two. NCR has no
 * provinces, so it lists its cities. Boundaries do change (Negros Island
 * Region, RA 12000 of 2024; Sulu leaving BARMM, SC 2024): edit the list here.
 */
enum Region: string
{
    case Ncr = 'ncr';
    case Car = 'car';
    case IlocosRegion = 'r1';
    case CagayanValley = 'r2';

    case Soccsksargen = 'r12';
    case Caraga = 'caraga';
    case Barmm = 'barmm';

    /** The short name people use: "Region IV-A", "NCR". */

    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Ncr => 'NCR',
            self::Car => 'CAR',
            self::IlocosRegion => 'Region I',

            self::CentralLuzon => 'Region III',

            self::Bicol => 'Region V',
            self::WesternVisayas => 'Region VI',
            self::NegrosIsland => 'NIR',
            self::CentralVisayas => 'Region VII',
            self::EasternVisayas => 'Region VIII',
            self::ZamboangaPeninsula => 'Region IX',
            self::NorthernMindanao => 'Region X',
            self::Davao => 'Region XI',
            self::Soccsksargen => 'Region XII',
            self::Caraga => 'Region XIII',
            self::Barmm => 'BARMM',
        };
    }

    public function officialName(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Ncr => 'National Capital Region',
            self::Car => 'Cordillera Administrative Region',
            self::IlocosRegion => 'Ilocos Region',
            self::CagayanValley => 'Cagayan Valley',
            self::CentralLuzon => 'Central Luzon',
            self::Calabarzon => 'CALABARZON',
            self::Mimaropa => 'MIMAROPA',
            self::Bicol => 'Bicol Region',
            self::WesternVisayas => 'Western Visayas',
            self::NegrosIsland => 'Negros Island Region',
            self::CentralVisayas => 'Central Visayas',
            self::EasternVisayas => 'Eastern Visayas',
            self::ZamboangaPeninsula => 'Zamboanga Peninsula',
            self::NorthernMindanao => 'Northern Mindanao',
            self::Davao => 'Davao Region',
            self::Soccsksargen => 'SOCCSKSARGEN',
            self::Caraga => 'Caraga',
            self::Barmm => 'Bangsamoro (BARMM)',
        };
    }

    /** "Region IV-A · CALABARZON" */
    public function fullLabel(): string
    {
        return $this->label() === $this->officialName() ? $this->label() : $this->label().' · '.$this->officialName();
    }

    /** What the second level is called: NCR has cities, the rest provinces. */
    public function areaLabel(): string
    {
        return $this === self::Ncr ? 'City' : 'Province';
    }

    /**
