    public function provinces(): array
    {
        return match ($this) {

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Settings;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\Region;
use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Adds or edits a client site (Region → Province → Client). Guards deployed
 * there carry the client's name as their detachment, so a rename updates them
 * in the same transaction.
 */
final class SaveClient
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    /**
     * @param  array{region: Region, province: string, name: string, site_address: string|null, latitude: float|null, longitude: float|null, geofence_meters: int, contact_person: string|null, contact_number: string|null}  $data
     */
    public function handle(?Client $client, array $data, User $actor): Client
    {
        if (($data['latitude'] === null) !== ($data['longitude'] === null)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['coordinates' => 'Enter both latitude and longitude, or neither.']);
        }

        if ($data['geofence_meters'] < 30 || $data['geofence_meters'] > 2000) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['geofence_meters' => 'Use a radius between 30 m and 2,000 m.']);
        }

        // Re-checked here, not only in the form: the province must belong to the region.
        if (! in_array($data['province'], $data['region']->provinces(), true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['province' => "Choose a {$data['region']->areaLabel()} in {$data['region']->label()}."]);
        }

        $duplicate = Client::query()
            ->where('region', $data['region']->value)
            ->where('province', $data['province'])
            ->where('name', $data['name'])
            ->when($client, fn ($query, Client $existing) => $query->whereKeyNot($existing->id))
            ->exists();

        if ($duplicate) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['name' => "{$data['name']} is already listed in {$data['province']}. Add the branch to the name (e.g. \"{$data['name']} – Imus\")."]);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($client, $data, $actor) {
            $isNew = $client === null;
            $client ??= new Client;
            $fields = ['region', 'province', 'name', 'site_address', 'latitude', 'longitude', 'geofence_meters', 'contact_person', 'contact_number'];
            $before = $isNew ? [] : [...$client->only($fields), 'region' => $client->region->value];
            $oldName = $isNew ? null : $client->name;

            $client->fill($data)->save();

            if ($oldName !== null && $oldName !== $client->name) {
                EmployeeProfile::query()->where('client_id', $client->id)->update(['detachment' => $client->name]);
            }

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Settings, $isNew ? 'client.created' : 'client.updated', "Saved client {$client->name} ({$client->locationLabel()})", $client,
                AuditLogger::diff($before, [...$client->only($fields), 'region' => $client->region->value]), causer: $actor);

            return $client;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\People;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\Shift;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\UpdateNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Moves a guard: their client (detachment), post and shift. Nothing else on
 * the record. Operations does this without HR's full edit access; a
 * Satellite Operation only for guards in their region, and only to a client
 * in their region.
 */
final class DeployEmployee
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function handle(EmployeeProfile $profile, ?Client $client, ?string $post, ?Shift $shift, User $actor): EmployeeProfile
    {
        if (! $actor->can(Ability::DeployGuards->value) || ! $actor->canSeeProfile($profile)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        if (! $profile->hasDeployment()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['deployClientId' => 'Office staff are not deployed to a client.']);
        }

        if ($client !== null && $actor->isRegionallyLimited() && $client->region !== $actor->operations_region) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['deployClientId' => 'Choose a client in your region.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($profile, $client, $post, $shift, $actor) {
            $fields = ['client_id', 'detachment', 'post', 'shift_id'];
            $before = $profile->only($fields);

            $profile->forceFill([
                'client_id' => $client?->id,
                'detachment' => $client?->name,
                'post' => filled($post) ? trim($post) : null,
            ]);
            $profile->shift()->associate($shift);
            $profile->save();

            $changes = AuditLogger::diff($before, $profile->only($fields));

            if ($changes['new'] !== []) {
                $this->audit->record(AuditArea::People, 'profile.deployed', "Deployed {$profile->name} to ".($client !== null ? "{$client->name} ({$client->locationLabel()})" : 'no client'), $profile, $changes, causer: $actor);
                // The guard reports somewhere new: they hear it from the app, not only by word of mouth.
                UpdateNotice::tellProfile($profile, $actor, 'Your deployment changed', $profile->assignmentLabel().($shift !== null ? ' · '.$shift->label() : '').'.', route('attendance'), 'map-pin', email: true);
            }

            return $profile;
        });
    }
}

Today at the site

The guards window shows each guard's attendance right now: On duty (late minutes), Not in yet (within grace), No clock-in (grace over), Absent · needs reliever (a notice nobody covered), covered, on leave, or shift not started. It counts them, warns how many posts may be uncovered with a link to Relievers, and refreshes every minute. A night guard counts against last night's shift until it ends.

app/Queries/Attendance/ClientAttendanceTodayQuery.php198 lines
Copied from the repository as it is today
<?php

namespace App\Queries\Attendance;

use App\Enums\AbsenceNoticeStatus;
use App\Models\AbsenceNotice;
use App\Models\AwayLog;
use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\DutyAssignment;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\Holiday;
use App\Models\LeaveRequest;
use App\Models\Shift;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use App\Services\Attendance\AttendanceCalculator;
use App\Support\Duration;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * Who is at a client's posts right now, so Operations can see a missing
 * guard and send a reliever. One row per guard deployed there, in a few
 * bulk queries (no N+1), plus the relievers covering the site today.
 *
 * "Today" is the guard's current duty day: before a night shift's end
 * (e.g. 03:00 on a 22:00–06:00 shift) that's yesterday's shift.
 *
 * States, in this order (a real clock-in always wins):
 *   away       – clocked in but left the post (reason, minutes; red past the limit)
 *   on_duty, clocked_out  – from the time log (red when a patrol round was missed)
 *   absent_covered / absent_open – an absence notice for the day
 *   off        – on the roster, but no duty today
 *   on_leave, holiday
 *   upcoming   – the shift hasn't started
 *   not_in     – started, no clock-in: "Not in yet" within grace,
 *                "No clock-in" after it, "Absent · no clock-in" once the shift ended
 *
 * @phpstan-type GuardToday array{state: string, label: string, detail: string|null, tone: string, attention: bool}
 * @phpstan-type Relief array{reliever: string, for: string, post: string|null}
 */
final class ClientAttendanceTodayQuery
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AttendanceCalculator $calculator,
        private readonly PatrolRoundsQuery $patrolRounds,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, EmployeeProfile>  $guards  the client's guards, with `shift` loaded
     * @return array{rows: array<int, GuardToday>, relief: list<Relief>}
     */
    public function handle(Client $client, Collection $guards, ?CarbonImmutable $now = null): array
    {
        $now ??= CarbonImmutable::now();
        $today = $now->startOfDay();
        $fallback = Shift::fallback();

        $userIds = $guards->pluck('user_id')->filter()->values();
        $from = $today->subDay();
        $window = (int) config('attendance.roster_window_days');

        // The roster decides the schedule: yesterday's or today's duty, whichever is running.
        $duties = DutyAssignment::query()->with('shift')->whereIn('user_id', $userIds)
            ->whereDate('duty_date', '>=', $from->toDateString())->whereDate('duty_date', '<=', $today->toDateString())
            ->get()
            ->keyBy(fn (DutyAssignment $duty) => $duty->user_id.'|'.$duty->duty_date->toDateString());

        $onRoster = DutyAssignment::query()->whereIn('user_id', $userIds)
            ->whereDate('duty_date', '>=', $today->subDays($window)->toDateString())->whereDate('duty_date', '<=', $today->addDays($window)->toDateString())
            ->distinct()->pluck('user_id')->flip();

        // Each guard's [duty day, shift], or null for a rostered guard with no duty (a day off).
        $schedules = $guards->mapWithKeys(function (EmployeeProfile $guard) use ($today, $from, $now, $fallback, $duties, $onRoster) {
            $yesterdays = $duties->get($guard->user_id.'|'.$from->toDateString());
            $todays = $duties->get($guard->user_id.'|'.$today->toDateString());

            if ($yesterdays !== null && $now->lt($this->calculator->shiftWindow($yesterdays->shift, $from)[1])) {
                return [$guard->id => [$from, $yesterdays->shift]];
            }

            if ($todays !== null) {
                return [$guard->id => [$today, $todays->shift]];
            }

            if ($guard->user_id !== null && $onRoster->has($guard->user_id)) {
                return [$guard->id => null];
            }

            // Not on the roster: their usual shift, counting last night's while it runs.
            $shift = $guard->shift ?? $fallback;
            [, $end] = $this->calculator->shiftWindow($shift, $from);

            return [$guard->id => [$shift->crossesMidnight() && $now->lt($end) ? $from : $today, $shift]];
        });

        $logs = TimeLog::query()->whereIn('user_id', $userIds)->between($from, $today)->get()
            ->keyBy(fn (TimeLog $log) => $log->user_id.'|'.$log->log_date->toDateString());

        $notices = AbsenceNotice::query()->whereIn('user_id', $userIds)
            ->whereDate('duty_date', '>=', $from->toDateString())->whereDate('duty_date', '<=', $today->toDateString())
            ->whereNotIn('status', [AbsenceNoticeStatus::Cancelled, AbsenceNoticeStatus::Arrived])
            ->with('reliever:id,name')
            ->get()
            ->keyBy(fn (AbsenceNotice $notice) => $notice->user_id.'|'.$notice->duty_date->toDateString());

        $leaves = LeaveRequest::query()->approved()->whereIn('user_id', $userIds)->overlapping($from, $today)->get(['user_id', 'start_date', 'end_date']);

        $holidays = Holiday::query()->whereDate('date', '>=', $from->toDateString())->whereDate('date', '<=', $today->toDateString())
            ->pluck('date')->map(fn ($date) => CarbonImmutable::parse($date)->toDateString())->flip();

        $away = AwayLog::query()->open()->with('latestLocation')->whereIn('user_id', $userIds)->get()->keyBy('user_id');

        $rows = [];

        foreach ($guards as $guard) {
            $schedule = $schedules[$guard->id];

            if ($schedule === null) {
                $rows[$guard->id] = ['state' => 'off', 'label' => 'Day off', 'detail' => 'Not on the roster today', 'tone' => 'gray', 'attention' => false];

                continue;
            }

            /** @var CarbonImmutable $day */
            [$day, $shift] = $schedule;
            $key = $guard->user_id.'|'.$day->toDateString();
            [$start, $end] = $this->calculator->shiftWindow($shift, $day);

            $log = $guard->user_id === null ? null : $logs->get($key);

            $rows[$guard->id] = $this->state(
                $log,
                $guard->user_id === null ? null : $notices->get($key),
                $leaves->contains(fn (LeaveRequest $leave) => $leave->user_id === $guard->user_id && $leave->start_date->lte($day) && $leave->end_date->gte($day)),
                $holidays->has($day->toDateString()),
                $start,
                $start->addMinutes($shift->grace_minutes),
                $end,
                $now,
                $guard->user_id === null ? null : $away->get($guard->user_id),
                $log?->isOpen() ? collect($this->patrolRounds->handle($log, $now)['rounds'])->where('state', 'missed')->count() : 0,
            );
        }

        $relief = array_values(AbsenceNotice::query()
            ->where('client_id', $client->id)
            ->where('status', AbsenceNoticeStatus::Covered)
            ->whereDate('duty_date', $today->toDateString())
            ->with(['reliever:id,name', 'user:id,name'])
            ->get()
            ->map(fn (AbsenceNotice $notice) => ['reliever' => $notice->reliever->name ?? '—', 'for' => $notice->user->name, 'post' => $notice->post])
            ->all());

        return ['rows' => $rows, 'relief' => $relief];
    }

    /**
     * @return GuardToday
     */
    private function state(?TimeLog $log, ?AbsenceNotice $notice, bool $onLeave, bool $holiday, CarbonImmutable $start, CarbonImmutable $graceEnd, CarbonImmutable $end, CarbonImmutable $now, ?AwayLog $away = null, int $missedRounds = 0): array
    {
        $at = fn (?CarbonImmutable $time) => $time?->format('g:i A');

        return match (true) {
            $log?->isOpen() === true && $away !== null => [
                'state' => 'away',
                'label' => 'Away · '.$away->reason->label(),
                'detail' => 'Since '.$at($away->left_at).' · back by '.$at($away->expectedBackAt()).($away->note ? ' · '.$away->note : '').($away->approved_at ? ' · approved' : '').($away->isLocationOverdue($now) ? ' · location overdue' : ''),
                'tone' => $away->needsAttention($now) ? 'red' : 'amber',
                'attention' => $away->needsAttention($now),
            ],
            $log?->isOpen() === true && $missedRounds > 0 => [
                'state' => 'on_duty',
                'label' => 'On duty · round missed',
                'detail' => "{$missedRounds} patrol ".str('round')->plural($missedRounds).' missed today',
                'tone' => 'red',
                'attention' => true,
            ],
            $log?->clock_in_at !== null && $log->clock_out_at === null => [
                'state' => 'on_duty',
                'label' => 'On duty',
                'detail' => 'In at '.$at($log->clock_in_at).($log->late_minutes > 0 ? ' · '.Duration::minutes($log->late_minutes).' late' : ''),
                'tone' => $log->late_minutes > 0 ? 'amber' : 'blue',
                'attention' => false,
            ],
            $log?->clock_in_at !== null => ['state' => 'clocked_out', 'label' => 'Clocked out', 'detail' => $at($log->clock_in_at).' – '.$at($log->clock_out_at), 'tone' => 'gray', 'attention' => false],
            $notice !== null && $notice->status === AbsenceNoticeStatus::Covered => ['state' => 'absent_covered', 'label' => ($notice->isNoShow() ? 'No-show' : 'Absent').' · covered', 'detail' => 'Reliever: '.($notice->reliever->name ?? '—'), 'tone' => 'blue', 'attention' => false],
            $notice !== null && $notice->isNoShow() => ['state' => 'absent_open', 'label' => 'No-show · needs reliever', 'detail' => 'No clock-in and no notice; Operations was alerted', 'tone' => 'red', 'attention' => true],
            $notice !== null => ['state' => 'absent_open', 'label' => 'Absent · needs reliever', 'detail' => 'Sent notice: '.$notice->reason, 'tone' => 'red', 'attention' => true],
            $onLeave => ['state' => 'on_leave', 'label' => 'On leave', 'detail' => null, 'tone' => 'gray', 'attention' => false],
            $holiday => ['state' => 'holiday', 'label' => 'Holiday', 'detail' => null, 'tone' => 'gray', 'attention' => false],
            $now->lt($start) => ['state' => 'upcoming', 'label' => 'Shift not started', 'detail' => 'Starts '.$at($start), 'tone' => 'gray', 'attention' => false],
            $now->gte($end) => ['state' => 'not_in', 'label' => 'Absent · no clock-in', 'detail' => 'Shift ended '.$at($end).' with no notice', 'tone' => 'red', 'attention' => true],
            $now->gt($graceEnd) => ['state' => 'not_in', 'label' => 'No clock-in', 'detail' => 'Shift started '.$at($start).', grace over', 'tone' => 'red', 'attention' => true],
            default => ['state' => 'not_in', 'label' => 'Not in yet', 'detail' => 'Shift started '.$at($start).', within grace', 'tone' => 'amber', 'attention' => false],
        };
    }
}

Lists by client site

Employees and Attendance Log have a Client site bar: Region → Province → Client, or "Office staff (no client)". Each pick clears the ones after it, the choice stays in the URL (?region=r4a&province=Cavite) so a filtered list can be bookmarked, and only places with clients are offered. It goes by the client a person is deployed to, so a reliever's punches at another site stay under their own detachment.

Why a trait? Two pages, one behaviour: FiltersByArea holds the three URL properties, the clearing rules and filterProfilesByArea(); each page only applies it to its own query (the log through timeLog.user.employeeProfile). The next list that needs it adds one use line and one @include.

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Concerns;

use App\Enums\Region;
use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;

/**
 * Region → province → client filters for a list of people, by the client
 * they're deployed to (not their home address). "Office staff" is a choice
 * of its own: they have no client. Each pick clears the ones after it, and
 * the lists only offer places that have clients (a Satellite Operation: its
 * own region only, as they see nothing else anyway).
 *
 * The page applies it with filterProfilesByArea() on an EmployeeProfile query
 * (or rowInArea() on roster rows), and uses InteractsWithUser.
 */
trait FiltersByArea
{
    /** areaRegion's value for office staff (no client). */
    public const string OFFICE = 'office';

    #[Url(as: 'region', except: '')]
    public string $areaRegion = '';

    #[Url(as: 'province', except: '')]
    public string $areaProvince = '';

    #[Url(as: 'client', except: '')]
    public string $areaClient = '';

    public function updatedAreaRegion(): void
    {
        $this->reset(['areaProvince', 'areaClient']);
        $this->backToFirstPage();
    }

    public function updatedAreaProvince(): void
    {
        $this->reset(['areaClient']);
        $this->backToFirstPage();
    }

    public function updatedAreaClient(): void
    {
        $this->backToFirstPage();
    }

    public function clearArea(): void
    {
        $this->reset(['areaRegion', 'areaProvince', 'areaClient']);
        $this->backToFirstPage();
    }

    /**
     * Whether a TodayRosterQuery row is in the chosen area: for a list filtered
     * in PHP (the dashboard's DTR) rather than in SQL.
     *
     * @param  array{office: bool, region: string|null, province: string|null, clientId: int|null}  $row
     */
    public function rowInArea(array $row): bool
    {
        return match (true) {
            $this->areaRegion === '' => true,
            $this->areaRegion === self::OFFICE => $row['office'],
            $this->areaClient !== '' => $row['clientId'] === (int) $this->areaClient,
            default => $row['region'] === $this->areaRegion && ($this->areaProvince === '' || $row['province'] === $this->areaProvince),
        };
    }

    /**
     * A Satellite Operation is offered its own region only, since the list shows no one
     * else. A page that shows every region to them (the dashboard) overrides this.
     */
    protected function limitsAreaToOwnRegion(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /** Paginated lists go back to page 1; the dashboard has no pages. */
    private function backToFirstPage(): void
    {
        if (method_exists($this, 'resetPage')) {
            $this->resetPage();
        }
    }

    public function hasAreaFilter(): bool
    {
        return $this->areaRegion !== '';
    }

    /**
     * @return list<Region>
     */
    public function areaRegions(): array
    {
        $own = $this->limitsAreaToOwnRegion() ? $this->currentUser()->operations_region : null;
        $used = Client::query()->distinct()->pluck('region')->map(fn (Region $region) => $region->value)->all();

        return array_values(array_filter(Region::cases(), fn (Region $region) => in_array($region->value, $used, true) && ($own === null || $own === $region)));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function areaProvinces(): array
    {
        if (Region::tryFrom($this->areaRegion) === null) {
            return [];
        }

        return array_values(Client::query()->where('region', $this->areaRegion)->orderBy('province')->get(['province'])
            ->map(fn (Client $client): string => $client->province)
            ->filter()->unique()->all());
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, Client>
     */
    public function areaClients(): Collection
    {
        if (Region::tryFrom($this->areaRegion) === null) {
            return new Collection;
        }

        return Client::query()
            ->where('region', $this->areaRegion)
            ->when($this->areaProvince !== '', fn ($query) => $query->where('province', $this->areaProvince))
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get();
    }

    /**
     * @param  Builder<EmployeeProfile>  $profiles
     * @return Builder<EmployeeProfile>
     */
    protected function filterProfilesByArea(Builder $profiles): Builder
    {
        if ($this->areaRegion === self::OFFICE) {
            return $profiles->where('is_office_staff', true);
        }

        if (Region::tryFrom($this->areaRegion) === null) {
            return $profiles;
        }

        if ($this->areaClient !== '') {
            return $profiles->where('client_id', (int) $this->areaClient);
        }

        return $profiles->whereHas('client', fn ($client) => $client
            ->where('region', $this->areaRegion)
            ->when($this->areaProvince !== '', fn ($query) => $query->where('province', $this->areaProvince)));
    }
}

Report Absence & relievers

A guard who can't report tells Operations ahead of time; Operation HQ or the region's Satellite sends a reliever to the post. It isn't leave: it doesn't excuse the day or touch payroll.

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> open: guard files (date, reason) → HQ + region's Satellite notified
  [*] --> open: no-show (grace over, no clock-in, no notice) → alert + who can hold the post
  open --> open: still uncovered 30 min later → HQ alerted again
  open --> covered: Assign reliever → reliever + guard notified
  covered --> covered: Change reliever
  open --> cancelled: guard cancels (not a no-show)
  open --> arrived: the no-show clocks in after all
  open --> not_covered: the day passed with no reliever (daily 00:15)

Not covered. An absence still open after its day becomes Not covered (CloseUncoveredAbsences), with a red badge and its own tab. It's kept and audited, because "was the post manned?" is what a client asks. Before, such rows stayed "Needs reliever" forever and buried the real ones.

No-shows: the guard who forgot to report

Every 5 minutes DetectNoShows looks at the roster: a duty whose grace period ended, with no clock-in, no notice and no approved leave, becomes a notice with source = no_show. It goes on the Relievers board first, and Operation HQ and the region's Satellite get a live alert that names whoever is still clocked in at that client ("Pedro Reyes (Night Duty, until 6:00 AM) is still clocked in there: ask them to stay"). Only rostered guards are checked: without a roster there's no day off on record. A test caught a real edge: a reliever sent at 6:11 for a 6:00 shift was flagged at once, so a late reliever gets an hour to arrive.

Once, safelyThe notice is created under the same user lock Report Absence takes, and the escalation is claimed in sent_alerts: running twice sends nothing twice.
Closes itselfRecordPunch calls RecordNoShowArrival: nobody sent yet → "Arrived late"; a reliever already sent → stays covered, Operations decides who stays.
Nearest and restedRelievers are listed same site → same province → same region, with tap-to-call numbers; anyone still on duty or off a shift under 8 hours ago isn't offered.

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Relievers;

use App\Enums\AbsenceNoticeStatus;
use App\Enums\AbsenceSource;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Models\AbsenceNotice;
use App\Models\DutyAssignment;
use App\Models\LeaveRequest;
use App\Models\SentAlert;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\NoShowAlert;
use App\Queries\Operations\HoldoverQuery;
use App\Services\Attendance\AttendanceCalculator;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;

/**
 * Run every 5 minutes. A guard who forgot (or didn't bother) to report an
 * absence must not leave a post empty for hours:
 *
 *  1. A duty on the roster whose grace period is over, with no clock-in, no
 *     notice and no approved leave, becomes a no-show: an absence notice
 *     (source no_show) on the Relievers board, and an alert to Operation HQ
 *     and the region's Satellite Operation. The alert names whoever is still
 *     clocked in at that client, who could stay until a reliever arrives.
 *  2. Any absence still uncovered `attendance.no_show.escalate_after_minutes`
 *     after the grace period, or after it was raised if that was later
 *     (no-show or reported), alerts Operation HQ again, once.
 *
 * A reliever is a guard on a duty too, and can be a no-show. One sent after
 * the shift began counts only `reliever_travel_minutes` after being sent.
 *
 * Only duties on the roster count: a guard never put on it has no "day off"
 * on record, so a missing clock-in can't be told from a rest day.
 * Once a shift has ended there's nothing left to cover, so it's left alone.
 * Safe to run twice: a notice is created once per guard and day (checked
 * under a lock), and the escalation is claimed in sent_alerts.
 */
final class DetectNoShows
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AttendanceCalculator $calculator,
        private readonly HoldoverQuery $holdover,
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @return array{noShows: int, escalated: int}
     */
    public function handle(CarbonImmutable $now): array
    {
        $operations = User::query()->notifiable([Role::OperationsHq, Role::SatelliteOperations])->with('roles')->get();

        return ['noShows' => $this->detect($now, $operations), 'escalated' => $this->escalate($now, $operations)];
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, User>  $operations
     */
    private function detect(CarbonImmutable $now, Collection $operations): int
    {
        $duties = DutyAssignment::query()
            ->with(['shift', 'client', 'user'])
            ->whereDate('duty_date', '>=', $now->subDay()->toDateString())
            ->whereDate('duty_date', '<=', $now->toDateString())
            ->whereHas('user', fn ($user) => $user->onPayroll()->fieldStaff())
            ->whereDoesntHave('timeLog')
            ->get();

        $raised = 0;

        foreach ($duties as $duty) {
            [$start, $end] = $this->calculator->shiftWindow($duty->shift, $duty->duty_date);
            $due = $start->addMinutes($duty->shift->grace_minutes);

            // A reliever sent after the start (the duty was saved then) gets time to get there.
            if ($duty->isRelief()) {
                $due = $due->max($duty->updated_at->addMinutes((int) config('attendance.no_show.reliever_travel_minutes')));
            }

            if ($now->lte($due) || $now->gte($end)) {
                continue;
            }

            $notice = $this->raise($duty, $start);

            if ($notice !== null) {
                Notification::send($this->operationsFor($operations, $duty->client?->region), new NoShowAlert($notice, NoShowAlert::DETECTED, $this->holdover->first($notice)));
                $raised++;
            }
        }

        return $raised;
    }

    private function raise(DutyAssignment $duty, CarbonImmutable $start): ?AbsenceNotice
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($duty, $start) {
            // The same lock SubmitAbsenceNotice takes: a guard reporting right now can't race this.
            User::query()->whereKey($duty->user_id)->lockForUpdate()->first();
            $date = $duty->duty_date->toDateString();

            $accountedFor = TimeLog::query()->where('user_id', $duty->user_id)->whereDate('log_date', $date)->exists()
                || AbsenceNotice::query()->where('user_id', $duty->user_id)->whereDate('duty_date', $date)->where('status', '!=', AbsenceNoticeStatus::Cancelled)->exists()
                || LeaveRequest::query()->approved()->where('user_id', $duty->user_id)->overlapping($duty->duty_date, $duty->duty_date)->exists();

            if ($accountedFor) {
                return null;
            }

            $notice = new AbsenceNotice;
            $notice->forceFill([
                'user_id' => $duty->user_id,
                'duty_date' => $date,
                'source' => AbsenceSource::NoShow,
                // A relief duty missed too: the reliever didn't come either.
                'reason' => 'Duty from '.$start->format('g:i A').': '.($duty->isRelief() ? 'sent as a reliever, but didn\'t clock in.' : 'didn\'t clock in or report.'),
                'client_id' => $duty->client_id,
                'detachment' => $duty->client->name ?? null,
                'post' => $duty->post,
                'duty_assignment_id' => $duty->id,
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Operations, 'absence.no_show', "{$duty->user->name} didn't clock in or report for {$duty->placeLabel()} on {$duty->duty_date->format('M j, Y')}", $notice);

            return $notice->setRelation('user', $duty->user)->setRelation('dutyAssignment', $duty);
        });
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, User>  $operations
     */
    private function escalate(CarbonImmutable $now, Collection $operations): int
    {
        $headquarters = $operations->filter(fn (User $user) => $user->hasRole(Role::OperationsHq))->values();

        if ($headquarters->isEmpty()) {
            return 0;
        }

        $after = (int) config('attendance.no_show.escalate_after_minutes');
        $sent = 0;

        $open = AbsenceNotice::query()
            ->where('status', AbsenceNoticeStatus::Open)
            ->whereDate('duty_date', '>=', $now->subDay()->toDateString())
            ->whereDate('duty_date', '<=', $now->toDateString())
            ->with(['user.employeeProfile.shift', 'client', 'dutyAssignment.shift'])
            ->get();

        foreach ($open as $notice) {
            $window = $notice->dutyWindow();

            // From when the post was known to be empty: the grace end, or later if the absence surfaced later.
            if ($now->lt($window['graceEnd']->max($notice->created_at)->addMinutes($after)) || $now->gte($window['end'])) {
                continue;
            }

            $claimed = DB::transaction(fn () => SentAlert::claim('absence.escalated', $notice));

            if ($claimed) {
                Notification::send($headquarters, new NoShowAlert($notice, NoShowAlert::ESCALATED, $this->holdover->first($notice)));
                $sent++;
            }
        }

        return $sent;
    }

    /**
     * Operation HQ always; a Satellite Operation only for its own region.
     *
     * @param  Collection<int, User>  $operations
     * @return Collection<int, User>
     */
    private function operationsFor(Collection $operations, mixed $region): Collection
    {
        return $operations->filter(fn (User $user) => $user->hasRole(Role::OperationsHq) || ($region !== null && $user->operations_region === $region))->values();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Queries\Operations;

use App\Models\AbsenceNotice;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use App\Services\Attendance\AttendanceCalculator;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * Who could hold the post until a reliever arrives: guards still clocked in
 * at the same client right now. The guard going off at that very post (the
 * night guard when the day guard is missing) comes first, then whoever's
 * shift ends closest to the missing one's start.
 */
final class HoldoverQuery
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AttendanceCalculator $calculator) {}

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, array{name: string, label: string}>
     */
    public function handle(AbsenceNotice $notice): Collection
    {
        if ($notice->client_id === null) {
            return collect();
        }

        $start = $notice->dutyWindow()['start'];

        return TimeLog::query()
            ->whereNotNull('clock_in_at')->whereNull('clock_out_at')
            ->whereDate('log_date', '>=', $notice->duty_date->subDay()->toDateString())
            ->where('user_id', '!=', $notice->user_id)
            ->whereHas('dutyAssignment', fn ($duty) => $duty->where('client_id', $notice->client_id))
            ->with(['user:id,name', 'dutyAssignment.shift'])
            ->get()
            ->map(function (TimeLog $log) use ($notice, $start) {
                $duty = $log->dutyAssignment;
                $end = $duty !== null ? $this->calculator->shiftWindow($duty->shift, $log->log_date)[1] : $start;

                return [
                    'name' => $log->user->name,
                    'label' => $log->user->name.' ('.($duty->shift->name ?? 'on duty').', until '.$end->format('g:i A').($duty?->post ? ', '.$duty->post : '').')',
                    'samePost' => $notice->post !== null && $duty?->post === $notice->post,
                    'gap' => abs($end->diffInMinutes($start)),
                ];
            })
            ->sortBy([['samePost', 'desc'], ['gap', 'asc']])
            ->map(fn (array $row) => ['name' => $row['name'], 'label' => $row['label']])
            ->values();
    }

    /** "Pedro Reyes (Night Duty, until 6:00 AM, Main Entrance)", or null when nobody is there. */
    public function first(AbsenceNotice $notice): ?string
    {
        return $this->handle($notice)->first()['label'] ?? null;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Relievers;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AbsenceNoticeStatus;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Models\AbsenceNotice;
use App\Models\DutyAssignment;
use App\Models\Shift;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\RelieverAssigned;
use App\Queries\Operations\ReliefCandidatesQuery;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Sends a reliever to the absent guard's post. Assigning again replaces the
 * reliever (someone fell through), until the day has passed.
 *
 * The reliever must be on the candidate list (ReliefCandidatesQuery) when
 * this runs, so two people can't both be sent to cover the same day twice.
 *
 * The reliever gets a relief DUTY on the roster for that day: the absent
 * guard's duty (or usual shift) at their client and post. That's what lets
 * the reliever clock in there, inside that post's geofence. Changing the
 * reliever moves the duty, unless the first one already clocked in.
 */
final class AssignReliever
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ReliefCandidatesQuery $candidates,
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {}

    public function handle(AbsenceNotice $notice, User $reliever, ?string $note, User $actor): AbsenceNotice
    {
        if (! $actor->can(Ability::ManageRelievers->value)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($notice, $reliever, $note, $actor) {
            $locked = AbsenceNotice::query()->with(['user', 'client'])->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($notice->id);

            if (! $actor->canSeeEmployee($locked->user)) {
                throw new AuthorizationException;
            }

            if ($locked->status === AbsenceNoticeStatus::Cancelled) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['relieverId' => 'The guard cancelled this notice: they\'re reporting after all.']);
            }

            if ($locked->duty_date->lt(today())) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['relieverId' => 'This day has passed.']);
            }

            if (! $this->candidates->handle($locked, $actor)->contains('id', $reliever->id)) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['relieverId' => "{$reliever->name} can't relieve that day: on leave, absent, already relieving someone, or outside your region."]);
            }

            $previous = $locked->reliever_id;
            $this->moveReliefDuty($locked, $reliever, $actor);

            $locked->forceFill([
                'status' => AbsenceNoticeStatus::Covered,
                'reliever_id' => $reliever->id,
                'covered_by' => $actor->id,
                'covered_at' => now(),
                'cover_note' => filled($note) ? trim($note) : null,
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Operations, 'absence.covered', "{$reliever->name} relieves {$locked->user->name} at {$locked->placeLabel()} on {$locked->duty_date->format('M j, Y')}", $locked, [
                'old' => ['reliever_id' => $previous],
                'new' => ['reliever_id' => $reliever->id],
            ], causer: $actor);

            $locked->setRelation('reliever', $reliever);
            $reliever->notify(new RelieverAssigned($locked, forReliever: true));
            $locked->user->notify(new RelieverAssigned($locked, forReliever: false));

            return $locked;
        });
    }

    private function moveReliefDuty(AbsenceNotice $notice, User $reliever, User $actor): void
    {
        $existing = DutyAssignment::query()->where('absence_notice_id', $notice->id)->lockForUpdate()->first();

        if ($existing !== null && $existing->user_id !== $reliever->id) {
            if (TimeLog::query()->where('duty_assignment_id', $existing->id)->exists()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['relieverId' => 'The current reliever already clocked in for this duty.']);
            }

            $existing->delete();
            $existing = null;
        }

        $absentDuty = DutyAssignment::query()->where('user_id', $notice->user_id)->whereDate('duty_date', $notice->duty_date->toDateString())->first();
        $notice->user->loadMissing('employeeProfile');
        $fallback = Shift::fallback();
        $shiftId = $absentDuty->shift_id ?? $notice->user->employeeProfile->shift_id ?? ($fallback->exists ? $fallback->id : null);

        // No shift saved anywhere (a bare install before ShiftSeeder): nothing to roster.
        if ($shiftId === null) {
            return;
        }

        ($existing ?? new DutyAssignment)->forceFill([
            'user_id' => $reliever->id,
            'duty_date' => $notice->duty_date->toDateString(),
            'shift_id' => $shiftId,
            'client_id' => $notice->client_id,
            'post' => $notice->post,
            'absence_notice_id' => $notice->id,
            'assigned_by' => $actor->id,
        ])->save();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Queries\Operations;

use App\Enums\AbsenceNoticeStatus;
use App\Models\AbsenceNotice;
use App\Models\DutyAssignment;
use App\Models\LeaveRequest;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Attendance\AttendanceCalculator;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;

/**
 * Who can relieve on that day: active guards the viewer may see (a Satellite
 * Operation: its region), other than the absent one, who aren't on approved
 * leave, haven't sent their own absence notice, aren't already relieving
 * someone, and have no duty of their own on the roster that day (a reliever
 * comes from their day off).
 *
 * Nor anyone who wouldn't be rested: still clocked in, or off a shift that
 * ended less than `attendance.no_show.reliever_min_rest_hours` before this
 * duty starts (the night guard going home is no reliever for the day shift).
 *
 * Ordered by how close they are (closeness()): same client, then the same
 * province, then the same region, then everyone else, by name.
 */
final class ReliefCandidatesQuery
{
    public const SAME_SITE = 0;

    public const SAME_PROVINCE = 1;

    public const SAME_REGION = 2;

    public const ELSEWHERE = 3;

    public function __construct(private readonly AttendanceCalculator $calculator) {}

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, User>
     */
    public function handle(AbsenceNotice $notice, User $viewer): Collection
    {
        $date = CarbonImmutable::parse($notice->duty_date);
        $notice->loadMissing('client');

        // Absent that day (their own notice), relieving someone else, or on approved leave.
        $sameDay = AbsenceNotice::query()
            ->whereDate('duty_date', $date->toDateString())
            ->whereNotIn('status', [AbsenceNoticeStatus::Cancelled, AbsenceNoticeStatus::Arrived])
            ->whereKeyNot($notice->id)
            ->get(['user_id', 'reliever_id']);

        $busy = array_values(array_unique([
            $notice->user_id,
            ...$sameDay->pluck('user_id')->all(),
            ...$sameDay->pluck('reliever_id')->filter()->all(),
            ...LeaveRequest::query()->approved()->overlapping($date, $date)->pluck('user_id')->all(),
            // On duty that day already; this notice's own relief duty doesn't count.
            ...DutyAssignment::query()->whereDate('duty_date', $date->toDateString())
                ->where(fn ($query) => $query->whereNull('absence_notice_id')->orWhere('absence_notice_id', '!=', $notice->id))
                ->pluck('user_id')->all(),
            ...$this->notRested($notice, $date),
        ]));

        return User::query()
            ->onPayroll()
            ->visibleTo($viewer)
            ->whereHas('employeeProfile', fn ($profile) => $profile->where('is_office_staff', false))
            ->whereNotIn('id', $busy)
            ->with('employeeProfile.client')
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get()
            ->sortBy(fn (User $user) => self::closeness($user, $notice))
            ->values();
    }

    /** SAME_SITE, SAME_PROVINCE, SAME_REGION or ELSEWHERE: from the guard's usual client to the post to cover. */
    public static function closeness(User $user, AbsenceNotice $notice): int
    {
        $theirs = $user->employeeProfile?->client;
        $post = $notice->client;

        return match (true) {
            $theirs === null || $post === null => self::ELSEWHERE,
            $theirs->id === $post->id => self::SAME_SITE,
            $theirs->region === $post->region && $theirs->province === $post->province => self::SAME_PROVINCE,
            $theirs->region === $post->region => self::SAME_REGION,
            default => self::ELSEWHERE,
        };
    }

    /**
     * Still on duty, or off a shift too recently to work this one.
     *
     * @return list<int>
     */
    private function notRested(AbsenceNotice $notice, CarbonImmutable $date): array
    {
        $start = $notice->dutyWindow()['start'];
        $restedSince = $start->subHours((int) config('attendance.no_show.reliever_min_rest_hours'));

        $clocked = TimeLog::query()
            ->whereNotNull('clock_in_at')
            ->where('clock_in_at', '<', $start)
            ->where(fn ($log) => $log
                ->where(fn ($open) => $open->whereNull('clock_out_at')->whereDate('log_date', '>=', $date->subDay()->toDateString()))
                ->orWhere('clock_out_at', '>', $restedSince))
            ->pluck('user_id');

        // The roster the day before (for a day still to come, nobody has clocked anything yet).
        $rostered = DutyAssignment::query()->with('shift')->whereDate('duty_date', $date->subDay()->toDateString())->get()
            ->filter(fn (DutyAssignment $duty) => $this->calculator->shiftWindow($duty->shift, $duty->duty_date)[1]->gt($restedSince))
            ->pluck('user_id');

        return array_values($clocked->merge($rostered)->map(fn ($id) => (int) $id)->unique()->all());
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Relievers;

use App\Enums\AbsenceNoticeStatus;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Models\AbsenceNotice;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\AbsenceNoticeFiled;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * A guard says ahead of time they can't report for duty. Operation HQ, and
 * the Satellite Operation of the post's region, are told at once so they
 * can find a reliever.
 *
 * This is NOT leave: it doesn't excuse the day or touch payroll. It only
 * makes sure the post is covered. A planned day off still goes through My Leave.
 */
final class SubmitAbsenceNotice
{
    /** How far ahead a notice may be filed. */
    public const MAX_DAYS_AHEAD = 60;

    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function handle(User $guard, CarbonImmutable $dutyDate, string $reason): AbsenceNotice
    {
        $profile = $guard->employeeProfile()->with('client')->first();

        if ($profile === null || ! $profile->hasDeployment() || ! $profile->employment_status->isActive()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['dutyDate' => 'Only guards deployed to a post file absence notices. Office staff use My Leave.']);
        }

        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();

        if ($dutyDate->lt($today) || $dutyDate->gt($today->addDays(self::MAX_DAYS_AHEAD))) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['dutyDate' => 'Choose today or a day in the next '.self::MAX_DAYS_AHEAD.' days.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($guard, $profile, $dutyDate, $reason) {
            // Locked on the user, so two taps can't file the same day twice.
            User::query()->whereKey($guard->id)->lockForUpdate()->first();

            $existing = AbsenceNotice::query()
                ->where('user_id', $guard->id)
                ->whereDate('duty_date', $dutyDate->toDateString())
                ->where('status', '!=', AbsenceNoticeStatus::Cancelled)
                ->first();

            // Already flagged as a no-show: reporting late still tells Operations why. It stays a no-show.
            if ($existing !== null && $existing->isNoShow() && $existing->status !== AbsenceNoticeStatus::Arrived) {
                return $this->explainNoShow($existing, $guard, $reason);
            }

            if ($existing !== null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['dutyDate' => 'You already sent a notice for this day.']);
            }

            $notice = new AbsenceNotice;
            $notice->forceFill([
                'user_id' => $guard->id,
                'duty_date' => $dutyDate->toDateString(),
                'reason' => trim($reason),
                'client_id' => $profile->client_id,
                'detachment' => $profile->detachment,
                'post' => $profile->post,
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Operations, 'absence.filed', "{$guard->name} can't report on {$dutyDate->format('M j, Y')}", $notice, causer: $guard);

            Notification::send($this->operations($profile->client?->region), new AbsenceNoticeFiled($notice->setRelation('user', $guard)));

            return $notice;
        });
    }

    private function explainNoShow(AbsenceNotice $notice, User $guard, string $reason): AbsenceNotice
    {
        $notice->forceFill(['reason' => mb_substr($notice->reason.' Reported at '.now()->format('g:i A').': '.trim($reason), 0, 2000)])->save();

        $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Operations, 'absence.no_show_explained', "{$guard->name} reported after being flagged as a no-show for {$notice->duty_date->format('M j, Y')}", $notice, causer: $guard);

        $notice->loadMissing('client');
        Notification::send($this->operations($notice->client?->region), new AbsenceNoticeFiled($notice->setRelation('user', $guard)));

        return $notice;
    }

    /**
     * Operation HQ always; a Satellite Operation only for its own region.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, User>
     */
    private function operations(mixed $region): Collection
    {
        return User::query()
            ->notifiable([Role::OperationsHq, Role::SatelliteOperations])
            ->with('roles')
            ->get()
            ->filter(fn (User $user) => $user->hasRole(Role::OperationsHq) || ($region !== null && $user->operations_region === $region))
            ->values();
    }
}

Documents & licenses

Admin's library in three tabs: company documents, licenses (due date required) and client & legal. Renew uploads a new copy and keeps the old one; a daily job warns Admin before licenses lapse.

Renewal = new rowThe old copy points at the new one (replaced_by_id). Lists show current copies; history stays.
Once per threshold60, 30, 7 days and on the day; only the nearest, claimed in sent_alerts with the due date in the key, so a renewal gets fresh alerts.
Private filesChecked by their bytes, stored privately, streamed to manage-documents only, every view audited.

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Documents;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\DocumentCategory;
use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\CompanyDocument;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\Files\PrivateUploadStore;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Uploads a document, or a renewal of one ($renewing): the renewal is a new
 * row and the old copy points at it, so nothing is overwritten and each
 * license keeps its history.
 */
final class StoreCompanyDocument
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PrivateUploadStore $uploads,
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array{category: DocumentCategory, title: string, client: Client|null, reference_number: string|null, issued_on: CarbonImmutable|null, expires_on: CarbonImmutable|null, notes: string|null}  $data
     */
    public function handle(array $data, UploadedFile $file, User $actor, ?CompanyDocument $renewing = null): CompanyDocument
    {
        if (! $actor->can(Ability::ManageDocuments->value)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        if ($data['issued_on'] !== null && $data['expires_on'] !== null && $data['expires_on']->lt($data['issued_on'])) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['expiresOn' => 'The due date can\'t be before the issue date.']);
        }

        if ($renewing !== null && $renewing->replaced_by_id !== null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['file' => 'This copy was already renewed. Renew the current one.']);
        }

        $disk = (string) config('documents.disk');
        $stored = $this->uploads->store($file, $disk, 'company-documents', $data['category']->value, ['pdf', 'png', 'jpg'], 'file');

        try {
            return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $stored, $actor, $renewing) {
                $document = new CompanyDocument;
                $document->forceFill([
                    'category' => $data['category'],
                    'title' => trim($data['title']),
                    'client_id' => $data['client']?->id,
                    'reference_number' => $data['reference_number'],
                    'issued_on' => $data['issued_on']?->toDateString(),
                    'expires_on' => $data['expires_on']?->toDateString(),
                    'notes' => $data['notes'],
                    'file_path' => $stored['path'],
                    'file_name' => $stored['name'],
                    'file_mime' => $stored['mime'],
                    'file_size' => $stored['size'],
                    'uploaded_by' => $actor->id,
                ])->save();

                if ($renewing !== null) {
                    CompanyDocument::query()->whereKey($renewing->id)->whereNull('replaced_by_id')->update(['replaced_by_id' => $document->id]);
                }

                $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Documents, $renewing !== null ? 'document.renewed' : 'document.uploaded',
                    ($renewing !== null ? 'Renewed ' : 'Uploaded ')."{$data['category']->singular()} \"{$document->title}\"", $document, [
                        'new' => ['expires_on' => $document->expires_on?->toDateString(), 'reference_number' => $document->reference_number],
                    ], causer: $actor);

                return $document;
            });
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            // Nothing points at the file any more.
            $this->uploads->delete($disk, $stored['path']);

            throw $exception;
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Documents;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Models\CompanyDocument;
use App\Models\SentAlert;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\DocumentDueNotice;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;

/**
 * Run daily: licenses and other documents nearing their due date, to Admin
 * (manage-documents). Same rules as the 201 alerts: only the nearest
 * threshold is sent, once per document and due date, so a renewal (a new row
 * with a new date) gets its own alerts and a missed week never sends two.
 */
final class SendDocumentExpiryAlerts
{
    /**
     * @return int how many alerts were sent
     */
    public function handle(CarbonImmutable $today): int
    {
        /** @var list<int> $thresholds */
        $thresholds = config('documents.expiry_alert_days');

        if ($thresholds === []) {
            return 0;
        }

        sort($thresholds);

        $recipients = User::query()->notifiable(Ability::ManageDocuments->roles())->get();

        if ($recipients->isEmpty()) {
            return 0;
        }

        $documents = CompanyDocument::query()
            ->current()
            ->whereNotNull('expires_on')
            ->whereDate('expires_on', '<=', $today->addDays((int) max($thresholds))->toDateString())
            ->get();

        $sent = 0;

        foreach ($documents as $document) {
            $daysLeft = (int) $document->daysToExpiry($today);
            $threshold = collect($thresholds)->first(fn (int $days) => $daysLeft <= $days) ?? (int) end($thresholds);
            $alert = sprintf('document.expiry.%d.%s', $threshold, $document->expires_on?->format('Ymd'));

            $sent += DB::transaction(function () use ($alert, $document, $daysLeft, $threshold, $recipients) {
                if (! SentAlert::claim($alert, $document)) {
                    return 0;
                }

                Notification::send($recipients, new DocumentDueNotice($document, $daysLeft, email: $threshold <= 30));

                return 1;
            });
        }

        return $sent;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Training;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\TrainingAttendance;
use App\Models\TrainingAttendee;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\UpdateNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Completed, did not complete, or back to enrolled. "Completed" is what shows
 * on the guard's employee record.
 */
final class MarkTrainingResult
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function handle(TrainingAttendee $attendee, TrainingAttendance $status, User $actor): void
    {
        if (! $actor->can(Ability::ManageTraining->value)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        $attendee->loadMissing(['training', 'profile']);

        if ($status !== TrainingAttendance::Enrolled && $attendee->training->starts_on->isFuture()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['attendance' => 'The training hasn\'t started yet.']);
        }

        $before = $attendee->status;

        if ($before === $status) {
            return;
        }

        $attendee->forceFill(['status' => $status])->save();

        $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Training, 'training.marked', "{$attendee->profile->name}: {$status->label()} in \"{$attendee->training->title}\"", $attendee->training, [
            'old' => ['status' => $before->value], 'new' => ['status' => $status->value],
        ], causer: $actor);

        if ($status !== TrainingAttendance::Enrolled) {
            UpdateNotice::tellProfile($attendee->profile, $actor, "{$attendee->training->title}: {$status->label()}",
                $status === TrainingAttendance::Completed ? 'It\'s on your training record now.' : 'Ask Admin about the next session.', route('my-training'), 'academic-cap');
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Admin;

use App\Actions\Training\DecideTrainingRequest;
use App\Actions\Training\DeleteTraining;
use App\Actions\Training\EnrollTrainee;
use App\Actions\Training\MarkTrainingResult;
use App\Actions\Training\RemoveTrainee;
use App\Actions\Training\SaveTraining;
use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\RequestStatus;
use App\Enums\TrainingAttendance;
use App\Livewire\Concerns\InteractsWithUser;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\Training;
use App\Models\TrainingAttendee;
use App\Models\TrainingRequest;
use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;

/**
 * Guards' training sessions and who completed them.
 *
 * @property-read Collection<int, Training> $trainings
 * @property-read Training|null $managing
 * @property-read Collection<int, EmployeeProfile> $enrollable
 * @property-read Collection<int, TrainingRequest> $requests
 * @property-read TrainingRequest|null $answering
 * @property-read Collection<int, Training> $upcoming
 */
#[Title('Training')]
class Trainings extends Component
{
    use InteractsWithUser;

    public bool $formOpen = false;

    public ?int $editingId = null;

    public string $title = '';

    public string $provider = '';

    public string $startsOn = '';

    public string $endsOn = '';

    public string $venue = '';

    public string $validUntil = '';

    public string $notes = '';

    /** The session whose attendees are open. */
    public ?int $managingId = null;

    public string $enrollProfileId = '';

    /** The guard's training request being answered, and how. */
    public ?int $answeringId = null;

    /** An upcoming session to add them to, or '' for "approve, add them later". */
    public string $sessionId = '';

    public string $reviewNote = '';

    private const FIELDS = ['editingId', 'title', 'provider', 'startsOn', 'endsOn', 'venue', 'validUntil', 'notes'];

    public function create(): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::ManageTraining->value);

        $this->reset(self::FIELDS);
        $this->resetErrorBag();
        $this->formOpen = true;
    }

    public function edit(int $id): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::ManageTraining->value);

        $training = Training::query()->findOrFail($id);
        $this->editingId = $training->id;
        $this->title = $training->title;
        $this->provider = (string) $training->provider;
        $this->startsOn = $training->starts_on->toDateString();
        $this->endsOn = (string) $training->ends_on?->toDateString();
        $this->venue = (string) $training->venue;
        $this->validUntil = (string) $training->valid_until?->toDateString();
        $this->notes = (string) $training->notes;
        $this->resetErrorBag();
        $this->formOpen = true;
    }

    public function cancel(): void
    {
        $this->reset(['formOpen', ...self::FIELDS]);
    }

    public function save(SaveTraining $save): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::ManageTraining->value);

        $validated = $this->validate([
            'title' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'provider' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'startsOn' => ['required', 'date'],
            'endsOn' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'venue' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'validUntil' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'notes' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:2000'],
        ], [], ['startsOn' => 'first day', 'endsOn' => 'last day', 'validUntil' => 'valid until']);

        $blank = fn (string $value): ?string => filled($value) ? trim($value) : null;

        $save->handle($this->editingId !== null ? Training::query()->findOrFail($this->editingId) : null, [
            'title' => trim($validated['title']),
            'provider' => $blank($validated['provider'] ?? ''),
            'starts_on' => $validated['startsOn'],
            'ends_on' => $blank($validated['endsOn'] ?? ''),
            'venue' => $blank($validated['venue'] ?? ''),
            'valid_until' => $blank($validated['validUntil'] ?? ''),
            'notes' => $blank($validated['notes'] ?? ''),
        ], $this->currentUser());

        $this->cancel();
        unset($this->trainings);
        $this->dispatch('notify', message: 'Training saved.');
    }

    public function delete(int $id, DeleteTraining $delete): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::ManageTraining->value);

        $delete->handle(Training::query()->findOrFail($id), $this->currentUser());
        unset($this->trainings);
        $this->dispatch('notify', message: 'Training deleted.');
    }

    // ---- Attendees ------------------------------------------------------

    public function manage(int $id): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::ManageTraining->value);

        $this->managingId = Training::query()->findOrFail($id)->id;
        $this->enrollProfileId = '';
        $this->resetErrorBag();
    }

    public function closeManage(): void
    {
        $this->reset(['managingId', 'enrollProfileId']);
        unset($this->trainings);
    }

    public function enroll(EnrollTrainee $enroll): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::ManageTraining->value);

        $this->validate(['enrollProfileId' => ['required', 'integer', 'exists:employee_profiles,id']], ['enrollProfileId.required' => 'Choose a guard.']);

        $enroll->handle(Training::query()->findOrFail($this->managingId), EmployeeProfile::query()->findOrFail((int) $this->enrollProfileId), $this->currentUser());

        $this->enrollProfileId = '';
        // Enrolling links a request of theirs that was waiting for a session.
        unset($this->managing, $this->enrollable, $this->requests);
    }

    public function mark(int $attendeeId, string $status, MarkTrainingResult $markResult): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::ManageTraining->value);

        validator(['status' => $status], ['status' => [Rule::enum(TrainingAttendance::class)]])->validate();

        $markResult->handle($this->attendee($attendeeId), TrainingAttendance::from($status), $this->currentUser());
        unset($this->managing);
    }

    public function remove(int $attendeeId, RemoveTrainee $removeTrainee): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::ManageTraining->value);

        $removeTrainee->handle($this->attendee($attendeeId), $this->currentUser());
        unset($this->managing, $this->enrollable);
    }

    // ---- Guards' requests -------------------------------------------------

    public function answer(int $id): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::ManageTraining->value);

        $this->answeringId = TrainingRequest::query()->pending()->findOrFail($id)->id;
        $this->sessionId = '';
        $this->reviewNote = '';
        $this->resetErrorBag();
    }

    public function closeAnswer(): void
    {
        $this->reset(['answeringId', 'sessionId', 'reviewNote']);
        $this->resetErrorBag();
    }

    public function approveRequest(DecideTrainingRequest $decide): void
    {
        $this->decideRequest($decide, RequestStatus::Approved);
    }

    public function declineRequest(DecideTrainingRequest $decide): void
    {
        $this->decideRequest($decide, RequestStatus::Rejected);
    }

    private function decideRequest(DecideTrainingRequest $decide, RequestStatus $decision): void
    {
        $this->authorize(Ability::ManageTraining->value);

        $validated = $this->validate([
            'sessionId' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'exists:trainings,id'],
            'reviewNote' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000'],
        ], [], ['sessionId' => 'session', 'reviewNote' => 'note']);

        $session = $decision === RequestStatus::Approved && filled($validated['sessionId']) ? Training::query()->findOrFail((int) $validated['sessionId']) : null;
        $request = $decide->handle($this->currentUser(), TrainingRequest::query()->findOrFail($this->answeringId), $decision, $session, filled($validated['reviewNote']) ? trim($validated['reviewNote']) : null);

        $this->closeAnswer();
        unset($this->requests, $this->trainings);
        $this->dispatch('notify', message: match (true) {
            $decision === RequestStatus::Rejected => "Declined. {$request->user->name} has been told why.",
            $session !== null => "Added {$request->user->name} to {$session->title}. They've been told.",
            default => "Approved. Add {$request->user->name} to a session when there's one: they'll be told then.",
        });
    }

    /**
     * Pending guards' requests, oldest first, then those approved and waiting for a session.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, TrainingRequest>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function requests(): Collection
    {
        return TrainingRequest::query()
            ->with('user.employeeProfile')
            ->where(fn ($query) => $query->where('status', RequestStatus::Pending)
                ->orWhere(fn ($waiting) => $waiting->where('status', RequestStatus::Approved)->whereNull('training_id')))
            ->orderByRaw('case when status = ? then 0 else 1 end', [RequestStatus::Pending->value])
            ->oldest()
            ->get();
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function answering(): ?TrainingRequest
    {
        return $this->answeringId !== null ? TrainingRequest::query()->with('user.employeeProfile')->find($this->answeringId) : null;
    }

    /**
     * Sessions not over yet, soonest first: where an approved request can go.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, Training>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function upcoming(): Collection
    {
        return Training::query()
            ->where(fn ($query) => $query->whereDate('ends_on', '>=', today())->orWhere(fn ($single) => $single->whereNull('ends_on')->whereDate('starts_on', '>=', today())))
            ->orderBy('starts_on')
            ->get();
    }

    private function attendee(int $id): TrainingAttendee
    {
        return TrainingAttendee::query()->where('training_id', $this->managingId)->findOrFail($id);
    }

    /**
     * Upcoming and ongoing first (soonest on top), then past ones (latest on top).
     *
     * @return Collection<int, Training>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function trainings(): Collection
    {
        $today = today();

        return Training::query()
            ->withCount(['attendees', 'attendees as completed_count' => fn ($query) => $query->where('status', TrainingAttendance::Completed)])
            ->orderByDesc('starts_on')
            ->get()
            ->sortBy(fn (Training $training) => ($training->ends_on ?? $training->starts_on)->lt($today) ? 1 : 0)
            ->values();
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function managing(): ?Training
    {
        return $this->managingId !== null
            ? Training::query()->with(['attendees' => fn ($query) => $query->with('profile')->orderBy('id')])->find($this->managingId)
            : null;
    }

    /**
     * Active guards not in the open session yet.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, EmployeeProfile>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function enrollable(): Collection
    {
        return EmployeeProfile::query()
            ->active()
            ->where('is_office_staff', false)
            ->whereDoesntHave('trainingAttendances', fn ($query) => $query->where('training_id', $this->managingId))
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get(['id', 'name', 'employee_number', 'detachment']);
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        return view('livewire.admin.trainings');
    }
}

Guards ask for a training

A guard often knows first that a refresher is due, so My Training lets them ask: which training, why, and an optional preferred start. Admin is told and answers on Training. Approving adds the guard to an upcoming session in the same step (it calls EnrollTrainee), or approves it "waiting for a session". In that case, the next time Admin enrolls them anywhere, EnrollTrainee links the waiting request and tells the guard, so nothing has to be remembered. Declining needs a note. Only the training half of roadmap item 29 is built: which inspection OSSI means is still open, and guessing would build the wrong feature.

flowchart LR
  G[Guard: My Training] -->|asks| A[Admin: Training requests]
  A -->|add to session| S[Enrolled in session]
  A -->|approve, no session yet| W[Waiting for a session]
  W -->|Admin enrolls them later| S
  A -->|decline + note| D[Declined]
  S & W & D -->|bell + email| G

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Training;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\RequestStatus;
use App\Models\Training;
use App\Models\TrainingRequest;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\TrainingRequestNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Admin answers a training request: approve (adding the guard to a session, or
 * "waiting for a session" when none is planned yet) or decline with a reason.
 * The guard is told either way.
 */
final class DecideTrainingRequest
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit, private readonly EnrollTrainee $enroll) {}

    public function handle(User $admin, TrainingRequest $request, RequestStatus $decision, ?Training $session, ?string $note): TrainingRequest
    {
        if (! $admin->can(Ability::ManageTraining->value)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        if (! in_array($decision, [RequestStatus::Approved, RequestStatus::Rejected], true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['review' => 'A training request is approved or declined.']);
        }

        if ($decision === RequestStatus::Rejected && blank($note)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reviewNote' => 'Say why, so the guard knows.']);
        }

        if ($session !== null && ($session->ends_on ?? $session->starts_on)->isBefore(today())) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['sessionId' => 'That session is over. Choose an upcoming one, or approve and add them later.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($admin, $request, $decision, $session, $note) {
            $locked = TrainingRequest::query()->with('user.employeeProfile')->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($request->id);

            if ($locked->status !== RequestStatus::Pending) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['review' => 'This request has already been answered.']);
            }

            $profile = $locked->user->employeeProfile;
            $alreadyIn = $session !== null && $profile !== null && $session->attendees()->where('employee_profile_id', $profile->id)->exists();

            if ($decision === RequestStatus::Approved && $session !== null && $profile !== null && ! $alreadyIn) {
                $this->enroll->handle($session, $profile, $admin);
            }

            $locked->forceFill([
                'status' => $decision,
                'training_id' => $decision === RequestStatus::Approved ? $session?->id : null,
                'reviewed_by' => $admin->id,
                'reviewed_at' => now(),
                'review_note' => filled($note) ? $note : null,
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Training, 'training.request_'.$decision->value, ($decision === RequestStatus::Approved ? 'Approved' : 'Declined')." {$locked->user->name}'s request for {$locked->kind->label()}".($session !== null && $decision === RequestStatus::Approved ? " (added to \"{$session->title}\")" : ''), $locked, causer: $admin);

            $locked->user->notify(new TrainingRequestNotice($locked->setRelation('training', $decision === RequestStatus::Approved ? $session : null), TrainingRequestNotice::DECIDED));

            return $locked;
        });
    }
}

Complaints

Any employee files; only HR handles. Open → Investigating → Resolved or Dismissed, and closing needs a written outcome the employee reads.

ConfidentialOnly handle-complaints opens HR's page; employees see their own.
Nothing leaksThe audit log and the bell say a complaint exists and its status, never what it says.
Not your ownAn HR member can't handle a complaint they filed.
Three points firstBefore sending, the complainant acknowledges: true as far as they know (a knowingly false one can itself be disciplined); the person involved may be told what is said, so they can give their side (due process); and no retaliation for good faith. They're saved word for word with the time (Complaint::acknowledgementLines()), and HR sees them on the case.

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Complaints;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\ComplaintStatus;
use App\Models\Complaint;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\ComplaintNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Its handler (HR, or the President or Vice President for HR staff's) moves a complaint along. Closing it (resolved or dismissed) needs the
 * outcome in writing, which the employee sees. Nobody handles a complaint
 * they filed themselves.
 */
final class UpdateComplaint
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function handle(Complaint $complaint, ComplaintStatus $status, ?string $resolution, User $actor): Complaint
    {
        // HR can't touch one filed by HR staff (the President or Vice President's), nor the President or Vice President HR's other cases.
        if (! $actor->can($complaint->handlerAbility()->value)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        if ($complaint->user_id === $actor->id) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['status' => 'You filed this complaint, so someone else handles it.']);
        }

        if ($status->isClosed() && mb_strlen(trim((string) $resolution)) < 10) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['resolution' => 'Write the outcome for the employee (at least a sentence) before closing it.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($complaint, $status, $resolution, $actor) {
            $locked = Complaint::query()->with('user')->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($complaint->id);
            $before = $locked->status;

            $locked->forceFill([
                'status' => $status,
                'handled_by' => $actor->id,
                'resolution' => filled($resolution) ? trim((string) $resolution) : null,
                'closed_at' => $status->isClosed() ? ($locked->closed_at ?? now()) : null,
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Complaints, 'complaint.updated', "Complaint {$locked->reference()}: {$status->label()}", $locked, [
                'old' => ['status' => $before->value], 'new' => ['status' => $status->value],
            ], causer: $actor);

            if ($before !== $status) {
                $locked->user->notify(new ComplaintNotice($locked, forHr: false));
            }

            return $locked;
        });
    }
}
