<?php

namespace App\Actions\Complaints;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\ComplaintCategory;
use App\Models\Complaint;
use App\Models\ComplaintSubject;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\ComplaintNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Support\ComplaintRules;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Any employee files a complaint; its handler is told it exists (not what it
 * says, outside the app): HR, or the President or Vice President when the complainant is in HR.
 * The audit log records the filing, never the contents.
 */
final class FileComplaint
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit, private readonly AttachComplaintFile $attach) {}

    /**
     * $acknowledged: the employee ticked "I've read these" on the form; the lines they read
     * (Complaint::acknowledgementLines) are saved word for word, with the time.
     * $witnesses and $proof are optional: no complaint needs proof to be filed.
     * $asksForHelp: "I need help now": the handler is alerted at once (bell and email).
     * $exemptFromLimit: opened by something else (a resignation for a just cause).
     * $picked: a common subject from HR's list; its words become the subject (else $subject, typed).
     *
     * @param  list<UploadedFile>  $proof
     */
    public function handle(User $employee, ComplaintCategory $category, string $subject, string $details, ?string $against, ?CarbonImmutable $incidentOn, bool $acknowledged = false, string $locale = 'en', ?string $witnesses = null, array $proof = [], bool $asksForHelp = false, bool $exemptFromLimit = false, ?ComplaintSubject $picked = null): Complaint
    {
        if ($picked !== null && ($picked->category !== $category || ! $picked->is_active)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['subjectId' => 'Choose a subject from the list for this category, or "Other".']);
        }

        // The subject's words are copied: renaming it later doesn't rewrite this complaint.
        $subject = $picked->label ?? $subject;

        // The weekly limit (HR's, ComplaintRules) never stands between someone and help, or a harassment complaint.
        if (! $asksForHelp && ! $exemptFromLimit && $category !== ComplaintCategory::Harassment) {
            $this->checkWeeklyLimit($employee);
        }

        if ($incidentOn !== null && $incidentOn->isFuture()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['incidentOn' => 'The date it happened can\'t be in the future.']);
        }

        if (count($proof) > (int) config('complaints.max_files')) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['proof' => 'Up to '.config('complaints.max_files').' files. Put several pages or screenshots in one PDF.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($employee, $category, $subject, $details, $against, $incidentOn, $acknowledged, $locale, $witnesses, $proof, $asksForHelp, $picked) {
            $forExecutive = Complaint::goesToExecutive($employee);
            $complaint = new Complaint;
            $complaint->forceFill([
                'user_id' => $employee->id,
                'for_executive' => $forExecutive,
                'asks_for_help' => $asksForHelp,
                'acknowledgement' => $acknowledged ? Complaint::acknowledgementLines($forExecutive ? 'the President or Vice President' : 'HR', $locale) : null,
                'acknowledged_at' => $acknowledged ? now() : null,
                'category' => $category,
                'complaint_subject_id' => $picked?->id,
                'subject' => trim($subject),
                'details' => trim($details),
                'against' => filled($against) ? trim($against) : null,
                'witnesses' => filled($witnesses) ? trim($witnesses) : null,
                'incident_on' => $incidentOn?->toDateString(),
            ])->save();

            // The handler is told once, below, with the complaint.
            foreach ($proof as $file) {
                $this->attach->handle($employee, $complaint, $file, notify: false);
            }

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Complaints, 'complaint.filed', "Complaint {$complaint->reference()} filed", $complaint, causer: $employee);

            $handlers = User::query()->notifiable($complaint->handlerAbility()->roles())->whereKeyNot($employee->id)->get();
            Notification::send($handlers, new ComplaintNotice($complaint->setRelation('user', $employee), forHr: true));

            return $complaint;
        });
    }

    /**
     * HR's limit on complaints in 7 days (ComplaintRules::allowanceFor, the same
     * count the form's counter shows; 0 = none).
     */
    private function checkWeeklyLimit(User $employee): void
    {
        ['limit' => $limit, 'used' => $used, 'left' => $left, 'nextAt' => $nextAt] = ComplaintRules::allowanceFor($employee);
        $first = $used->first();

        if ($left !== 0 || $first === null || $nextAt === null) {
            return;
        }

        $which = $limit === 1 ? "You filed {$first->reference()} on {$first->created_at->format('M j')}" : "You filed {$limit} complaints in the last 7 days";

        throw ValidationException::withMessages(['limit' => "{$which}. You can file another from {$nextAt->format('M j, g:i A')}, or add to an open one on this page. Harassment, and asking for help, can be sent any time."]);
    }
}

Proof: welcome, never required

The request was "require proof". The app invites it instead: up to 5 photos, screenshots or PDFs and a "Who saw it" field, plus Ask for proof for HR on the case. Requiring it would block the complaints that matter most: harassment and threats usually leave nothing on paper, and RA 11313 and RA 7877 expect employers to investigate them anyway. Abuse is already covered by the acknowledged line "a complaint I know to be false can itself lead to discipline". The files follow the leave-document pattern: checked by their bytes, private disk, opened only by the complainant and the handler, every handler view audited.

Question you'd askAnswer
HR asked for proof and the employee has none. Is the case stuck?No. Asking is only a request: the case moves on as before, and HR closes it with a written outcome. "They haven't added any since" just tells HR where it stands.
Does the bell say what proof was asked for?No. Like every complaint notice it says only that proof was asked for or added. The note is read in the app, on My Complaints.

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Complaints;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Models\Complaint;
use App\Models\ComplaintFile;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\ComplaintNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\Files\PrivateUploadStore;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * The complainant attaches proof (a screenshot, a photo, a document), when filing
 * or later while the case is open. Optional: a complaint never needs it to be
 * filed. Checked by its bytes, kept private. Added later, the handler is told,
 * and a request for proof counts as answered.
 */
final class AttachComplaintFile
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PrivateUploadStore $uploads,
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {}

    public function handle(User $employee, Complaint $complaint, UploadedFile $file, bool $notify = true): ComplaintFile
    {
        if ($complaint->user_id !== $employee->id) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        if ($complaint->status->isClosed()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['proof' => 'This complaint is closed.']);
        }

        $max = (int) config('complaints.max_files');

        if ($complaint->files()->count() >= $max) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['proof' => "Up to {$max} files. Put several pages or screenshots in one PDF."]);
        }

        $stored = $this->uploads->store($file, (string) config('complaints.files_disk'), 'complaints/'.$complaint->id, 'proof', ['png', 'jpg', 'pdf'], 'proof');

        $attached = new ComplaintFile;
        $attached->forceFill([
            'complaint_id' => $complaint->id,
            'path' => $stored['path'],
            'name' => $stored['name'],
            'mime' => $stored['mime'],
            'uploaded_by' => $employee->id,
        ])->save();

        // That proof was added, never what it is.
        $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Complaints, 'complaint.proof_added', "Proof added to complaint {$complaint->reference()}", $complaint, causer: $employee);

        if ($notify) {
            $complaint->forceFill(['proof_requested_at' => null])->save();
            $handlers = User::query()->notifiable($complaint->handlerAbility()->roles())->whereKeyNot($employee->id)->get();
            Notification::send($handlers, new ComplaintNotice($complaint->setRelation('user', $employee), forHr: true, event: ComplaintNotice::PROOF_ADDED));
        }

        return $attached;
    }
}

"I need help now", and a limit that never blocks help

The first thing on the form is I need help now. Ticked, the handler gets a bell and an email at once, the case goes to the top of their list with a red badge, and it opens with a banner and the employee's contact number. Even that email carries no contents: who, the reference and a link. The weekly limit (roadmap: "1 complaint per week") is HR's number in the app, starting at 1, and it never counts help requests, harassment or resignation cases. A limit meant to stop spam must never stand between someone and help.

Question you'd askAnswer
Why is the limit checked in the Action, not the form?FileComplaint is the one way in, so the rule can't be skipped by another caller. A resignation's complaint passes exemptFromLimit: true on purpose.
Why a list of subjects and "Other"?The list is quicker on a phone and lets HR count what keeps coming back (each subject shows its last 90 days). A list alone would force people to squeeze their problem into the wrong label, so "Other (type it)" is always there. HR keeps the list in the app (SaveComplaintSubject); a complaint copies the words, like merit records copy their type, so renaming one never rewrites history.
How does the employee know before writing that they've used this week's complaint?A counter at the top, like a token balance: "You can file 1 complaint this week", or "Next one possible Oct 27, 9:37 AM". It comes from ComplaintRules::allowanceFor(), the same count FileComplaint checks, so the screen and the rule can't disagree. It's a rolling 7 days, so filing Sunday night and Monday morning isn't possible.
Why does only a help request send an email?Email leaves the app, so ordinary complaints stay bell only. Someone in danger can't wait for HR to open the app, and the email still says nothing of what happened.

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Content;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\EmploymentStatus;
use App\Models\CompanyPolicy;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\UpdateNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\Files\PrivateUploadStore;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Adds or edits a section of the Company Policy page. An attached PDF (the
 * signed copy) replaces the previous one; $removeFile drops it.
 */
final class SavePolicy
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PrivateUploadStore $uploads,
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array{title: string, body: string, sort_order: int}  $data
     */
    public function handle(?CompanyPolicy $policy, array $data, ?UploadedFile $file, bool $removeFile, User $actor): CompanyPolicy
    {
        if (! $actor->can(Ability::ManagePolicies->value)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        $disk = (string) config('documents.disk');
        $stored = $file !== null ? $this->uploads->store($file, $disk, 'policies', 'policy', ['pdf'], 'file') : null;
        $oldPath = $policy?->file_path;

        try {
            $policy = DB::transaction(function () use ($policy, $data, $stored, $removeFile, $actor) {
                $isNew = $policy === null;
                $policy ??= new CompanyPolicy;
                $before = $isNew ? [] : $policy->only(['title', 'sort_order']);

                $policy->fill($data);
                $policy->updated_by = $actor->id;

                if ($stored !== null) {
                    $policy->forceFill(['file_path' => $stored['path'], 'file_name' => $stored['name']]);
                } elseif ($removeFile) {
                    $policy->forceFill(['file_path' => null, 'file_name' => null]);
                }

                $bodyChanged = $isNew || $policy->isDirty(['title', 'body', 'file_path']);
                $policy->save();

                // Everyone is bound by company policy, so everyone hears of a new or changed one.
                if ($bodyChanged) {
                    Notification::send(User::query()->whereKeyNot($actor->id)->whereDoesntHave('employeeProfile', fn ($profile) => $profile->whereNotIn('employment_status', EmploymentStatus::active()))->get(),
                        new UpdateNotice(($isNew ? 'New company policy: ' : 'Company policy updated: ').$policy->title, 'Read it on Company Policy.', route('company-policy'), 'book-open'));
                }

                $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Content, $isNew ? 'policy.created' : 'policy.updated', "Saved company policy \"{$policy->title}\"", $policy,
                    AuditLogger::diff($before, $policy->only(['title', 'sort_order'])), causer: $actor);

                return $policy;
            });
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            $this->uploads->delete($disk, $stored['path'] ?? null);

            throw $exception;
        }

        // The old file goes only once the row no longer points at it.
        if ($oldPath !== null && $oldPath !== $policy->file_path) {
            $this->uploads->delete($disk, $oldPath);
        }

        return $policy;
    }
}

Duty Roster & anti-cheating

Guards don't keep one fixed shift, so Operations rosters each day (9-hour duties: 8 hours plus the meal break). A clock-in is matched to that day's duty; late, undertime, overtime and night differential follow it. A guard never rostered keeps their usual shift, so nothing breaks before rosters exist.

flowchart TD
  A[Clock In] --> B{GPS fix within ±100 m?}
  B -->|no| R1[Refused: fix too rough]
  B -->|yes| C{Duty whose window holds now?
60 min before start → end}
  C -->|yes| G{Inside the post's geofence?}
  C -->|on roster, none now| R2[Refused: too early / ended / day off + next duty]
  C -->|never rostered| U[Usual shift] --> G
  G -->|no| R3[Refused: You're 2.3 km from the post]
  G -->|yes| OK[Punch saved against the duty]
Early is free, not paidClock in up to an hour before; late counts from the start, night differential only inside the duty, overtime only when approved.
Geofence both waysClock-in and clock-out must be inside the client's radius. The phone's stated error widens it by 50 m at most, and a fix rougher than ±100 m is refused.
Manual, never silentWhen a phone or GPS fails, Operations records it by hand with a reason: marked Manual, audited, and never over a selfie punch.
Nobody forgets quietlySendAttendanceAlerts runs every 5 minutes. Someone still clocked in after their shift is reminded first. If it's still open later, their head hears, following the owner's chain (Heads::toTell): a guard → Operation HQ and the region's Satellite; HR, Operation HQ and Accounting → the President or VP; a Satellite → Operation HQ; other office staff (Admin…) → HR. HR is copied, as timekeeper, on the office staff it doesn't head. An office staffer with no clock-in on a work day is reminded too, and each head gets one summary bell naming only their people. Office staff have no roster, so HR's office work days tell a rest day from a missed day. The times are HR's rules on the Attendance Log (AttendanceAlertRules). A guard missing a rostered duty is a no-show, handled by DetectNoShows.

<?php

namespace App\Queries\Attendance;

use App\Data\DutyForPunch;
use App\Models\DutyAssignment;
use App\Models\Shift;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Attendance\AttendanceCalculator;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;

/**
 * Which duty a clock-in right now belongs to.
 *
 *  1. A rostered duty whose window holds "now": from early_clock_in_minutes
 *     before its start to its end. Yesterday's duty counts too, so a guard
 *     late for a 22:00–07:00 duty can still clock in at 00:30.
 *  2. On the roster (any duty within roster_window_days) but none now:
 *     refused, with the reason (too early, already over, or a day off) and
 *     their next duty.
 *  3. Never rostered: their usual shift from the employee record, today.
 */
final class CurrentDutyQuery
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AttendanceCalculator $calculator) {}

    public function handle(User $user, CarbonImmutable $now): DutyForPunch
    {
        $user->loadMissing(['employeeProfile.shift', 'employeeProfile.client']);
        $profile = $user->employeeProfile;
        $today = $now->startOfDay();
        $early = (int) config('attendance.early_clock_in_minutes');
        $usualShift = $profile->shift ?? Shift::fallback();

        $recent = DutyAssignment::query()
            ->with(['shift', 'client'])
            ->where('user_id', $user->id)
            ->whereDate('duty_date', '>=', $today->subDay()->toDateString())
            ->whereDate('duty_date', '<=', $today->toDateString())
            ->orderByDesc('duty_date')
            ->get();

        foreach ($recent as $duty) {
            [$start, $end] = $this->calculator->shiftWindow($duty->shift, $duty->duty_date);

            if ($now->gte($start->subMinutes($early)) && $now->lte($end)) {
                return new DutyForPunch($duty, $duty->shift, $duty->duty_date, $duty->client ?? $profile?->client);
            }
        }

        $window = (int) config('attendance.roster_window_days');
        $onRoster = $recent->isNotEmpty() || DutyAssignment::query()
            ->where('user_id', $user->id)
            ->whereDate('duty_date', '>=', $today->subDays($window)->toDateString())
            ->whereDate('duty_date', '<=', $today->addDays($window)->toDateString())
            ->exists();

        if (! $onRoster) {
            return new DutyForPunch(null, $usualShift, $today, $profile?->client);
        }

        $next = DutyAssignment::query()->with(['shift', 'client'])
            ->where('user_id', $user->id)
            ->whereDate('duty_date', '>', $today->toDateString())
            ->orderBy('duty_date')
            ->first();

        $todays = $recent->first(fn (DutyAssignment $duty) => $duty->duty_date->isSameDay($today));
        $refusal = 'You have no duty today. If Operations called you in, ask them to add it to the Duty Roster first.';

        if ($todays !== null) {
            [$start, $end] = $this->calculator->shiftWindow($todays->shift, $todays->duty_date);
            $refusal = $now->lt($start)
                ? "Your duty today starts at {$start->format('g:i A')}. You can clock in from {$start->subMinutes($early)->format('g:i A')}."
                : "Your duty today ended at {$end->format('g:i A')}.";
        }

        return new DutyForPunch(null, $usualShift, $today, $profile?->client, $refusal, $next);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Attendance;

use App\Livewire\Admin\AttendanceLog;
use App\Models\Holiday;
use App\Models\LeaveRequest;
use App\Models\SentAlert;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\UpdateNotice;
use App\Services\Attendance\AttendanceCalculator;
use App\Support\AttendanceAlertRules;
use App\Support\Heads;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;

/**
 * Run every 5 minutes. Two gaps nobody heard about before (the rules are HR's, AttendanceAlertRules):
 *
 *  1. A missed clock-out. The employee first, some minutes after the shift ended ("clock out
 *     now"); if it's still open later, their head (App\Support\Heads: the owner's chain).
 *  2. An office staffer who hasn't clocked in on a work day (not on leave, not a holiday): the
 *     employee first, and one summary bell per head per run, naming only the people they head.
 *     Guards are covered by DetectNoShows (their roster says when they're due).
 *
 * Each alert is claimed in sent_alerts, so it goes once however often this runs.
 */
final class SendAttendanceAlerts
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AttendanceCalculator $calculator) {}

    /**
     * @return array{reminded: int, escalated: int, officeMissing: int}
     */
    public function handle(CarbonImmutable $now): array
    {
        $rules = AttendanceAlertRules::all();
        [$reminded, $escalated] = $this->missedClockOuts($now, $rules);

        return ['reminded' => $reminded, 'escalated' => $escalated, 'officeMissing' => $this->officeNoClockIns($now, $rules)];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array{clock_out_reminder_minutes: int, clock_out_escalate_minutes: int, office_clock_in_reminder_minutes: int, office_work_days: list<int>}  $rules
     * @return array{0: int, 1: int}
     */
    private function missedClockOuts(CarbonImmutable $now, array $rules): array
    {
        $reminded = $escalated = 0;

        $open = TimeLog::query()
            ->with(['shift', 'user.employeeProfile.shift', 'user.employeeProfile.client', 'dutyAssignment.client'])
            ->whereNotNull('clock_in_at')->whereNull('clock_out_at')
            ->whereDate('log_date', '>=', $now->subDays(2)->toDateString())
            ->whereHas('user', fn ($user) => $user->onPayroll())
            ->get();

        foreach ($open as $log) {
            $shift = $log->shift ?? $log->user->employeeProfile?->shift;

            if ($shift === null) {
                continue;
            }

            [, $end] = $this->calculator->shiftWindow($shift, $log->log_date);
            $ended = $end->format('g:i A').' ('.$end->format('D, M j').')';

            if ($now->gte($end->addMinutes($rules['clock_out_reminder_minutes'])) && $this->claim('clock_out.reminder', $log)) {
                UpdateNotice::tell($log->user, null, 'You haven\'t clocked out',
                    "Your shift ended at {$ended}. Clock out now on My Attendance. If you left earlier, tell your supervisor the real time.", route('attendance'), 'clock');
                $reminded++;
            }

            if ($now->gte($end->addMinutes($rules['clock_out_escalate_minutes'])) && $this->claim('clock_out.escalated', $log)) {
                Notification::send(Heads::toTell($log->user, $log->dutyAssignment?->client), new UpdateNotice("Not clocked out: {$log->user->name}",
                    "Shift ended at {$ended}; still clocked in since ".$log->clock_in_at?->format('g:i A').'. Check with them, then record the real time.',
                    route('attendance-log', ['show' => AttendanceLog::NOT_CLOCKED_OUT]), 'clock-alert'));
                $escalated++;
            }
        }

        return [$reminded, $escalated];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array{clock_out_reminder_minutes: int, clock_out_escalate_minutes: int, office_clock_in_reminder_minutes: int, office_work_days: list<int>}  $rules
     */
    private function officeNoClockIns(CarbonImmutable $now, array $rules): int
    {
        $today = $now->startOfDay();

        if (! in_array($today->isoWeekday(), $rules['office_work_days'], true) || Holiday::query()->whereDate('date', $today->toDateString())->exists()) {
            return 0;
        }

        $onLeave = LeaveRequest::query()->approved()->overlapping($today, $today)->pluck('user_id')->flip();
        $missing = 0;
        /** @var array<int, array{head: User, names: list<string>}> $byHead each head, and who of theirs is missing */
        $byHead = [];

        $staff = User::query()->onPayroll()
            ->whereHas('employeeProfile', fn ($profile) => $profile->where('is_office_staff', true)->whereNotNull('shift_id'))
            ->whereDoesntHave('timeLogs', fn ($logs) => $logs->whereDate('log_date', $today->toDateString()))
            ->with('employeeProfile.shift')
            ->get();

        foreach ($staff as $user) {
            $shift = $user->employeeProfile?->shift;

            if ($shift === null || $onLeave->has($user->id)) {
                continue;
            }

            [$start, $end] = $this->calculator->shiftWindow($shift, $today);

            if ($now->lt($start->addMinutes($shift->grace_minutes + $rules['office_clock_in_reminder_minutes'])) || $now->gte($end)) {
                continue;
            }

            if ($this->claim('office.no_clock_in.'.$today->format('Ymd'), $user)) {
                UpdateNotice::tell($user, null, 'You haven\'t clocked in today',
                    'Your shift started at '.$start->format('g:i A').'. Clock in on My Attendance, or file leave if you\'re off today.', route('attendance'), 'clock');
                $missing++;

                foreach (Heads::toTell($user) as $head) {
                    $byHead[$head->id]['head'] = $head;
                    $byHead[$head->id]['names'][] = $user->name.' ('.$start->format('g:i A').')';
                }
            }
        }

        // One bell per head for the whole batch: only the people they head.
        foreach ($byHead as ['head' => $head, 'names' => $names]) {
            $head->notify(new UpdateNotice(
                count($names).' not clocked in yet',
                implode(', ', $names).'. Not on leave today.', route('attendance-log'), 'clock-alert'));
        }

        return $missing;
    }

    private function claim(string $alert, TimeLog|User $subject): bool
    {
        return DB::transaction(fn () => SentAlert::claim($alert, $subject));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Attendance;

use App\Actions\Patrols\CloseForgottenAways;
use App\Actions\Relievers\RecordNoShowArrival;
use App\Data\DutyForPunch;
use App\Enums\PunchType;
use App\Enums\TimeLogStatus;
use App\Models\AwayLog;
use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\Office;
use App\Models\Shift;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Queries\Attendance\CurrentDutyQuery;
use App\Services\Attendance\AttendanceCalculator;
use App\Services\Attendance\Geofence;
use App\Services\Attendance\PunchPhotoStore;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\UniqueConstraintViolationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Records one clock-in or clock-out with its selfie and GPS position.
 *
 * Which schedule it counts against: the guard's rostered duty for now
 * (CurrentDutyQuery), or their usual shift when they aren't on the roster.
 * Off duty, too early or after the duty ended, the clock-in is refused.
 *
 * Anti-cheating, checked BEFORE anything is saved:
 *  - a GPS fix rougher than attendance.max_gps_accuracy_meters is refused;
 *  - the punch must be inside the post's geofence (client coordinates + radius),
 *    for clock-out too, so nobody clocks out from home; office staff inside their
 *    OSSI office's (an office staffer with no office set has no geofence);
 *  - the server's clock, never the phone's; the selfie is burned with the time.
 * Clocking in early is allowed but earns nothing: late, night differential
 * and overtime all count from the scheduled start.
 *
 * Concurrency (spec: "two rapid taps produce one punch"):
 *  - the day's time log row is locked with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, so a second
 *    request waits, then sees the first punch and is rejected;
 *  - for a clock-in there is no row to lock yet, so two racing inserts are
 *    stopped by the unique (user_id, log_date) index instead.
 *
 * The caller says WHICH punch it means. If the server guessed, a double-tapped
 * clock-in would silently become a clock-out.
 *
 * The phone (a cookie code, CheckPunchDevice): a guard's first clock-in registers
 * their phone; a punch from another one still counts, and is flagged to Operations
 * and HR (ReportOtherPhone).
 */
final class RecordPunch
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PunchPhotoStore $photos,
        private readonly AttendanceCalculator $calculator,
        private readonly CurrentDutyQuery $currentDuty,
        private readonly Geofence $geofence,
        private readonly RecordNoShowArrival $noShowArrival,
        private readonly CheckPunchDevice $checkDevice,
        private readonly ReportOtherPhone $reportOtherPhone,
    ) {}

    public function handle(
        User $user,
        PunchType $type,
        string $photoDataUrl,
        float $latitude,
        float $longitude,
        ?int $accuracyMeters = null,
        ?string $address = null,
        ?string $deviceToken = null,
        ?string $deviceLabel = null,
    ): TimeLog {
        $this->ensureValidCoordinates($latitude, $longitude);
        $this->ensureAccurateEnough($accuracyMeters);

        $now = CarbonImmutable::now();
        $duty = null;

        if ($type === PunchType::ClockIn) {
            $duty = $this->currentDuty->handle($user, $now);

            if ($duty->refusal !== null) {
                throw $this->reject($duty->refusal.$this->nextDutyHint($duty));
            }

            $this->ensureAtPost($duty->site ?? $this->officeOf($user), $latitude, $longitude, $accuracyMeters, $type);
        } else {
            $this->ensureAtPost($this->clockOutSite($user, $now) ?? $this->officeOf($user), $latitude, $longitude, $accuracyMeters, $type);
        }

        // Stored first, outside the transaction: file writes can't be rolled back, so we delete it on failure instead.
        $photoPath = $this->photos->store($photoDataUrl, $user, $type, $now);

        try {
            [$timeLog, $punch] = DB::transaction(function () use ($user, $type, $now, $duty, $photoPath, $latitude, $longitude, $accuracyMeters, $address, $deviceToken, $deviceLabel) {
                $timeLog = $duty !== null
                    ? $this->clockIn($user, $now, $duty)
                    : $this->clockOut($user, $now);

                $punch = $timeLog->punches()->create([
                    'type' => $type,
                    'punched_at' => $now,
                    'photo_path' => $photoPath,
                    'latitude' => $latitude,
                    'longitude' => $longitude,
                    'accuracy_meters' => $accuracyMeters,
                    // A failed address lookup never blocks the punch (spec rule 6).
                    'address' => $address !== null && trim($address) !== '' ? mb_substr(trim($address), 0, 500) : null,
                    ...$this->checkDevice->handle($user, $deviceToken, $deviceLabel !== null ? mb_substr($deviceLabel, 0, 100) : null, $now),
                ]);

                return [$timeLog, $punch];
            });
        } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException) {
            $this->photos->delete($photoPath);

            throw $this->reject('You have already clocked in for this duty.');
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->photos->delete($photoPath);

            throw $e;
        }

        // After the commit: the punch is saved whatever happens to the alert.
        if ($punch->other_device) {
            $this->reportOtherPhone->handle($punch);
        }

        return $timeLog;
    }

    private function clockIn(User $user, CarbonImmutable $now, DutyForPunch $duty): TimeLog
    {
        $existing = TimeLog::query()
            ->where('user_id', $user->id)
            ->whereDate('log_date', $duty->dutyDate->toDateString())
            ->lockForUpdate()
            ->first();

        if ($existing !== null) {
            throw $this->reject($duty->dutyDate->isToday() ? 'You have already clocked in today.' : 'You have already clocked in for this duty.');
        }

        $shift = $duty->shift;
        $late = $this->calculator->lateMinutes($now, $shift, $duty->dutyDate);

        $timeLog = new TimeLog;
        $timeLog->user()->associate($user);
        $timeLog->shift_id = $shift->exists ? $shift->id : null;
        $timeLog->duty_assignment_id = $duty->duty?->id;
        $timeLog->log_date = $duty->dutyDate;
        $timeLog->clock_in_at = $now;
        $timeLog->late_minutes = $late;
        $timeLog->status = TimeLogStatus::fromMinutes($late, 0, hasClockedOut: false);
        $timeLog->save();

        // Still "away" from an earlier duty (never tapped Back, never clocked out, and the
        // scheduler hasn't closed it yet)? It ended with that duty: close it, flagged, so it
        // doesn't carry into this one and hide the patrol scanner.
        AwayLog::query()->where('user_id', $user->id)->where('time_log_id', '!=', $timeLog->id)->open()->with('timeLog.shift')->get()
            ->each(function (AwayLog $away) use ($now) {
                $dutyEnd = CloseForgottenAways::dutyEnd($away)->min($now);
                $away->forceFill(['returned_at' => $dutyEnd->greaterThan($away->left_at) ? $dutyEnd : $away->left_at, 'auto_closed_at' => $now])->save();
            });

        // Flagged as a no-show, then turned up: Operations stops looking for a reliever.
        $this->noShowArrival->handle($timeLog);

        return $timeLog;
    }

    private function clockOut(User $user, CarbonImmutable $now): TimeLog
    {
        $timeLog = $this->openLog($user, $now, lock: true);

        if ($timeLog === null) {
            $closedToday = TimeLog::query()
                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
                ->whereDate('log_date', $now->toDateString())
                ->whereNotNull('clock_out_at')
                ->exists();

            throw $this->reject($closedToday ? 'You have already clocked out today.' : 'You must clock in before you can clock out.');
        }

        $shift = $timeLog->shift ?? $this->usualShift($user);
        $clockIn = $timeLog->clock_in_at ?? $now;

        $timeLog->clock_out_at = $now;
        $timeLog->undertime_minutes = $this->calculator->undertimeMinutes($now, $shift, $timeLog->log_date);
        $timeLog->overtime_minutes = $this->calculator->overtimeMinutes($clockIn, $now, $shift);
        $timeLog->status = TimeLogStatus::fromMinutes($timeLog->late_minutes, $timeLog->undertime_minutes, hasClockedOut: true);
        $timeLog->save();

        // Still marked away? The clock-out passed the geofence, so they're back at the post.
        AwayLog::query()->where('time_log_id', $timeLog->id)->open()->update(['returned_at' => $now]);

        return $timeLog;
    }

    /**
     * Today's open log, or yesterday's if that shift crosses midnight (a
     * 22:00–07:00 guard clocks out the next morning). A day-shift log left
     * open yesterday is NOT closed today; it stays incomplete.
     */
    private function openLog(User $user, CarbonImmutable $now, bool $lock): ?TimeLog
    {
        $candidates = TimeLog::query()
            ->with(['shift', 'dutyAssignment.client'])
            ->where('user_id', $user->id)
            ->whereNotNull('clock_in_at')
            ->whereNull('clock_out_at')
            ->whereDate('log_date', '>=', $now->subDay()->toDateString())
            ->whereDate('log_date', '<=', $now->toDateString())
            ->orderByDesc('log_date')
            ->when($lock, fn ($query) => $query->lockForUpdate())
            ->get();

        return $candidates->first(function (TimeLog $log) use ($now): bool {
            if ($log->log_date->isSameDay($now)) {
                return true;
            }

            return ($log->shift ?? Shift::fallback())->crossesMidnight();
        });
    }

    /**
     * Where a clock-out must happen: the post of the duty being closed, else
     * the guard's usual client.
     */
    private function clockOutSite(User $user, CarbonImmutable $now): ?Client
    {
        $open = $this->openLog($user, $now, lock: false);
        $user->loadMissing('employeeProfile.client');

        return $open->dutyAssignment->client ?? $user->employeeProfile?->client;
    }

    private function usualShift(User $user): Shift
    {
        $user->loadMissing('employeeProfile.shift');

        return $user->employeeProfile->shift ?? Shift::fallback();
    }

    /** An office staffer's OSSI office (their clock-in place); null for guards or when none is set. */
    private function officeOf(User $user): ?Office
    {
        $user->loadMissing('employeeProfile.office');

        return $user->employeeProfile?->is_office_staff ? $user->employeeProfile->office : null;
    }

    private function ensureAtPost(Client|Office|null $site, float $latitude, float $longitude, ?int $accuracyMeters, PunchType $type): void
    {
        if ($site === null || ! $site->hasGeofence()) {
            return;
        }

        $distance = $this->geofence->distanceMeters($latitude, $longitude, (float) $site->latitude, (float) $site->longitude);

        if (! $this->geofence->isInside($distance, $site->geofence_meters, $accuracyMeters)) {
            $verb = $type === PunchType::ClockIn ? 'Clock in' : 'Clock out';
            $where = $site instanceof Office ? 'at the office' : 'at your post';

            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['location' => "You're {$this->geofence->describe($distance)} from {$site->name}. {$verb} {$where}."]);
        }
    }

    private function ensureAccurateEnough(?int $accuracyMeters): void
    {
        $limit = (int) config('attendance.max_gps_accuracy_meters');

        if ($accuracyMeters !== null && $accuracyMeters > $limit) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['location' => "Your GPS fix is too rough (±{$accuracyMeters} m). Step into an open spot or wait a few seconds, then try again."]);
        }
    }

    private function nextDutyHint(DutyForPunch $duty): string
    {
        if ($duty->next === null) {
            return '';
        }

        [$start] = $this->calculator->shiftWindow($duty->next->shift, $duty->next->duty_date);

        return " Your next duty: {$start->format('D, M j \a\t g:i A')}, {$duty->next->placeLabel()}.";
    }

    private function ensureValidCoordinates(float $latitude, float $longitude): void
    {
        if ($latitude < -90 || $latitude > 90 || $longitude < -180 || $longitude > 180) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['location' => 'Your GPS location is missing or invalid. Allow location access and try again.']);
        }
    }

    private function reject(string $message): ValidationException
    {
        return ValidationException::withMessages(['punch' => $message]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services\Attendance;

/**
 * Pure distance math for the post geofence: no queries, no config reads.
 */
final class Geofence
{
    private const EARTH_RADIUS_METERS = 6_371_000;

    /**
     * Great-circle (haversine) distance in whole meters.
     */
    public function distanceMeters(float $fromLat, float $fromLng, float $toLat, float $toLng): int
    {
        $dLat = deg2rad($toLat - $fromLat);
        $dLng = deg2rad($toLng - $fromLng);

        $a = sin($dLat / 2) ** 2 + cos(deg2rad($fromLat)) * cos(deg2rad($toLat)) * sin($dLng / 2) ** 2;

        return (int) round(self::EARTH_RADIUS_METERS * 2 * atan2(sqrt($a), sqrt(1 - $a)));
    }

    /**
     * Inside the radius, allowing for the phone's stated GPS error: a fix
     * "±30 m" that lands 170 m out on a 150 m fence could really be inside.
     * The allowance is capped, so a vague fix can't stretch the fence.
     */
    public function isInside(int $distanceMeters, int $radiusMeters, ?int $accuracyMeters): bool
    {
        return $distanceMeters <= $radiusMeters + min(max(0, $accuracyMeters ?? 0), 50);
    }

    /** "850 m" or "2.3 km" */
    public function describe(int $meters): string
    {
        return $meters < 1000 ? "{$meters} m" : number_format($meters / 1000, 1).' km';
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Roster;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\TimeLogStatus;
use App\Models\DutyAssignment;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\UpdateNotice;
use App\Services\Attendance\AttendanceCalculator;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Operations records a duty's attendance by hand when the guard's phone or
 * GPS failed (or the post is outside coverage). It's the exception, so it
 * needs a written reason, is marked "manual" everywhere, and is audited.
 *
 * Never over a punched record: a selfie punch is evidence and stays as it is.
 * Times are checked against the duty: no future times, clock-out after
 * clock-in, at most 24 hours.
 */
final class RecordManualAttendance
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AttendanceCalculator $calculator,
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {}

    public function handle(DutyAssignment $duty, CarbonImmutable $clockIn, ?CarbonImmutable $clockOut, string $reason, User $actor): TimeLog
    {
        $duty->loadMissing(['user', 'client', 'shift']);
        RosterRules::authorize($duty->user, $duty->client, $actor);

        $now = CarbonImmutable::now();
        [$start] = $this->calculator->shiftWindow($duty->shift, $duty->duty_date);

        $errors = array_filter([
            'manualReason' => mb_strlen(trim($reason)) < 10 ? 'Say why it was recorded by hand (at least a few words).' : null,
            'manualIn' => match (true) {
                $clockIn->gt($now) => 'The clock-in can\'t be in the future.',
                $clockIn->lt($start->subHours(2)) || $clockIn->gt($start->addHours(12)) => 'The clock-in must be near this duty\'s start ('.$start->format('M j, g:i A').').',
                default => null,
            },
            'manualOut' => match (true) {
                $clockOut === null => null,
                $clockOut->gt($now) => 'The clock-out can\'t be in the future.',
                $clockOut->lte($clockIn) => 'The clock-out must be after the clock-in.',
                $clockIn->diffInHours($clockOut) > 24 => 'A duty can\'t be longer than 24 hours.',
                default => null,
            },
        ]);

        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages($errors);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($duty, $clockIn, $clockOut, $reason, $actor) {
            $log = TimeLog::query()->where('user_id', $duty->user_id)->whereDate('log_date', $duty->duty_date->toDateString())->lockForUpdate()->first();

            if ($log !== null && $log->punches()->exists()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['manualIn' => "{$duty->user->name} punched in with a selfie for this duty. That record stays as it is."]);
            }

            $before = $log?->only(['clock_in_at', 'clock_out_at']) ?? [];
            $log ??= new TimeLog;
            $late = $this->calculator->lateMinutes($clockIn, $duty->shift, $duty->duty_date);
            $undertime = $clockOut !== null ? $this->calculator->undertimeMinutes($clockOut, $duty->shift, $duty->duty_date) : 0;

            $log->forceFill([
                'user_id' => $duty->user_id,
                'shift_id' => $duty->shift_id,
                'duty_assignment_id' => $duty->id,
                'log_date' => $duty->duty_date->toDateString(),
                'clock_in_at' => $clockIn,
                'clock_out_at' => $clockOut,
                'late_minutes' => $late,
                'undertime_minutes' => $undertime,
                'overtime_minutes' => $clockOut !== null ? $this->calculator->overtimeMinutes($clockIn, $clockOut, $duty->shift) : 0,
                'status' => TimeLogStatus::fromMinutes($late, $undertime, hasClockedOut: $clockOut !== null),
                'recorded_by' => $actor->id,
                'manual_reason' => trim($reason),
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Attendance, 'attendance.manual', "Recorded {$duty->user->name}'s attendance by hand for {$duty->duty_date->format('M j')}", $log, [
                ...AuditLogger::diff($before, $log->only(['clock_in_at', 'clock_out_at'])),
                'note' => trim($reason),
            ], causer: $actor);

            // Their pay follows this record, so they see what was entered for them, and by whom.
            UpdateNotice::tell($duty->user, $actor, 'Attendance recorded for you: '.$duty->duty_date->format('D, M j'),
                'In '.$clockIn->format('g:i A').($clockOut !== null ? ', out '.$clockOut->format('g:i A') : '').". Entered by hand by {$actor->name}: ".trim($reason).' If it\'s wrong, tell Operations.', route('attendance'), 'clock');

            return $log;
        });
    }
}
QuestionAnswer
Why not just pay clock-in to clock-out?Then clocking in early or leaving late pads pay, and nobody is ever late. The duty is the yardstick; time beyond it is overtime and needs approval.
A guard is late for a 22:00 duty and arrives at 00:30. Which day?Last night's: the window includes yesterday's duty until it ends, so the log is dated the duty's day and 140 minutes late.
How does a reliever clock in at someone else's post?Assigning them creates a relief duty at the absent guard's client and post, so that geofence applies.
The hours aren't in the Duty list. Now what?Custom time… (last in the list) opens the same box HR uses on the employee record (<x-shift-hours>): common hours in one tap, Start / End, "9 hours · ends the next day", grace. It starts from the duty already picked. Saving goes through ShiftForTimes: the same hours reuse an existing shift (22:00–07:00 is Night Duty) instead of piling up "Custom" copies.
What is "Record by hand"?Operations entering a duty's clock-in (and clock-out) when the guard's phone or GPS failed: a reason is required, it's marked Manual, audited, and never replaces a real selfie punch.

<?php

namespace App\Actions\People;

use App\Actions\Settings\SaveShift;
use App\Models\Shift;
use App\Models\User;

/**
 * HR typed an employee's times instead of picking a shift ("Custom time").
 * Lateness, undertime and payroll all work from a Shift, so this returns
 * the shift with exactly those times and grace: an existing one if there
 * is one (no duplicates), else a new "Custom" shift, saved through
 * SaveShift so it's audited and shows on the Shifts page like any other.
 */
final class ShiftForTimes
{
    public function __construct(private readonly SaveShift $saveShift) {}

    /**
     * @param  string  $start  HH:MM, 24-hour
     * @param  string  $end  HH:MM, 24-hour (earlier than $start = ends the next day)
     */
    public function handle(string $start, string $end, int $graceMinutes, User $actor): Shift
    {
        // Saved as "07:00" or "07:00:00" depending on how the shift was made.
        $existing = Shift::query()
            ->whereIn('start_time', [$start, $start.':00'])
            ->whereIn('end_time', [$end, $end.':00'])
            ->where('grace_minutes', $graceMinutes)
            ->orderByDesc('is_default')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->first();

        return $existing ?? $this->saveShift->handle(null, [
            'name' => 'Custom',
            'start_time' => $start,
            'end_time' => $end,
            'grace_minutes' => $graceMinutes,
            'is_default' => false,
        ], $actor);
    }
}
Try it
  1. As opshq@example.test: Duty Roster → click a day → Night Duty. Then another day → Custom time… → tap 7–4 and save.
  2. As Maria: My Attendance shows the duty and the week; the dev-only simulate button stands at her post, so Clock In works.
24

Patrols & time away

Proof of work between clock-in and clock-out. Roving guards scan QR checkpoints every round; anyone leaving the post says why and shares their location every 15 minutes until they're back. Operations sees both live, and is alerted when a round is missed or an absence runs long.

A sticker, a place, a photoThe QR's code is random, the GPS must be at the checkpoint, and the camera frame that read it is kept, so a photo of the sticker scanned from home shows.
Rounds, not pingsThe duty is cut into windows of the client's interval; a round is done only when every checkpoint was scanned inside it.
Away has a reason, a "back by" and a trailTraffic and queues are normal work, so time away is measured against the time the person said, not a fixed limit. They pick how long (each reason has a usual length) and can add time with a reason, with no approval needed. Running late is amber. The supervisor is alerted only after 30 minutes with no location, or an hour past their own time without asking for more. No meal break: it's already in the duty. "Back at post" is never blocked, just recorded with its distance.
They say their own time: nothing suggestedThe reasons used to read "Official business (usually 2 hrs)". That's anchoring: the suggestion became the plan, so a 20-minute bank errand took 2 hours and still looked on time, because "running late" only started after the suggested time. Now the reasons show no hours, and "How long will you be out?" starts on Choose your time and is required. They're held to their own word. AwayReason::usualMinutes() is kept only as a fallback for older rows. Office reasons: Official business, Client site visit (a post or detachment), Government office (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, BIR, DOLE, PNP-SOSIA), Appointment, Personal.
Choices plus a note, not a blank boxThe choice sets the time held to, lets the President or Vice President filter and read alerts ("Not back yet (Government office)"), and is one tap on a phone. The required note carries the specifics. Free text alone would come back as "OB", "bank" and "sss pasig" for the same thing.
The note asks what's useful, and no moreOne "Note (where, who asked)" became a question per reason (AwayReason::noteLabel()): "Where, and what for" on work trips, because that's what the approver needs; "Who asked" only where someone sent them (a client errand, a supervisor's call); just "Where" on personal ones. An appointment's purpose is health information, sensitive under RA 10173, so its label says "no need to say what for". The old example, "Dentist at…", was nudging people to give it.
"File leave" only for personal timePast 4 hours, Appointment and Personal point to My Leave (AwayReason::isPersonal()). A day at PNP-SOSIA or three site visits is work, so official reasons never get the hint.
Office staff report to the President or Vice PresidentOffice staff tap "Stepping out of the office" with office reasons (Official business, Government office, Appointment…). Distance is measured from the head office (OFFICE_* env), and the President or Vice President monitors, approves and gets the alerts on Office Away, the same way the President or Vice President approves office leave.
Sorted for thousandsStatus tabs (Needs attention first), name/reason/region filters and a paged "back today" list. Only open absences are loaded, and indexes on away_logs(returned_at, left_at) and left_at keep "who is out now" fast as the table grows; "today" is a time range, not whereDate(), so the index is used.

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Patrols;

use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\PatrolCheckpoint;
use App\Models\PatrolScan;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Attendance\Geofence;
use App\Services\Attendance\PunchPhotoStore;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * A roving guard scans a checkpoint's QR sticker. Proof the guard was
 * physically there, at that time:
 *
 *  - the QR code is random and must belong to the client of the guard's duty;
 *  - the guard must be clocked in;
 *  - the GPS fix must be accurate enough and within reach of the checkpoint
 *    (its own coordinates, or the client's geofence);
 *  - the camera frame that read the QR is kept, so a photo of a photo shows.
 *
 * Scanning the same checkpoint again within a few minutes returns the first
 * scan instead of adding another.
 */
final class RecordPatrolScan
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PunchPhotoStore $photos,
        private readonly Geofence $geofence,
    ) {}

    public function handle(User $guard, string $payload, string $photoDataUrl, float $latitude, float $longitude, ?int $accuracyMeters): PatrolScan
    {
        if ($latitude < -90 || $latitude > 90 || $longitude < -180 || $longitude > 180) {
            throw $this->reject('Your GPS location is missing. Allow location access and try again.');
        }

        if ($accuracyMeters !== null && $accuracyMeters > (int) config('attendance.max_gps_accuracy_meters')) {
            throw $this->reject("Your GPS fix is too rough (±{$accuracyMeters} m). Wait a few seconds, then scan again.");
        }

        $code = str_starts_with($payload, PatrolCheckpoint::QR_PREFIX) ? substr($payload, strlen(PatrolCheckpoint::QR_PREFIX)) : '';
        $checkpoint = $code === '' ? null : PatrolCheckpoint::query()->with('client')->where('code', $code)->active()->first();

        if ($checkpoint === null) {
            throw $this->reject('That isn\'t an OSSI checkpoint QR. Scan the sticker at the checkpoint.');
        }

        $now = CarbonImmutable::now();
        $log = TimeLog::query()->with('dutyAssignment.client')
            ->where('user_id', $guard->id)->whereNotNull('clock_in_at')->whereNull('clock_out_at')
            ->whereDate('log_date', '>=', $now->subDay()->toDateString())
            ->latest('clock_in_at')
            ->first();

        if ($log === null) {
            throw $this->reject('Clock in first: scans count during your duty.');
        }

        $guard->loadMissing('employeeProfile.client');
        $site = $log->dutyAssignment->client ?? $guard->employeeProfile?->client;

        if ($site === null || $site->id !== $checkpoint->client_id) {
            throw $this->reject($site === null
                ? "{$checkpoint->name} is at {$checkpoint->client->name}, and you have no post today."
                : "{$checkpoint->name} is at {$checkpoint->client->name}. Your post today is {$site->name}: scan the stickers there.");
        }

        $distance = $this->ensureInReach($checkpoint, $site, $latitude, $longitude, $accuracyMeters);

        $repeat = PatrolScan::query()
            ->where('time_log_id', $log->id)
            ->where('patrol_checkpoint_id', $checkpoint->id)
            ->where('scanned_at', '>=', $now->subMinutes((int) config('attendance.patrol.repeat_scan_minutes')))
            ->first();

        if ($repeat !== null) {
            return $repeat;
        }

        $photoPath = $this->photos->storeAs($photoDataUrl, sprintf('patrols/%d/%s', $guard->id, $now->toDateString()), 'scan');

        try {
            $scan = new PatrolScan;
            $scan->forceFill([
                'user_id' => $guard->id,
                'patrol_checkpoint_id' => $checkpoint->id,
                'time_log_id' => $log->id,
                'scanned_at' => $now,
                'latitude' => $latitude,
                'longitude' => $longitude,
                'accuracy_meters' => $accuracyMeters,
                'distance_meters' => $distance,
                'photo_path' => $photoPath,
            ])->save();

            return $scan->setRelation('checkpoint', $checkpoint);
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            $this->photos->delete($photoPath);

            throw $exception;
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return int|null meters from the checkpoint (or the site), when it has coordinates
     */
    private function ensureInReach(PatrolCheckpoint $checkpoint, Client $site, float $latitude, float $longitude, ?int $accuracyMeters): ?int
    {
        [$lat, $lng, $radius] = match (true) {
            $checkpoint->hasLocation() => [(float) $checkpoint->latitude, (float) $checkpoint->longitude, (int) config('attendance.patrol.checkpoint_radius_meters')],
            $site->hasGeofence() => [(float) $site->latitude, (float) $site->longitude, $site->geofence_meters],
            default => [null, null, null],
        };

        if ($lat === null || $lng === null || $radius === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $distance = $this->geofence->distanceMeters($latitude, $longitude, $lat, $lng);

        if (! $this->geofence->isInside($distance, $radius, $accuracyMeters)) {
            throw $this->reject("You're {$this->geofence->describe($distance)} from {$checkpoint->name}. Scan it where the sticker is.");
        }

        return $distance;
    }

    private function reject(string $message): ValidationException
    {
        return ValidationException::withMessages(['scan' => $message]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Queries\Attendance;

use App\Models\PatrolCheckpoint;
use App\Models\PatrolScan;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use App\Services\Attendance\AttendanceCalculator;
use App\Services\Attendance\Geofence;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * The patrol rounds of one roving duty: the duty is cut into windows of the
 * client's patrol interval (06:00–08:00, 08:00–10:00…), and each round is
 * complete when every active checkpoint was scanned inside its window.
 *
 * Rounds that end before the guard clocked in don't count against them.
 *
 * A round can also look faked (`suspicious`, a reason in words): its scans
 * came faster than anyone walks between checkpoints, or all from one spot
 * while the pinned checkpoints are metres apart. That's the guard scanning
 * photos of the stickers from the guardhouse.
 *
 * @phpstan-type Round array{index: int, from: CarbonImmutable, to: CarbonImmutable, state: string, scanned: list<int>, missing: list<string>, suspicious: string|null}
 */
final class PatrolRoundsQuery
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AttendanceCalculator $calculator,
        private readonly Geofence $geofence,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @return array{rounds: list<Round>, checkpoints: Collection<int, PatrolCheckpoint>}
     */
    public function handle(TimeLog $log, CarbonImmutable $now): array
    {
        $log->loadMissing(['dutyAssignment.shift', 'dutyAssignment.client']);
        $duty = $log->dutyAssignment;
        $client = $duty?->client;

        if ($duty === null || ! $duty->patrols || $client === null || $log->clock_in_at === null) {
            return ['rounds' => [], 'checkpoints' => new Collection];
        }

        $checkpoints = PatrolCheckpoint::query()->where('client_id', $client->id)->active()->orderBy('sort_order')->orderBy('name')->get();

        if ($checkpoints->isEmpty()) {
            return ['rounds' => [], 'checkpoints' => $checkpoints];
        }

        $scans = PatrolScan::query()->where('time_log_id', $log->id)->orderBy('scanned_at')->get(['patrol_checkpoint_id', 'scanned_at', 'latitude', 'longitude']);
        [$start, $end] = $this->calculator->shiftWindow($duty->shift, $duty->duty_date);
        $interval = max(15, $client->patrol_interval_minutes);
        $clockedOut = $log->clock_out_at;

        $rounds = [];
        $index = 0;

        for ($from = $start; $from->lt($end); $from = $from->addMinutes($interval)) {
            $to = $from->addMinutes($interval)->min($end);

            if ($to->lte($log->clock_in_at)) {
                continue;
            }

            $index++;
            $inRound = $scans->filter(fn (PatrolScan $scan) => $scan->scanned_at->gte($from) && $scan->scanned_at->lt($to))->values();
            $scanned = $inRound->pluck('patrol_checkpoint_id')->unique()->values()->all();
            $missing = $checkpoints->reject(fn (PatrolCheckpoint $checkpoint) => in_array($checkpoint->id, $scanned, true))->pluck('name')->values()->all();
            $over = $now->gte($to) || ($clockedOut !== null && $clockedOut->lt($to));

            $rounds[] = [
                'index' => $index,
                'from' => $from,
                'to' => $to,
                'state' => match (true) {
                    $missing === [] => 'done',
                    $over => 'missed',
                    $now->gte($from) => 'current',
                    default => 'upcoming',
                },
                'scanned' => array_values(array_map('intval', $scanned)),
                'missing' => array_values(array_map('strval', $missing)),
                'suspicious' => $this->suspicious($inRound, $checkpoints),
            ];
        }

        return ['rounds' => $rounds, 'checkpoints' => $checkpoints];
    }

    /**
     * Why a round's scans don't look like someone walking the route, or null.
     *
     * @param  Collection<int, PatrolScan>  $scans  the round's scans, in time order
     * @param  Collection<int, PatrolCheckpoint>  $checkpoints
     */
    private function suspicious(Collection $scans, Collection $checkpoints): ?string
    {
        // One scan per checkpoint (the first), and at least three of them to judge a route.
        $route = $scans->unique('patrol_checkpoint_id')->values();
        $first = $route->first();
        $last = $route->last();

        if ($route->count() < 3 || $first === null || $last === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $seconds = (int) $first->scanned_at->diffInSeconds($last->scanned_at);
        $perCheckpoint = (int) config('attendance.patrol.suspicious_seconds_per_checkpoint');

        if ($seconds < ($route->count() - 1) * $perCheckpoint) {
            return "{$route->count()} checkpoints scanned in {$seconds} seconds";
        }

        // All scanned from one spot, though the checkpoints themselves are spread out.
        $pinned = $checkpoints->filter(fn (PatrolCheckpoint $checkpoint) => $checkpoint->hasLocation() && in_array($checkpoint->id, $route->pluck('patrol_checkpoint_id')->all(), true))->values();

        if ($pinned->count() >= 2
            && $this->spread($pinned->map(fn (PatrolCheckpoint $checkpoint) => [(float) $checkpoint->latitude, (float) $checkpoint->longitude])) >= (int) config('attendance.patrol.suspicious_spread_meters')
            && $this->spread($route->map(fn (PatrolScan $scan) => [(float) $scan->latitude, (float) $scan->longitude])) <= (int) config('attendance.patrol.suspicious_same_spot_meters')) {
            return "all {$route->count()} checkpoints scanned from one spot";
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * The largest distance between any two of these points, in metres.
     *
     * @param  Collection<int, array{0: float, 1: float}>  $points
     */
    private function spread(Collection $points): int
    {
        $widest = 0;
        $all = $points->values()->all();

        foreach ($all as $i => [$lat, $lng]) {
            foreach (array_slice($all, $i + 1) as [$otherLat, $otherLng]) {
                $widest = max($widest, $this->geofence->distanceMeters($lat, $lng, $otherLat, $otherLng));
            }
        }

        return $widest;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Patrols;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\AwayReason;
use App\Models\AwayLog;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Someone on duty says they're stepping away, why, and for how long (the
 * reason's usual time unless they pick another). A guard leaving the post is
 * watched by Operations; office staff stepping out of the office by the
 * Executive (like their leave). They can add time while away (ExtendAway).
 */
final class LeavePost
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    /**
     * @param  int|null  $minutes  how long they expect to be; null = the reason's usual time
     */
    public function handle(User $guard, AwayReason $reason, ?string $note, ?float $latitude, ?float $longitude, ?int $minutes = null): AwayLog
    {
        $guard->loadMissing('employeeProfile');
        $isOffice = $guard->employeeProfile->is_office_staff ?? true;

        if (! in_array($reason, AwayReason::for($isOffice), true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['awayReason' => 'Choose one of the reasons listed.']);
        }

        if ($minutes !== null && ! in_array($minutes, config('attendance.away.durations'), true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['awayMinutes' => 'Choose one of the lengths listed.']);
        }

        $minutes ??= $reason->usualMinutes();

        if ($reason->needsNote() && mb_strlen(trim((string) $note)) < 5) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['awayNote' => 'Say where you\'re going (a few words).']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($guard, $reason, $note, $latitude, $longitude, $minutes) {
            // Locked on the user: two taps can't open two absences.
            User::query()->whereKey($guard->id)->lockForUpdate()->first();
            $now = CarbonImmutable::now();

            $log = TimeLog::query()->where('user_id', $guard->id)->whereNotNull('clock_in_at')->whereNull('clock_out_at')
                ->whereDate('log_date', '>=', $now->subDay()->toDateString())->latest('clock_in_at')->first();

            if ($log === null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['awayReason' => 'You\'re not clocked in.']);
            }

            if (AwayLog::query()->where('user_id', $guard->id)->open()->exists()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['awayReason' => 'You\'re already marked away. Tap "Back at post" first.']);
            }

            $away = new AwayLog;
            $away->forceFill([
                'user_id' => $guard->id,
                'time_log_id' => $log->id,
                'reason' => $reason,
                'note' => filled($note) ? mb_substr(trim((string) $note), 0, 500) : null,
                'left_at' => $now,
                'left_latitude' => $latitude,
                'left_longitude' => $longitude,
                'expected_back_at' => $now->addMinutes($minutes),
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Attendance, 'away.left', "{$guard->name} left the post: {$reason->label()}, back by {$now->addMinutes($minutes)->format('g:i A')}", $away, causer: $guard);

            return $away;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Patrols;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Models\AwayExtension;
use App\Models\AwayLog;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * "I need more time": traffic, a long queue, the errand grew. The person adds
 * time to their own absence with a short reason; no approval is needed, and
 * nobody is alerted. It moves the expected return, so a lateness alert only
 * comes if they're well past the new time.
 */
final class ExtendAway
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function handle(User $person, int $minutes, string $reason): AwayExtension
    {
        $reason = trim($reason);

        if (! in_array($minutes, config('attendance.away.extensions'), true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['extendMinutes' => 'Choose how much time to add.']);
        }

        if (mb_strlen($reason) < 3) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['extendReason' => 'Say why in a few words (e.g. traffic on EDSA).']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($person, $minutes, $reason) {
            $away = AwayLog::query()->where('user_id', $person->id)->open()->lockForUpdate()->first();

            if ($away === null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['extendMinutes' => 'You\'re not marked away.']);
            }

            $now = CarbonImmutable::now();
            $previous = $away->expectedBackAt();
            // Added from now when already late, so "+30 min" really means 30 more minutes.
            $next = ($previous->greaterThan($now) ? $previous : $now)->addMinutes($minutes);

            if ($away->left_at->diffInMinutes($next) > (int) config('attendance.away.max_minutes')) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['extendMinutes' => 'That\'s longer than one absence can be. Tap "Back" when you return, or call your supervisor.']);
            }

            $extension = new AwayExtension;
            $extension->forceFill([
                'away_log_id' => $away->id,
                'minutes' => $minutes,
                'reason' => mb_substr($reason, 0, 200),
                'previous_back_at' => $previous,
                'new_back_at' => $next,
            ])->save();

            $away->forceFill(['expected_back_at' => $next])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Attendance, 'away.extended', "{$person->name} added {$minutes} min ({$reason}); back by {$next->format('g:i A')}", $away, causer: $person);

            return $extension;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Enums\AwayReason;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne;

/**
 * Someone away from their post (or the office) during work: why, from when,
 * when they said they'd be back (and any time added), until when, and
 * whether a supervisor approved it. Nothing is fillable: the Actions set
 * every column.
 *
 * What counts as a problem is deliberately narrow: running late is normal
 * (traffic, queues), so it's only a heads-up. A supervisor is alerted when
 * nobody knows where they are (no location for a while) or they're well past
 * their own time without asking for more.
 *
 * @property int $id
 * @property int $user_id
 * @property int $time_log_id
 * @property AwayReason $reason
 * @property string|null $note
 * @property CarbonImmutable $left_at
 * @property string|null $left_latitude
 * @property string|null $left_longitude
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $expected_back_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $returned_at
 * @property string|null $returned_latitude
 * @property string|null $returned_longitude
 * @property int|null $returned_distance_meters
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $auto_closed_at closed at the duty's end because nobody ended it
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $locations_pruned_at its GPS trail was deleted (retention)
 * @property int|null $approved_by
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $approved_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable $created_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable $updated_at
 * @property-read User $user
 * @property-read TimeLog $timeLog
 * @property-read User|null $approver
 * @property-read AwayLocationUpdate|null $latestLocation
 * @property-read Collection<int, AwayExtension> $extensions
 * @property-read int|null $extensions_count
 */
class AwayLog extends Model
{
    /**
     * @var array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected $attributes = [
        'note' => null,
        'returned_at' => null,
        'returned_distance_meters' => null,
        'approved_by' => null,
        'approved_at' => null,
    ];

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'reason' => AwayReason::class,
            'left_at' => 'datetime',
            'expected_back_at' => 'datetime',
            'returned_at' => 'datetime',
            'auto_closed_at' => 'datetime',
            'locations_pruned_at' => 'datetime',
            'approved_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * How the absence stands, as a badge [tone, text], for the lists, the
     * location window and the employee record alike.
     *
     * @return array{0: string, 1: string}
     */
    public function outcome(CarbonImmutable $now): array
    {
        $past = $this->minutesPastExpected($now);

        return match (true) {
            $this->approved_at !== null => ['blue', 'Approved by '.($this->approver->name ?? '—')],
            $this->auto_closed_at !== null => ['red', 'Never ended: closed at duty end'],
            $this->returned_at !== null && $past > 0 => ['amber', "Back {$past} min after ".$this->expectedBackAt()->format('g:i A')],
            $this->returned_at !== null => ['gray', 'Back on time'],
            $this->isLocationOverdue($now) => ['red', 'No location for '.(int) $this->lastSeenAt()->diffInMinutes($now).' min'],
            $this->isLate($now) => ['red', "{$past} min past their time"],
            $past > 0 => ['amber', "Running late · {$past} min past their time"],
            default => ['gray', 'Out now'],
        };
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function user(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<TimeLog, $this>
     */
    public function timeLog(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(TimeLog::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function approver(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'approved_by');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<AwayLocationUpdate, $this>
     */
    public function locationUpdates(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(AwayLocationUpdate::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasOne<AwayLocationUpdate, $this>
     */
    public function latestLocation(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(AwayLocationUpdate::class)->latestOfMany('recorded_at');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<AwayExtension, $this>
     */
    public function extensions(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(AwayExtension::class)->orderBy('id');
    }

    /** When they said they'd be back, with any time added; older rows: the reason's usual time. */
    public function expectedBackAt(): CarbonImmutable
    {
        return $this->expected_back_at ?? $this->left_at->addMinutes($this->reason->usualMinutes());
    }

    /** Minutes past the expected time (0 when not past it); measured to the return once back. */
    public function minutesPastExpected(CarbonImmutable $now): int
    {
        $end = $this->returned_at ?? $now;

        return $end->greaterThan($this->expectedBackAt()) ? (int) $this->expectedBackAt()->diffInMinutes($end) : 0;
    }

    /** Past the time they said, not approved: a heads-up (amber), not a violation. */
    public function isPastExpected(CarbonImmutable $now): bool
    {
        return $this->approved_at === null && $this->minutesPastExpected($now) > 0;
    }

    /** Well past their own time and still out, with no more time asked: worth a call. */
    public function isLate(CarbonImmutable $now): bool
    {
        return $this->returned_at === null && $this->approved_at === null
            && $this->minutesPastExpected($now) >= (int) config('attendance.away.late_alert_minutes');
    }

    /** When they last said where they are: the latest update, or leaving. */
    public function lastSeenAt(): CarbonImmutable
    {
        $this->loadMissing('latestLocation');

        return $this->latestLocation->recorded_at ?? $this->left_at;
    }

    /** Time for a location update: a reminder on their phone only. */
    public function isLocationDue(CarbonImmutable $now): bool
    {
        return $this->returned_at === null && $this->lastSeenAt()->diffInMinutes($now) >= (int) config('attendance.away.location_update_minutes');
    }

    /** No location for long enough that the supervisor is told. */
    public function isLocationOverdue(CarbonImmutable $now): bool
    {
        return $this->returned_at === null && $this->lastSeenAt()->diffInMinutes($now) >= (int) config('attendance.away.location_alert_minutes');
    }

    /** Nobody knows where they are, or they're well past their time: the red ones. */
    public function needsAttention(CarbonImmutable $now): bool
    {
        return $this->isLocationOverdue($now) || $this->isLate($now);
    }

    /**
     * Still away.
     *
     * @param  Builder<AwayLog>  $query
     */
    public function scopeOpen(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->whereNull('returned_at');
    }

    public function minutesAway(CarbonImmutable $now): int
    {
        return (int) $this->left_at->diffInMinutes($this->returned_at ?? $now);
    }
}
