<?php

namespace App\Actions\Patrols;

use App\Models\AwayLocationUpdate;
use App\Models\AwayLog;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Attendance\Geofence;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * A guard away from the post shares where they are. Asked for every
 * attendance.away.location_update_minutes; Operations sees the latest spot,
 * how far it is from the post, and a map link, and is alerted when an update
 * is overdue.
 *
 * Informational, never blocking: a rough fix is saved with its accuracy so
 * Operations can judge it.
 */
final class UpdateAwayLocation
{
    public function __construct(private readonly Geofence $geofence) {}

    public function handle(User $guard, float $latitude, float $longitude, ?int $accuracyMeters): AwayLocationUpdate
    {
        if ($latitude < -90 || $latitude > 90 || $longitude < -180 || $longitude > 180) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['location' => 'Your GPS location is missing. Allow location access and try again.']);
        }

        $away = AwayLog::query()->with('timeLog.dutyAssignment.client')->where('user_id', $guard->id)->open()->latest('left_at')->first();

        if ($away === null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['location' => 'You\'re not marked away.']);
        }

        $update = new AwayLocationUpdate;
        $update->forceFill([
            'away_log_id' => $away->id,
            'recorded_at' => CarbonImmutable::now(),
            'latitude' => $latitude,
            'longitude' => $longitude,
            'accuracy_meters' => $accuracyMeters,
            'distance_meters' => $this->distanceFromPost($away, $guard, $latitude, $longitude),
        ])->save();

        return $update;
    }

    /**
     * Meters from where they work, when that place has coordinates. Shared
     * with ReturnToPost.
     */
    public function distanceFromPost(AwayLog $away, User $guard, float $latitude, float $longitude): ?int
    {
        $post = self::postFor($away, $guard);

        return $post !== null ? $this->geofence->distanceMeters($latitude, $longitude, $post['lat'], $post['lng']) : null;
    }

    /**
     * Where this person works: a guard's post (the duty's client, else their
     * usual one), or for office staff their OSSI office, else the head office
     * set in attendance.office. Null when that place has no coordinates.
     *
     * @return array{lat: float, lng: float, radius: int, name: string}|null
     */
    public static function postFor(AwayLog $away, User $person): ?array
    {
        $person->loadMissing(['employeeProfile.client', 'employeeProfile.office']);

        $office = $person->employeeProfile?->is_office_staff ? $person->employeeProfile->office : null;

        if ($office !== null && $office->hasGeofence()) {
            return ['lat' => (float) $office->latitude, 'lng' => (float) $office->longitude, 'radius' => $office->geofence_meters, 'name' => $office->name];
        }

        if ($person->employeeProfile->is_office_staff ?? true) {
            /** @var array{name: string, latitude: float|null, longitude: float|null, radius_meters: int} $office */
            $office = config('attendance.office');

            return $office['latitude'] !== null && $office['longitude'] !== null
                ? ['lat' => $office['latitude'], 'lng' => $office['longitude'], 'radius' => $office['radius_meters'], 'name' => $office['name']]
                : null;
        }

        $away->loadMissing('timeLog.dutyAssignment.client');
        $site = $away->timeLog->dutyAssignment->client ?? $person->employeeProfile?->client;

        return $site !== null && $site->hasGeofence()
            ? ['lat' => (float) $site->latitude, 'lng' => (float) $site->longitude, 'radius' => $site->geofence_meters, 'name' => $site->name]
            : null;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Queries\Attendance;

use App\Actions\Patrols\UpdateAwayLocation;
use App\Contracts\ReverseGeocoder;
use App\Enums\AwayReason;
use App\Models\AwayExtension;
use App\Models\AwayLocationUpdate;
use App\Models\AwayLog;
use App\Services\Attendance\Geofence;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;

/**
 * Everything the "where is this guard" window shows for one absence: the
 * post and its geofence, every point of the trail (left → updates → back),
 * and the street address of the latest spot.
 *
 * Only the latest spot is looked up (cached by the geocoder): OpenStreetMap
 * asks for at most one lookup a second.
 *
 * @phpstan-type TrailPoint array{lat: float|null, lng: float|null, accuracy: int|null, label: string, kind: string, at: CarbonImmutable, distance: int|null, mapUrl: string|null}
 */
final class AwayTrailQuery
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ReverseGeocoder $geocoder,
        private readonly Geofence $geofence,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @return array{post: array{lat: float, lng: float, radius: int, name: string}|null, points: list<TrailPoint>, address: string|null, latest: TrailPoint}
     */
    public function handle(AwayLog $away): array
    {
        $away->loadMissing(['locationUpdates', 'extensions', 'timeLog.dutyAssignment.client', 'user.employeeProfile.client']);
        // A guard's post, or the head office for office staff.
        $post = UpdateAwayLocation::postFor($away, $away->user);

        $distance = fn (?float $lat, ?float $lng): ?int => $post !== null && $lat !== null && $lng !== null
            ? $this->geofence->distanceMeters($lat, $lng, $post['lat'], $post['lng'])
            : null;
        $map = fn (?float $lat, ?float $lng): ?string => $lat !== null && $lng !== null ? "https://www.google.com/maps?q={$lat},{$lng}" : null;

        $leftLat = $away->left_latitude !== null ? (float) $away->left_latitude : null;
        $leftLng = $away->left_longitude !== null ? (float) $away->left_longitude : null;

        $points = [[
            'lat' => $leftLat, 'lng' => $leftLng, 'accuracy' => null, 'kind' => 'left', 'at' => $away->left_at,
            'label' => 'Left '.$away->left_at->format('g:i A'), 'distance' => $distance($leftLat, $leftLng), 'mapUrl' => $map($leftLat, $leftLng),
        ]];

        foreach ($away->locationUpdates->sortBy('recorded_at') as $update) {
            /** @var AwayLocationUpdate $update */
            $lat = (float) $update->latitude;
            $lng = (float) $update->longitude;
            $points[] = [
                'lat' => $lat, 'lng' => $lng, 'accuracy' => $update->accuracy_meters, 'kind' => 'update', 'at' => $update->recorded_at,
                'label' => $update->recorded_at->format('g:i A'), 'distance' => $update->distance_meters ?? $distance($lat, $lng), 'mapUrl' => $map($lat, $lng),
            ];
        }

        // "Needed more time" has no position: the timeline shows it, the map skips it.
        foreach ($away->extensions as $extension) {
            /** @var AwayExtension $extension */
            $points[] = [
                'lat' => null, 'lng' => null, 'accuracy' => null, 'kind' => 'extended', 'at' => $extension->created_at,
                'label' => '+'.AwayReason::durationLabel($extension->minutes).': '.$extension->reason.' (back by '.$extension->new_back_at->format('g:i A').')', 'distance' => null, 'mapUrl' => null,
            ];
        }

        usort($points, fn (array $a, array $b) => $a['at'] <=> $b['at']);

        if ($away->returned_at !== null) {
            $lat = $away->returned_latitude !== null ? (float) $away->returned_latitude : null;
            $lng = $away->returned_longitude !== null ? (float) $away->returned_longitude : null;
            $points[] = [
                'lat' => $lat, 'lng' => $lng, 'accuracy' => null, 'kind' => 'returned', 'at' => $away->returned_at,
                'label' => 'Back '.$away->returned_at->format('g:i A'), 'distance' => $away->returned_distance_meters ?? $distance($lat, $lng), 'mapUrl' => $map($lat, $lng),
            ];
        }

        // The latest point that has coordinates (an update can't lack them; leaving or returning can).
        $latest = collect($points)->last(fn (array $point) => $point['lat'] !== null) ?? $points[array_key_last($points)];

        $address = $latest['lat'] !== null && $latest['lng'] !== null ? $this->geocoder->addressFor($latest['lat'], $latest['lng']) : null;

        return ['post' => $post, 'points' => $points, 'address' => $address, 'latest' => $latest];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Admin;

use App\Actions\Patrols\ApproveAway;
use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AwayReason;
use App\Enums\Region;
use App\Livewire\Concerns\InteractsWithUser;
use App\Models\AwayLog;
use App\Queries\Attendance\AwayTrailQuery;
use App\Support\Heads;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\WithPagination;

/**
 * Who is away from work right now, why, for how long and where: the list,
 * the location window (map, address, trail) and Approve.
 *
 * Two audiences, like leave:
 *  - 'field':  guards away from their post, for Operations (embedded on
 *              Patrols; a Satellite Operation sees its region);
 *  - 'office': office staff out of the office, for the President or Vice President
 *              (the Office Away page).
 *
 * The list is sorted into status tabs (needs attention first) and filtered
 * by name, reason and region, so it stays readable with hundreds out.
 *
 * @property-read Collection<int, AwayLog> $openAways
 * @property-read array<string, int> $statusCounts
 * @property-read Collection<int, AwayLog> $awayNow
 * @property-read LengthAwarePaginator<int, AwayLog> $awayToday
 * @property-read AwayLog|null $viewingAway
 * @property-read array{post: array{lat: float, lng: float, radius: int, name: string}|null, points: list<array{lat: float|null, lng: float|null, accuracy: int|null, label: string, kind: string, at: CarbonImmutable, distance: int|null, mapUrl: string|null}>, address: string|null, latest: array{lat: float|null, lng: float|null, accuracy: int|null, label: string, kind: string, at: CarbonImmutable, distance: int|null, mapUrl: string|null}}|null $trail
 */
#[Title('Office Away')]
class AwayMonitor extends Component
{
    use InteractsWithUser, WithPagination;

    /**
     * The status tabs over the people out now. "Needs attention" is narrow on
     * purpose: no location for a while, or well past their own time.
     */
    public const STATUSES = [
        'all' => 'All',
        'attention' => 'Needs attention',
        'late' => 'Past their time',
        'overdue' => 'Location overdue',
        'approved' => 'Approved',
    ];

    #[Locked]
    public string $scope = 'office';

    /** The absence whose location window is open. */
    public ?int $viewingAwayId = null;

    public string $status = 'all';

    public string $search = '';

    /** An AwayReason value, or '' for every reason. */
    public string $reason = '';

    /** A Region value, or '' for every region (guards only). */
    public string $region = '';

    /** The day of the "back" list, Y-m-d; '' = today. Earlier days are the history. */
    public string $day = '';

    public function previousDay(): void
    {
        $this->day = $this->shownDay()->subDay()->toDateString();
        $this->resetPage('back');
    }

    public function nextDay(): void
    {
        $next = $this->shownDay()->addDay();
        $this->day = $next->isToday() || $next->isFuture() ? '' : $next->toDateString();
        $this->resetPage('back');
    }

    /** The day shown: a valid past date, else today (a typed URL can't ask for the future). */
    public function shownDay(): CarbonImmutable
    {
        $day = preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', $this->day) === 1 ? CarbonImmutable::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $this->day) : false;

        return $day instanceof CarbonImmutable && $day->startOfDay()->lessThan(CarbonImmutable::today()) ? $day->startOfDay() : CarbonImmutable::today();
    }

    public function mount(string $scope = 'office'): void
    {
        $this->scope = $scope === 'field' ? 'field' : 'office';
        $this->authorize($this->ability()->value);
    }

    public function updated(string $property): void
    {
        if (in_array($property, ['search', 'reason', 'region', 'day'], true)) {
            $this->resetPage('back');
        }
    }

    public function approve(int $awayId, ApproveAway $approve): void
    {
        $this->authorize($this->ability()->value);

        $approve->handle($this->scoped()->findOrFail($awayId), $this->currentUser());
        unset($this->openAways, $this->statusCounts, $this->awayNow, $this->awayToday, $this->viewingAway, $this->trail);
        $this->dispatch('notify', message: 'Time away approved.');
    }

    public function viewAway(int $awayId): void
    {
        $this->authorize($this->ability()->value);

        $this->viewingAwayId = $this->scoped()->findOrFail($awayId)->id;
        unset($this->viewingAway, $this->trail);
    }

    public function closeAway(): void
    {
        $this->reset('viewingAwayId');
    }

    private function ability(): Ability
    {
        return $this->scope === 'office' ? Ability::MonitorOfficeAway : Ability::ManagePatrols;
    }

    /**
     * Absences this audience covers: guards in the viewer's reach, or office staff (an account
     * with no HR profile counts as office staff): all of them for the President or VP and the
     * Super Admin, every non-HR staffer for HR, else only those the viewer heads (Operation HQ:
     * Satellites). Only the head approves (ApproveAway::canApprove).
     *
     * @return Builder<AwayLog>
     */
    private function scoped(): Builder
    {
        $viewer = $this->currentUser();

        return AwayLog::query()->whereHas('user', fn (Builder $user) => match (true) {
            $this->scope !== 'office' => $user->visibleTo($viewer)->whereHas('employeeProfile', fn (Builder $profile) => $profile->where('is_office_staff', false)),
            default => Heads::constrainOfficeStaffSeenBy($user, $viewer),
        });
    }

    /** Regions are a filter only for guards, and only for viewers who see more than one. */
    public function filtersByRegion(): bool
    {
        return $this->scope === 'field' && ! $this->currentUser()->isRegionallyLimited();
    }

    /**
     * The audience, narrowed by the search, reason and region filters.
     *
     * @return Builder<AwayLog>
     */
    private function filtered(): Builder
    {
        $search = trim($this->search);
        $reason = AwayReason::tryFrom($this->reason);
        $region = $this->filtersByRegion() ? Region::tryFrom($this->region) : null;

        return $this->scoped()
            ->when($search !== '', fn (Builder $query) => $query->whereHas('user', fn (Builder $user) => $user->where('name', 'like', '%'.$search.'%')))
            ->when($reason !== null, fn (Builder $query) => $query->where('reason', $reason?->value))
            // The post they're rostered at today, else the client they're deployed to.
            ->when($region !== null, fn (Builder $query) => $query->where(fn (Builder $where) => $where
                ->whereHas('timeLog.dutyAssignment.client', fn (Builder $client) => $client->where('region', $region?->value))
                ->orWhere(fn (Builder $undeployed) => $undeployed
                    ->whereDoesntHave('timeLog.dutyAssignment.client')
                    ->whereHas('user.employeeProfile.client', fn (Builder $client) => $client->where('region', $region?->value)))));
    }

    /**
     * Everyone out right now who matches the filters, before the status tab.
     * Always a small set (only open absences), so the status is worked out here.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, AwayLog>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function openAways(): Collection
    {
        return $this->filtered()->open()
            ->with(['user.employeeProfile', 'timeLog.dutyAssignment.client', 'approver', 'latestLocation'])
            ->withCount('extensions')
            ->orderBy('left_at')
            ->get();
    }

    /**
     * How many fall under each status tab.
     *
     * @return array<string, int>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function statusCounts(): array
    {
        $now = CarbonImmutable::now();

        return collect(array_keys(self::STATUSES))
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (string $status) => [$status => $this->openAways->filter(fn (AwayLog $away) => self::hasStatus($away, $status, $now))->count()])
            ->all();
    }

    private static function hasStatus(AwayLog $away, string $status, CarbonImmutable $now): bool
    {
        return match ($status) {
            'attention' => $away->needsAttention($now),
            'late' => $away->isPastExpected($now),
            'overdue' => $away->isLocationOverdue($now),
            'approved' => $away->approved_at !== null,
            default => true,
        };
    }

    /**
     * The list on screen: the tab's people, the ones needing attention first.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, AwayLog>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function awayNow(): Collection
    {
        $now = CarbonImmutable::now();
        $status = array_key_exists($this->status, self::STATUSES) ? $this->status : 'all';

        return $this->openAways
            ->filter(fn (AwayLog $away) => self::hasStatus($away, $status, $now))
            ->sortBy(fn (AwayLog $away) => [self::hasStatus($away, 'attention', $now) ? 0 : 1, $away->left_at->getTimestamp()])
            ->values();
    }

    /**
     * Finished absences of the chosen day (today unless picked), for the
     * record: paged, with the real total. Earlier days are the history.
     *
     * @return LengthAwarePaginator<int, AwayLog>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function awayToday(): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        $day = $this->shownDay();

        // A range, not whereDate(): a function on the column would skip its index.
        return $this->filtered()->whereNotNull('returned_at')
            ->whereBetween('left_at', [$day->startOfDay(), $day->endOfDay()])
            ->with(['user.employeeProfile', 'approver'])
            ->latest('left_at')
            ->paginate(15, pageName: 'back');
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function viewingAway(): ?AwayLog
    {
        return $this->viewingAwayId !== null
            ? $this->scoped()->with(['user.employeeProfile', 'approver', 'timeLog.dutyAssignment.client'])->find($this->viewingAwayId)
            : null;
    }

    /**
     * @return array{post: array{lat: float, lng: float, radius: int, name: string}|null, points: list<array{lat: float|null, lng: float|null, accuracy: int|null, label: string, kind: string, at: CarbonImmutable, distance: int|null, mapUrl: string|null}>, address: string|null, latest: array{lat: float|null, lng: float|null, accuracy: int|null, label: string, kind: string, at: CarbonImmutable, distance: int|null, mapUrl: string|null}}|null
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function trail(): ?array
    {
        return $this->viewingAway !== null ? app(AwayTrailQuery::class)->handle($this->viewingAway) : null;
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        return view('livewire.admin.away-monitor');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Patrols;

use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Models\AwayLog;
use App\Models\SentAlert;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\PatrolAlert;
use App\Queries\Attendance\PatrolRoundsQuery;
use App\Support\Heads;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;

/**
 * Run every 15 minutes. Sends, once each:
 *  - a roving guard missed a patrol round (a checkpoint not scanned in time);
 *  - a round looks faked (scanned in seconds, or all from one spot);
 *  - someone away is well past the time they said they'd be back, without
 *    asking for more (once per expected time: adding time and running late
 *    again alerts again);
 *  - someone away hasn't shared their location for a long while.
 * Merely running a little late, or a reminder to share, is never an alert.
 *
 * Guards' alerts go to Operation HQ and the region's Satellite Operation; office staff's to
 * their head (App\Support\Heads), like their leave.
 */
final class SendPatrolAlerts
{
    public function __construct(private readonly PatrolRoundsQuery $rounds) {}

    /**
     * @return int how many alerts were sent
     */
    public function handle(CarbonImmutable $now): int
    {
        $operations = User::query()->notifiable([Role::OperationsHq, Role::SatelliteOperations])->with('roles')->get();

        return $this->missedRounds($now, $operations) + $this->lateAway($now, $operations) + $this->overdueLocation($now, $operations);
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, User>  $operations
     */
    private function missedRounds(CarbonImmutable $now, Collection $operations): int
    {
        if ($operations->isEmpty()) {
            return 0;
        }

        $logs = TimeLog::query()
            ->whereHas('dutyAssignment', fn ($query) => $query->where('patrols', true))
            ->whereDate('log_date', '>=', $now->subDay()->toDateString())
            ->whereNotNull('clock_in_at')
            ->with(['user', 'dutyAssignment.client', 'dutyAssignment.shift'])
            ->get();

        $sent = 0;

        foreach ($logs as $log) {
            foreach ($this->rounds->handle($log, $now)['rounds'] as $round) {
                $client = $log->dutyAssignment?->client;

                // Scanned, but not walked: photos of the stickers, from one spot or in seconds.
                if ($round['suspicious'] !== null) {
                    $sent += $this->send("patrol.suspicious.{$round['index']}", $log, $this->operationsFor($operations, $client?->region),
                        new PatrolAlert($log->user->name, "Round {$round['index']} looks faked at ".($client->name ?? 'the post'), ucfirst($round['suspicious']).' ('.$round['from']->format('g:i').'–'.$round['to']->format('g:i A').'). Check the scan photos on Patrols, or call the guard.', route('patrols')));
                }

                if ($round['state'] !== 'missed') {
                    continue;
                }

                $sent += $this->send("patrol.missed.{$round['index']}", $log, $this->operationsFor($operations, $client?->region),
                    new PatrolAlert($log->user->name, "Round {$round['index']} missed ({$round['from']->format('g:i')}–{$round['to']->format('g:i A')}) at ".($client->name ?? 'the post'), 'Not scanned: '.implode(', ', $round['missing']).'.'));
            }
        }

        return $sent;
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, User>  $operations
     */
    private function lateAway(CarbonImmutable $now, Collection $operations): int
    {
        $sent = 0;

        foreach (AwayLog::query()->open()->whereNull('approved_at')->with(['user.employeeProfile', 'timeLog.dutyAssignment.client'])->get() as $away) {
            if (! $away->isLate($now)) {
                continue;
            }

            [$recipients, $where, $page, $url] = $this->audience($away, $operations);
            $sent += $this->send('away.late.'.$away->expectedBackAt()->format('YmdHis'), $away, $recipients,
                new PatrolAlert($away->user->name, "Not back yet: {$away->minutesPastExpected($now)} min past {$away->expectedBackAt()->format('g:i A')} ({$away->reason->label()})", ($away->note ?? 'No note.')." Away from {$where} since {$away->left_at->format('g:i A')}; no more time asked. Call them, or approve it on {$page}.", $url));
        }

        return $sent;
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, User>  $operations
     */
    private function overdueLocation(CarbonImmutable $now, Collection $operations): int
    {
        $sent = 0;

        foreach (AwayLog::query()->open()->with(['user.employeeProfile', 'latestLocation', 'timeLog.dutyAssignment.client'])->get() as $away) {
            if (! $away->isLocationOverdue($now)) {
                continue;
            }

            // Once per silence: keyed on the last time they shared, so a new
            // update and then another silence alerts again, but no repeats.
            [$recipients, , $page, $url] = $this->audience($away, $operations);
            $sent += $this->send('away.location.'.$away->lastSeenAt()->format('YmdHis'), $away, $recipients,
                new PatrolAlert($away->user->name, 'No location shared for '.(int) $away->lastSeenAt()->diffInMinutes($now).' min while away ('.$away->reason->label().')', 'Last seen '.$away->lastSeenAt()->format('g:i A').'; expected back by '.$away->expectedBackAt()->format('g:i A').". Call them, or check {$page}.", $url));
        }

        return $sent;
    }

    /**
     * Who hears about this absence, and where to send them.
     *
     * @param  Collection<int, User>  $operations
     * @return array{0: Collection<int, User>, 1: string, 2: string, 3: string}
     */
    private function audience(AwayLog $away, Collection $operations): array
    {
        if ($away->user->employeeProfile->is_office_staff ?? true) {
            return [Heads::of($away->user), 'the office', 'Office Away', route('office-away')];
        }

        return [$this->operationsFor($operations, $away->timeLog->dutyAssignment?->client?->region), 'the post', 'Patrols', route('patrols')];
    }

    /**
     * Operation HQ always; a Satellite Operation only for its own region.
     *
     * @param  Collection<int, User>  $operations
     * @return Collection<int, User>
     */
    private function operationsFor(Collection $operations, mixed $region): Collection
    {
        return $operations->filter(fn (User $user) => $user->hasRole(Role::OperationsHq) || ($region !== null && $user->operations_region === $region))->values();
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, User>  $recipients
     */
    private function send(string $alert, TimeLog|AwayLog $subject, Collection $recipients, PatrolAlert $notice): int
    {
        if ($recipients->isEmpty()) {
            return 0;
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($alert, $subject, $recipients, $notice) {
            if (! SentAlert::claim($alert, $subject)) {
                return 0;
            }

            Notification::send($recipients, $notice);

            return 1;
        });
    }
}

import loadLeaflet from './leaflet-loader';

// Leaflet (loaded when a map is first opened, leaflet-loader.js).
let L = null;

/**
 * The map in the "where is this person" window (Patrols / Office Away): the
 * post or office and its circle, the trail since they left, and the latest
 * spot with its GPS accuracy. OpenStreetMap tiles; markers are drawn
 * circles, so no marker images need bundling.
 *
 * `data` = { post: {lat, lng, radius, name} | null, points: [{lat, lng, accuracy, label, kind}] }
 * in time order; points without coordinates (e.g. "needed more time") are
 * skipped. The last point with coordinates is the latest spot.
 *
 * It opens fitted to the trail, with the post too when it's near (a far
 * post would shrink the trail to one dot). The timeline next to it sends
 * `away-map-focus` with a point's index to show that spot.
 *
 * Leaflet objects live in this closure, not on the Alpine component:
 * Alpine's reactive proxies break Leaflet's internals.
 */
export default function awayMap(data) {
    const blue = '#2563eb';
    const amber = '#d97706';
    const gray = '#6b7280';
    // The post is shown on open only when it's within this distance of the trail.
    const nearPostMeters = 3000;

    let map = null;
    let gone = false;
    let markers = {};
    let focused = null;
    let latestMarker = null;
    let trail = [];

    // Back to the resting state: no point highlighted, the latest spot labelled.
    const unfocus = () => {
        focused?.setStyle({ weight: 2, color: '#fff' });
        focused = null;
        latestMarker?.openTooltip();
    };

    const fit = (bounds) => {
        if (bounds.length === 1) {
            map.setView(bounds[0], 17);
        } else if (bounds.length > 1) {
            map.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: [30, 30], maxZoom: 17 });
        } else {
            map.setView([14.5995, 120.9842], 11); // Manila, when nothing has coordinates
        }
    };

    return {
        hasPost: data.post !== null,
        postFar: false,

        init() {
            // The window opens with a transition: wait until it has its size.
            setTimeout(() => this.draw(), 120);
        },

        destroy() {
            gone = true;
            map?.remove();
            map = null;
            markers = {};
            focused = null;
        },

        async draw() {
            if (!this.$refs.map) return;

            L = await loadLeaflet();
            // Closed while Leaflet was loading.
            if (gone || !this.$refs.map?.isConnected) return;

            map = L.map(this.$refs.map, { scrollWheelZoom: false, attributionControl: true });
            L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
                maxZoom: 19,
                attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors',
            }).addTo(map);

            if (data.post) {
                const post = [data.post.lat, data.post.lng];
                L.circle(post, { radius: data.post.radius, color: blue, weight: 1, fillColor: blue, fillOpacity: 0.08 }).addTo(map);
                L.circleMarker(post, { radius: 7, color: '#fff', weight: 2, fillColor: blue, fillOpacity: 1 })
                    .bindTooltip(data.post.name, { direction: 'top' })
                    .addTo(map);
            }

            const located = data.points
                .map((point, index) => ({ ...point, index }))
                .filter((point) => point.lat !== null && point.lng !== null);
            trail = located.map((point) => [point.lat, point.lng]);

            if (located.length > 1) {
                L.polyline(trail, { color: gray, weight: 2, dashArray: '4 6' }).addTo(map);
            }

            located.forEach((point, position) => {
                const latest = position === located.length - 1;
                const at = [point.lat, point.lng];

                if (latest && point.accuracy) {
                    L.circle(at, { radius: point.accuracy, color: amber, weight: 1, fillColor: amber, fillOpacity: 0.12 }).addTo(map);
                }

                markers[point.index] = L.circleMarker(at, {
                    radius: latest ? 8 : 5,
                    color: '#fff',
                    weight: 2,
                    fillColor: latest ? amber : gray,
                    fillOpacity: 1,
                })
                    .bindTooltip(point.label, { direction: 'top', permanent: latest })
                    .addTo(map);

                if (latest) latestMarker = markers[point.index];
            });

            if (data.post && trail.length > 0) {
                const post = L.latLng(data.post.lat, data.post.lng);
                this.postFar = Math.min(...trail.map((at) => post.distanceTo(at))) > nearPostMeters;
            }

            this.showTrail();
        },

        /** The whole trail, plus the post when it's near. */
        showTrail() {
            if (!map) return;
            unfocus();
            fit(data.post && !this.postFar ? [...trail, [data.post.lat, data.post.lng]] : trail);
        },

        /** The trail and the post together, however far apart. */
        showPost() {
            if (!map || !data.post) return;
            unfocus();
            fit([...trail, [data.post.lat, data.post.lng]]);
        },

        /** One point of the timeline: centre it and say what it is. */
        focus(index) {
            const marker = markers[index];
            if (!map || !marker) return;

            unfocus();
            // Only one label at a time: the latest spot's permanent one would cover this one.
            if (marker !== latestMarker) latestMarker?.closeTooltip();
            marker.setStyle({ weight: 3, color: blue });
            focused = marker;
            map.setView(marker.getLatLng(), Math.max(map.getZoom(), 17));
            marker.openTooltip();
            this.$refs.map.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
        },
    };
}

// jsQR (~130 KB) is only the fallback for browsers without the built-in BarcodeDetector,
// so it's loaded the first time one of those reads a frame, not with every page.
let jsQRModule = null;

/**
 * Checkpoint scanner. Opens the BACK camera, reads QR codes from the live
 * video (the browser's BarcodeDetector where it exists, jsQR elsewhere,
 * e.g. iPhone Safari), and on a hit sends the code, that same camera frame
 * (proof of the spot) and the GPS fix to ClockPanel::submitScan().
 *
 * Lives only while the modal is open (x-if); destroy() stops camera and GPS.
 */
const MAX_SIDE = 960;

export default function patrolScanner({ maxAccuracy = 100 } = {}) {
    return {
        stream: null,
        watchId: null,
        coords: null,
        detector: null,
        timer: null,
        busy: false,
        error: null,
        locationError: null,
        message: null,
        ok: false,
        failed: false,
        pauseUntil: 0,

        async init() {
            this.startLocation();
            await this.startCamera();

            if ('BarcodeDetector' in window) {
                try {
                    this.detector = new window.BarcodeDetector({ formats: ['qr_code'] });
                } catch {
                    this.detector = null;
                }
            }

            this.timer = setInterval(() => this.scanFrame(), 350);
        },

        destroy() {
            clearInterval(this.timer);
            this.stream?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
            if (this.watchId !== null) navigator.geolocation?.clearWatch(this.watchId);
        },

        async startCamera() {
            if (!window.isSecureContext || !navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
                this.error = 'The camera needs HTTPS. Open this site with https://';
                return;
            }

            try {
                this.stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: { ideal: 'environment' } }, audio: false });
                this.$refs.video.srcObject = this.stream;
                await this.$refs.video.play();
            } catch (error) {
                this.error = `Camera unavailable: ${error.message}`;
            }
        },

        startLocation() {
            if (!navigator.geolocation) {
                this.error = 'This browser cannot share its location.';
                return;
            }

            this.watchId = navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(
                (position) => { this.coords = position.coords; this.locationError = null; },
                // Passing errors (position unavailable, a timeout) clear on the next reading.
                (error) => { this.locationError = error.code === error.PERMISSION_DENIED ? 'Location is blocked. Allow it for this site to scan.' : 'Looking for your GPS position…'; },
                { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 15000, maximumAge: 5000 },
            );
        },

        frameCanvas() {
            const video = this.$refs.video;
            if (!video || !video.videoWidth) return null;

            const scale = Math.min(1, MAX_SIDE / Math.max(video.videoWidth, video.videoHeight));
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = Math.round(video.videoWidth * scale);
            canvas.height = Math.round(video.videoHeight * scale);
            canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

            return canvas;
        },

        async readCode(canvas) {
            if (this.detector) {
                const found = await this.detector.detect(canvas).catch(() => []);
                return found[0]?.rawValue ?? null;
            }

            const { default: jsQR } = await (jsQRModule ??= import('jsqr'));
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            const image = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

            return jsQR(image.data, image.width, image.height, { inversionAttempts: 'dontInvert' })?.data ?? null;
        },

        async scanFrame() {
            // After a refusal, wait before reading again: the sticker is usually still in view,
            // and re-sending it twice a second would only repeat the same answer.
            if (this.busy || this.ok || Date.now() < this.pauseUntil) return;

            const canvas = this.frameCanvas();
            if (!canvas) return;

            const code = await this.readCode(canvas);
            if (!code) return;

            if (!this.coords) {
                this.message = 'QR read. Waiting for your GPS position…';
                return;
            }

            if ((this.coords.accuracy ?? 0) > maxAccuracy) {
                this.message = `QR read. Getting a precise GPS fix (now ±${Math.round(this.coords.accuracy)} m)… keep the camera on the sticker.`;
                return;
            }

            this.busy = true;
            this.failed = false;
            this.message = 'Saving the scan…';

            let result;
            try {
                result = await this.$wire.submitScan(
                    code,
                    canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.8),
                    this.coords.latitude,
                    this.coords.longitude,
                    this.coords.accuracy ? Math.round(this.coords.accuracy) : null,
                );
            } catch {
                // No answer (no signal, server error): never leave it stuck on "Saving…".
                result = null;
            }

            this.busy = false;

            if (!result || typeof result.ok !== 'boolean') {
                this.fail('The scan didn\'t reach the office (no signal or a server problem). Keep the sticker in view: it tries again in a few seconds.');
                return;
            }

            this.ok = result.ok;

            if (result.ok) {
                this.message = result.message;
                setTimeout(() => this.$dispatch('close-scan-modal'), 1400);
            } else {
                this.fail(result.message);
            }
        },

        fail(message) {
            this.failed = true;
            this.message = message;
            this.pauseUntil = Date.now() + 4000;

            // Let them read it, then go back to looking for a QR.
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (!this.ok && Date.now() >= this.pauseUntil) {
                    this.failed = false;
                    this.message = null;
                }
            }, 4500);
        },
    };
}

/**
 * The best GPS fix within a few seconds, for "Leaving post" and "Back at post".
 *
 * The first reading is often rough (±100 m and worse, from Wi-Fi or cell
 * towers) and the phone sharpens it within seconds, so this watches the
 * position and resolves as soon as it's within `maxAccuracy`, or with the
 * best one seen when time runs out (the server then explains if it's too
 * rough). `onProgress(accuracy)` reports the best so far, for the button.
 *
 * @returns {Promise<{latitude: number, longitude: number, accuracy: number|null}>}
 */
export function currentPosition(maxAccuracy = 100, onProgress = () => {}, timeoutMs = 20000) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        if (!navigator.geolocation) {
            reject(new Error('This browser cannot share its location.'));
            return;
        }

        let best = null;
        let done = false;
        let watchId = null;
        let timer = null;

        const finish = (callback) => {
            if (done) return;
            done = true;
            if (watchId !== null) navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(watchId);
            clearTimeout(timer);
            callback();
        };

        watchId = navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(
            (position) => {
                const fix = { latitude: position.coords.latitude, longitude: position.coords.longitude, accuracy: position.coords.accuracy ? Math.round(position.coords.accuracy) : null };

                if (best === null || (fix.accuracy ?? Infinity) < (best.accuracy ?? Infinity)) best = fix;
                onProgress(best.accuracy);

                if ((best.accuracy ?? 0) <= maxAccuracy) finish(() => resolve(best));
            },
            // Only "permission denied" ends the wait. Phones report passing errors
            // (position unavailable, a timeout) between readings; keep waiting for a better one.
            (error) => {
                if (error.code === error.PERMISSION_DENIED) finish(() => reject(error));
            },
            { enableHighAccuracy: true, maximumAge: 0 },
        );

        timer = setTimeout(() => finish(() => (best ? resolve(best) : reject(new Error('No GPS position yet. Step outside and try again.')))), timeoutMs);
    });
}

25

Live bell & important notices

The bell never polls: every request resets the idle timeout, so polling would keep an unattended payroll screen signed in forever. New notifications are pushed over a WebSocket (Laravel Reverb) and drawn in the browser with no request at all.

flowchart LR
  A[An Action notifies someone] --> Q[(queue)]
  Q --> D[database row = the bell]
  D -->|NotificationSent| L[BroadcastNewNotification]
  L --> R[Reverb: private-App.Models.User.id]
  R --> B[live-bell.js: badge, item, pop-up]
One listenerEvery notification with a database channel is broadcast by one listener, so new notification classes are live without remembering to.
Never twiceA broadcast failure is reported, not thrown: throwing would retry the notification's job and write the row (and send the email) again.
Who hears whatThe requester hears their leave/overtime answer (RequestDecided) and their payslip (PayslipReady, bell only). Supervisors hear no-shows, missed rounds, someone 60+ min past their own time, and time away nobody ended.

The scheduler raises the time-based alerts: without it, a late "168 min past their time" never exists (the rule was fine, the scheduler wasn't running). The queue worker only sends the emails: the bell item is written in the request itself, because a leave request once sat in the jobs table with no worker running and the President or Vice President never saw it.

Why a trait, not "just run the worker"? A stopped worker is silent: nothing errors, people just stop hearing about things. WritesBellImmediately puts the bell on the sync connection (viaConnections()) and leaves only the slow part, email, queued. An architecture test fails if a notice forgets it.
app/Support/WritesBellImmediately.php23 lines
Copied from the repository as it is today
<?php

namespace App\Support;

/**
 * For a queued notification: the bell row (and its live push) is written in
 * the same request, on the "sync" connection; only the email waits for the
 * queue worker. Without it, a stopped worker meant a leave request nobody
 * heard about: its bell item sat in the jobs table with the email.
 *
 * The live push can't break the request: BroadcastNewNotification reports
 * and swallows a Reverb failure.
 */
trait WritesBellImmediately
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function viaConnections(): array
    {
        return ['database' => 'sync'];
    }
}
app/Listeners/BroadcastNewNotification.php32 lines
Copied from the repository as it is today
<?php

namespace App\Listeners;

use App\Events\NotificationArrived;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Notifications\DatabaseNotification;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Events\NotificationSent;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Every notification that lands in the bell (the "database" channel) is also
 * pushed live. One listener instead of a "broadcast" channel on each
 * notification class, so new notifications are live without remembering to.
 */
final class BroadcastNewNotification
{
    public function handle(NotificationSent $event): void
    {
        if ($event->channel !== 'database' || ! $event->notifiable instanceof User || ! $event->response instanceof DatabaseNotification) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            event(new NotificationArrived($event->notifiable, $event->response));
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // The row is saved; the bell shows it on the next page load. Failing here would
            // retry the notification's job and write the row (and send the email) twice.
            report($e);
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Events;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Broadcasting\PrivateChannel;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Broadcasting\ShouldBroadcastNow;
use Illuminate\Notifications\DatabaseNotification;

/**
 * Pushes a new bell notification to the recipient's open tabs over WebSockets
 * (Reverb), so the bell updates without polling.
 *
 * Broadcast NOW, not queued: it's sent from inside the notification's own
 * queued job, right after the database row is written.
 */
final class NotificationArrived implements ShouldBroadcastNow
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly User $user,
        public readonly DatabaseNotification $notification,
    ) {}

    public function broadcastOn(): PrivateChannel
    {
        return new PrivateChannel("App.Models.User.{$this->user->id}");
    }

    public function broadcastAs(): string
    {
        return 'notification.arrived';
    }

    /**
     * Only what the bell shows: the same fields the dropdown reads from the row.
     *
     * @return array{id: string, title: string, body: string, url: string|null, icon: string, unread: int}
     */
    public function broadcastWith(): array
    {
        /** @var array<string, mixed> $data */
        $data = $this->notification->data;

        return [
            'id' => (string) $this->notification->id,
            'title' => is_string($data['title'] ?? null) ? $data['title'] : 'Notification',
            'body' => is_string($data['body'] ?? null) ? $data['body'] : '',
            'url' => is_string($data['url'] ?? null) ? $data['url'] : null,
            'icon' => is_string($data['icon'] ?? null) ? $data['icon'] : 'info',
            'unread' => $this->user->unreadNotifications()->count(),
        ];
    }
}
resources/js/live-bell.js58 lines
Copied from the repository as it is today
import startEcho from './echo';

/**
 * The live half of the notification bell. A new notification arrives over the
 * WebSocket and is drawn here, in the browser, with NO request to the server:
 * a request would reset the idle timeout, so a screen nobody is using would
 * never sign out. Clicking it is real activity and goes through Livewire as usual.
 *
 * When Livewire re-renders the bell (opening one, "Mark all as read", a page
 * load), the server's list already contains these, so the live ones are dropped.
 */
export default function liveBell({ userId, unread }) {
    return {
        open: false,
        unread,
        live: [],
        toast: null,
        toastHandle: null,

        init() {
            window.Livewire?.hook?.('morphed', ({ component }) => {
                if (component.id !== this.$wire.$id) return;

                this.live = [];
                this.unread = Number(this.$root.dataset.unread ?? 0);
            });

            startEcho()
                ?.private(`App.Models.User.${userId}`)
                .listen('.notification.arrived', (notification) => this.arrive(notification));
        },

        destroy() {
            window.Echo?.leave(`App.Models.User.${userId}`);
            clearTimeout(this.toastHandle);
        },

        arrive(notification) {
            if (this.live.some((item) => item.id === notification.id)) return;

            this.live.unshift(notification);
            this.unread = notification.unread;
            this.toast = notification;

            clearTimeout(this.toastHandle);
            this.toastHandle = setTimeout(() => (this.toast = null), 8000);
        },

        get badge() {
            return this.unread > 9 ? '9+' : String(this.unread);
        },

        openLive(id) {
            this.toast = null;
            this.$wire.open(id);
        },
    };
}

<?php

namespace App\Notifications;

use App\Enums\RequestStatus;
use App\Models\LeaveRequest;
use App\Models\OvertimeRequest;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\WritesBellImmediately;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Messages\MailMessage;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notification;

/**
 * The answer to someone's own leave or overtime request: bell and email, with
 * the reviewer's note. Approved overtime says how much, when less was approved.
 */
final class RequestDecided extends Notification implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable, WritesBellImmediately;

    public function __construct(public readonly LeaveRequest|OvertimeRequest $request)
    {
        $request->loadMissing('reviewer');
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function via(User $notifiable): array
    {
        return ['database', 'mail'];
    }

    public function toMail(User $notifiable): MailMessage
    {
        return (new MailMessage)
            ->subject($this->title())
            ->greeting("Hello {$notifiable->name},")
            ->line($this->body())
            ->action('Open', $this->url());
    }

    /**
     * @return array{title: string, body: string, url: string, icon: string}
     */
    public function toArray(User $notifiable): array
    {
        return ['title' => $this->title(), 'body' => $this->body(), 'url' => $this->url(), 'icon' => $this->request instanceof LeaveRequest ? 'clipboard' : 'clock-plus'];
    }

    private function approved(): bool
    {
        return $this->request->status === RequestStatus::Approved;
    }

    private function title(): string
    {
        $verdict = $this->approved() ? 'approved' : 'not approved';

        return match (true) {
            $this->request instanceof LeaveRequest => "Leave {$verdict}: {$this->request->dateRangeLabel()}",
            $this->request->addedForThem() => "Extra time added: {$this->request->date->format('M j')}",
            default => "Overtime {$verdict}: {$this->request->date->format('M j')}",
        };
    }

    private function body(): string
    {
        $by = $this->request->reviewer->name ?? 'Your supervisor';
        $note = filled($this->request->review_note) ? " Note: {$this->request->review_note}" : '';

        if ($this->request instanceof OvertimeRequest && $this->approved()) {
            $approved = (int) $this->request->approved_minutes;
            $hours = fn (int $minutes): string => rtrim(rtrim(number_format($minutes / 60, 2), '0'), '.').' '.($minutes === 60 ? 'hour' : 'hours');
            $less = $approved < $this->request->requested_minutes ? " (you asked for {$hours($this->request->requested_minutes)})" : '';

            // Operations added it: nothing was asked, so say what and why.
            if ($this->request->addedForThem()) {
                return "{$by} added {$hours($approved)} of extra time for you: ".rtrim($this->request->reason, '. ').'. Paid up to the time you clocked.';
            }

            return "{$by} approved {$hours($approved)}{$less}.{$note}";
        }

        return "{$by} ".($this->approved() ? 'approved' : 'did not approve')." it.{$note}";
    }

    private function url(): string
    {
        return $this->request instanceof LeaveRequest ? route('leave') : route('overtime');
    }
}

26

Organization chart

The President or Vice President's view of the company, filled from live data: headquarters by role (President and Vice President by position), then the field side, region → province → client → guards.

flowchart TD
  B{{Board of Directors}} --> P([President]) --> V([Vice President]) --> S[Super Admin]
  S --> HR[HR] & AC[Accounting] & AD[Admin] & OP[Operation HQ]
  OP --> SAT[Satellite Operation] --> F[Regional → Provincial → clients → guards]

The top is the Board of Directors, drawn as a hexagon, with the President and then the Vice President below it, as on the company's own chart. The Board and the officers are different things: the Board governs and elects the President and Vice President, who run the company. The Board box lists the President (the Revised Corporation Code, Sec. 24, requires the President to be a director, so they appear on both) and the Vice President (company decision), both taken from their roles. There used to be a "Member of the Board of Directors" checkbox on employee records (is_board_member); it was removed on 2026-10-21 because nobody knew when to tick it, and in a company this size the directors who aren't the President or VP are usually owners who aren't employees at all. If they need showing, the plan is a separate "Board members" list, not a tick on an employee. A single "Executive" role used to be a position too; it mixed app access up with the company's structure, so it was retired.

A hexagon with an outlineclip-path cuts a border off with the shape. So .org-hexagon is two hexagons: the outer one filled with the line colour, the card 1px inside it.
Roles, not a drawingEach box lists who holds that role today, so the chart can't go stale. A box nobody holds says "Not assigned".
A few queriesEveryone with an office role in one query, clients with a guard count in another: the size of the company doesn't change the number of queries.
Plain HTML linesBoxes and CSS connectors (.org-row, .org-cell), no chart library. On a phone it scrolls sideways and opens centred.

<?php

namespace App\Queries\People;

use App\Enums\EmploymentStatus;
use App\Enums\Region;
use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * The company's structure, as the President or Vice President sees it:
 *
 *   Board of Directors → President → Vice President → Super Admin
 *     → HR, Accounting, Admin, Operation HQ
 *       → Satellite Operation → Regional → Provincial → clients → guards
 *
 * Every box is filled from live data: people by role, and the field side from
 * the clients and the guards deployed to them. A few queries in all, whatever the size.
 *
 * @phpstan-type Box array{title: string, people: Collection<int, User>}
 * @phpstan-type ClientRow array{client: Client, guards: int}
 * @phpstan-type ProvinceRow array{name: string, clients: list<ClientRow>, guards: int}
 * @phpstan-type RegionRow array{region: Region, satellites: Collection<int, User>, provinces: list<ProvinceRow>, clients: int, guards: int}
 */
final class OrganizationQuery
{
    /**
     * @return array{chart: array{board: Box, president: Box, vicePresident: Box, superAdmin: Box, departments: list<Box>, satellite: Box}, field: list<RegionRow>}
     */
    public function handle(): array
    {
        return ['chart' => $this->chart(), 'field' => $this->field()];
    }

    /**
     * @return array{board: Box, president: Box, vicePresident: Box, superAdmin: Box, departments: list<Box>, satellite: Box}
     */
    private function chart(): array
    {
        // Everyone who still works here and holds an office role, once.
        $people = User::query()
            ->notifiable([...Role::leadership(), Role::SuperAdmin, Role::Hr, Role::Accounting, Role::Admin, Role::OperationsHq, Role::SatelliteOperations])
            ->with(['roles', 'employeeProfile'])
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get();

        $withRole = fn (Role $role) => $people->filter(fn (User $user) => $user->hasRole($role))->values();
        $box = fn (string $title, Collection $who) => ['title' => $title, 'people' => $who];

        // By role: the President and Vice President have no HR record (Role::withoutEmployeeRecord).
        $president = $withRole(Role::President);
        $vicePresident = $withRole(Role::VicePresident);

        return [
            // The Board: the President (a director by law, Revised Corporation Code Sec. 24) and the
            // Vice President, both by role (company decision, 2026-10-21; no per-employee tick).
            'board' => $box('Board of Directors', $president->merge($vicePresident)->unique('id')->sortBy('name')->values()),
            'president' => $box('President', $president),
            'vicePresident' => $box('Vice President', $vicePresident),
            'superAdmin' => $box('Super Admin', $withRole(Role::SuperAdmin)),
            'departments' => [
                $box('HR', $withRole(Role::Hr)),
                $box('Accounting', $withRole(Role::Accounting)),
                $box('Admin', $withRole(Role::Admin)),
                $box('Operation HQ', $withRole(Role::OperationsHq)),
            ],
            'satellite' => $box('Satellite Operation', $withRole(Role::SatelliteOperations)),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * The field side: each region with its Satellite Operation officers, its
     * provinces, their clients, and how many active guards each client has.
     * Regions in the enum's order (NCR, CAR, Region I…), only those with clients.
     *
     * @return list<RegionRow>
     */
    private function field(): array
    {
        $clients = Client::query()
            ->withCount(['employeeProfiles as guards_count' => fn ($profile) => $profile
                ->where('is_office_staff', false)
                ->whereIn('employment_status', EmploymentStatus::active())])
            ->orderBy('province')->orderBy('name')
            ->get()
            ->groupBy(fn (Client $client) => $client->region->value);

        $satellites = User::query()->notifiable([Role::SatelliteOperations])->with('employeeProfile')->orderBy('name')->get();

        $regions = [];

        foreach (Region::cases() as $region) {
            $inRegion = $clients->get($region->value);

            if ($inRegion === null) {
                continue;
            }

            $provinces = [];

            foreach ($inRegion->groupBy('province') as $province => $group) {
                $rows = array_values($group->map(fn (Client $client) => ['client' => $client, 'guards' => (int) $client->getAttribute('guards_count')])->all());
                $provinces[] = ['name' => (string) $province, 'clients' => $rows, 'guards' => array_sum(array_column($rows, 'guards'))];
            }

            $regions[] = [
                'region' => $region,
                'satellites' => $satellites->filter(fn (User $user) => $user->operations_region === $region)->values(),
                'provinces' => $provinces,
                'clients' => $inRegion->count(),
                'guards' => array_sum(array_column($provinces, 'guards')),
            ];
        }

        return $regions;
    }
}

27

A dashboard for every role

One page, four sections, each behind its own Ability: Waiting for you (everyone), At a glance (a few numbers per job), Today (attendance, filterable by client site) and People by area (region → province → client).

Abilities, not role namesThe page asks "can this person supervise attendance?", never "is this HR?". Someone with two roles gets both sets, and a new role only needs its Abilities.
One source for "waiting"The cards are the sidebar's badges (Navigation::for()), so a card can never say 2 while the badge says 3.
No query for the areasThe roster already loads each person's client; WorkforceByAreaQuery only counts the rows. More regions, same number of queries.
Indent guides, like VS CodeAn open region or province draws a thin line from under its arrow down past its children. It's a before: line on a wrapper around the children, positioned at the arrow's centre (measured in the browser), and darker while hovered. No extra markup per row.
36 employees, 31 headcountThe President or Vice President's Employees tile counts everyone employed; Headcount counts who clocks in. The tile's hint explains the gap in the same words: "31 clock in · 4 no account yet". The rest is the President or Vice President, who's paid outside payroll.

<?php

namespace App\Queries\People;

use App\Enums\Region;
use App\Queries\Attendance\TodayRosterQuery;

/**
 * Today's people by where they're deployed: region → province → client, plus
 * office staff and guards not deployed yet. Counted from TodayRosterQuery's
 * rows (already scoped to what the viewer may see), so it costs no query.
 *
 *   people   on payroll there
 *   in       clocked in today (late included)
 *   late     of those, late
 *   notIn    nothing yet: no time in, no leave, no holiday
 *   onLeave  approved leave today
 *
 * @phpstan-import-type RosterRow from TodayRosterQuery
 *
 * @phpstan-type AreaCounts array{people: int, in: int, late: int, notIn: int, onLeave: int}
 * @phpstan-type ClientArea array{id: int, name: string, counts: AreaCounts}
 * @phpstan-type ProvinceArea array{name: string, counts: AreaCounts, clients: list<ClientArea>}
 * @phpstan-type RegionArea array{value: string, label: string, counts: AreaCounts, provinces: list<ProvinceArea>}
 * @phpstan-type Workforce array{regions: list<RegionArea>, office: AreaCounts, undeployed: AreaCounts, total: AreaCounts}
 */
final class WorkforceByAreaQuery
{
    /**
     * @param  list<RosterRow>  $roster
     * @return Workforce
     */
    public function handle(array $roster): array
    {
        /** @var array<string, array<string, array<int, list<RosterRow>>>> $tree region → province → client → rows */
        $tree = [];
        /** @var array<int, string> $clientNames */
        $clientNames = [];
        $office = [];
        $undeployed = [];

        foreach ($roster as $row) {
            if ($row['office']) {
                $office[] = $row;
            } elseif ($row['clientId'] === null || $row['region'] === null) {
                $undeployed[] = $row;
            } else {
                $tree[$row['region']][(string) $row['province']][$row['clientId']][] = $row;
                $clientNames[$row['clientId']] = (string) $row['detachment'];
            }
        }

        $regions = [];

        foreach (Region::cases() as $region) {
            if (! isset($tree[$region->value])) {
                continue;
            }

            $provinces = [];
            $byProvince = $tree[$region->value];
            ksort($byProvince);

            foreach ($byProvince as $province => $byClient) {
                $clients = [];

                foreach ($byClient as $clientId => $rows) {
                    $clients[] = ['id' => $clientId, 'name' => $clientNames[$clientId], 'counts' => self::count($rows)];
                }

                usort($clients, fn (array $a, array $b) => strcmp($a['name'], $b['name']));
                $provinces[] = ['name' => (string) $province, 'counts' => self::count(array_merge(...array_values($byClient))), 'clients' => $clients];
            }

            $regions[] = [
                'value' => $region->value,
                'label' => $region->label(),
                'counts' => self::sum(array_map(fn (array $province) => $province['counts'], $provinces)),
                'provinces' => $provinces,
            ];
        }

        return [
            'regions' => $regions,
            'office' => self::count($office),
            'undeployed' => self::count($undeployed),
            'total' => self::count($roster),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<RosterRow>  $rows
     * @return AreaCounts
     */
    private static function count(array $rows): array
    {
        $counts = ['people' => 0, 'in' => 0, 'late' => 0, 'notIn' => 0, 'onLeave' => 0];

        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $counts['people']++;
            $counts['in'] += $row['clockIn'] !== null ? 1 : 0;
            $counts['late'] += in_array($row['status'], ['late', 'late_and_undertime'], true) ? 1 : 0;
            $counts['notIn'] += $row['status'] === 'pending' ? 1 : 0;
            $counts['onLeave'] += $row['status'] === 'on_leave' ? 1 : 0;
        }

        return $counts;
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<AreaCounts>  $all
     * @return AreaCounts
     */
    private static function sum(array $all): array
    {
        $total = ['people' => 0, 'in' => 0, 'late' => 0, 'notIn' => 0, 'onLeave' => 0];

        foreach ($all as $counts) {
            foreach ($counts as $key => $value) {
                $total[$key] += $value;
            }
        }

        return $total;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Queries\Dashboard;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AbsenceSource;
use App\Enums\EmploymentStatus;
use App\Enums\PayrollRunStatus;
use App\Models\AbsenceNotice;
use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\PayrollRun;
use App\Models\Training;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Queries\People\ProbationEndingQuery;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;

/**
 * The "at a glance" tiles: a few numbers per job, each shown only to those
 * whose Ability covers it (never by role name), so a person with two roles
 * gets both sets. What already waits for a decision is the sidebar badges'
 * job ("Waiting for you"), so it isn't repeated here.
 *
 * @phpstan-type Tile array{group: string, label: string, value: string, hint: string|null, url: string, tone: string, icon: string}
 */
final class DashboardHighlightsQuery
{
    public function __construct(private readonly ProbationEndingQuery $probation) {}

    /**
     * @return list<Tile>
     */
    public function handle(User $user, CarbonImmutable $today): array
    {
        $tiles = [];
        $can = fn (Ability $ability): bool => $user->can($ability->value);

        // The President or Vice President: the company in three numbers.
        if ($can(Ability::ViewOrganization)) {
            $active = EmployeeProfile::query()->active();
            $guards = (clone $active)->where('is_office_staff', false)->count();
            $office = (clone $active)->where('is_office_staff', true)->count();
            $clients = Client::query()->count();
            $regions = Client::query()->distinct()->count('region');

            // Everyone employed, which is more than the Headcount below: that one counts who clocks in,
            // so the hint explains the gap in its words (the rest: no account yet, or the President or Vice President).
            $clockIn = EmployeeProfile::query()->paidHere()->whereNotNull('user_id')->count();
            $noAccount = (clone $active)->whereNull('user_id')->count();
            $tiles[] = self::tile('Company', 'Employees', (string) ($guards + $office), "{$clockIn} clock in".($noAccount > 0 ? " · {$noAccount} no account yet" : ''), route('organization'), icon: 'users');
            $tiles[] = self::tile('Company', 'Clients', (string) $clients, $regions === 1 ? 'in 1 region' : "in {$regions} regions", route('organization'), icon: 'building');
        }

        // HR: people coming in, still to sign up, and probation decisions.
        if ($can(Ability::ManagePeople)) {
            $ending = $this->probation->handle($today)->count();
            $hired = EmployeeProfile::query()->whereBetween('hire_date', [$today->startOfMonth()->toDateString(), $today->endOfMonth()->toDateString()])->count();
            $noAccount = EmployeeProfile::query()->active()->whereNull('user_id')->count();

            // The count includes those already past it; the hint says how many, since they're regular by law (Art. 296).
            $overdue = EmployeeProfile::query()->probationOverdue()->count();
            $tiles[] = self::tile('People', 'Probation ending', (string) $ending, $overdue > 0 ? "{$overdue} already past ".config('hr.probation.months').' months' : 'within '.config('hr.probation.remind_days_before').' days', route('employees', ['status' => EmploymentStatus::Probationary->value]), $ending > 0 ? 'amber' : 'gray', 'clock');
            $tiles[] = self::tile('People', 'Hired this month', (string) $hired, $today->format('F Y'), route('employees'), icon: 'user-plus');
            $tiles[] = self::tile('People', 'No account yet', (string) $noAccount, 'not registered', route('employees', ['account' => 'unregistered']), $noAccount > 0 ? 'amber' : 'gray', 'user');
        }

        // Accounting: where the latest payroll run stands, and when pay goes out next.
        if ($can(Ability::ManagePayroll)) {
            $run = PayrollRun::query()->latest('start_date')->first();
            $tiles[] = $run === null
                ? self::tile('Payroll', 'Latest payroll run', 'None yet', 'Create one on Payroll', route('payroll'), icon: 'banknotes')
                : self::tile('Payroll', 'Latest payroll run', $run->status->label(), $run->periodLabel(), route('payroll', ['run' => $run->id]), icon: 'banknotes');

            $next = PayrollRun::query()->where('status', '!=', PayrollRunStatus::Paid)->orderBy('pay_date')->first();
            $tiles[] = $next === null
                ? self::tile('Payroll', 'Next pay day', '—', 'no unpaid run', route('payroll'), icon: 'calendar')
                : self::nextPayDay($next, $today);
        }

        // Operations: today's absences, from reported to covered (one query for all three).
        if ($can(Ability::ManageRelievers)) {
            $notices = AbsenceNotice::query()->visibleTo($user)->whereDate('duty_date', $today->toDateString())->get(['source', 'reliever_id']);
            $reported = $notices->where('source', AbsenceSource::Guard)->count();
            $noShows = $notices->where('source', AbsenceSource::NoShow)->count();
            $covered = $notices->whereNotNull('reliever_id')->count();

            $tiles[] = self::tile('Operations', 'Absences reported', (string) $reported, 'told ahead today', route('relievers'), icon: 'calendar');
            $tiles[] = self::tile('Operations', 'No-shows', (string) $noShows, 'didn\'t clock in or report', route('relievers'), $noShows > 0 ? 'red' : 'gray', 'clock-alert');
            $tiles[] = self::tile('Operations', 'Relievers sent', (string) $covered, $notices->isEmpty() ? 'no absences today' : "{$covered} of {$notices->count()} posts covered", route('relievers'), icon: 'arrows-right-left');
        }

        // Admin: training coming up.
        if ($can(Ability::ManageTraining)) {
            $upcoming = Training::query()->whereBetween('starts_on', [$today->toDateString(), $today->addDays(14)->toDateString()])->count();
            $tiles[] = self::tile('Admin', 'Training, next 14 days', (string) $upcoming, null, route('trainings'), icon: 'academic-cap');
        }

        return $tiles;
    }

    /**
     * "Oct 20 · in 5 days": amber within 3 days, red on the day or overdue (still unpaid).
     *
     * @return Tile
     */
    private static function nextPayDay(PayrollRun $run, CarbonImmutable $today): array
    {
        $days = (int) $today->diffInDays($run->pay_date, false);

        $hint = match (true) {
            $days < 0 => abs($days).' '.str('day')->plural(abs($days)).' overdue',
            $days === 0 => 'today',
            default => 'in '.$days.' '.str('day')->plural($days),
        };

        return self::tile('Payroll', 'Next pay day', $run->pay_date->format('M j'), $hint, route('payroll', ['run' => $run->id]), $days <= 0 ? 'red' : ($days <= 3 ? 'amber' : 'gray'), 'calendar');
    }

    /**
     * @return Tile
     */
    private static function tile(string $group, string $label, string $value, ?string $hint, string $url, string $tone = 'gray', string $icon = 'info'): array
    {
        return ['group' => $group, 'label' => $label, 'value' => $value, 'hint' => $hint, 'url' => $url, 'tone' => $tone, 'icon' => $icon];
    }
}
