<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Admin;

use App\Actions\Payroll\AdvancePayrollRun;
use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\PayrollRunStatus;
use App\Enums\Region;
use App\Livewire\Concerns\FiltersByArea;
use App\Livewire\Concerns\InteractsWithUser;
use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\PayrollRun;
use App\Queries\Attendance\TodayRosterQuery;
use App\Queries\Attendance\WeeklyTrendQuery;
use App\Queries\Dashboard\DashboardHighlightsQuery;
use App\Queries\Payroll\PayrollOverviewQuery;
use App\Queries\People\BirthdaysQuery;
use App\Queries\People\WorkforceByAreaQuery;
use App\Support\Navigation;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;
use Livewire\Component;

/**
 * The staff dashboard, one page for every staff role. Each section has its
 * own Ability, so each person sees the parts of their job:
 *
 *   Waiting for you   everyone: the sidebar's badges (leave to decide, relievers, complaints…)
 *   At a glance       per job: DashboardHighlightsQuery (HR's probation, Accounting's run…)
 *   People by area    view-people: region → province → client, with today's attendance
 *   Today             supervise-attendance: counts, charts and the DTR, filterable by area
 *
 * The roster is fetched once per request (#[Computed] memoizes it) and filtered
 * in PHP, since it's at most one row per employee. A Satellite Operation
 * account sees only its region's guards.
 *
 * @phpstan-import-type RosterRow from TodayRosterQuery
 * @phpstan-import-type Workforce from WorkforceByAreaQuery
 * @phpstan-import-type Tile from DashboardHighlightsQuery
 * @phpstan-import-type TrendDay from WeeklyTrendQuery
 * @phpstan-import-type PayrollOverview from PayrollOverviewQuery
 *
 * @property-read list<RosterRow> $roster
 * @property-read array{total: int, on_time: int, late: int, absent: int, clocked_in: int, on_leave: int} $stats
 * @property-read list<RosterRow> $filtered
 * @property-read list<array{label: string, route: string, icon: string, badge: int, hint: string}> $waiting
 * @property-read list<Tile> $highlights
 * @property-read Workforce $workforce
 * @property-read list<TrendDay> $trend
 * @property-read PayrollOverview $payroll
 * @property-read list<array{id: int, period: string, status: PayrollRunStatus, step: int, payDay: string, payHint: string, late: bool, payslips: int, missing: int}> $payrollRuns
 * @property-read array{rate: int|null, in: int, expected: int, change: int|null} $trendHeadline
 * @property-read list<array{profile: EmployeeProfile, on: CarbonImmutable}> $birthdays
 */
#[Title('Dashboard')]
class AttendanceDashboard extends Component
{
    use FiltersByArea, InteractsWithUser;

    #[Url(as: 'q', except: '')]
    public string $search = '';

    #[Url(as: 'status', except: 'all')]
    public string $statusFilter = 'all';

    #[Url(as: 'range', except: 7)]
    public int $trendDays = 7;

    public function canSeeAttendance(): bool
    {
        return $this->currentUser()->can(Ability::SuperviseAttendance->value);
    }

    public function canSeePeople(): bool
    {
        return $this->currentUser()->can(Ability::ViewPeople->value);
    }

    public function canSeePayroll(): bool
    {
        return $this->currentUser()->can(Ability::ManagePayroll->value);
    }

    /**
     * Birthdays this month that this viewer may see (BirthdaysQuery: HR all, Operations guards).
     *
     * @return list<array{profile: EmployeeProfile, on: CarbonImmutable}>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function birthdays(): array
    {
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();

        return app(BirthdaysQuery::class)->handle($this->currentUser(), $today->startOfMonth(), $today->endOfMonth());
    }

    /**
     * Payroll cost and deductions for Accounting: the Payroll page's own numbers.
     *
     * @return PayrollOverview
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function payroll(): array
    {
        return app(PayrollOverviewQuery::class)->handle();
    }

    /**
     * Runs still to finish, oldest first (up to 3), each with where it stands in
     * draft → processing → approved → paid, its pay day, and the payslips still
     * missing; the last paid run when none is open. What the Payroll page's
     * charts don't show: what's left to do.
     *
     * @return list<array{id: int, period: string, status: PayrollRunStatus, step: int, payDay: string, payHint: string, late: bool, payslips: int, missing: int}>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function payrollRuns(): array
    {
        $runs = PayrollOverviewQuery::recentRuns();
        $open = $runs->filter(fn (PayrollRun $run) => $run->status !== PayrollRunStatus::Paid)->sortBy('start_date')->take(3);
        $shown = $open->isNotEmpty() ? $open : $runs->where('status', PayrollRunStatus::Paid)->take(1);
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $advance = app(AdvancePayrollRun::class);

        return array_values($shown->map(function (PayrollRun $run) use ($today, $advance): array {
            $days = (int) $today->diffInDays($run->pay_date, false);
            $paid = $run->status === PayrollRunStatus::Paid;

            return [
                'id' => $run->id,
                'period' => $run->periodLabel(),
                'status' => $run->status,
                'step' => array_search($run->status, PayrollRunStatus::cases(), true) ?: 0,
                'payDay' => $run->pay_date->format('M j'),
                'payHint' => match (true) {
                    $paid => 'paid',
                    $days < 0 => abs($days).' '.str('day')->plural(abs($days)).' overdue',
                    $days === 0 => 'today',
                    default => 'in '.$days.' '.str('day')->plural($days),
                },
                'late' => ! $paid && $days <= 0,
                'payslips' => (int) $run->payslip_records_count,
                // Paid runs are closed: nothing can be missing any more.
                'missing' => $paid ? 0 : $advance->employeesWithoutPayslip($run),
            ];
        })->all());
    }

    /**
     * What each sidebar count means, as the card's third line: what is waiting,
     * not just which page. A count added to the sidebar later still gets a card,
     * with the general line.
     */
    private const array WAITING_HINTS = [
        'leave-requests' => 'to decide', // "to endorse" for Operations: see waiting()
        'overtime-requests' => 'to review',
        'relievers' => 'posts need a reliever',
        'complaint-cases' => 'open cases',
        'resignations' => 'to accept',
        'final-pay' => 'to prepare or sign',
        'load-requests' => 'to approve',
        'daily-rates' => 'need a daily rate',
        'payroll' => 'runs to finish',
        'payroll-concerns' => 'to answer',
        'notices-to-explain' => 'to decide',
        'reimbursement-requests' => 'to approve',
        'documents' => 'expiring soon',
        'patrols' => 'guards away from post',
        'office-away' => 'out of the office now',
    ];

    /**
     * What waits for this person: the sidebar items that carry a count.
     *
     * @return list<array{label: string, route: string, icon: string, badge: int, hint: string}>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function waiting(): array
    {
        $user = $this->currentUser();
        // Operations' step on a guard's leave is endorsing it; HR and the President or Vice President decide.
        $endorses = $user->can(Ability::EndorseGuardLeave->value) && ! $user->canAny([Ability::ReviewFieldLeave->value, Ability::ReviewOfficeLeave->value]);

        $items = collect(Navigation::for($user))->pluck('items')->flatten(1)
            ->filter(fn (array $item) => $item['badge'] > 0)
            ->map(fn (array $item) => [
                'label' => $item['label'], 'route' => $item['route'], 'icon' => $item['icon'], 'badge' => $item['badge'],
                'hint' => $item['route'] === 'leave-requests' && $endorses ? 'to endorse' : (self::WAITING_HINTS[$item['route']] ?? 'need your attention'),
            ]);

        return array_values($items->all());
    }

    /**
     * @return list<Tile>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function highlights(): array
    {
        return app(DashboardHighlightsQuery::class)->handle($this->currentUser(), CarbonImmutable::today());
    }

    /**
     * @return list<RosterRow>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function roster(): array
    {
        return app(TodayRosterQuery::class)->handle($this->currentUser());
    }

    /**
     * @return Workforce
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function workforce(): array
    {
        return app(WorkforceByAreaQuery::class)->handle($this->roster);
    }

    /**
     * Today's counts for the chosen area (all of it when none is chosen).
     *
     * @return array{total: int, on_time: int, late: int, absent: int, clocked_in: int, on_leave: int}
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function stats(): array
    {
        $roster = collect($this->roster)->filter(fn (array $row) => $this->rowInArea($row));

        return [
            'total' => $roster->count(),
            'on_time' => $roster->whereIn('status', ['on_time', 'undertime'])->count(),
            'late' => $roster->whereIn('status', ['late', 'late_and_undertime'])->count(),
            'absent' => $roster->where('status', 'pending')->count(),
            'clocked_in' => $roster->where('clockedIn', true)->count(),
            'on_leave' => $roster->where('status', 'on_leave')->count(),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return list<RosterRow>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function filtered(): array
    {
        $needle = mb_strtolower($this->search);

        return array_values(collect($this->roster)
            ->filter(fn (array $row) => $this->rowInArea($row))
            ->filter(fn (array $row) => match ($this->statusFilter) {
                'all' => true,
                'clocked_in' => $row['clockedIn'],
                'absent' => $row['status'] === 'pending',
                'late' => in_array($row['status'], ['late', 'late_and_undertime'], true),
                default => $row['status'] === $this->statusFilter,
            })
            ->filter(fn (array $row) => $needle === '' || str_contains(mb_strtolower($row['name'].' '.$row['detachment'].' '.$row['post']), $needle))
            ->all());
    }

    /**
     * The attendance chart's range, in days, ending today (the 7D / 14D / 30D tabs).
     */
    public const array TREND_RANGES = [7, 14, 30];

    public function setTrendDays(int $days): void
    {
        $this->trendDays = in_array($days, self::TREND_RANGES, true) ? $days : 7;
    }

    /**
     * The last $trendDays days, today included.
     *
     * @return list<TrendDay>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function trend(): array
    {
        $days = in_array($this->trendDays, self::TREND_RANGES, true) ? $this->trendDays : 7;

        return app(WeeklyTrendQuery::class)->handle(CarbonImmutable::today()->subDays($days - 1), $this->currentUser(), $days);
    }

    /**
     * The chart's headline: today's attendance rate, and the change from yesterday in points.
     *
     * @return array{rate: int|null, in: int, expected: int, change: int|null}
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function trendHeadline(): array
    {
        $trend = $this->trend;
        $today = $trend[count($trend) - 1] ?? null;
        $yesterday = $trend[count($trend) - 2] ?? null;

        return [
            'rate' => $today['rate'] ?? null,
            'in' => $today['in'] ?? 0,
            'expected' => $today['expected'] ?? 0,
            'change' => isset($today['rate'], $yesterday['rate']) ? $today['rate'] - $yesterday['rate'] : null,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * What today's numbers cover, in words: the area picked in the Client site bar, else
     * what this person sees at all ("whole company", or a Satellite Operation's region).
     */
    public function scopeLabel(): string
    {
        $region = Region::tryFrom($this->areaRegion);

        return match (true) {
            $this->areaRegion === self::OFFICE => 'office staff',
            $this->areaClient !== '' => (string) (Client::query()->whereKey((int) $this->areaClient)->value('name') ?? 'this client'),
            $this->areaProvince !== '' => $this->areaProvince,
            $region !== null => $region->label(),
            default => $this->viewerScope(),
        };
    }

    /**
     * What this person's dashboard counts at all (User::scopeOnDashboardOf): "whole company";
     * for Operations, guards only: "all guards", or "guards · NCR" for a Satellite Operation.
     */
    public function viewerScope(): string
    {
        $user = $this->currentUser();
        $region = $user->operations_region?->label() ?? 'no region set';

        if (! $this->canSeeOfficeStaff()) {
            return 'all guards';
        }

        return $user->isRegionallyLimited() ? $region : 'whole company';
    }

    /** Every region is on this page, also for a Satellite Operation (guards only). */
    protected function limitsAreaToOwnRegion(): bool
    {
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Whether a person or area in this region may be opened from here: a Satellite
     * Operation sees every guard on the dashboard, but records in its region only.
     */
    public function opensRegion(?string $region): bool
    {
        $user = $this->currentUser();

        return ! $user->isRegionallyLimited() || ($region !== null && $region === $user->operations_region?->value);
    }

    /** Office staff in the numbers (and as a choice in the Client site bar), or guards only. */
    public function canSeeOfficeStaff(): bool
    {
        return $this->currentUser()->can(Ability::ViewOfficeStaff->value);
    }

    /** "Good morning" / "Good afternoon" / "Good evening", by the clock. */
    public function greeting(): string
    {
        $hour = (int) now()->format('G');

        return match (true) {
            $hour < 12 => 'Good morning',
            $hour < 18 => 'Good afternoon',
            default => 'Good evening',
        };
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        return view('livewire.admin.attendance-dashboard');
    }
}

28

Resignation and clearance

The other end of onboarding: the letter, 30 days' notice (Labor Code Art. 300) or a just cause, HR settling the last day, a clearance checklist, and the account closing the day after the last day.

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> pending: filed (or HR records a paper letter)
  pending --> withdrawn: the employee takes it back
  pending --> accepted: HR sets the last day (waiver if under 30 days)
  accepted --> completed: separated (day after last day) AND fully cleared
No "reject"Resigning is the employee's right; HR only settles the date. So the action is AcceptResignation, never a review.
Whichever comes lastCompleteResignation is called after every tick and after every separation, and does nothing until both are true. No order to remember.
Same rule as complaintsAn HR member's resignation goes to the President or Vice President (for_executive, set when filed); other HR staff never see it.
Reasons are a checklistPeople rarely leave for one reason, so they tick all that apply, nothing pre-ticked. "Others" needs the words. Stored in reasons (JSON). reason stays as the main one, so lists keep working: a just cause if any, else the first ticked.
A just cause is looked intoArt. 300(b) accuses the company or someone acting for it, so filing one also opens a complaint case (FileComplaint from FileResignation, linked by complaints.resignation_id). It's the same handler, and it closes only with a written outcome. Settling the date alone would leave the company knowing about mistreatment with no record of acting on it.
A sample letterThe empty letter box was the hardest step. Resignation::sampleLetter() fills it from the reasons, position and last day. Anything only the employee can say is left in [brackets], and the form won't send until they're replaced.
Why people leaveThe checklist feeds a summary on HR's page (ResignationReasonsQuery): the last 12 months, most common reason first, guards and office staff apart, plus "Others" in their own words.
Acknowledge, brieflyBefore sending, six plain sentences on what happens next (notice, withdrawal, clearance, final pay and COE, the account closing) and a required "I've read these". Short on purpose: a long terms page gets ticked unread. A just cause changes the wording (no "free will", no notice line). The lines are saved word for word with the time (acknowledgement), so the record holds even if the text changes later. An English · Filipino switch shows them in Filipino (lang/fil/acknowledgements.php), and the record keeps the language that was read.
The law's own just causesInstead of one vague "Just cause", the second group is Art. 300(b)'s four items (serious insult, inhuman treatment, a crime against them or their family, an analogous cause), each labelled with its paragraph. They stay folded behind one question ("did the company, or someone acting for it, do something that makes you leave at once?"), because a just cause is a serious claim that skips the 30 days, and it shouldn't be one stray tap away. Unticking the question clears them (ChoosesResignationReasons, shared by the employee's form and HR's). Ticking one removes the 30-day rule and the waiver. HR sees "Just cause (Art. 300(b)(2)): no notice needed". Art. 300's text sits under the checklist to read. It's the Labor Code article (formerly 285), not an RA.

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Resignations;

use App\Actions\Complaints\FileComplaint;
use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\ComplaintCategory;
use App\Enums\ResignationReason;
use App\Models\Resignation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\ResignationNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * An employee resigns: the letter, the reason, and the last day they ask for.
 * Labor Code Art. 300: at least 30 days' written notice, unless it's for a
 * just cause; a shorter notice must ask HR to waive the rest. HR may also
 * enter a paper letter for the employee ($recordedBy). A just cause also
 * opens a complaint case about what happened (FileComplaint).
 */
final class FileResignation
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
        private readonly FileComplaint $complaints,
    ) {}

    /**
     * $reasons: every one ticked on the checklist (or a single one). A just cause among
     * them (Art. 300(b)) means no notice is needed.
     *
     * $consentsToDeduction: written consent (Labor Code Art. 113) to deduct unpaid loans,
     * load and accountabilities from the final pay and cash bond. Without it, what's owed
     * is shown on the final-pay statement but not taken.
     *
     * $acknowledged: the employee ticked "I've read these" on the form; the lines they
     * read (Resignation::acknowledgementLines) are saved word for word, with the time.
     * They include the authorization to deduct what's owed, so it also sets the consent.
     *
     * @param  ResignationReason|array<ResignationReason>  $reasons
     */
    public function handle(User $employee, ResignationReason|array $reasons, ?string $reasonOther, string $letter, CarbonImmutable $requestedLastDay, bool $asksWaiver, ?User $recordedBy = null, bool $consentsToDeduction = false, bool $acknowledged = false, string $locale = 'en'): Resignation
    {
        $reasons = array_values(array_unique(is_array($reasons) ? $reasons : [$reasons], SORT_REGULAR));

        if ($reasons === []) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reasons' => 'Tick at least one reason.']);
        }

        // The main one: a just cause if any (it decides the notice), else the first ticked.
        $reason = collect($reasons)->first(fn (ResignationReason $r) => $r->skipsNotice()) ?? $reasons[0];

        $employee->loadMissing('employeeProfile');
        $forExecutive = Resignation::goesToExecutive($employee);

        // HR entering a paper letter: only for someone they handle (an HR member's goes to the President or Vice President).
        if ($recordedBy !== null && ! $recordedBy->can(($forExecutive ? Ability::HandleHrResignations : Ability::HandleResignations)->value)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        // The President or Vice President's leaving is decided outside the system (company decision, 2026-10-15).
        if ($employee->isPaidOutsidePayroll()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reasons' => 'The President\'s or Vice President\'s resignation isn\'t filed here.']);
        }

        if ($employee->employeeProfile === null || ! $employee->employeeProfile->employment_status->isActive()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reasons' => 'Only someone still working here can resign.']);
        }

        $hasOthers = in_array(ResignationReason::Others, $reasons, true);

        if ($hasOthers && blank($reasonOther)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reasonOther' => 'Write the other reason.']);
        }

        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();

        if ($requestedLastDay->lt($today)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['lastDay' => 'The last day can\'t be in the past.']);
        }

        $notice = (int) $today->diffInDays($requestedLastDay);

        if (! $reason->skipsNotice() && $notice < Resignation::NOTICE_DAYS && ! $asksWaiver) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['lastDay' => 'The law asks for at least '.Resignation::NOTICE_DAYS.' days\' notice (Labor Code Art. 300): a last day on or after '.$today->addDays(Resignation::NOTICE_DAYS)->format('M j, Y').'. For an earlier one, ask '.($forExecutive ? 'the President or Vice President' : 'HR').' to waive the rest.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($employee, $reason, $reasons, $hasOthers, $reasonOther, $letter, $requestedLastDay, $asksWaiver, $recordedBy, $forExecutive, $notice, $consentsToDeduction, $acknowledged, $locale) {
            if (Resignation::query()->where('user_id', $employee->id)->open()->lockForUpdate()->exists()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reasons' => 'There is already a resignation in progress.']);
            }

            $resignation = new Resignation;
            $resignation->forceFill([
                'user_id' => $employee->id,
                'for_executive' => $forExecutive,
                'reason' => $reason,
                'reasons' => array_map(fn (ResignationReason $r) => $r->value, $reasons),
                'reason_other' => $hasOthers ? trim((string) $reasonOther) : null,
                'letter' => trim($letter),
                'acknowledgement' => $acknowledged ? Resignation::acknowledgementLines($reason->skipsNotice(), $forExecutive ? 'the President or Vice President' : 'HR', $locale) : null,
                'acknowledged_at' => $acknowledged ? now() : null,
                'requested_last_day' => $requestedLastDay->toDateString(),
                // A waiver only matters when the notice is short and there's no just cause.
                'asks_waiver' => $asksWaiver && ! $reason->skipsNotice() && $notice < Resignation::NOTICE_DAYS,
                'recorded_by' => $recordedBy?->id,
                // The acknowledgement includes the written authorization to deduct what's owed (Art. 113).
                'deduction_consent_at' => $consentsToDeduction || $acknowledged ? now() : null,
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::People, 'resignation.filed', "{$employee->name} resigned, last day asked ".$requestedLastDay->format('M j, Y'), $resignation, causer: $recordedBy ?? $employee);

            $handlers = User::query()->notifiable($resignation->handlerAbility()->roles())->whereKeyNot($employee->id)->get();
            Notification::send($handlers, new ResignationNotice($resignation->setRelation('user', $employee), ResignationNotice::FILED));

            // A just cause is an accusation against the company or someone acting for it: open a
            // complaint case about it, so it's looked into and closed with a written outcome, not
            // only answered with a last day. Same handler (HR, or the President or Vice President for HR staff).
            if ($reason->skipsNotice()) {
                $causes = collect($reasons)->filter(fn (ResignationReason $r) => $r->skipsNotice())->map(fn (ResignationReason $r) => $r->labelForOthers())->implode(', ');
                $complaint = $this->complaints->handle($employee, ComplaintCategory::Conduct, 'Just cause given for resigning: '.$causes, trim($letter), null, null, exemptFromLimit: true);
                $complaint->forceFill(['resignation_id' => $resignation->id])->save();
                $resignation->setRelation('complaint', $complaint);
            }

            return $resignation;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Resignations;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\ResignationStatus;
use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Models\Resignation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\ResignationNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * HR (or the President or Vice President, for HR staff) accepts a resignation and fixes the
 * last day: the one asked for, or another agreed with the employee. A last day
 * under 30 days' notice without a just cause means the notice is waived.
 * The employee is told, and for a guard Operations too, to cover the post.
 *
 * There is no "reject": a resignation is the employee's right (Art. 300);
 * the only thing to settle is the date.
 */
final class AcceptResignation
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function handle(Resignation $resignation, User $actor, CarbonImmutable $lastDay, ?string $note): Resignation
    {
        if (! $actor->can($resignation->handlerAbility()->value)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        if ($resignation->user_id === $actor->id) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['lastDay' => 'Someone else accepts your own resignation.']);
        }

        if ($lastDay->lt($resignation->created_at->startOfDay())) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['lastDay' => 'The last day can\'t be before the resignation was filed.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($resignation, $actor, $lastDay, $note) {
            $locked = Resignation::query()->with('user.employeeProfile.client')->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($resignation->id);

            if ($locked->status !== ResignationStatus::Pending) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['lastDay' => 'This resignation has been handled already.']);
            }

            $locked->forceFill([
                'status' => ResignationStatus::Accepted,
                'last_day' => $lastDay->toDateString(),
                'notice_waived' => ! $locked->skipsNotice() && $locked->noticeDays($lastDay) < Resignation::NOTICE_DAYS,
                'decided_by' => $actor->id,
                'decided_at' => now(),
                'decision_note' => filled($note) ? trim((string) $note) : null,
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::People, 'resignation.accepted', "Accepted {$locked->user->name}'s resignation, last day ".$lastDay->format('M j, Y'), $locked, [
                'new' => ['last_day' => $lastDay->toDateString(), 'notice_waived' => $locked->notice_waived],
            ], causer: $actor);

            $locked->user->notify(new ResignationNotice($locked, ResignationNotice::ACCEPTED));

            // A guard leaves a post: Operation HQ and the region's Satellite plan who covers it.
            if ($locked->isGuard()) {
                $region = $locked->user->employeeProfile?->client?->region;
                $operations = User::query()->notifiable([Role::OperationsHq, Role::SatelliteOperations])->with('roles')->get()
                    ->filter(fn (User $user) => $user->hasRole(Role::OperationsHq) || ($region !== null && $user->operations_region === $region))
                    ->values();
                Notification::send($operations, new ResignationNotice($locked, ResignationNotice::ACCEPTED_OPERATIONS));
            }

            return $locked;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Resignations;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\EmploymentStatus;
use App\Enums\ResignationStatus;
use App\Models\Resignation;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Run daily: the day after an accepted resignation's last day, the employee
 * becomes Resigned, which closes their account (sign-in refused, open
 * sessions ended: EnsureAccountIsActive). Clearance may still be running;
 * the resignation completes when it's done. Idempotent: separated once.
 */
final class ApplySeparations
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
        private readonly CompleteResignation $complete,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @return int how many people were separated
     */
    public function handle(CarbonImmutable $today): int
    {
        $due = Resignation::query()
            ->where('status', ResignationStatus::Accepted)
            ->whereNull('separated_at')
            ->whereDate('last_day', '<', $today->toDateString())
            ->pluck('id');

        foreach ($due as $id) {
            DB::transaction(function () use ($id) {
                $resignation = Resignation::query()->with('user.employeeProfile')->whereKey($id)->lockForUpdate()->first();

                if ($resignation === null || $resignation->separated_at !== null) {
                    return;
                }

                $resignation->user->employeeProfile?->forceFill(['employment_status' => EmploymentStatus::Resigned])->save();
                $resignation->forceFill(['separated_at' => now()])->save();

                $this->audit->record(AuditArea::People, 'resignation.separated', "{$resignation->user->name} resigned: last day was ".$resignation->effectiveLastDay()->format('M j, Y'), $resignation);

                $this->complete->handle($resignation);
            });
        }

        return $due->count();
    }
}

29

Final pay and the cash bond

What a resigned employee gets at the end: the pro-rated 13th month, plus the cash bond refund, plus or minus Accounting's adjustments, minus what they still owe (the resignation's acknowledgement is the written authorization). Accounting signs it, and the President or Vice President's signature, always last, releases it. Only those two see the amounts.

The company's four decisions

  1. Leave isn't converted to cash. Caveat: Art. 95 makes the 5-day Service Incentive Leave convertible unless the company already gives at least 5 paid leave days a year, so keep the policy at 5 or more.
  2. Cash bond: ₱100 per cut-off (₱200 a month), a cash_bond deduction, refunded in full (Art. 114).
  3. Accounting signs, then the President or Vice President. At first five signed (Operation HQ, Admin and HR too), but that showed everyone's pay to them. Now only Accounting and the President or Vice President see final pay; the others confirm their part on the resignation clearance.
  4. What's owed: always deducted for a resignation filed in the system. Art. 113 asks for written authorization, and it's one of the required "Before you send" lines, so there's no optional box to skip. A paper letter needs their signed authorization (HR ticks it). The bond covers it first, the final pay never goes below ₱0, and the rest is a receivable.
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> draft: Accounting prepares (on/after the last day)
  draft --> signing: send for signatures (frozen)
  signing --> draft: a signer sends it back (signatures cleared)
  signing --> signing: Accounting signs
  signing --> released: the President or Vice President signs last
LineCounted?From
Salary up to the last dayNo (info)The regular payroll pays it; a warning appears if days worked have no payslip yet
13th month, pro-rated+ThirteenthMonthBasisQuery to the last day
Cash bond refund+CashBondBalanceQuery: opening + from payslips ± corrections
Adjustments±Accounting, each with a reason
Loans / advances / load owed− with consent, info withoutActive deductions' remaining balance
Why the last salary isn't addedThe person is on payroll until their last day, so the regular cut-off pays them. Adding it here would pay it twice. The statement only shows it, so nobody forgets to run that cut-off.
Why the loan's id rides on the lineRelease settles exactly the loan on the statement (deduction_id), not one matched by its label, and only as far as the final pay covered it. The rest stays on the loan as the receivable.
Why the President or Vice President is lastFinalPay::signableRoleFor() offers the President and Vice President roles only once Accounting has signed, and never lets anyone sign their own. The last signature does the release: refunds the bond, stops the deduction, settles the loans, ticks the clearance and emails the employee.
Not paid twice in DecemberA released final pay's thirteenth_amount counts as earlier_paid in the year's 13th-month run.
An empty statement says what's nextBefore it's prepared, the dialog says who prepares it and from when ("Accounting prepares it from the last day, Nov 14, 2026"), and the footer only appears when it has a button. Sending back needs a note, so the field says so, and the input shows its own error once.

<?php

namespace App\Queries\Payroll;

use App\Models\EmployeeDeduction;
use App\Models\PayslipRecord;
use App\Models\Resignation;
use App\Models\TimeLog;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;

/**
 * The final-pay statement of a resignation, computed from what the system
 * already knows, one line per item with where it came from:
 *
 *   + 13th month, pro-rated to the last day (ThirteenthMonthBasisQuery: earned − already paid)
 *   + cash bond refund (CashBondBalanceQuery)
 *   ± Accounting's adjustments (each with a reason)
 *   − what's still owed on loans, cash advances and load, only with the employee's
 *     written consent (Labor Code Art. 113); without it, shown but not deducted
 *   = net, never below zero; anything left owed is a receivable, collected separately
 *
 * The last salary is NOT added: the person is on payroll until their last day, so
 * the regular run pays it. It's shown as an "info" line, with a warning when days
 * worked have no payslip yet, so nothing is paid twice or forgotten.
 *
 * @phpstan-type Line array{kind: string, label: string, amount: float, note: string|null, deduction_id?: int}
 * @phpstan-type Statement array{
 *     lines: list<Line>, total_pay: float, total_deducted: float, net: float, receivable: float,
 *     thirteenth_year: int, thirteenth_amount: float, cash_bond_refund: float,
 *     owed: list<array{deduction_id: int, amount: float}>, warnings: list<string>
 * }
 */
final class FinalPayStatementQuery
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ThirteenthMonthBasisQuery $thirteenth,
        private readonly CashBondBalanceQuery $cashBond,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  list<array{label: string, amount: float, reason: string, by: string}>  $adjustments
     * @return Statement
     */
    public function handle(Resignation $resignation, array $adjustments = []): array
    {
        $userId = $resignation->user_id;
        $lastDay = $resignation->effectiveLastDay();
        $lines = [];
        $warnings = [];

        // The last salary: paid in the regular payroll. Shown, not counted.
        $lastPayslip = PayslipRecord::query()->with('payrollRun')->where('user_id', $userId)
            ->join('payroll_runs', 'payroll_runs.id', '=', 'payslip_records.payroll_run_id')
            ->orderByDesc('payroll_runs.end_date')->select('payslip_records.*')->first();
        $coveredUntil = $lastPayslip?->payrollRun->end_date;
        $unpaidDays = TimeLog::query()->where('user_id', $userId)
            ->whereDate('log_date', '<=', $lastDay->toDateString())
            ->when($coveredUntil, fn ($query, CarbonImmutable $until) => $query->whereDate('log_date', '>', $until->toDateString()))
            ->count();

        if ($lastPayslip !== null) {
            $run = $lastPayslip->payrollRun;
            $lines[] = self::line('info', 'Salary up to the last day', (float) $lastPayslip->net_pay,
                "Paid in the regular payroll: {$run->periodLabel()} ({$run->status->label()}), pay day {$run->pay_date->format('M j, Y')}. Not added here, so it isn't paid twice.");
        }

        if ($unpaidDays > 0) {
            $warnings[] = "{$unpaidDays} ".str('day')->plural($unpaidDays).' worked up to the last day '.($unpaidDays === 1 ? 'has' : 'have').' no payslip yet. Generate the last cut-off in Payroll so the salary is paid there.';
        }

        // 13th month, pro-rated to the last day.
        $year = (int) $lastDay->format('Y');
        $thirteenth = $this->thirteenth->handle($year, $lastDay)[$userId] ?? null;
        $thirteenthAmount = round((float) ($thirteenth['amount'] ?? 0), 2);
        $lines[] = self::line('pay', "13th month, {$year} (pro-rated)", $thirteenthAmount, $thirteenth === null
            ? 'No generated payslips this year.'
            : '₱'.number_format((float) $thirteenth['earned'], 2).' earned to '.$lastDay->format('M j').($thirteenth['earlier_paid'] > 0 ? ' − ₱'.number_format((float) $thirteenth['earlier_paid'], 2).' already paid' : '').'.');

        // Cash bond, refunded.
        $bond = $this->cashBond->forUser($userId);
        $refund = max(0.0, $bond['balance']);
        if ($refund > 0 || $bond['opening'] > 0 || $bond['collected'] > 0) {
            $lines[] = self::line('pay', 'Cash bond refund', $refund,
                '₱'.number_format($bond['opening'], 2).' paid in before the system + ₱'.number_format($bond['collected'], 2).' from payslips'.($bond['adjustments'] !== 0.0 ? ' ± ₱'.number_format($bond['adjustments'], 2).' corrections' : '').'.');
        }

        // Accounting's adjustments.
        foreach ($adjustments as $adjustment) {
            $amount = round((float) $adjustment['amount'], 2);
            $lines[] = self::line($amount >= 0 ? 'pay' : 'deduct', $adjustment['label'], abs($amount), "{$adjustment['reason']} ({$adjustment['by']})");
        }

        // What's still owed: deducted only with written consent.
        $owed = [];
        $notDeducted = 0;
        $consent = $resignation->deduction_consent_at !== null;
        // Anything with a balance left: loans, cash advances, load, and a charged uniform or a
        // lost or damaged item (Equipment), whose balance is set when it's charged.
        $debts = EmployeeDeduction::query()->active()->where('user_id', $userId)
            ->whereNotNull('remaining_balance')->where('remaining_balance', '>', 0)->orderBy('id')->get();

        foreach ($debts as $deduction) {
            $amount = round((float) $deduction->remaining_balance, 2);

            if ($consent) {
                // The loan's id rides along, so releasing settles exactly this loan.
                $lines[] = [...self::line('deduct', "{$deduction->type->label()}: {$deduction->label}", $amount, 'Still owed.'), 'deduction_id' => $deduction->id];
                $owed[] = ['deduction_id' => $deduction->id, 'amount' => $amount];
            } else {
                $lines[] = self::line('info', "{$deduction->type->label()}: {$deduction->label}", $amount, 'Still owed, not deducted: no written consent (Labor Code Art. 113). Collect it separately.');
                $notDeducted++;
            }
        }

        if ($notDeducted > 0) {
            $warnings[] = 'The employee hasn\'t consented to deductions, so what they owe isn\'t taken from this final pay.';
        }

        $pay = round(array_sum(array_map(fn (array $line) => $line['kind'] === 'pay' ? $line['amount'] : 0.0, $lines)), 2);
        $deducted = round(array_sum(array_map(fn (array $line) => $line['kind'] === 'deduct' ? $line['amount'] : 0.0, $lines)), 2);

        return [
            'lines' => $lines,
            'total_pay' => $pay,
            'total_deducted' => $deducted,
            'net' => round(max(0.0, $pay - $deducted), 2),
            'receivable' => round(max(0.0, $deducted - $pay), 2),
            'thirteenth_year' => $year,
            'thirteenth_amount' => $thirteenthAmount,
            'cash_bond_refund' => round($refund, 2),
            'owed' => $owed,
            'warnings' => $warnings,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return Line
     */
    private static function line(string $kind, string $label, float $amount, ?string $note): array
    {
        return ['kind' => $kind, 'label' => $label, 'amount' => round($amount, 2), 'note' => $note];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\FinalPay;

use App\Actions\Resignations\CompleteResignation;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\ClearanceItem;
use App\Enums\DeductionType;
use App\Enums\FinalPayStatus;
use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Models\CashBondEntry;
use App\Models\EmployeeDeduction;
use App\Models\FinalPay;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\FinalPayNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * A signer signs for their step (FinalPay::signableRoleFor). When Accounting has
 * signed, the President and Vice President are asked; either one's signature releases it:
 *
 *   - the cash bond is refunded (a negative ledger entry) and its deduction stops
 *   - what was owed is settled, as far as the final pay covered it; any rest
 *     stays on the loan as the receivable
 *   - "Final pay released" is ticked on the clearance (which may complete the resignation)
 *   - the employee is told by email, and Accounting
 */
final class SignFinalPay
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
        private readonly CompleteResignation $complete,
    ) {}

    public function handle(FinalPay $finalPay, User $signer): FinalPay
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($finalPay, $signer) {
            $locked = FinalPay::query()->with(['user', 'resignation.user.employeeProfile'])->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($finalPay->id);
            $role = $locked->signableRoleFor($signer);

            if ($role === null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['finalPay' => $locked->status === FinalPayStatus::Signing && ! $locked->readyForLeadership() && FinalPay::holdsStep($signer, Role::President)
                    ? 'The President or Vice President signs last, after Accounting.'
                    : 'There is nothing for you to sign here.']);
            }

            $signoffs = $locked->signoffs ?? [];
            $signoffs[$role->value] = ['by' => $signer->name, 'by_id' => $signer->id, 'at' => now()->toIso8601String()];
            $locked->forceFill(['signoffs' => $signoffs])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Payroll, 'final_pay.signed', "Signed {$locked->user->name}'s final pay as ".FinalPay::signerLabel($role), $locked, causer: $signer);

            if ($role === Role::President) {
                return $this->release($locked, $signer);
            }

            // Everyone before the leadership is done: now the President or Vice President.
            if ($locked->readyForLeadership()) {
                Notification::send(SubmitFinalPay::holders(Role::leadership(), $locked), new FinalPayNotice($locked, FinalPayNotice::TO_SIGN));
            }

            return $locked;
        });
    }

    private function release(FinalPay $finalPay, User $executive): FinalPay
    {
        $finalPay->forceFill(['status' => FinalPayStatus::Released, 'released_at' => now()])->save();

        // The cash bond goes back to them, and stops being taken.
        if ((float) $finalPay->cash_bond_refund > 0) {
            $refund = new CashBondEntry;
            $refund->forceFill([
                'user_id' => $finalPay->user_id,
                'kind' => CashBondEntry::REFUND,
                'amount' => number_format(-(float) $finalPay->cash_bond_refund, 2, '.', ''),
                'note' => 'Refunded in final pay',
                'recorded_by' => $executive->id,
                'final_pay_id' => $finalPay->id,
            ])->save();
        }

        EmployeeDeduction::query()->where('user_id', $finalPay->user_id)->where('type', DeductionType::CashBond)->update(['is_active' => false]);

        // What was owed: settled up to what the pay side covered; the rest stays as the receivable.
        $cover = max(0.0, (float) $finalPay->total_pay - $this->negativeAdjustments($finalPay));

        foreach ($finalPay->lines ?? [] as $line) {
            // Only lines for a loan (they carry its id); adjustments that take money off have none.
            if ($line['kind'] !== 'deduct' || ! isset($line['deduction_id']) || $cover <= 0) {
                continue;
            }

            $deduction = EmployeeDeduction::query()->where('user_id', $finalPay->user_id)->whereKey($line['deduction_id'])->lockForUpdate()->first();

            if ($deduction === null || $deduction->remaining_balance === null) {
                continue;
            }

            $taken = min($cover, (float) $deduction->remaining_balance);
            $left = round((float) $deduction->remaining_balance - $taken, 2);
            $deduction->forceFill(['remaining_balance' => number_format($left, 2, '.', ''), 'is_active' => $left > 0])->save();
            $cover -= $taken;
        }

        // Ticked on the clearance, which may complete the resignation.
        $resignation = $finalPay->resignation;
        $clearance = $resignation->clearance ?? [];
        $clearance[ClearanceItem::FinalPay->value] = ['at' => now()->toIso8601String(), 'by' => "{$executive->name} (final pay released)"];
        $resignation->forceFill(['clearance' => $clearance])->save();

        $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Payroll, 'final_pay.released', "Released {$finalPay->user->name}'s final pay: net ₱".number_format((float) $finalPay->net, 2), $finalPay, causer: $executive);
        $this->complete->handle($resignation);

        $finalPay->user->notify(new FinalPayNotice($finalPay, FinalPayNotice::RELEASED_TO_EMPLOYEE));
        Notification::send(SubmitFinalPay::holders([Role::Accounting], $finalPay), new FinalPayNotice($finalPay, FinalPayNotice::RELEASED));

        return $finalPay;
    }

    /** Adjustments that take off money: they use the pay side before what's owed does. */
    private function negativeAdjustments(FinalPay $finalPay): float
    {
        return array_sum(array_map(fn (array $adjustment) => $adjustment['amount'] < 0 ? abs($adjustment['amount']) : 0.0, $finalPay->adjustments ?? []));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Queries\Payroll;

use App\Enums\DeductionType;
use App\Models\CashBondEntry;
use App\Models\EmployeeDeduction;
use App\Models\PayslipRecord;

/**
 * Each person's cash bond, from two sources that never overlap:
 *
 *   collected   the "Cash Bond" lines on their generated payslips (₱100 a cut-off,
 *               or less when the pay couldn't cover it: then it simply wasn't taken)
 *   entries     the ledger: what was paid in before the system (opening), corrections,
 *               and the refund in final pay (negative)
 *
 *   balance = opening + collected + adjustments + refunds
 *
 * Generated payslips count, paid or not: the deduction was made on that payslip.
 *
 * @phpstan-type CashBond array{per_cutoff: float, opening: float, collected: float, adjustments: float, refunded: float, balance: float}
 */
final class CashBondBalanceQuery
{
    /**
     * @param  list<int>  $userIds
     * @return array<int, CashBond> keyed by user_id; everyone asked for, zeros when none
     */
    public function handle(array $userIds): array
    {
        if ($userIds === []) {
            return [];
        }

        // One running total per source, keyed by user; read with ?? 0 at the end.
        /** @var array<int, float> $perCutoff */
        $perCutoff = [];
        /** @var array<int, float> $collected */
        $collected = [];
        /** @var array<string, array<int, float>> $entries kind → user → total */
        $entries = [CashBondEntry::OPENING => [], CashBondEntry::ADJUSTMENT => [], CashBondEntry::REFUND => []];

        // The active deduction: how much a cut-off takes.
        foreach (EmployeeDeduction::query()->active()->where('type', DeductionType::CashBond)->whereIn('user_id', $userIds)->get(['user_id', 'installment_amount']) as $deduction) {
            $perCutoff[$deduction->user_id] = ($perCutoff[$deduction->user_id] ?? 0.0) + (float) $deduction->installment_amount;
        }

        // Payslip lines of type cash_bond (stored in loan_lines with the deduction's type).
        foreach (PayslipRecord::query()->whereIn('user_id', $userIds)->whereNotNull('loan_lines')->select(['id', 'user_id', 'loan_lines'])->lazy(500) as $record) {
            foreach ($record->loan_lines ?? [] as $line) {
                if ($line['type'] === DeductionType::CashBond->value) {
                    $collected[$record->user_id] = ($collected[$record->user_id] ?? 0.0) + (float) $line['amount'];
                }
            }
        }

        foreach (CashBondEntry::query()->whereIn('user_id', $userIds)->selectRaw('user_id, kind, SUM(amount) as total')->groupBy('user_id', 'kind')->get() as $entry) {
            $kind = array_key_exists($entry->kind, $entries) ? $entry->kind : CashBondEntry::ADJUSTMENT;
            $entries[$kind][$entry->user_id] = ($entries[$kind][$entry->user_id] ?? 0.0) + (float) $entry->getAttribute('total');
        }

        $rows = [];

        foreach ($userIds as $id) {
            $opening = round($entries[CashBondEntry::OPENING][$id] ?? 0.0, 2);
            $fromPayslips = round($collected[$id] ?? 0.0, 2);
            $adjustments = round($entries[CashBondEntry::ADJUSTMENT][$id] ?? 0.0, 2);
            $refunded = round($entries[CashBondEntry::REFUND][$id] ?? 0.0, 2);

            $rows[$id] = [
                'per_cutoff' => round($perCutoff[$id] ?? 0.0, 2),
                'opening' => $opening,
                'collected' => $fromPayslips,
                'adjustments' => $adjustments,
                'refunded' => $refunded,
                'balance' => round($opening + $fromPayslips + $adjustments + $refunded, 2),
            ];
        }

        return $rows;
    }

    /**
     * @return CashBond
     */
    public function forUser(int $userId): array
    {
        return $this->handle([$userId])[$userId];
    }
}

<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Actions\FinalPay\PrepareFinalPay;
use App\Actions\FinalPay\SignFinalPay;
use App\Actions\FinalPay\SubmitFinalPay;
use App\Actions\FinalPay\UpdateFinalPayAdjustments;
use App\Actions\Payroll\EnrollCashBond;
use App\Actions\Payroll\RecordCashBondEntry;
use App\Actions\Payroll\SaveEmployeeDeduction;
use App\Actions\Resignations\ApplySeparations;
use App\Actions\Resignations\UpdateClearance;
use App\Enums\ClearanceItem;
use App\Enums\DeductionAuthorizationBasis;
use App\Enums\DeductionType;
use App\Enums\ResignationReason;
use App\Enums\ResignationStatus;
use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Models\CashBondEntry;
use App\Models\FinalPay;
use App\Models\Resignation;
use App\Models\User;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;

/**
 * Sample final pays, one at each stage, for guards who already have payslips
 * from PayrollSampleSeeder (so the 13th month has something to pro-rate):
 *
 *   guard2  last day today, consent      → ready for Accounting to prepare
 *   guard8  last day Sep 30, consent     → a draft with an adjustment, to send for signatures
 *   guard4  last day Sep 30, NO consent  → sent for signatures: Accounting signs next
 *   guard3  last day Sep 30, consent     → released, owing more than the final pay (a receivable)
 *
 * Each also has a cash bond paid in before the system (₱200 a month).
 * Safe to run again (`php artisan db:seed --class=FinalPaySampleSeeder`): a guard
 * who already has a resignation is skipped. Past resignations are written directly
 * (filing refuses past dates); everything after goes through the real Actions.
 */
class FinalPaySampleSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        $signers = [];
        foreach ([Role::OperationsHq, Role::Admin, Role::Hr, Role::Accounting, Role::President] as $role) {
            $signers[$role->value] = User::query()->whereHas('roles', fn ($query) => $query->where('role', $role->value))->orderBy('id')->first();
        }

        if (in_array(null, $signers, true)) {
            $this->command->warn('Operation HQ, Admin, HR, Accounting and the President each need an account: nothing seeded.');

            return;
        }

        /** @var array<string, User> $signers */
        $accounting = $signers[Role::Accounting->value];
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $endOfSeptember = CarbonImmutable::parse($today->year.'-09-30');

        // 1. Ready to prepare: the last day is today.
        if ($resignation = $this->resign('guard2@example.test', $today, ResignationReason::AnotherJob, 'I was offered a position closer to home in Batangas. Thank you for the years at OSSI.', true, 1800, $signers)) {
            $this->line($resignation, 'ready to prepare (last day today)');
        }

        // 2. A draft with an adjustment, for Accounting to send.
        if ($resignation = $this->resign('guard8@example.test', $endOfSeptember, ResignationReason::Family, 'I need to go home to Iloilo to take care of my mother.', true, 1800, $signers)) {
            $pay = app(PrepareFinalPay::class)->handle($resignation, $accounting);
            app(UpdateFinalPayAdjustments::class)->handle($pay, $accounting, 'Unreturned flashlight', -350, 'Not returned at turnover; agreed in writing.');
            $this->line($resignation, 'draft, with an adjustment');
        }

        // 3. Signing, without consent: the loan is shown, not deducted.
        if ($resignation = $this->resign('guard4@example.test', $endOfSeptember, ResignationReason::Health, 'My doctor advised me to stop night duty for my health.', false, 1600, $signers)) {
            $pay = app(SubmitFinalPay::class)->handle(app(PrepareFinalPay::class)->handle($resignation, $accounting), $accounting);
            $this->line($resignation, 'sent for signatures: Accounting signs next');
        }

        // 4. Released, owing more than the final pay: the rest is a receivable.
        if ($user = User::query()->where('email', 'guard3@example.test')->first()) {
            if (! $user->employeeDeductions()->where('label', 'Cash advance (Sep 2026)')->exists() && ! $user->resignations()->exists()) {
                app(SaveEmployeeDeduction::class)->handle($user, 'Cash advance (Sep 2026)', DeductionType::CashAdvance, 1000, 6000, $accounting, DeductionAuthorizationBasis::Paper);
            }
        }
        if ($resignation = $this->resign('guard3@example.test', $endOfSeptember, ResignationReason::Studies, 'I am going back to school this semester to finish my criminology degree.', true, 1400, $signers)) {
            $pay = app(SubmitFinalPay::class)->handle(app(PrepareFinalPay::class)->handle($resignation, $accounting), $accounting);
            // In the signing order: Accounting, then the President or VP (who releases it).
            foreach (FinalPay::SIGNERS as $role) {
                app(SignFinalPay::class)->handle($pay, $signers[$role->value]);
            }
            $this->line($resignation, 'released, with a receivable');
        }

        // The day after each past last day: Resigned, accounts closed.
        app(ApplySeparations::class)->handle($today);
    }

    /**
     * An accepted resignation (30 days' notice), with the cash bond paid in before
     * the system and the clearance ticked, except loans (final pay settles them) and final pay itself.
     *
     * @param  array<string, User>  $signers
     */
    private function resign(string $email, CarbonImmutable $lastDay, ResignationReason $reason, string $letter, bool $consent, float $bondPaidBefore, array $signers): ?Resignation
    {
        $user = User::query()->where('email', $email)->with('employeeProfile')->first();

        if ($user === null || $user->resignations()->exists()) {
            $this->command->line("Skipped {$email}: no such account, or it already has a resignation.");

            return null;
        }

        $hr = $signers[Role::Hr->value];
        $filed = $lastDay->subDays(Resignation::NOTICE_DAYS)->setTime(9, 0);

        $resignation = new Resignation;
        $resignation->forceFill([
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'reason' => $reason,
            'letter' => $letter,
            'requested_last_day' => $lastDay->toDateString(),
            'status' => ResignationStatus::Accepted,
            'last_day' => $lastDay->toDateString(),
            'decided_by' => $hr->id,
            'decided_at' => $filed->addDay(),
            'deduction_consent_at' => $consent ? $filed : null,
            'created_at' => $filed,
            'updated_at' => $filed->addDay(),
        ])->save();

        app(EnrollCashBond::class)->handle($user, $signers[Role::Accounting->value]);
        if (! CashBondEntry::query()->where('user_id', $user->id)->where('kind', CashBondEntry::OPENING)->exists()) {
            app(RecordCashBondEntry::class)->handle($user, CashBondEntry::OPENING, $bondPaidBefore, 'From the old cash bond ledger (₱200 a month)', $signers[Role::Accounting->value]);
        }

        foreach (ClearanceItem::for(true) as $item) {
            if (! in_array($item, [ClearanceItem::FinalPay, ClearanceItem::LoansSettled], true) && ! ($item === ClearanceItem::Certificate && $lastDay->isToday())) {
                $resignation = app(UpdateClearance::class)->handle($resignation, $item, true, $hr);
            }
        }

        return $resignation;
    }

    private function line(Resignation $resignation, string $stage): void
    {
        $this->command->info("{$resignation->user->name}: last day {$resignation->effectiveLastDay()->format('M j')}, {$stage}.");
    }
}

30

Merits and demerits

Recognition and minor offences, recorded by whoever supervises the person, always with a reason, from a list of types HR keeps. The employee is told, can add their side to a demerit, and sees their 12-month total. Nothing touches pay.

flowchart LR
  G[Supervisor: Give a merit or demerit] -->|type + date + what happened| R[(merit_records)]
  R --> N[Employee told: bell + email]
  N -->|demerit, within 5 days| S[Add my side]
  S --> T[Whoever gave it is told]
  R -.->|mistake / reply disproves it| V[Take back + reason: struck through, not counted]
  R --> C[12-month totals: My Profile, 201 file, Employees]
The employeeWho may give one (MeritRecord::canGive)
A guardOperation HQ; their region's Satellite Operation; HR
Office staffHR
HR staffThe President or Vice President (like their leave and complaints)
A list of types, not free pointsHR keeps the types and their points, so "Out of uniform" is −1 whoever writes it. "Other…" exists, capped at 20 points and with a reason. Records copy the title and points when given, so changing a type later never rewrites history; a type in use is switched off, never deleted.
Their side, in writingA demerit nobody can answer isn't fair. For 5 days (the same span as a Notice to Explain) the employee can add their side, once, kept next to the demerit, and whoever gave it is told.
Never deletedA mistake is taken back with a reason: struck through, with who and why, and it no longer counts. The Audit Log has every give, reply and take-back.
Not pay, and not disciplinePenalty deductions need written consent (Art. 113), so no demerit deducts anything. Serious offences need due process before a real sanction: a Notice to Explain (roadmap 30), not a demerit alone.
Picking the employeeOperation HQ may choose from every guard, so it's a search, not a dropdown. Search by name or employee number. Before typing, PeopleToActOnQuery suggests the people at the client site of your last record (the same post comes up again), or else the first of the people you supervise. It's the same picker in Issue a notice.
The icon: a scale, not a checkA checkmark reads as "done" or "approved", and in this app it means exactly that (signatures, "on this payslip"). Merits and demerits weigh good against bad, so the menu uses a balance scale. The buttons carry no "+": "Give a merit or demerit" already says what it does, and an icon on a long label only makes it heavier.
12 months, one queryMeritTotalsQuery sums merit and demerit points per person in one grouped query, for a whole page of employees. Old mistakes stop counting, so people can recover.

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Support\Heads;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;

/**
 * A merit or demerit given to an employee (roadmap item 21). Points are signed
 * and copied from the type when given. A demerit can be answered by the
 * employee until reply_until. Never deleted: voided with a reason.
 *
 * @property int $id
 * @property int $user_id
 * @property int|null $merit_type_id
 * @property string $kind merit | demerit
 * @property string $title
 * @property int $points signed
 * @property string $reason
 * @property CarbonImmutable $occurred_on
 * @property int|null $given_by
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $reply_until
 * @property string|null $employee_reply
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $replied_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $voided_at
 * @property int|null $voided_by
 * @property string|null $void_reason
 * @property CarbonImmutable $created_at
 * @property-read User $user
 * @property-read User|null $giver
 * @property-read User|null $voider
 */
class MeritRecord extends Model
{
    /** Days a demerit stays open for the employee's side (like the 5 days of a Notice to Explain). */
    public const REPLY_DAYS = 5;

    /** The total counts the last 12 months: old mistakes stop counting. */
    public const COUNTS_MONTHS = 12;

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'points' => 'integer',
            'occurred_on' => 'date',
            'reply_until' => 'date',
            'replied_at' => 'datetime',
            'voided_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function user(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function giver(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'given_by');
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function voider(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'voided_by');
    }

    /**
     * Not voided.
     *
     * @param  Builder<MeritRecord>  $query
     */
    public function scopeStanding(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->whereNull('voided_at');
    }

    /**
     * Counted in the total: standing, in the last 12 months.
     *
     * @param  Builder<MeritRecord>  $query
     */
    public function scopeCounting(Builder $query, ?CarbonImmutable $today = null): void
    {
        $query->standing()->whereDate('occurred_on', '>', ($today ?? CarbonImmutable::today())->subMonths(self::COUNTS_MONTHS)->toDateString());
    }

    public function isDemerit(): bool
    {
        return $this->kind === MeritType::DEMERIT;
    }

    /** The employee can still add their side. */
    public function awaitsReply(): bool
    {
        return $this->isDemerit() && $this->voided_at === null && $this->employee_reply === null
            && $this->reply_until !== null && ! CarbonImmutable::today()->isAfter($this->reply_until);
    }

    /**
     * Who may give this person a merit or demerit: whoever supervises them (App\Support\Heads).
     * Guards: Operation HQ, their region's Satellite Operation, HR. A Satellite Operation:
     * Operation HQ. Other office staff: HR. HR staff: the President or Vice President. Never yourself.
     */
    public static function canGive(User $giver, User $employee): bool
    {
        if ($giver->id === $employee->id || ! $giver->can(Ability::GiveMerits->value)) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($giver->hasRole(Role::SuperAdmin)) {
            return true;
        }

        $employee->loadMissing('employeeProfile');

        // Their head (Heads: a Satellite's is Operation HQ); HR may also give a guard one.
        return Heads::isHeadOf($giver, $employee)
            || (Heads::groupOf($employee) === Heads::OPERATIONS && $giver->hasRole(Role::Hr));
    }

    /**
     * Whose records a viewer sees in the Merits & Demerits list: the same people
     * they may give one to. HR and Super Admin: everyone but HR staff for HR (the
     * Executive's), Operation HQ: guards, a Satellite: its region's guards.
     *
     * @param  Builder<MeritRecord>  $query
     */
    public function scopeVisibleTo(Builder $query, User $viewer): void
    {
        if ($viewer->hasRole(Role::SuperAdmin)) {
            return;
        }

        $query->where(function (Builder $visible) use ($viewer) {
            $visible->whereRaw('1 = 0');

            if ($viewer->hasRole(Role::Hr)) {
                $visible->orWhereHas('user', fn (Builder $user) => $user->whereKeyNot($viewer->id)->whereDoesntHave('roles', fn (Builder $roles) => $roles->where('role', Role::Hr->value)));
            }

            if ($viewer->hasAnyRole(...Role::leadership())) {
                $visible->orWhereHas('user', fn (Builder $user) => $user->whereHas('roles', fn (Builder $roles) => $roles->where('role', Role::Hr->value)));
            }

            // Guards: all of them for Operation HQ; a Satellite's region only.
            if ($viewer->hasRole(Role::OperationsHq)) {
                // Guards, and the Satellite Operations it heads.
                $visible->orWhereHas('user.employeeProfile', fn (Builder $profile) => $profile->where('is_office_staff', false))
                    ->orWhereHas('user.roles', fn (Builder $roles) => $roles->where('role', Role::SatelliteOperations->value));
            } elseif ($viewer->hasRole(Role::SatelliteOperations)) {
                $visible->orWhereHas('user.employeeProfile', fn (Builder $profile) => $profile->where('is_office_staff', false)->visibleTo($viewer));
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * Who sees a person's merits on their 201 file: whoever may give them one,
     * HR and the President or Vice President. The employee sees their own on My Profile.
     */
    public static function canView(User $viewer, User $employee): bool
    {
        return $viewer->id === $employee->id
            || self::canGive($viewer, $employee)
            || $viewer->hasAnyRole(Role::Hr, Role::SuperAdmin, ...Role::leadership());
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\People;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Models\MeritRecord;
use App\Models\MeritType;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\MeritNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * A merit or demerit for one employee, by whoever supervises them
 * (MeritRecord::canGive). Usually a type from HR's list, whose points are
 * copied; "Other" takes a title and points (±1 to ±20) of its own. A reason is
 * always required. The employee is told, and may add their side to a demerit
 * within REPLY_DAYS.
 *
 * Nothing here touches pay: penalty deductions need written consent (Labor
 * Code Art. 113). Serious offences go through a Notice to Explain.
 */
final class GiveMerit
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    /**
     * @param  int|null  $otherPoints  signed, for "Other" only: + merit, − demerit
     */
    public function handle(User $giver, User $employee, ?MeritType $type, string $reason, CarbonImmutable $occurredOn, ?string $otherTitle = null, ?int $otherPoints = null): MeritRecord
    {
        if (! MeritRecord::canGive($giver, $employee)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $errors = array_filter([
            'reason' => mb_strlen(trim($reason)) < 5 ? 'Say what happened (a few words).' : null,
            'occurredOn' => match (true) {
                $occurredOn->isAfter($today) => 'The date can\'t be in the future.',
                $occurredOn->isBefore($today->subDays(90)) => 'Only the last 90 days.',
                default => null,
            },
            'typeId' => $type !== null && ! $type->is_active ? 'That type is no longer used.' : null,
            'otherTitle' => $type === null && mb_strlen(trim((string) $otherTitle)) < 3 ? 'Name it (e.g. "Helped a lost visitor").' : null,
            'otherPoints' => $type === null && ($otherPoints === null || $otherPoints === 0 || abs($otherPoints) > 20) ? 'Points from 1 to 20.' : null,
        ]);

        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages($errors);
        }

        $points = $type !== null ? $type->signedPoints() : (int) $otherPoints;
        $kind = $points < 0 ? MeritType::DEMERIT : MeritType::MERIT;

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($giver, $employee, $type, $reason, $occurredOn, $otherTitle, $points, $kind, $today) {
            $record = new MeritRecord;
            $record->forceFill([
                'user_id' => $employee->id,
                'merit_type_id' => $type?->id,
                'kind' => $kind,
                'title' => $type !== null ? $type->name : trim((string) $otherTitle),
                'points' => $points,
                'reason' => trim($reason),
                'occurred_on' => $occurredOn->toDateString(),
                'given_by' => $giver->id,
                'reply_until' => $kind === MeritType::DEMERIT ? $today->addDays(MeritRecord::REPLY_DAYS)->toDateString() : null,
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::People, "{$kind}.given", ucfirst($kind)." for {$employee->name}: {$record->title} (".sprintf('%+d', $points).')', $record, [
                'points' => $points,
                'reason' => $record->reason,
                'occurred_on' => $record->occurred_on->toDateString(),
            ], causer: $giver);

            $employee->notify(new MeritNotice($record, MeritNotice::GIVEN));

            return $record;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\People;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Models\MeritRecord;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\MeritNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * The employee's side of a demerit, once, within MeritRecord::REPLY_DAYS. It's
 * kept next to the demerit for anyone who reads it later, and whoever gave it
 * is told (they can void it if the reply changes things).
 */
final class ReplyToDemerit
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function handle(User $employee, MeritRecord $record, string $reply): MeritRecord
    {
        if ($record->user_id !== $employee->id) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        if (mb_strlen(trim($reply)) < 5) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reply' => 'Write your side (a few words).']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($employee, $record, $reply) {
            $locked = MeritRecord::query()->with('giver')->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($record->id);

            if (! $locked->awaitsReply()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reply' => 'This can\'t be answered any more.']);
            }

            $locked->forceFill(['employee_reply' => trim($reply), 'replied_at' => CarbonImmutable::now()])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::People, 'demerit.replied', "{$employee->name} replied to a demerit: {$locked->title}", $locked, causer: $employee);

            $locked->giver?->notify(new MeritNotice($locked, MeritNotice::REPLIED));

            return $locked;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Queries\People;

use App\Models\MeritRecord;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;

/**
 * Each person's merits, demerits and net over the last 12 months (standing
 * records only), in one query for a whole list.
 */
final class MeritTotalsQuery
{
    /**
     * @param  list<int>  $userIds
     * @return array<int, array{merits: int, demerits: int, net: int}> keyed by user id; only people with records
     */
    public function handle(array $userIds, ?CarbonImmutable $today = null): array
    {
        if ($userIds === []) {
            return [];
        }

        $totals = [];

        foreach (MeritRecord::query()->counting($today)->whereIn('user_id', $userIds)
            ->selectRaw('user_id, sum(case when points > 0 then points else 0 end) as merits, sum(case when points < 0 then -points else 0 end) as demerits')
            ->groupBy('user_id')->toBase()->get() as $row) {
            $totals[(int) $row->user_id] = ['merits' => (int) $row->merits, 'demerits' => (int) $row->demerits, 'net' => (int) $row->merits - (int) $row->demerits];
        }

        return $totals;
    }
}

  2. As guard5@example.test: My Profile → Merits & demerits → Add my side.

31

Notices to Explain

Due process before a real sanction: the twin-notice rule (Labor Code Art. 297–299; King of Kings Transport v. Mamac). The first notice says what happened, the rule, the possible penalty, and gives at least 5 calendar days to explain. The second notice is the decision with its reasons. The system enforces the order; it can't be skipped.

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> issued: 1st notice (acts, rule, penalty, ≥ 5 days)
  issued --> explained: written explanation (+ hearing request)
  issued --> ready: the days pass, no explanation
  explained --> decided: 2nd notice: decision + reasons
  ready --> decided
All four, or no noticeVague charges fail due process. IssueNoticeToExplain requires the specific acts (what, when, where, who saw it), the rule, the possible penalty, and an explain-by date at least 5 days out. A shorter date is refused with the earliest allowed one.
No decision before their chanceNoticeToExplain::readyToDecide() is true only once they've explained or the days have passed. The decision form doesn't show before that, and DecideNotice refuses it too.
Received isn't agreeing"I received this notice" and "I received the decision" are the proof of service. They're kept with the time; writing an explanation counts as receiving.
Nothing automatic afterA dismissal tells HR to set Terminated and start the clearance and final pay; a suspension simply has no attendance to pay. A demerit can go with the decision (chapter 30).
WhoGuards: Operation HQ, or their region's Satellite (the roadmap's "Operations only" holds for guards). Office staff: HR. HR staff: the President or Vice President. HR and the President or Vice President read them all; other HR staff never read an HR member's.
