<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\NteOutcome;
use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Support\Heads;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;

/**
 * A Notice to Explain and its decision: the twin-notice rule (roadmap 30).
 *
 * @property int $id
 * @property int $user_id
 * @property int|null $issued_by
 * @property string $subject
 * @property CarbonImmutable $incident_date
 * @property string $details
 * @property string $rule_violated
 * @property NteOutcome $possible_penalty
 * @property CarbonImmutable $explain_by
 * @property string $status issued | explained | decided
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $acknowledged_at
 * @property string|null $explanation
 * @property bool $wants_hearing
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $explained_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $hearing_at
 * @property string|null $hearing_place
 * @property NteOutcome|null $decision
 * @property string|null $decision_reason
 * @property int|null $suspension_days
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $suspension_from
 * @property int|null $merit_record_id
 * @property int|null $decided_by
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $decided_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $decision_acknowledged_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable $created_at
 * @property-read User $user
 * @property-read User|null $issuer
 * @property-read User|null $decider
 * @property-read MeritRecord|null $demerit
 */
class NoticeToExplain extends Model
{
    protected $table = 'notices_to_explain';

    /** At least 5 calendar days to explain (King of Kings Transport v. Mamac). */
    public const MIN_DAYS = 5;

    public const ISSUED = 'issued';

    public const EXPLAINED = 'explained';

    public const DECIDED = 'decided';

    /**
     * @var array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected $attributes = [
        'status' => self::ISSUED,
        'wants_hearing' => false,
    ];

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'incident_date' => 'date',
            'possible_penalty' => NteOutcome::class,
            'explain_by' => 'date',
            'acknowledged_at' => 'datetime',
            'wants_hearing' => 'boolean',
            'explained_at' => 'datetime',
            'hearing_at' => 'datetime',
            'decision' => NteOutcome::class,
            'suspension_from' => 'date',
            'decided_at' => 'datetime',
            'decision_acknowledged_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function user(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function issuer(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'issued_by');
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function decider(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'decided_by');
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<MeritRecord, $this>
     */
    public function demerit(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(MeritRecord::class, 'merit_record_id');
    }

    /**
     * @param  Builder<NoticeToExplain>  $query
     */
    public function scopeOpen(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->where('status', '!=', self::DECIDED);
    }

    public function isDecided(): bool
    {
        return $this->status === self::DECIDED;
    }

    /** Still within the days given to explain. */
    public function canStillExplain(): bool
    {
        return $this->status === self::ISSUED && ! CarbonImmutable::today()->isAfter($this->explain_by);
    }

    /**
     * Due process done: the explanation is in, or the days to give it have passed.
     * Only then can it be decided.
     */
    public function readyToDecide(): bool
    {
        return $this->status === self::EXPLAINED
            || ($this->status === self::ISSUED && CarbonImmutable::today()->isAfter($this->explain_by));
    }

    /** Where it stands, in words, for lists. */
    public function stage(): string
    {
        return match (true) {
            $this->isDecided() => $this->decision?->label() ?? 'Decided',
            $this->hearing_at !== null && $this->hearing_at->isFuture() => 'Hearing '.$this->hearing_at->format('M j, g:i A'),
            $this->status === self::EXPLAINED => 'Explained · to decide',
            $this->readyToDecide() => 'No explanation · to decide',
            default => 'Waiting for the explanation (until '.$this->explain_by->format('M j').')',
        };
    }

    /**
     * Who may issue one to this person, hear it and decide: whoever supervises
     * them (App\Support\Heads). Guards: Operation HQ, or their region's Satellite Operation.
     * A Satellite Operation: Operation HQ. Other office staff: HR. HR staff: the President or
     * Vice President. Never yourself.
     */
    public static function canIssue(User $issuer, User $employee): bool
    {
        if ($issuer->id === $employee->id || ! $issuer->can(Ability::IssueNoticesToExplain->value)) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($issuer->hasRole(Role::SuperAdmin)) {
            return true;
        }

        $employee->loadMissing('employeeProfile');

        // Their head: the owner's chain, in one place.
        return Heads::isHeadOf($issuer, $employee);
    }

    /**
     * Who may read one: whoever may issue it, HR (all but HR staff's), the
     * Executive and Super Admin. The employee reads their own on My Notices.
     */
    public static function canView(User $viewer, User $employee): bool
    {
        return $viewer->id === $employee->id
            || self::canIssue($viewer, $employee)
            || $viewer->hasAnyRole(Role::SuperAdmin, ...Role::leadership())
            || ($viewer->hasRole(Role::Hr) && ! $employee->hasRole(Role::Hr));
    }

    /**
     * The list on Notices to Explain: the people the viewer may read one of.
     *
     * @param  Builder<NoticeToExplain>  $query
     */
    public function scopeVisibleTo(Builder $query, User $viewer): void
    {
        if ($viewer->hasAnyRole(Role::SuperAdmin, ...Role::leadership())) {
            return;
        }

        $query->where(function (Builder $visible) use ($viewer) {
            $visible->whereRaw('1 = 0');

            if ($viewer->hasRole(Role::Hr)) {
                $visible->orWhereHas('user', fn (Builder $user) => $user->whereKeyNot($viewer->id)->whereDoesntHave('roles', fn (Builder $roles) => $roles->where('role', Role::Hr->value)));
            }

            if ($viewer->hasRole(Role::OperationsHq)) {
                // Guards, and the Satellite Operations it heads.
                $visible->orWhereHas('user.employeeProfile', fn (Builder $profile) => $profile->where('is_office_staff', false))
                    ->orWhereHas('user.roles', fn (Builder $roles) => $roles->where('role', Role::SatelliteOperations->value));
            } elseif ($viewer->hasRole(Role::SatelliteOperations)) {
                $visible->orWhereHas('user.employeeProfile', fn (Builder $profile) => $profile->where('is_office_staff', false)->visibleTo($viewer));
            }
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\People;

use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\NteOutcome;
use App\Models\NoticeToExplain;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\NoticeToExplainNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * The first notice (roadmap 30): the specific acts, with the date; the rule they
 * break; the penalty it could lead to; and at least 5 calendar days to explain in
 * writing. Due process (King of Kings Transport v. Mamac) needs all four, so all
 * four are required. The employee is told by bell and email.
 */
final class IssueNoticeToExplain
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function handle(User $issuer, User $employee, string $subject, CarbonImmutable $incidentDate, string $details, string $rule, NteOutcome $possiblePenalty, CarbonImmutable $explainBy): NoticeToExplain
    {
        if (! NoticeToExplain::canIssue($issuer, $employee)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $errors = array_filter([
            'subject' => mb_strlen(trim($subject)) < 5 ? 'Name the offence (e.g. "Sleeping on post").' : null,
            'incidentDate' => $incidentDate->isAfter($today) ? 'The date can\'t be in the future.' : null,
            'details' => mb_strlen(trim($details)) < 20 ? 'Describe the specific acts: what, when, where, who saw it.' : null,
            'rule' => mb_strlen(trim($rule)) < 5 ? 'Name the company rule or policy it breaks.' : null,
            'possiblePenalty' => $possiblePenalty === NteOutcome::Cleared ? 'Choose the penalty it could lead to.' : null,
            'explainBy' => $explainBy->isBefore($today->addDays(NoticeToExplain::MIN_DAYS)) ? 'Give at least '.NoticeToExplain::MIN_DAYS.' calendar days to explain: '.$today->addDays(NoticeToExplain::MIN_DAYS)->format('M j').' or later.' : null,
        ]);

        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages($errors);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($issuer, $employee, $subject, $incidentDate, $details, $rule, $possiblePenalty, $explainBy) {
            $notice = new NoticeToExplain;
            $notice->forceFill([
                'user_id' => $employee->id,
                'issued_by' => $issuer->id,
                'subject' => trim($subject),
                'incident_date' => $incidentDate->toDateString(),
                'details' => trim($details),
                'rule_violated' => trim($rule),
                'possible_penalty' => $possiblePenalty,
                'explain_by' => $explainBy->toDateString(),
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::People, 'nte.issued', "Notice to Explain to {$employee->name}: {$notice->subject}", $notice, [
                'possible_penalty' => $possiblePenalty->value,
                'explain_by' => $notice->explain_by->toDateString(),
            ], causer: $issuer);

            $employee->notify(new NoticeToExplainNotice($notice, NoticeToExplainNotice::ISSUED));

            return $notice;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\People;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\NteOutcome;
use App\Models\MeritRecord;
use App\Models\MeritType;
use App\Models\NoticeToExplain;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\NoticeToExplainNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * The second notice: the decision and its reasons, only once due process is
 * done (explained, or the days to explain have passed). Cleared, a written
 * reprimand, a suspension (days and from when), or dismissal. It can also give a
 * demerit from HR's list.
 *
 * Nothing is changed automatically beyond that: HR sets "Terminated" on the
 * employee record for a dismissal (and is told), and a suspension simply has no
 * attendance to pay. The employee is told.
 */
final class DecideNotice
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly GiveMerit $giveMerit,
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {}

    public function handle(User $actor, NoticeToExplain $notice, NteOutcome $decision, string $reason, ?int $suspensionDays = null, ?CarbonImmutable $suspensionFrom = null, ?MeritType $demerit = null): NoticeToExplain
    {
        if (! NoticeToExplain::canIssue($actor, $notice->user)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        $suspending = $decision === NteOutcome::Suspension;
        $errors = array_filter([
            'decision' => match (true) {
                $notice->isDecided() => 'It was already decided.',
                ! $notice->readyToDecide() => 'Wait for the explanation, or until '.$notice->explain_by->format('M j').': the employee must have their chance to explain first.',
                default => null,
            },
            'decisionReason' => mb_strlen(trim($reason)) < 20 ? 'Give the reasons: the facts found and why this decision (a few sentences).' : null,
            'suspensionDays' => $suspending && ($suspensionDays === null || $suspensionDays < 1 || $suspensionDays > 30) ? 'From 1 to 30 days.' : null,
            'suspensionFrom' => $suspending && $suspensionFrom === null ? 'From when?' : null,
            'demeritTypeId' => $demerit !== null && $demerit->kind !== MeritType::DEMERIT ? 'Choose a demerit.' : null,
        ]);

        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages($errors);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $notice, $decision, $reason, $suspending, $suspensionDays, $suspensionFrom, $demerit) {
            $locked = NoticeToExplain::query()->with('user')->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($notice->id);

            // Dated the incident, unless that's older than merits go back (then today).
            $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
            $record = $demerit !== null && $decision !== NteOutcome::Cleared && MeritRecord::canGive($actor, $locked->user)
                ? $this->giveMerit->handle($actor, $locked->user, $demerit, "Notice to Explain: {$locked->subject}. ".trim($reason), $locked->incident_date->isBefore($today->subDays(90)) ? $today : $locked->incident_date)
                : null;

            $locked->forceFill([
                'status' => NoticeToExplain::DECIDED,
                'decision' => $decision,
                'decision_reason' => trim($reason),
                'suspension_days' => $suspending ? $suspensionDays : null,
                'suspension_from' => $suspending ? $suspensionFrom?->toDateString() : null,
                'merit_record_id' => $record?->id,
                'decided_by' => $actor->id,
                'decided_at' => CarbonImmutable::now(),
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::People, 'nte.decided', "Decision on {$locked->user->name}'s Notice to Explain ({$locked->subject}): {$decision->label()}", $locked, [
                'decision' => $decision->value,
                'suspension_days' => $locked->suspension_days,
                'reason' => $locked->decision_reason,
            ], causer: $actor);

            $locked->user->notify(new NoticeToExplainNotice($locked, NoticeToExplainNotice::DECIDED));

            // A dismissal: HR updates the employee record (status, final pay, clearance).
            if ($decision === NteOutcome::Dismissal) {
                $hr = User::query()->notifiable(Ability::ManagePeople->roles())->whereKeyNot($actor->id)->get();
                Notification::send($hr, new NoticeToExplainNotice($locked, NoticeToExplainNotice::DISMISSAL_HR));
            }

            return $locked;
        });
    }
}

32

Promotions and position history

A promotion is a new position from a date, and pay follows the position. So the question is always which payslips it pays from. A position history answers it: pay uses the position held on each cut-off's start date.

flowchart LR
  P[HR: Promote, from Nov 1] --> H[(position_changes)]
  H --> R[EffectiveRatesQuery: position held on the cut-off start]
  R -->|Oct 16-31| O[old rate ₱610]
  R -->|Nov 1-15 on| N[new rate ₱800]
  B[Back-dated: from Oct 1] --> H
  H -.->|cut-offs already paid| C[Corrections from earlier cut-offs: +₱950 suggested]
The bug it preventsRates used the current position for any date. One promotion would have re-priced every earlier cut-off, and the earlier-cut-off check would have suggested months of back pay that was never owed. Now PositionChange::positionsOn() gives the position on the date, and the earlier payslips keep theirs.
Only on a cut-off startPay works per cut-off (the run's start date picks the rate), so a promotion "from Oct 20" would be ambiguous. The date must be the 1st or the 16th, which says exactly which payslip changes. The form starts on the next one and shows what the position pays then.
Back-dated works by itself"Approved today, from Oct 1": the record changes now, and the next run's Corrections from earlier cut-offs suggests the difference for the cut-offs already paid ("daily rate ₱610.00 → ₱800.00"), for Accounting to accept.
A personal rate still winsIf someone has their own rate, the position's doesn't apply. Accounting is told so, to review it on Daily Rates, instead of the promotion silently not raising pay.
Form edits are history tooChanging the position on the employee form records an "Edited on the record" change from today, so nothing slips past the history. A promotion uses Promote, with its date, reason and notices.

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Enums\Position;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;

/**
 * One change of an employee's position (roadmap 22). Pay uses the position held
 * on each cut-off's start date, from this history (EffectiveRatesQuery).
 *
 * @property int $id
 * @property int $employee_profile_id
 * @property Position|null $from_position
 * @property Position $to_position
 * @property string $kind promotion | transfer | edit
 * @property CarbonImmutable $effective_on
 * @property string|null $reason
 * @property int|null $recorded_by
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $applied_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable $created_at
 * @property-read EmployeeProfile $profile
 * @property-read User|null $recorder
 */
class PositionChange extends Model
{
    public const PROMOTION = 'promotion';

    public const TRANSFER = 'transfer';

    public const EDIT = 'edit';

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'from_position' => Position::class,
            'to_position' => Position::class,
            'effective_on' => 'date',
            'applied_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<EmployeeProfile, $this>
     */
    public function profile(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(EmployeeProfile::class, 'employee_profile_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function recorder(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'recorded_by');
    }

    /**
     * Recorded, but its day hasn't come yet.
     *
     * @param  Builder<PositionChange>  $query
     */
    public function scopePending(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->whereNull('applied_at');
    }

    public function kindLabel(): string
    {
        return match ($this->kind) {
            self::PROMOTION => 'Promotion',
            self::TRANSFER => 'Change of position',
            default => 'Edited on the record',
        };
    }

    /**
     * The position each profile held on a date, from the history: the last change
     * that started on or before it; before the first change, the position it
     * changed from; with no history, the record's current position.
     *
     * @param  iterable<EmployeeProfile>  $profiles
     * @return array<int, Position|null> keyed by employee_profile_id
     */
    public static function positionsOn(iterable $profiles, CarbonInterface $date): array
    {
        $current = [];
        foreach ($profiles as $profile) {
            $current[$profile->id] = $profile->position;
        }

        if ($current === []) {
            return [];
        }

        $byProfile = self::query()
            ->whereIn('employee_profile_id', array_keys($current))
            ->orderBy('effective_on')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->get(['employee_profile_id', 'from_position', 'to_position', 'effective_on'])
            ->groupBy('employee_profile_id');

        $positions = $current;
        $day = $date->toDateString();

        foreach ($byProfile as $profileId => $changes) {
            $held = $changes->first()?->from_position;
            foreach ($changes as $change) {
                if ($change->effective_on->toDateString() <= $day) {
                    $held = $change->to_position;
                }
            }
            $positions[(int) $profileId] = $held;
        }

        return $positions;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\People;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\Position;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\PositionChange;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\PositionChangeNotice;
use App\Queries\People\PositionRatesInForceQuery;
use App\Queries\People\RatesInForceQuery;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * A promotion, or a lateral change of position (roadmap 22), recorded by HR.
 *
 * The date is a cut-off start (the 1st or the 16th): pay uses the position held
 * on each cut-off's start, so this says exactly which payslip changes. It can be
 * up to 90 days back (the cut-offs already paid are then suggested as corrections
 * on the next run) or up to a year ahead (the position switches on its day,
 * ApplyPositionChanges). One change waiting at a time.
 *
 * The employee and Accounting are told; Accounting especially when the person has
 * a personal rate, which would still win over the new position's rate.
 */
final class ChangePosition
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
        private readonly PositionRatesInForceQuery $positionRates,
        private readonly RatesInForceQuery $personalRates,
    ) {}

    public function handle(User $actor, EmployeeProfile $profile, Position $to, string $kind, CarbonImmutable $effectiveOn, string $reason): PositionChange
    {
        if (! $actor->can(Ability::ManagePeople->value)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $current = PositionChange::positionsOn([$profile], $effectiveOn)[$profile->id] ?? null;

        $errors = array_filter([
            'kind' => ! in_array($kind, [PositionChange::PROMOTION, PositionChange::TRANSFER], true) ? 'A promotion or a change of position.' : null,
            'toPosition' => match (true) {
                ! in_array($to, Position::for((bool) $profile->is_office_staff), true) => 'Choose a position for '.($profile->is_office_staff ? 'office staff' : 'field staff').'.',
                $to === $current => 'That\'s already their position then.',
                default => null,
            },
            'effectiveOn' => match (true) {
                ! in_array($effectiveOn->day, [1, 16], true) => 'Use a cut-off start, the 1st or the 16th: pay changes from that payslip.',
                $effectiveOn->isBefore($today->subDays(90)) => 'At most 90 days back.',
                $effectiveOn->isAfter($today->addYear()) => 'At most a year ahead.',
                default => null,
            },
            'reason' => mb_strlen(trim($reason)) < 5 ? 'Say why (e.g. "Passed the shift-in-charge assessment").' : null,
        ]);

        if ($errors === [] && PositionChange::query()->where('employee_profile_id', $profile->id)->pending()->exists()) {
            $errors['effectiveOn'] = 'A change is already waiting for its day. Cancel it first.';
        }

        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages($errors);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $profile, $to, $kind, $effectiveOn, $reason, $current, $today) {
            $now = ! $effectiveOn->isAfter($today);

            $change = new PositionChange;
            $change->forceFill([
                'employee_profile_id' => $profile->id,
                'from_position' => $current,
                'to_position' => $to,
                'kind' => $kind,
                'effective_on' => $effectiveOn->toDateString(),
                'reason' => trim($reason),
                'recorded_by' => $actor->id,
                'applied_at' => $now ? CarbonImmutable::now() : null,
            ])->save();

            // Back-dated or today: the record takes it now. Ahead: on its day.
            if ($now) {
                $profile->forceFill(['position' => $to])->save();
            }

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::People, "position.{$kind}", "{$change->kindLabel()} of {$profile->name}: ".($current?->label() ?? 'none')." → {$to->label()} from {$effectiveOn->format('M j, Y')}", $change, [
                'from' => $current?->value,
                'to' => $to->value,
                'effective_on' => $effectiveOn->toDateString(),
                'reason' => $change->reason,
            ], causer: $actor);

            $change->setRelation('profile', $profile);
            $profile->loadMissing('user');
            $profile->user?->notify(new PositionChangeNotice($change, PositionChangeNotice::EMPLOYEE));

            // Accounting: the new rate, or that a personal rate still wins.
            $hasPersonalRate = isset($this->personalRates->handle([$profile->id], $effectiveOn)[$profile->id]);
            $newRate = $this->positionRates->handle($effectiveOn)[$to->value] ?? null;
            Notification::send(
                User::query()->notifiable(Ability::ManagePayroll->roles())->get(),
                new PositionChangeNotice($change, PositionChangeNotice::ACCOUNTING, $newRate, $hasPersonalRate),
            );

            return $change;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Queries\People;

use App\Data\ResolvedRate;
use App\Enums\RateSource;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\PositionChange;
use App\Services\Payroll\RateScheduleResolver;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;

/**
 * Each employee's daily rate on a date, the one place that decides it:
 *
 *   1. their personal rate (Daily Rates → Change rate), else
 *   2. the company rate of the position they held ON THAT DATE (Daily Rates →
 *      Rate per position; the position from PositionChange history, so a
 *      promotion counts from its date only), else
 *   3. the schedule's company default for field or office staff.
 */
final class EffectiveRatesQuery
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly RatesInForceQuery $personal,
        private readonly PositionRatesInForceQuery $positions,
        private readonly RateScheduleResolver $schedules,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  iterable<EmployeeProfile>  $profiles
     * @return array<int, ResolvedRate> keyed by employee_profile_id
     */
    public function handle(iterable $profiles, CarbonInterface $date): array
    {
        $list = [];
        foreach ($profiles as $profile) {
            $list[] = $profile;
        }

        $personal = $this->personal->handle(array_map(fn (EmployeeProfile $profile) => $profile->id, $list), $date);
        $positions = $this->positions->handle($date);
        $schedule = $this->schedules->forDate($date);
        $held = PositionChange::positionsOn($list, $date);

        $resolved = [];

        foreach ($list as $profile) {
            $position = $held[$profile->id] ?? null;
            $resolved[$profile->id] = match (true) {
                isset($personal[$profile->id]) => new ResolvedRate($personal[$profile->id], RateSource::Personal),
                $position !== null && isset($positions[$position->value]) => new ResolvedRate($positions[$position->value], RateSource::Position),
                default => new ResolvedRate($schedule->dailyRate($profile->is_office_staff), RateSource::Default),
            };
        }

        return $resolved;
    }

    public function forProfile(EmployeeProfile $profile, CarbonInterface $date): ResolvedRate
    {
        return $this->handle([$profile], $date)[$profile->id];
    }
}

33

Reimbursements (office staff only)

Office staff sometimes pay for the company out of pocket: a Grab to SSS, a notarial fee, printer ink. They file it with the receipt, the President or Vice President approves it, and the next payslip pays it back. No petty cash changes hands, and every peso has a receipt, an approver and a payslip line.

flowchart LR
  F[Office staff: File, with the receipt] --> W{President or VP}
  W -->|Reject, with a reason| X[Employee told]
  W -->|Approve| A[Approved: Accounting told]
  A --> G[GeneratePayslip: PayApprovedReimbursements]
  G --> L[Reimbursement line, not taxed] --> P[Paid]
Office staff onlyReimbursement::canFile(): office staff on this payroll, still active. Guards' costs on duty go through Operations. The President or Vice President is paid outside payroll. The menu item shows only for those who can file.
Always a receiptA photo or a PDF, checked by its bytes (PrivateUploadStore) and kept private. Only the owner and view-reimbursements (President, Vice President, Accounting) can open it. The trip it came from (Office Away) is optional, so a fare can be matched to a logged trip.
Deployment costs (roadmap 5)A guard who pays a fare to reach a far post can't file a reimbursement, so Operations files it for them on Deployment Costs (Operation HQ for any guard, a Satellite for its region's). The guard is the one paid (user_id); Operations is filed_by, vouches for it, and is told the decision. Same approval by the President or Vice President, paid on the guard's payslip. Operations staff's own costs are a "Deployment" reimbursement that says which deployment.
From the reliefThe usual deployment cost is a reliever's fare, and the relief already knows the reliever, post, date and who was covered. So Relievers → Claim the reliever's fare (and Reliefs to claim on Deployment Costs) open the form filled from it. The claim is linked (absence_notice_id), the relief shows "Fare claimed ₱280.00 · Waiting for approval", and the locked relief row allows one standing claim, so the same fare is never paid twice.
Certified"I certify these are true", required: the receipt is genuine and spent on company business, not paid back another way or claimed twice, and a false claim can mean dismissal (Art. 297). Saved word for word with the time; the approver sees it.
The limitsSpent within the last 60 days and not in the future, ₱1 to ₱20,000 (bigger purchases go through Accounting), and what it was for and for whom. These are company policy, not law, so Accounting sets them on Reimbursements → Limits (audited), with a separate, usually lower cap for a guard's deployment claim (Reimbursement::limits()). The forms read the same numbers. The form says it in plain words under the receipt: "File within 60 days of spending it. Up to ₱20,000 per request; bigger purchases go through Accounting." A request still waiting can be cancelled by the employee.
One approver, never their ownThe President or Vice President (approve-reimbursements) approves or rejects. A rejection needs a reason the employee reads. Accounting sees every request but doesn't decide; they're told once one is approved.
Paid by the payslip itselfInside GeneratePayslip's transaction, before the figures, every approved, unpaid reimbursement becomes an approved Reimbursement adjustment. It is non-taxable and add-only. It's then marked Paid with the run, so a regenerated payslip never adds it twice.

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\ReimbursementCategory;
use App\Enums\ReimbursementStatus;
use App\Support\Acknowledgements;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;

/**
 * Money an office staff member spent for the company, with the receipt (roadmap
 * 25). The President or Vice President approves it; the next payslip pays it back as a
 * non-taxable Reimbursement line (PayApprovedReimbursements).
 *
 * A deployment claim (roadmap 5) is one Operations files for a guard who paid for a
 * deployment: user_id is the guard (paid back on their payslip), filed_by is Operations.
 *
 * @property int $id
 * @property int $user_id who's paid back
 * @property int|null $filed_by Operations, for a guard's deployment claim; null when they filed it themselves
 * @property string|null $deployment_for which deployment (the post, the relief)
 * @property int|null $absence_notice_id the relief a reliever's fare claim came from (one standing claim per relief)
 * @property ReimbursementCategory $category
 * @property CarbonImmutable $spent_on
 * @property string $amount
 * @property string $purpose
 * @property int|null $away_log_id
 * @property string $receipt_path
 * @property string|null $receipt_name
 * @property string $receipt_mime
 * @property ReimbursementStatus $status
 * @property int|null $decided_by
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $decided_at
 * @property string|null $decision_note
 * @property int|null $payroll_adjustment_id
 * @property int|null $paid_in_run_id
 * @property list<string>|null $acknowledgement what they certified before sending, word for word
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $acknowledged_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable $created_at
 * @property-read User $user
 * @property-read User|null $decider
 * @property-read User|null $filer
 * @property-read AbsenceNotice|null $absenceNotice
 * @property-read AwayLog|null $awayLog
 * @property-read PayrollRun|null $paidInRun
 */
class Reimbursement extends Model
{
    /** The "reimbursements" Setting Accounting edits (SaveReimbursementLimits). */
    public const SETTING = 'reimbursements';

    /**
     * The limits in force: what Accounting set on the Reimbursements page, else the
     * starting values (config payroll.reimbursements). Company policy, not law.
     *
     * @return array{file_within_days: int, max_amount: int, deployment_max_amount: int}
     */
    public static function limits(): array
    {
        $saved = Setting::value(self::SETTING);
        $start = (array) config('payroll.reimbursements');
        $pick = fn (string $key) => (int) ($saved[$key] ?? $start[$key] ?? 0);

        return ['file_within_days' => $pick('file_within_days'), 'max_amount' => $pick('max_amount'), 'deployment_max_amount' => $pick('deployment_max_amount')];
    }

    /** Receipts older than this many days aren't accepted: file it while it's fresh. */
    public static function fileWithinDays(): int
    {
        return self::limits()['file_within_days'];
    }

    /**
     * The most one claim can be, in pesos; larger purchases go through Accounting.
     * A guard's deployment claim (filed by Operations) has its own, usually lower, cap.
     */
    public static function maxAmount(bool $deployment = false): int
    {
        return self::limits()[$deployment ? 'deployment_max_amount' : 'max_amount'];
    }

    /**
     * @var array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected $attributes = [
        'status' => 'pending',
    ];

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'category' => ReimbursementCategory::class,
            'spent_on' => 'date',
            'amount' => 'decimal:2',
            'status' => ReimbursementStatus::class,
            'decided_at' => 'datetime',
            'acknowledgement' => 'array',
            'acknowledged_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function user(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function decider(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'decided_by');
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function filer(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'filed_by');
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<AbsenceNotice, $this>
     */
    public function absenceNotice(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(AbsenceNotice::class);
    }

    /** Filed by Operations for a guard (a deployment claim), not by the person paid back. */
    public function filedForThem(): bool
    {
        return $this->filed_by !== null && $this->filed_by !== $this->user_id;
    }

    /** Who answers for it: Operations for a deployment claim, else the employee. */
    public function filedByUserId(): int
    {
        return $this->filed_by ?? $this->user_id;
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<AwayLog, $this>
     */
    public function awayLog(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(AwayLog::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<PayrollRun, $this>
     */
    public function paidInRun(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(PayrollRun::class, 'paid_in_run_id');
    }

    /**
     * @param  Builder<Reimbursement>  $query
     */
    public function scopePending(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->where('status', ReimbursementStatus::Pending);
    }

    /**
     * Approved, waiting for a payslip.
     *
     * @param  Builder<Reimbursement>  $query
     */
    public function scopeToPay(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->where('status', ReimbursementStatus::Approved)->whereNull('payroll_adjustment_id');
    }

    /**
     * What the employee certifies before sending a claim: the usual expense
     * certification, in plain words.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public static function acknowledgementLines(string $locale = 'en', bool $forGuard = false): array
    {
        // Filing for a guard, Operations certifies the deployment it ordered or confirmed.
        return array_map(fn (string $key) => Acknowledgements::line('reimbursement.'.$key, $locale), $forGuard ? ['for_guard_genuine', 'once', 'false_claim'] : ['genuine', 'once', 'false_claim']);
    }

    /**
     * Operations filing a guard's deployment cost: Operation HQ for any guard, a
     * Satellite only for its region's (canSeeEmployee); an active guard on this payroll.
     */
    public static function canFileFor(User $filer, User $guard): bool
    {
        $guard->loadMissing('employeeProfile');

        return $filer->can(Ability::FileDeploymentClaims->value)
            && $filer->id !== $guard->id
            && $guard->employeeProfile !== null
            && ! $guard->employeeProfile->is_office_staff
            && $guard->employeeProfile->employment_status->isActive()
            && $filer->canSeeEmployee($guard);
    }

    /** Someone with a claim to see: they can file one, or one was filed for them. */
    public static function canSeeOwn(User $user): bool
    {
        return self::canFile($user) || self::query()->where('user_id', $user->id)->exists();
    }

    /** Office staff on this payroll only (not guards, not the President or Vice President). */
    public static function canFile(User $user): bool
    {
        $user->loadMissing('employeeProfile');

        return $user->employeeProfile !== null
            && (bool) $user->employeeProfile->is_office_staff
            && $user->employeeProfile->employment_status->isActive()
            && ! $user->isPaidOutsidePayroll();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Payroll;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\ReimbursementCategory;
use App\Models\AbsenceNotice;
use App\Models\AwayLog;
use App\Models\Reimbursement;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\ReimbursementNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\Files\PrivateUploadStore;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Office staff file what they spent for the company (roadmap 25): what for, the
 * date, the amount, the purpose and the receipt (always). It can point to the
 * Office Away trip it came from. The President or Vice President is told.
 *
 * Deployment claims (roadmap 5): Operations ($filedBy) files one for a guard who paid
 * for a deployment; the guard ($employee) is paid back on their payslip and is told.
 * A "Deployment" cost always says which deployment ($deploymentFor). A reliever's fare
 * can come from the relief itself ($relief): prefilled, linked, one standing claim per relief.
 */
final class FileReimbursement
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PrivateUploadStore $uploads,
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {}

    /**
     * $acknowledged: the employee ticked "I certify these are true" on the form; the lines
     * (Reimbursement::acknowledgementLines) are saved word for word, with the time.
     */
    public function handle(User $employee, ReimbursementCategory $category, CarbonImmutable $spentOn, float $amount, string $purpose, UploadedFile $receipt, ?int $awayLogId = null, bool $acknowledged = false, string $locale = 'en', ?User $filedBy = null, ?string $deploymentFor = null, ?AbsenceNotice $relief = null): Reimbursement
    {
        if ($filedBy !== null && $filedBy->id !== $employee->id) {
            if (! Reimbursement::canFileFor($filedBy, $employee)) {
                throw new AuthorizationException;
            }

            // A reliever's fare, from the relief: it must be theirs, done, and in the receipt window.
            if ($relief !== null && ($relief->reliever_id !== $employee->id || ! $relief->fareClaimable())) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['relief' => 'That relief isn\'t this guard\'s, or isn\'t done yet.']);
            }

            // A guard's claim is always a deployment cost: the relief, or their post, unless said otherwise.
            $category = ReimbursementCategory::Deployment;
            $awayLogId = null;
            $deploymentFor = filled($deploymentFor) ? $deploymentFor : ($relief?->reliefLabel() ?? $employee->employeeProfile?->assignmentLabel());
        } else {
            $relief = null;
            $filedBy = null;

            if (! Reimbursement::canFile($employee)) {
                throw new AuthorizationException;
            }
        }

        if ($category === ReimbursementCategory::Deployment && blank($deploymentFor)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['deploymentFor' => 'Say which deployment: the post, and who was relieved or moved.']);
        }

        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $cap = Reimbursement::maxAmount(deployment: $filedBy !== null);
        $errors = array_filter([
            'spentOn' => match (true) {
                $spentOn->isAfter($today) => 'The date can\'t be in the future.',
                $spentOn->isBefore($today->subDays(Reimbursement::fileWithinDays())) => 'Only receipts from the last '.Reimbursement::fileWithinDays().' days.',
                default => null,
            },
            // A guard's deployment claim has its own cap (Reimbursement::maxAmount(deployment: true)).
            'amount' => $amount <= 0 || $amount > $cap ? 'From ₱1 to ₱'.number_format($cap).'. Bigger purchases go through Accounting.' : null,
            'purpose' => mb_strlen(trim($purpose)) < 10 ? 'Say what it was for, and for whom.' : null,
            'awayLogId' => $awayLogId !== null && ! AwayLog::query()->whereKey($awayLogId)->where('user_id', $employee->id)->exists() ? 'Choose one of your own trips.' : null,
        ]);

        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages($errors);
        }

        $disk = (string) config('payroll.concerns.disk');
        $stored = $this->uploads->store($receipt, $disk, 'reimbursements/'.$employee->id, 'receipt', ['png', 'jpg', 'pdf'], 'receipt');

        try {
            return DB::transaction(function () use ($employee, $category, $spentOn, $amount, $purpose, $awayLogId, $stored, $acknowledged, $locale, $filedBy, $deploymentFor, $relief) {
                // One standing fare claim per relief: the relief row is locked so two staff can't both claim it.
                if ($relief !== null) {
                    $locked = AbsenceNotice::query()->with('fareClaims')->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($relief->id);

                    if (($standing = $locked->activeFareClaim()) !== null) {
                        throw ValidationException::withMessages(['relief' => 'This relief\'s fare is already claimed (₱'.number_format((float) $standing->amount, 2).', '.strtolower($standing->status->label()).').']);
                    }
                }

                $reimbursement = new Reimbursement;
                $reimbursement->forceFill([
                    'user_id' => $employee->id,
                    'filed_by' => $filedBy?->id,
                    'category' => $category,
                    'spent_on' => $spentOn->toDateString(),
                    'amount' => number_format($amount, 2, '.', ''),
                    'purpose' => trim($purpose),
                    'deployment_for' => $category === ReimbursementCategory::Deployment ? trim((string) $deploymentFor) : null,
                    'absence_notice_id' => $relief?->id,
                    'away_log_id' => $awayLogId,
                    'receipt_path' => $stored['path'],
                    'receipt_name' => $stored['name'],
                    'receipt_mime' => $stored['mime'],
                    'acknowledgement' => $acknowledged ? Reimbursement::acknowledgementLines($locale, forGuard: $filedBy !== null) : null,
                    'acknowledged_at' => $acknowledged ? now() : null,
                ])->save();

                $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Payroll, 'reimbursement.filed', $filedBy !== null
                    ? "{$filedBy->name} filed a deployment claim for {$employee->name}: ₱".number_format($amount, 2)
                    : "{$employee->name} filed a reimbursement: {$category->short()} ₱".number_format($amount, 2), $reimbursement, causer: $filedBy ?? $employee);

                Notification::send(User::query()->notifiable(Ability::ApproveReimbursements->roles())->whereKeyNot(array_filter([$employee->id, $filedBy?->id]))->get(), new ReimbursementNotice($reimbursement, ReimbursementNotice::FILED));

                // The guard hears that Operations filed it for them, and that it's coming on their payslip.
                if ($filedBy !== null) {
                    $employee->notify(new ReimbursementNotice($reimbursement->setRelation('filer', $filedBy), ReimbursementNotice::FILED_FOR_YOU));
                }

                return $reimbursement;
            });
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $this->uploads->delete($disk, $stored['path']);

            throw $e;
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Payroll;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\ReimbursementStatus;
use App\Models\Reimbursement;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\ReimbursementNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * The President or Vice President approves a reimbursement (it's paid on the next payslip) or
 * rejects it with a reason. The employee is told; Accounting too, once approved.
 * Never your own.
 */
final class DecideReimbursement
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function handle(User $approver, Reimbursement $reimbursement, bool $approve, ?string $note): Reimbursement
    {
        // Never your own, nor one you filed for a guard.
        if (! $approver->can(Ability::ApproveReimbursements->value) || in_array($approver->id, [$reimbursement->user_id, $reimbursement->filed_by], true)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        if (! $approve && mb_strlen(trim((string) $note)) < 5) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['decisionNote' => 'Say why it\'s rejected (a few words).']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($approver, $reimbursement, $approve, $note) {
            $locked = Reimbursement::query()->with('user')->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($reimbursement->id);

            if ($locked->status !== ReimbursementStatus::Pending) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['decisionNote' => 'It was already decided, or cancelled.']);
            }

            $locked->forceFill([
                'status' => $approve ? ReimbursementStatus::Approved : ReimbursementStatus::Rejected,
                'decided_by' => $approver->id,
                'decided_at' => CarbonImmutable::now(),
                'decision_note' => $note !== null && trim($note) !== '' ? trim($note) : null,
            ])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Payroll, $approve ? 'reimbursement.approved' : 'reimbursement.rejected', ($approve ? 'Approved' : 'Rejected')." {$locked->user->name}'s reimbursement of ₱".number_format((float) $locked->amount, 2), $locked, ['note' => $locked->decision_note], causer: $approver);

            $locked->user->notify(new ReimbursementNotice($locked, ReimbursementNotice::DECIDED));
            // Operations, for a deployment claim they filed for a guard.
            if ($locked->filedForThem()) {
                $locked->loadMissing('filer');
                $locked->filer?->notify(new ReimbursementNotice($locked, ReimbursementNotice::DECIDED));
            }
            if ($approve) {
                Notification::send(User::query()->notifiable(Ability::ManagePayroll->roles())->get(), new ReimbursementNotice($locked, ReimbursementNotice::TO_PAY));
            }

            return $locked;
        });
    }
}

namespace App\Actions\Payroll;

use App\Enums\AdjustmentCategory;
use App\Enums\AdjustmentStatus;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\ReimbursementStatus;
use App\Models\PayrollAdjustment;
use App\Models\PayrollRun;
use App\Models\Reimbursement;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * Called by GeneratePayslip, inside its transaction, before the figures are
 * computed: every approved reimbursement of this employee not yet paid becomes a
 * non-taxable Reimbursement line on this payslip. Approved already by the
 * Executive, so it's added as approved (no second check), and marked paid.
 */
final class PayApprovedReimbursements
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    /**
     * @return int how many were added
     */
    public function handle(PayrollRun $run, User $employee, User $actor): int
    {
        $added = 0;

        foreach (Reimbursement::query()->toPay()->where('user_id', $employee->id)->lockForUpdate()->orderBy('id')->get() as $reimbursement) {
            $adjustment = new PayrollAdjustment;
            $adjustment->forceFill([
                'payroll_run_id' => $run->id,
                'user_id' => $employee->id,
                'category' => AdjustmentCategory::Reimbursement,
                'amount' => $reimbursement->amount,
                'reason' => "{$reimbursement->category->short()}, {$reimbursement->spent_on->format('M j')}: ".Str::limit($reimbursement->purpose, 80),
                'status' => AdjustmentStatus::Approved,
                'created_by' => $actor->id,
                'reviewed_by' => $reimbursement->decided_by,
                'reviewed_at' => $reimbursement->decided_at ?? CarbonImmutable::now(),
            ])->save();

            $reimbursement->forceFill(['status' => ReimbursementStatus::Paid, 'payroll_adjustment_id' => $adjustment->id, 'paid_in_run_id' => $run->id])->save();
            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Payroll, 'reimbursement.paid', "Paid {$employee->name}'s reimbursement of ₱".number_format((float) $reimbursement->amount, 2)." on {$run->periodLabel()}", $reimbursement, causer: $actor);
            $added++;
        }

        return $added;
    }
}

Birthday reminders

HR enters a date of birth on the employee record. On the morning of the birthday, HR gets a bell, and for a guard so do Operation HQ and their region's Satellite Operation. The dashboard lists "Birthdays this month". The reminder shows only the day and month, never the age.

Encrypted, because it reveals ageAge is sensitive personal information (RA 10173 Sec. 3(l)). So birth_date is an encrypted text column holding "Y-m-d", read with EmployeeProfile::birthDate(). It is in SENSITIVE, so the audit log shows "(changed)" and never the date. Because it's encrypted the database can't match on it, so BirthdaysQuery picks the candidates in SQL and compares the day and month in PHP. That's at most one row per employee.
Who is toldSendBirthdayReminders runs each morning at 7:15. It sends to HR for everyone, and for a guard also to Operation HQ and the Satellite of the guard's client region (the same rule as other-phone alerts). It never sends to the person themselves. SentAlert::claim('birthday.2026', $profile) makes it once a year, however often it runs. The dashboard card uses the see-birthdays ability with the same scope.
The right to objectThe reminder rests on legitimate interest (Sec. 12(f)), so an employee may object. HR switches on Keep their birthday private and nobody is reminded. The privacy notice says so, and its version moved to 2026-10-22.1.
Feb 29birthdayIn($year) puts it on Feb 28 in a common year. Age 18 or over is checked on save (no minors on staff).

<?php

namespace App\Queries\People;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

/**
 * Birthdays between two dates (this month, or today), for someone who may see them
 * (Ability::SeeBirthdays): HR everyone; Operations guards only (a Satellite: its region's).
 * Never someone who keeps their birthday private, or who no longer works here.
 *
 * The date of birth is encrypted, so the matching is done here in PHP: at most one
 * row per employee.
 */
final class BirthdaysQuery
{
    /**
     * @return list<array{profile: EmployeeProfile, on: CarbonImmutable}> by date, then name
     */
    public function handle(User $viewer, CarbonImmutable $from, CarbonImmutable $to): array
    {
        if (! $viewer->can(Ability::SeeBirthdays->value)) {
            return [];
        }

        $rows = [];
        foreach (self::candidates()->visibleTo($viewer)->when(! $viewer->hasAnyRole(Role::Hr, Role::SuperAdmin), fn (Builder $guards) => $guards->where('is_office_staff', false))->get() as $profile) {
            foreach (array_unique([$from->year, $to->year]) as $year) {
                $on = $profile->birthdayIn($year);
                if ($on !== null && $on->betweenIncluded($from->startOfDay(), $to->startOfDay())) {
                    $rows[] = ['profile' => $profile, 'on' => $on];
                }
            }
        }

        usort($rows, fn (array $a, array $b) => [$a['on'], $a['profile']->name] <=> [$b['on'], $b['profile']->name]);

        return $rows;
    }

    /**
     * Still working here, with a date of birth, not kept private.
     *
     * @return Builder<EmployeeProfile>
     */
    public static function candidates(): Builder
    {
        return EmployeeProfile::query()->active()->where('birthday_private', false)->whereNotNull('birth_date')->with('client');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\People;

use App\Enums\Role;
use App\Models\EmployeeProfile;
use App\Models\SentAlert;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\BirthdayToday;
use App\Queries\People\BirthdaysQuery;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;

/**
 * Run each morning: whose birthday it is today, to HR, and for a guard also to
 * Operation HQ and their region's Satellite Operation. Once per person per year
 * (SentAlert), however often it runs. Day and month only: never the age.
 */
final class SendBirthdayReminders
{
    /**
     * @return int how many birthdays were announced
     */
    public function handle(CarbonImmutable $today): int
    {
        $staff = User::query()->notifiable([Role::Hr, Role::OperationsHq, Role::SatelliteOperations])->with('roles')->get();

        if ($staff->isEmpty()) {
            return 0;
        }

        $sent = 0;

        foreach (BirthdaysQuery::candidates()->get() as $profile) {
            if (! $profile->birthdayIn($today->year)?->isSameDay($today)) {
                continue;
            }

            $recipients = $this->recipients($staff, $profile);

            if ($recipients->isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            $sent += DB::transaction(function () use ($profile, $recipients, $today) {
                if (! SentAlert::claim('birthday.'.$today->year, $profile)) {
                    return 0;
                }

                Notification::send($recipients, new BirthdayToday($profile));

                return 1;
            });
        }

        return $sent;
    }

    /**
     * HR for everyone; Operation HQ and the region's Satellite for a guard. Not the person themselves.
     *
     * @param  Collection<int, User>  $staff
     * @return Collection<int, User>
     */
    private function recipients(Collection $staff, EmployeeProfile $profile): Collection
    {
        $region = $profile->client?->region;

        return $staff->filter(fn (User $user) => $user->hasRole(Role::Hr)
            || (! $profile->is_office_staff && ($user->hasRole(Role::OperationsHq) || ($region !== null && $user->operations_region === $region))))
            ->reject(fn (User $user) => $user->id === $profile->user_id)
            ->values();
    }
}
35

Petty cash

Petty cash the imprest way: a fund of a fixed amount, kept by one custodian. Each payment is logged with its receipt. When cash runs low, the custodian asks Accounting to replenish what was spent. Once Accounting releases it, the fund is whole again.

flowchart LR
  F[Fund ₱5,000, custodian] --> E[Expense + receipt] --> E
  E --> R[Ask to replenish: all unrequested expenses]
  R --> A{Accounting}
  A -->|Release| W[Cash back: fund whole]
  A -->|Return, with what to fix| E
One number, computedCash on hand = fund − expenses not yet replenished. That counts expenses not in any request and those in a request still pending. Nothing stores a balance that could drift (PettyCashFund::cashOnHand()). An expense can't be more than the cash on hand; the fund row is locked, so two at once can't both fit.
Who does whatAccounting (manage-petty-cash) sets up funds and releases or returns requests, never their own. The President and Vice President see every fund (view-petty-cash). The custodian is any employee Accounting names; one person keeps one active fund. They get the page through PettyCashFund::custodianOf(), not a role.
A returned requestIts expenses go back on the list (petty_cash_replenishment_id cleared), so the custodian can fix or remove them and ask again. An expense inside a pending request can't be removed.
Receipts stay privateStored by PrivateUploadStore and served only to the custodian and petty cash viewers (ShowPettyCashReceiptController). Everything is audited under the new Finance area.

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\ReplenishmentStatus;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

/**
 * A petty cash fund, kept the imprest way: a fixed amount in the custodian's hands.
 * Each expense is logged with its receipt; once Accounting releases a replenishment,
 * the cash spent is back and the fund is whole again.
 *
 *   cash on hand = amount − expenses not yet replenished (waiting, or in a request still pending)
 *
 * Nothing is fillable: the Actions set every column.
 *
 * @property int $id
 * @property string $name
 * @property int|null $office_id
 * @property int $custodian_id
 * @property string $amount
 * @property bool $is_active
 * @property CarbonImmutable $created_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable $updated_at
 * @property-read Office|null $office
 * @property-read User $custodian
 * @property-read Collection<int, PettyCashExpense> $expenses
 * @property-read Collection<int, PettyCashReplenishment> $replenishments
 */
class PettyCashFund extends Model
{
    /**
     * @var array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected $attributes = [
        'is_active' => true,
        'office_id' => null,
    ];

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return ['amount' => 'decimal:2', 'is_active' => 'boolean'];
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<Office, $this>
     */
    public function office(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Office::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function custodian(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'custodian_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<PettyCashExpense, $this>
     */
    public function expenses(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(PettyCashExpense::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<PettyCashReplenishment, $this>
     */
    public function replenishments(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(PettyCashReplenishment::class);
    }

    /**
     * Expenses whose cash hasn't come back yet: not in a request, or in one still waiting.
     *
     * @return Builder<PettyCashExpense>
     */
    public function outstandingExpenses(): Builder
    {
        return PettyCashExpense::query()->where('petty_cash_fund_id', $this->id)
            ->where(fn (Builder $open) => $open->whereNull('petty_cash_replenishment_id')
                ->orWhereHas('replenishment', fn (Builder $request) => $request->where('status', ReplenishmentStatus::Pending)));
    }

    public function spent(): float
    {
        return round((float) $this->outstandingExpenses()->sum('amount'), 2);
    }

    public function cashOnHand(): float
    {
        return round((float) $this->amount - $this->spent(), 2);
    }

    public function pendingReplenishment(): ?PettyCashReplenishment
    {
        return $this->replenishments()->where('status', ReplenishmentStatus::Pending)->first();
    }

    /** The active fund this person keeps, if any. */
    public static function custodianOf(User $user): ?self
    {
        return self::query()->where('custodian_id', $user->id)->where('is_active', true)->first();
    }

    /** Who opens the Petty Cash page: those who view every fund, and a fund's custodian. */
    public static function canOpenPage(User $user): bool
    {
        return $user->can(Ability::ViewPettyCash->value) || self::custodianOf($user) !== null;
    }

    /** Who may look at this fund (and its receipts). */
    public function canBeSeenBy(User $user): bool
    {
        return $user->can(Ability::ViewPettyCash->value) || $this->custodian_id === $user->id;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Finance;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\ReplenishmentStatus;
use App\Models\PettyCashExpense;
use App\Models\PettyCashFund;
use App\Models\PettyCashReplenishment;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\PettyCashNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * The custodian asks Accounting to replenish the fund: every expense not yet in a
 * request goes in, with their total. One request waits at a time. Accounting is told.
 */
final class RequestReplenishment
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function handle(PettyCashFund $fund, User $custodian): PettyCashReplenishment
    {
        if (! $fund->is_active || $fund->custodian_id !== $custodian->id) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($fund, $custodian) {
            $locked = PettyCashFund::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($fund->id);

            if ($locked->replenishments()->where('status', ReplenishmentStatus::Pending)->exists()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['replenish' => 'A request is already waiting for Accounting. Add these to the next one.']);
            }

            $expenses = PettyCashExpense::query()->where('petty_cash_fund_id', $locked->id)->whereNull('petty_cash_replenishment_id')->lockForUpdate()->get();

            if ($expenses->isEmpty()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['replenish' => 'There are no expenses to replenish yet.']);
            }

            $request = new PettyCashReplenishment;
            $request->forceFill([
                'petty_cash_fund_id' => $locked->id,
                'requested_by' => $custodian->id,
                'amount' => number_format((float) $expenses->sum('amount'), 2, '.', ''),
            ])->save();

            PettyCashExpense::query()->whereKey($expenses->modelKeys())->update(['petty_cash_replenishment_id' => $request->id]);

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Finance, 'petty_cash.replenishment_requested', "{$custodian->name} asked to replenish {$locked->name}: ₱".number_format((float) $request->amount, 2)." ({$expenses->count()} ".str('expense')->plural($expenses->count()).')', $request, causer: $custodian);

            Notification::send(User::query()->notifiable(Ability::ManagePettyCash->roles())->whereKeyNot($custodian->id)->get(), new PettyCashNotice($request->setRelation('fund', $locked), PettyCashNotice::REQUESTED));

            return $request;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Finance;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\ReplenishmentStatus;
use App\Models\PettyCashExpense;
use App\Models\PettyCashReplenishment;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\PettyCashNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Accounting releases a replenishment (the cash is given back: the fund is whole again)
 * or returns it with a reason (its expenses go back to the custodian's list, to fix or
 * remove and ask again). Never the custodian deciding their own. The custodian is told.
 */
final class DecideReplenishment
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function handle(PettyCashReplenishment $request, bool $release, ?string $note, User $actor): void
    {
        if (! $actor->can(Ability::ManagePettyCash->value) || $request->requested_by === $actor->id) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        if (! $release && blank($note)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['decisionNote' => 'Say what to fix, so the custodian can ask again.']);
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $release, $note, $actor) {
            $locked = PettyCashReplenishment::query()->with(['fund', 'requester'])->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($request->id);

            if ($locked->status !== ReplenishmentStatus::Pending) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['decisionNote' => 'This request was already decided.']);
            }

            $locked->forceFill([
                'status' => $release ? ReplenishmentStatus::Released : ReplenishmentStatus::Rejected,
                'decided_by' => $actor->id,
                'decided_at' => CarbonImmutable::now(),
                'decision_note' => filled($note) ? trim((string) $note) : null,
            ])->save();

            // Returned: its expenses are free again, to fix or remove and ask for again.
            if (! $release) {
                PettyCashExpense::query()->where('petty_cash_replenishment_id', $locked->id)->update(['petty_cash_replenishment_id' => null]);
            }

            $amount = '₱'.number_format((float) $locked->amount, 2);
            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Finance, $release ? 'petty_cash.replenishment_released' : 'petty_cash.replenishment_returned',
                ($release ? "Released {$amount} to replenish {$locked->fund->name}" : "Returned the {$amount} request for {$locked->fund->name}: {$note}"), $locked, causer: $actor);

            $locked->requester->notify(new PettyCashNotice($locked, $release ? PettyCashNotice::RELEASED : PettyCashNotice::RETURNED));
        });
    }
}

NTC radio masterlist

Every two-way radio the agency owns: its brand, model, serial number, frequency, NTC permit number and expiry, and where it is (a client post, a guard, or in stock). Admin and Operation HQ keep the list (manage-radios).

Status decides "where"Only a radio In use has a post or a guard, and it must have one of them. Spare, For repair, Lost and Disposed clear both (SaveRadio). Delete is only for a radio added by mistake. One that leaves the agency (sold, scrapped or returned) is marked Disposed, or Lost, so the masterlist keeps it as the record.
Permit alertsSendRadioPermitAlerts runs daily at 7:20, using the same steps as company documents (60, 30, 7 and 0 days) and the same once-per-date claim. Email is added from 30 days out. Disposed radios are skipped. The menu badge counts permits expiring within 30 days.
ClearanceOn a resignation, "Firearm, radio and post equipment returned" lists any radio still assigned to the person, so it's collected before final pay.

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Operations;

use App\Enums\Ability;
use App\Enums\AuditArea;
use App\Enums\RadioStatus;
use App\Models\Radio;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\UpdateNotice;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Adds or edits a radio on the NTC masterlist. Only a radio in use has a post or a
 * guard; any other status puts it back in stock (both cleared). Audited with the changes.
 */
final class SaveRadio
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    /**
     * @param  array{brand: string, model: string, serial_number: string, frequency: string|null, ntc_permit_number: string|null, permit_expires_on: CarbonImmutable|null, status: RadioStatus, client_id: int|null, assigned_user_id: int|null, notes: string|null}  $data
     */
    public function handle(?Radio $radio, array $data, User $actor): Radio
    {
        if (! $actor->can(Ability::ManageRadios->value)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        $data['serial_number'] = strtoupper(trim($data['serial_number']));

        if ($data['status'] !== RadioStatus::InUse) {
            $data['client_id'] = null;
            $data['assigned_user_id'] = null;
        } elseif ($data['client_id'] === null && $data['assigned_user_id'] === null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['clientId' => 'A radio in use is at a post or with a guard: choose one.']);
        }

        $duplicate = Radio::query()->where('serial_number', $data['serial_number'])->when($radio, fn ($query, Radio $existing) => $query->whereKeyNot($existing->id))->exists();
        if ($duplicate) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['serialNumber' => "Serial number {$data['serial_number']} is already on the list."]);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($radio, $data, $actor) {
            $isNew = $radio === null;
            $radio ??= new Radio;
            $fields = array_keys($data);
            $snapshot = fn (Radio $r) => [...$r->only($fields), 'status' => $r->status->value, 'permit_expires_on' => $r->permit_expires_on?->toDateString()];
            $before = $isNew ? [] : $snapshot($radio);
            $oldHolder = $radio->assigned_user_id;

            $radio->forceFill([...$data, 'permit_expires_on' => $data['permit_expires_on']?->toDateString()])->save();

            $this->audit->record(AuditArea::Operations, $isNew ? 'radio.created' : 'radio.updated', "Saved radio {$radio->brand} {$radio->model} (SN {$radio->serial_number})", $radio,
                AuditLogger::diff($before, $snapshot($radio->refresh())), causer: $actor);

            // Issued to a guard: it's company property in their care, returned at clearance.
            if ($radio->assigned_user_id !== null && $radio->assigned_user_id !== $oldHolder) {
                UpdateNotice::tell($radio->assignedTo()->first(), $actor, "Radio issued to you: {$radio->brand} {$radio->model}",
                    "Serial number {$radio->serial_number}. It's company property in your care: keep it with you on duty and return it when asked.", route('attendance'), 'radio');
            }

            return $radio;
        });
    }
}

Referrals (hiring perks)

Any employee on payroll can refer someone (Refer a Friend). HR marks the referral hired by linking the new record, or not hired with a reason. Once the hire has stayed the set number of days, the bonus is paid on the referrer's payslip.

flowchart LR
  S[Employee refers: name, mobile, job] --> H{HR}
  H -->|Not hired, why| N[Referrer told]
  H -->|Hired: pick the record| D[Bonus + due date frozen]
  D --> G[Referrer's payslip after the due date]
  G -->|Hire still here, or left after the due date| P[Referral bonus line]
  G -->|Hire left before| F[No bonus, referrer told]
Terms in the appThe bonus and the days to stay are HR's settings (SaveReferralTerms, audited). The starting values, ₱1,000 and 90 days, are placeholders. A referral copies the terms when it's marked hired, so a later change never touches it.
Paid by the payslip itselfLike reimbursements: inside GeneratePayslip, PayDueReferralBonuses turns each bonus due by the end of the cut-off into an approved Referral bonus line. That line isn't taxed here, since it's within the ₱90,000 a year of 13th month and other benefits. Referral::hireStayed() checks the hire: still working here, or their last day was on or after the due date. If not, the referral is closed with no bonus.
Clean and fairThe mobile number is made readable (0917 123 4567), and the same person can't be referred twice while a referral is open (the first counts). Nobody can refer themselves. The privacy notice asks the referrer to tell the person first.
